Description:
Dear Candidate,

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Site Engineer to manage waterproofing, retrofit, repairs application projects across. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, billing, coordination with applicator manpower, and client interaction to ensure timely and quality project completion.

Please go through the Job Profile. Interested candidate are required to share their profile at shraddha.bhosle@jsw.in

Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Execution & Supervision
Supervise waterproofing application works at site.
Ensure work is executed as per technical specifications and quality standards.
Conduct site inspections and resolve technical issues.
Maintain daily progress reports.
2. Billing & Documentation
Prepare client RA bills and subcontractor/applicator bills.
Measure work quantities and maintain proper billing records.
Coordinate with accounts for timely submission and approvals.
Maintain material reconciliation statements.
3. Manpower Coordination
Coordinate with applicator teams and subcontractors.
Ensure availability of required manpower and materials.
Monitor productivity and discipline at site.
Provide technical guidance to applicators.
4. Client Coordination
Act as the primary point of contact at site.
Attend client meetings and provide project updates.
Handle site-related queries and ensure client satisfaction.
Coordinate for approvals, inspections, and certifications.
5. Planning & Material Management
Plan daily and weekly work schedules.
Ensure proper storage and usage of waterproofing materials.
Monitor material consumption and reduce wastage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
25 years of experience in waterproofing or construction site execution.
Good knowledge of waterproofing systems (PU coating, APP membrane, injection grouting, etc.).
Strong billing and measurement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and billing software.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Position description: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to lead the mechanical operations within the Blast Furnace department at Jindal Ferrous Limited. This role demands a strategic thinker with deep expertise in blast furnace mechanical systems, committed to optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring equipment reliability, and driving continuous improvement initiatives in a mining and metals environment. The ideal candidate will oversee maintenance, coordinate cross-functional teams, and implement best practices to support the companys production goals while adhering to safety and environmental standards.

Primary Responsibilities:
Lead and manage all mechanical operations related to the blast furnace, ensuring optimal performance and minimal downtime.
Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to enhance equipment reliability and lifespan.
Coordinate with production, quality, and safety teams to align mechanical activities with overall plant objectives.
Supervise and mentor mechanical engineering staff, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
Oversee troubleshooting and root cause analysis of mechanical failures, implementing corrective actions promptly.
Manage budgeting, procurement, and inventory control for mechanical spare parts and equipment.
Ensure compliance with industry safety standards, environmental regulations, and company policies in all mechanical operations.
Drive process improvement projects using data-driven methodologies to increase operational efficiency and reduce costs.
Collaborate with external vendors and contractors for specialized maintenance and equipment upgrades.
Prepare detailed reports and presentations for senior management on mechanical performance, challenges, and improvement plans.

Description:
SUMMARY
Finance Manager
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to lead all aspects of financial strategy, including planning, reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and internal control systems. In this role, you will oversee the complete financial lifecycle, ensuring full compliance with legal and regulatory requirements while managing critical closing activities at month and year-end. You will provide high-level strategic analysis to support business growth and profitability. Furthermore, the position involves managing the finance department and collaborating closely with senior executives and external stakeholders to ensure sound financial governance.

Location: Bhubaneswar

Experience: 5-10 years
Key Responsibilities
Lead the development of financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and conduct variance analysis.
Prepare and analyze comprehensive financial statements, including Profit & Loss, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow statements.
Manage the end-to-end execution of month-end and year-end financial close processes.
Oversee general ledger management, including the processing of journal entries and account reconciliations.
Utilize and maintain ERP and accounting software systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or QuickBooks.
Monitor critical financial metrics, including budget variances, gross and operating margins, working capital, DSO, DPO, and cash runway.
Manage cash flow strategies, treasury operations, and working capital requirements.
Ensure strict compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax laws, and statutory obligations.
Coordinate with external auditors, banks, tax authorities, and internal departments.
Strengthen internal financial controls and streamline workflows for accounts payable, receivable, and reporting.
Identify and implement opportunities to automate financial processes and enhance operational efficiency.
Provide guidance, mentorship, and direction to finance team members.
Present financial reports and strategic insights to senior leadership to support decision - making.
Mandatory Skills & Qualifications
Financial Planning & Reporting
Strong expertise in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A).
Skilled in budgeting, forecasting, and performing variance analysis.
Capable of preparing and presenting accurate financial statements.
Proficient in managing Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow data.
Knowledge of financial reporting frameworks such as GAAP, IFRS, or Ind AS.
Accounting & Financial Operations
Experienced in executing month-end and year-end closing procedures.
Competent in General Ledger (GL) administration.
Skilled in processing journal entries and performing account reconciliations.
Capable of managing Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) functions.
Proficient in cash flow management and optimizing working capital.
Experienced in implementing internal controls and coordinating audits.
Knowledgeable in statutory and tax compliance, including GST, VAT, and TDS where relevant.
Technical Skills
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, financial modeling, and macros.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or QuickBooks.
Familiarity with financial reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.


Requirements

A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.
An MBA or Master's degree in Finance is highly desirable.
5-10 years of progressive experience within Finance or Accounting functions.
Relevant industry background in IT Services, Manufacturing, BFSI, Retail, Healthcare, or comparable sectors.
Preferred Skills
Experience utilizing financial planning platforms such as Anaplan, Adaptive Insights, or Hyperion.
Familiarity with M&A due diligence, investor reporting, or fundraising support.
Background in managing multi-entity and multi-currency financial consolidation.
Knowledge of SQL or Python for financial data analysis and automation.
Professional designations such as CA, CPA, CMA, ACCA, or CFA.
Key Focus Areas: Financial Planning & Analysis, Budgeting, Forecasting, Financial Reporting, Month-End Closing, ERP Systems, Cash Flow Management, Statutory Compliance, Internal Controls, and Team Leadership.

Description:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:-

Monitor daily operation of laboratory and reporting results to all concerns

Plan daily weekly monthly and annual maintenance required for the Instruments in the lab to ensure the availabilities through the year.

Responsibilities:

1. Chemical Analysis of Materials:

o Collection of samples received from yard, rakes, and trucks in process and customer end samples.

o Thorough knowledge on Sample collection, preparation as per International standard methods.

o Well conversant with NABL (ISO/IEC 17025), prepare and develop and update ISO documents to comply with company policies.

o Plan and arrange to carry out calibration of typical Instruments to ensure accuracy of results reported.

o Conduct routine chemical analysis of raw materials (e.g., iron ore, limestone, coke, and fluxes) and sinter products to ensure compliance with quality specifications.

o Analyze blast furnace materials, including coke, sinter, slag, and hot metal, to monitor chemical properties and optimize production processes.

o Perform both wet chemical analysis and instrumental techniques such as XRF, ICP, OES ,CS- combustion analysis ,GC, Orsat, Microscopy and other methods as required for accurate material testing.

o Monitor the quality of sinter and blast furnace materials, ensuring they meet the required chemical, physical and metallurgical specifications for optimal performance.

o Carry out periodic inspections and tests to ensure that the sinter plant and blast furnace operations adhere to quality standards.

o Investigate and address any discrepancies in material quality, reporting findings and suggesting corrective actions to the production team.

o Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all chemical analyses, test results, and quality control activities in both hard and soft form.

o Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols while handling chemicals, materials, and laboratory equipment.

o Comply with environmental regulations and company policies regarding waste disposal, emissions, and handling of hazardous materials.



Qualifications:

Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in Chemistry, Diploma in Chemical Engineering/ Metallurgy.

Experience: Minimum of 7 years for AM, 5 years for Chemist /Executive and 3 years for Asst. Eng. in similar position in BF/SP Laboratory in a chemical analysis or metallurgical laboratory, preferably in integrated steel plant.

Computer knowledge is essential.

Skills:

o Strong understanding of chemical processes involved in sintering and blast furnace operations.

o Proficiency with laboratory techniques and equipment such as X-ray fluorescence (XRF), ICP, and other instrumental methods.

o Experience in quality control and assurance processes, specifically related to metallurgical materials.

o Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.

o Ability to interpret data and provide actionable insights to improve process efficiency.

Position: Tender Manager
Department: Tendering & Business Development
Industry: Building Construction / Real Estate / Infrastructure
Reporting To: COO / Managing Director
Location: Head Office
1. Job Summary
The Tender Manager will be responsible for managing the complete tendering process for building construction projects, from identifying tender opportunities and preparing technical and commercial bids to submission, negotiation, and handover of awarded projects to the execution team. The role requires strong knowledge of civil construction, estimation, costing, BOQ analysis, contract documentation, and government and private-sector tendering procedures.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Tender Identification & Planning
Identify and evaluate new tender opportunities for residential, commercial, industrial, and high-rise building construction projects.
Review tender notices, eligibility criteria, scope of work, submission deadlines, and contractual requirements.
Coordinate with clients, consultants, government departments, and private developers regarding tender opportunities.
Maintain a tender database and prepare a tender submission schedule.
B. Tender Document Preparation
Study tender documents, drawings, technical specifications, BOQ, scope of work, and contract conditions.
Prepare and review technical bids, commercial bids, and prequalification documents.
Arrange required documents, including company credentials, work experience certificates, financial statements, GST, PAN, EPF, ESI, labour licences, and other statutory documents, as applicable.
Ensure compliance with tender eligibility requirements and submission guidelines.
C. Estimation & Costing
Prepare detailed project cost estimates for building construction works.
Analyse BOQ quantities, rates, material costs, labour costs, equipment costs, subcontractor quotations, overheads, and profit margins.
Obtain and evaluate quotations from suppliers, vendors, and subcontractors.
Coordinate with the estimation, purchase, planning, finance, and technical teams to finalise competitive tender rates.
Assess project risks, price variations, taxes, contingencies, and contractual liabilities before bid submission.
D. E-Tendering & Bid Submission
Manage online tender registration, document uploads, and bid submission through relevant e-procurement portals.
Coordinate EMD, tender fees, bank guarantees, and other bid security requirements.
Ensure timely and error-free submission of technical and financial bids.
Monitor tender corrigenda, pre-bid meeting notices, clarifications, and amendments.
Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of all tender-related information.
E. Client Coordination & Negotiation
Attend pre-bid meetings and technical discussions with clients and consultants.
Prepare responses to tender queries and clarification requests.
Participate in commercial negotiations and rate finalisation with management approval.
Track tender results, bid status, and client feedback.
F. Contract Award & Handover
Review letters of intent, work orders, contract agreements, and award conditions.
Coordinate with management and the legal team to review commercial terms and contractual risks.
Prepare a detailed tender handover to the project execution team, including BOQ, approved rates, scope, timelines, and key contract conditions.
Maintain records of submitted tenders, awarded projects, unsuccessful bids, and tender performance.
3. Educational Qualification
B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering preferred.
Diploma in Civil Engineering may be considered for candidates with substantial relevant experience.
Additional qualifications in construction management, quantity surveying, estimation, or contract management will be an advantage.
4. Experience
Minimum 710 years of relevant experience in tendering, estimation, costing, and bid management in building construction or infrastructure projects.
Experience in residential, commercial, industrial, or high-rise building projects is preferred.
Proven experience in handling government and/or private-sector tenders independently.
5. Required Skills
Strong knowledge of civil construction estimation, costing, BOQ, and rate analysis.
Expertise in tender documentation and e-tendering portals.
Knowledge of construction contracts, tender eligibility, EMD, BG, and statutory documentation.
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and relevant estimation software.
Excellent negotiation, analytical, communication, and coordination skills.
Ability to manage multiple tenders and meet strict submission deadlines.
6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Timely and accurate submission of tenders.
Tender qualification and success rate.
Accuracy of project estimation and cost calculations.
Compliance with tender requirements and documentation standards.
Value of contracts secured and contribution to business growth.
Effective coordination and timely handover of awarded projects.
7. Personal Attributes
Strong commercial awareness and attention to detail.
Leadership and team management capabilities.
Proactive approach to identifying business opportunities.
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
High standards of integrity and confidentiality.

Description:
SUMMARY
Technical Business Analyst

Summary
We are currently recruiting an experienced Technical Business Analyst to act as a vital bridge connecting business stakeholders with technical development teams. In this position, the successful candidate will be responsible for identifying business needs, transforming them into detailed technical specifications, performing in-depth data analysis, and ensuring the effective deployment of technology solutions. The ideal applicant will demonstrate strong analytical skills, a comprehensive understanding of technical principles, a history of managing stakeholder relationships, and practical experience working within Agile delivery environments.

Location: Bhubaneswar, Odisha

Experience: 5-10 years

Responsibilities
Identify, evaluate, and formally document both business and technical requirements.
Prepare essential documentation, including Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), Software Specifications (SRS), user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Translate high-level business objectives into actionable technical specifications.
Create process diagrams, wireframes, and data mapping schemas using tools like Visio, Lucidchart, or Figma.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, software developers, Quality Assurance teams, UX designers, and business stakeholders.
Perform data analysis and validation tasks using SQL queries.
Demonstrate expertise in REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML data formats, and system integration protocols.
Track project progress, monitor requirements and defects, and report on delivery metrics through Jira and other reporting platforms.
Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend workflow improvements.
Lead Agile and Scrum ceremonies, such as sprint planning and backlog grooming sessions.
Manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT) efforts and assist in validating test cases.
Ensure all requirements remain aligned with business goals throughout the entire project lifecycle.


Requirements
Gathering & Documentation:
Proficiency in developing Business Documents (BRD).
Expertise in drafting Functional Documents (FRD).
Ability to produce Software Specifications (SRS).
Experience authoring user stories and defining acceptance criteria.
Technical Skills:
Advanced SQL usage for data analysis and verification.
Strong understanding of REST and SOAP API architectures.
Familiarity with JSON/XML structures and system integration patterns.
Competence in process modeling using BPMN and UML standards.
Skill in creating wireframes and process flowcharts.
Tools & Methodologies:
Proficiency with Jira and Confluence platforms.
Experience using Visio, Lucidchart, or Figma.
Strong working knowledge of Agile and Scrum frameworks.
Expertise in project documentation and requirement management.
Core Competencies:
Exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills.
Effective stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Strong problem-solving and negotiation capabilities.
High level of attention to detail.
Capacity to handle multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
Education & Experience:
A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
4-5 years of professional experience in a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst capacity.
Proven track record of collaborating with cross-functional business and technical teams.
Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into viable technical solutions.
Comprehensive understanding of software development and project delivery lifecycles.
Preferred Skills
Practical experience with data visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Understanding of data warehousing principles.
Background in designing test cases and coordinating UAT processes.
Foundational knowledge of Python or other scripting languages.
Relevant industry experience within IT Services, BFSI, E-commerce, or Healthcare sectors.
Key Competencies
Analysis of Business and Technical requirements.
Data Analysis and Validation.
Process Optimization and Improvement.
Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration.

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Job Purpose
The Community Mobilizer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, implementing and monitoring specialist health camps and Anganwadi Centre upgradation activities. The role involves coordination with government health departments, ICDS officials, local administration, healthcare professionals, vendors and community stakeholders to ensure effective project implementation and timely achievement of project objectives.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. Specialist Health Camp Planning and Implementation
Plan and coordinate specialist health camps in consultation with the project team and district health authorities.
Coordinate with CDMO, DPM, MOIC, Block Health Officials and other relevant government departments for necessary approvals and support.
Identify suitable camp locations in consultation with local stakeholders and ensure adequate infrastructure and logistics.
Coordinate with specialist doctors, medical teams, diagnostic service providers and other healthcare professionals.
Ensure availability of medicines, medical equipment, diagnostic facilities and IEC materials during health camps.
Coordinate community mobilisation through ASHA workers, ANMs, Anganwadi workers, PRI members and local representatives.
Ensure proper patient registration, screening, consultation, investigation, referral and follow-up services.
Maintain camp-wise beneficiary records, photographs, reports and other supporting documents.
B. Anganwadi Centre Upgradation
Conduct baseline assessments and identify Anganwadi Centres requiring infrastructure and facility upgradation.
Coordinate with ICDS officials, CDPOs, supervisors and Anganwadi workers for site selection and implementation.
Assess infrastructure requirements, including painting, flooring, sanitation, drinking water, electrical fittings, furniture and child-friendly facilities.
Coordinate with vendors, contractors and suppliers for procurement and execution of approved upgradation activities.
Monitor the quality of civil works, installation of equipment and timely completion of activities.
Ensure that upgraded Anganwadi Centres are safe, child-friendly, hygienic and conducive to early childhood care and development.
Maintain before-and-after photographs, completion certificates, expenditure records and handover documents.
C. Project Coordination and Stakeholder Management
Maintain regular coordination with government departments, donor representatives and community stakeholders.
Organise review meetings, field visits and stakeholder consultations.
Address field-level implementation challenges and ensure timely resolution.
Build effective working relationships with district and block-level officials.
Ensure adherence to donor guidelines, organisational policies and approved project plans.
D. Monitoring, Documentation and Reporting
Prepare monthly work plans and activity schedules.
Monitor project progress against approved targets and deliverables.
Prepare and submit monthly progress reports (MPRs), activity reports and case studies.
Maintain beneficiary databases, camp records, attendance sheets and supporting documentation.
Track project expenditure and coordinate with the finance team for budget utilisation.
Document success stories, best practices and project outcomes.
Support donor visits, monitoring visits and project review meetings.
3. Educational Qualification
Graduate/Postgraduate in Social Work, Rural Development,
4. Experience
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in project coordination and implementation.
Experience in organising health camps, community health programmes or CSR projects.
Experience coordinating with government health departments and ICDS/Women and Child Development departments.
Experience in infrastructure development, procurement and vendor management will be an added advantage.
5. Key Skills and Competencies
Strong project planning and coordination skills.
Government liaisoning and stakeholder management.
Knowledge of community-based healthcare services.
Vendor management and infrastructure monitoring.
Report writing and documentation.
MS Office and Excel proficiency.
Good communication and team management skills.
Willingness to travel extensively to project locations.

Graduate/Postgraduate
MS Office and Excel proficiency.
Good communication and team management skills.
Willingness to travel extensively to project locations.

Title: Supervisor
EmploymentType: Full-Time, PermanentMinimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)    Role Overview: The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend. This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.   Key Responsibilities: 1. Site Operations Oversight: Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.  Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.  Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.  Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.  Observe and respond to suspicious manmaterial movements.  Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).  Maintain visitorvendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.  Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.  Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.  2. Technical Systems & Documentation: Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.  Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.  Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.  Take access approvals via eApproval portals.  3. Reporting & MIS: Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.  Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.  Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.  4. Emergency & Incident Management: Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.  Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.  Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.  Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.  5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination: Respond to client queries and share required reports (dailyweeklymonthly) within agreed SLAs.  Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.  Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.  Handle onboardingoffboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.  6. G4S Internal Coordination: Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.  Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.  Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.  Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.    Candidate Profile: Minimum Requirements: Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)  Minimum 5–10 years of experience in security operations management  Experience handling multi-location operations preferred  Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.  Essential Competencies: Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.  Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.  Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.  Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.  Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.    Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): 100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting  95% uptime for security equipment and systems  2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)  SLA adherence for report submissions and audits  Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description: Job Description: Admin Support    Position Title: Admin Support Employment Type: Full-Time, PermanentMinimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)    Role Overview: The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend. This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.   Key Responsibilities: 1. Site Operations Oversight: Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.  Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.  Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.  Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.  Observe and respond to suspicious manmaterial movements.  Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).  Maintain visitorvendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.  Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.  Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.  2. Technical Systems & Documentation: Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.  Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.  Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.  Take access approvals via eApproval portals.  3. Reporting & MIS: Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.  Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.  Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.  4. Emergency & Incident Management: Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.  Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.  Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.  Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.  5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination: Respond to client queries and share required reports (dailyweeklymonthly) within agreed SLAs.  Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.  Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.  Handle onboardingoffboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.  6. G4S Internal Coordination: Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.  Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.  Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.  Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.    Candidate Profile: Minimum Requirements: Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)  Minimum 5–10 years of experience in security operations management  Experience handling multi-location operations preferred  Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.  Essential Competencies: Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.  Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.  Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.  Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.  Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.    Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): 100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting  95% uptime for security equipment and systems  2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)  SLA adherence for report submissions and audits  Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%
AboutCompany: Founded in 1989, G4S India is the leading security solutions group in the country. The company today has more than 160,000 employees with a strong network of over 200 branches and regional offices spread throughout India.

Job Introduction:
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergencies, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.
Protect premises, property, and information
Reporting daily to the supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorised person
Write appropriate reports as required
Benefits and Advantages of Joining G4S
Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves
Annual Bonus of max 1-month salary
Gratuity (after 5 years of service)
Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from the employer and 12% from the employee
ESI Health Coverage for self & family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years of age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits
Ideal Candidate
Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass

About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

JOB SUMMARY
Direct customer service and sales to existing MLI customers through relationship building. Existing Customer database will be provided by company (called the Book of Relations- BoR).
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Service through relationship management
Establishing and strengthening relationship with the allocated customer base.
Ensure retention of customers in his/her allocated Book of Relations (existing customer database).
Act as single point of contact for customers for any customer query/complaint.
Identify financial goals of customers and providing financial planning assistance.
Competition Analysis for giving professional advice to customer
Fix self appointments everyday from the given customer database as per the campaign
Sales
Focus on cross-sell & up-sell opportunity in allocated customers.
Ensure successful completion of licensing as per MLI standards
Measures of Success
TAT adherence for updating System - CRM Next
Successful completion of cross-sell/ up-sell Business Goals month on month
Collection of payment/premium from 91-180 days due policies
Complaint Resolution /Customer satisfaction
Achievement of Retention Targets.
> 45 unique customer meetings in a month
More than 90% attendance (of total working days)
Successfully score >=80% in the Functional Trainings imparted
Key Relationships (Internal /External)
Internal HR/Trainers/Supervisors/Peers
External- Customers
Key competencies/skills required
Process & Result orientation
Customer centricity & relationship building
Basic Computer Knowledge.
Good communication skills- English and regional language
Desired qualification and experience
0 – 1.5 years in sales of Insurance/ Mutual Fund/ CASA/ Investments/ Loans/ Real Estate.
Age Bracket: 20-25 years
Must own a conveyance
Good communication skills

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.

Description:
We are looking for a talented Computer Vision Developer to design and implement advanced image and video processing solutions.
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in computer vision algorithms, deep learning frameworks, and real-time image analysis, enabling innovative AI-driven applications.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and optimize computer vision models for image classification, object detection, segmentation, and tracking.
Implement solutions using OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
Work on image preprocessing, feature extraction, and data augmentation techniques.
Integrate vision models into production systems and optimize for real-time performance.
Collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, and product teams to deliver AI solutions.
Ensure model accuracy, scalability, and deployment efficiency.
Stay updated with the latest research and advancements in computer vision and deep learning.
Required Skills:
Strong experience with OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar libraries.
Proficiency in Python (and optionally C++ for performance-critical tasks).
Knowledge of image processing techniques and computer vision algorithms.
Experience with CNNs, object detection models (YOLO, Faster R-CNN), and segmentation models (Mask R-CNN, U-Net).
Familiarity with GPU acceleration and model optimization for deployment.
Preferred Skills:
Experience with video analytics, 3D vision, or AR/VR applications.
Knowledge of edge deployment (NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT).
Understanding of cloud-based AI services (AWS Sagemaker, GCP AI Platform).

Location: PAN INDIA

EXPERIENCE:5-10 YEARS

Description:
Position Title: Team Leader Operations
Department: Operations Sales Voice (Ecommerce)
Location: Bhubaneswar

Key Responsibilities
1. Team & Performance Management
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of sales advisors to meet daily/weekly/monthly sales targets.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
Monitor and improve team performance using operational KPIs
Implement performance improvement plans (PIP) for underperforming team members.

2. Operational Excellence
Ensure adherence to SLA, process policies, and compliance requirements.
Maintain daily and weekly operations dashboards and scorecards.
Ensure accurate score calculation, rating mechanisms, and parameter adherence.
Work closely with Quality, Training, and Workforce Management teams for smooth operations.
Support new process transitions and stabilize teams during pilot phases.
3. Sales Coaching & Customer Engagement
Coach advisors on effective sales communication, objection handling, and valuebased selling.
Ensure that every interaction focuses on convincing customers to complete their purchase from the cart.
Monitor call audits to identify gaps and implement targeted coaching sessions.
Drive bestpractice sharing to enhance sales effectiveness.


Educational & Experience Requirements
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory).
2-3 years of work experience in a relevant Contact Center sales voice process.
Prior experience in international/premium contact center environments, especially during new process transitions.
Minimum 1 year experience as a Team Leader in a sales voice sales program (current role).

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain automation test frameworks for web and API applications.
Create robust and reusable automated test scripts using Java, C#, and Python.
Develop and execute functional, regression, smoke, and integration test suites.
Implement the Page Object Model (POM), Data-Driven, Hybrid, and BDD frameworks.
Analyze test results, identify defects, and work closely with development teams for resolution.
Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines.
Participate in Agile/Scrum activities including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
Prepare and maintain test documentation, defect reports, and automation metrics.
Ensure quality standards and best practices are followed throughout the SDLC.
Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Selenium WebDriver.
Proficiency in Java, C#, and/or Python.
Experience with automation frameworks using:
TestNG / JUnit (Java)
NUnit (C#)
PyTest (Python)
Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts.
Expertise in framework development using:
Page Object Model (POM)
Data-Driven Framework
Hybrid Framework
BDD Framework (Cucumber/SpecFlow)
Experience with source control tools such as Git, GitHub, or Bitbucket.
Knowledge of build tools such as Maven, Gradle, and MSBuild.
Experience with defect tracking tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps.
Good understanding of SQL and database testing.
API Testing Skills
Strong experience in API Testing using:
Postman
Rest Assured (Java)
Python Requests Library
Understanding of REST API concepts, JSON, XML, and Swagger/OpenAPI.
CI/CD & DevOps
Experience integrating automation suites with:
Jenkins
Azure DevOps
GitHub Actions
Understanding of Continuous Integration and Continuous Testing practices.
Preferred Skills
Experience in mobile automation using Appium.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Knowledge of performance testing tools like JMeter.
Familiarity with Docker and containerized test execution.
ISTQB Certification is an added advantage.

Job Description Marketing Consultant

Hiring Marketing & Business Development
Company Name: Ashree Infratech
Position: Marketing Consultant
Department: Marketing & Business Development
Location: bhubaneswar, Odisha
Experience: 37 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
Ashree Infratech is looking for a result-oriented Marketing Consultant who can develop and execute marketing strategies to strengthen the company's brand presence, generate business opportunities, and drive customer engagement. The candidate will be responsible for managing marketing campaigns, digital promotions, brand positioning, and business development initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement marketing strategies to promote the company's projects, services, and brand.
Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across social media platforms and other online channels.
Manage social media presence, content planning, advertisements, and promotional activities.
Identify potential customers, business opportunities, and new market segments.
Coordinate with internal teams, agencies, designers, and external marketing partners.
Plan and execute promotional campaigns, exhibitions, events, and property marketing activities.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify industry trends and business opportunities.
Develop marketing presentations, brochures, proposals, and promotional materials.
Monitor campaign performance, lead generation, customer engagement, and marketing ROI.
Support the business development team in generating qualified leads and converting prospects into customers.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.

Job Description Architect
Hiring Architecture & Design
Company Name: Ashree Infratech
Position: Architect
Department: Architecture & Design
Location: Bhubaneswar, Odisha
Experience: 3–8 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
Ashree Infratech is seeking a creative and technically proficient Architect to manage architectural planning, design development, drawings, and project coordination. The candidate will be responsible for developing functional and aesthetically appealing designs while ensuring compliance with applicable building regulations, construction standards, and project requirements.

Key Responsibilities
Develop architectural concepts, layouts, plans, elevations, sections, and detailed construction drawings.
Prepare architectural designs for residential, commercial, and infrastructure-related projects.
Coordinate with structural engineers, MEP consultants, contractors, and project management teams.
Conduct site visits to monitor construction progress and ensure execution aligns with approved architectural drawings.
Review drawings, specifications, and technical documents before project execution.
Ensure architectural designs comply with applicable building codes, local development regulations, and statutory requirements.
Coordinate with clients and management to understand project requirements and incorporate design modifications.
Prepare 2D and 3D architectural presentations, models, and visualizations.
Identify design discrepancies and provide appropriate technical solutions during project execution.
Assist in material selection, space planning, design detailing, and cost-effective design development.
Maintain proper documentation of drawings, revisions, approvals, and project-related design records.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Architecture (B.Arch) from a recognized institution.
Registration with the Council of Architecture (COA), where required for the role.
3–8 years of relevant experience in architectural design and project coordination.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, 3ds Max, Lumion, or other relevant architectural software.
Strong understanding of building planning, construction drawings, materials, and execution processes.
Knowledge of local building regulations, development norms, and approval processes.
Strong visualization, creativity, and technical drawing skills.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet design deadlines.

Description:
Job Summary
Function SummaryThe agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customer in a)Resolving policy service needb)Renewal collection to resolve policy holder s service needs, Cross sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment -Develop various sources of agent hiring build a team of agent agent pipe line. -Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring -Conduct Career Seminar of prospects-Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms
Agent Development -Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training Field demonstration (FOD s) -Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits. -Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals. -Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same
Meet Business Targets -Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans. -Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc -Ensure companies product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms. -Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan
Customer Centricity -Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion -Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty -Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need -Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.
Measures of Success:-Achievement of business plan GPA-Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.-Number MTD Active-Persistency as per grid-Number of EC/MDRT agent


Qualifications
Sales Background
Minimum 2 years experience, at least 6 months in last job
Age criteria: 24 years to 35 years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Develop and implement effective agency development strategies to drive business growth.
Build and maintain strong relationships with agents, brokers, and other stakeholders.

Strong knowledge of the insurance products and services offered by Axis Max Life Insurance Limited.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with agents, brokers, and other stakeholders in the insurance industry.

Description:
Career Opportunities
Position
AM - Customer Advisory Team
Asst Manager- 5A
Department
Customer Advisory Team
Reporting to
Branch Relationship Management
JOB SUMMARY
Direct customer service and sales to existing MLI customers through relationship building. Existing Customer database will be provided by company (called the Book of Relations- BoR).
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Service through relationship management
Establishing and strengthening relationship with the allocated customer base.
Ensure retention of in his/her allocated Book of Relations (existing customer database).
Act as single point of contact for customers for any customer query/complaint.
Identify financial goals of customers and providing financial planning assistance.
Competition Analysis for giving professional advice to customer
Fix self appointments everyday from the given customer database as per the campaign
Sales
Focus on cross-sell up-sell opportunity in allocated customers.
Ensure successful completion of licensing as per MLI standards
MEASURES OF SUCCESS
TAT adherence for updating System - CRM Next
Successful completion of cross-sell/ up-sell Business Goals month on month
Collection of payment/premium from 91-180 days due policies
Complaint Resolution /Customer satisfaction
Achievement of Retention Targets.
> 45 unique customer meetings in a month
More than 90% attendance (of total working days)
Successfully score >=80% in the Functional Trainings imparted
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
Assistant Manager - Customer Advisory Team:
1.5 - 2 years in sales of Insurance/ Mutual Fund/ CASA/ Investments/ Loans/ Real Estate.
Minimum 6 months exposure to Life Insurance
Age Bracket: 25-30 years
Must own a conveyance
KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES
Process Result orientation
Customer centricity relationship building
Basic Computer Knowledge.
Good communication skills- English and regional language
Max Life is progressing on the digitization journey of service and sales, which may require candidates to be equipped with Tablets for their work.

Disclaimer: Appointment to this role will be on a Fixed Term Contract (FTC). Only candidates who are comfortable with and willing to accept contractual employment should submit their applications.

Roles & Responsibilities:-
Managing and supervising day-to-day civil maintenance and repair activities within the plant premises, including buildings, and other civil infrastructure.
Planning and monitoring execution of civil repair, renovation, improvement and Mega ARC jobs as per approved scope, drawings and specifications.
Conducting regular site inspections, identifying civil defects and coordinating timely rectification to maintain the condition and usability of plant infrastructure.
Preparing and checking BOQs, estimates, material requirements and work schedules for civil maintenance and project activities.
Monitoring contractor and vendor activities, ensuring proper manpower deployment, work allocation, productivity and quality of execution.
Verifying measurements, checking work completion and coordinating preparation and submission of client and vendor bills with supporting documents.
Ensuring execution of works as per approved drawings, technical specifications, quality standards and applicable construction practices.
Coordinating with plant departments, clients, vendors and internal stakeholders for work planning and timely completion of jobs.
Ensuring compliance with site safety requirements, including work permits, job safety assessments, barricading and safe execution of civil activities.
Maintaining daily progress reports, measurement records, work completion reports, site instructions and other project-related documentation.
Monitoring material consumption, workmanship and site housekeeping, and ensuring optimum utilization of resources.
Coordinating closure of civil-related complaints and audit observations within the stipulated timeline.

Preferred candidate profile
Should have relevant experience in industrial civil maintenance, repair works, project execution and contractor/vendor coordination.

Job Description
Job Description: 

Objective: To develop the assigned Key accounts and to identify, acquire and manage new key accounts
Title: Sales- Team Leader
Function:Commercial
Sub function: Modern Trade
Job Responsibilities

•Totally accountable for the assigned key accounts both for growth in volumes and share.
•Monthly tracking of volume, territory sales, share and other parameters.
•To develop an Annual Customer Plan for all the accounts and get customer buy-in. To execute against the same.
•Account Management that involves developing existing key accounts through innovative consumer and trade promotions, packaging /pricing strategies and merchandising inputs. 
•Work closely with the Merchandising team to design, acquire and place merchandising material suited to the Key account.
•Develop promotions specific to the key account in coordination with marketing and implement the same
•Analyzing post activity results and create and maintain archive of successes and failures
•Negotiate, convert and secure long term deals with competition key accounts at a reasonable cost.
•Tracking new promotions in competition brands and accounts.
•Training of bartenders/waiters for suggestive selling
-
Supervises:  Market Developers and Account Developers 
Reports To:   Area Sales Manager (Key Account Manager)
Key Customers:    Knowledge about Key accounts
  Job Requirement
Qualifications: Graduation/PG
Experience: 4 to 8 years
Functional Skills:
•Planning and Organizing
•Relationship Management
•Presentation Skills
•Good communication & Coordination Skills
•Team worker
•Influencing Skills
•Strong Analytical skills
Travel:  70% traveling

Location: Multiple Locations / Pan-India Hubs
Experience: 2 – 8 Years
Role Type: Full-Time, Individual Contributor

About the Role
We are looking for high-energy, target-driven Business Development Managers to drive our Mid-Market corporate sales across Pan-India hubs. In this role, you will focus on acquiring new mid-sized corporate clients and expanding business within existing accounts.
You will manage mid-sized commercial deals (ranging from 20 Lakhs to 85 Lakhs+ / 25K–100K in annual contract value), allowing you to focus purely on high-impact corporate accounts while smaller transactional inquiries are handled by our operations team.

What’s in It for You? (Compensation & Growth)
Monthly Payouts: Fast-paced monthly performance tracking with monthly commission payouts.
Multi-Year Earning Potential: Earn trailing commissions in Years 2 and 3 for multi-year contracts you close, plus an Annual Target Bonus.
Clear Career Path: High performers hitting targets for 2 consecutive years qualify for fast-track promotion to Enterprise Sales roles.

Key Responsibilities
1. New Business Acquisition (50% of your time)
Identify and pitch to potential corporate clients across industrial corridors, manufacturing plants, logistics hubs, and commercial buildings through cold calling, field visits, and networking.
Follow up on and convert inbound leads from digital marketing, website inquiries, and branch referrals.
Prepare accurate pricing proposals/cost sheets using company tools and respond to commercial RFQs while maintaining healthy profit margins.
Close multi-year security service contracts within the mid-market segment.
2. Account Expansion & Retention (35% of your time)
Build strong relationships with existing mid-market clients to expand manpower deployments across new sites.
Cross-sell electronic security solutions (CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection packages) to existing customers.
Manage timely contract renewals (targeting 90%+ retention) and execute annual price revisions aligned with statutory minimum wage updates.
3. Sales Operations & Smooth Handover (15% of your time)
Maintain up-to-date pipeline data, meeting notes, and deal stages in Salesforce (CRM).
Coordinate closely with Branch Operations and Finance teams after contract signing to ensure smooth deployment and timely billing.
Who We Are Looking For
Experience & Education:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (MBA in Sales/Marketing is a plus).
Manager: 2–5 years of proven experience in high-volume B2B / field sales.
Senior Manager: 5–8 years of proven B2B / commercial services sales experience.

Skills & Competencies:
Sales Hustle: Strong track record in B2B field sales, cold calling, lead qualification, and closing deals quickly.
Client Relationship Management: Ability to engage and negotiate with Business Owners, Plant Heads, Facility Managers, and Purchase Officers.
Commercial Acumen: Comfortable working with pricing/costing sheets, profit margins, and basic labour compliance/minimum wage structures.
Tech-Savvy: Hands-on experience using CRM tools (like Salesforce) and MS Excel.
(Preferred) Basic understanding of manned guarding or electronic security systems (CCTV, access control).

Description:
Key Roles and Responsibilities
1. Patient Consultation: Provide medical consultation and clinical examination to infants, children and adolescents attending the health camp.
2. Growth & Development Assessment: Assess children's physical growth, nutritional status and developmental milestones.
3. Diagnosis & Treatment: Diagnose and manage common childhood illnesses such as fever, cough, cold, diarrhoea, respiratory infections, anaemia and other paediatric conditions.

6. Newborn & Infant Care: Provide guidance on breastfeeding, complementary feeding, newborn care and essential infant healthcare practices.
7. Prescription: Prescribe appropriate medicines and treatment based on the child's age, weight and clinical condition.

9. Referral Services: Refer children with serious or complicated medical conditions to appropriate government or specialised healthcare facilities.

11. Medical Documentation: Maintain patient consultation records, diagnosis, prescriptions, growth assessment and referral details.
Required Qualification & Experience
MBBS with MD/DNB in Paediatrics.
Valid medical registration.
Relevant experience in child healthcare and management of paediatric conditions.
Experience in community health camps will be preferred.

Description:
Key Roles and Responsibilities
1. Patient Consultation: Provide medical consultation and examination to patients with skin, hair and nail-related problems.
2. Clinical Assessment: Assess patients' medical history, symptoms and skin conditions to identify dermatological disorders.
3. Diagnosis & Treatment: Diagnose and manage common skin conditions such as fungal infections, eczema, acne, psoriasis, allergies, scabies and other skin disorders.
4. Hair & Nail Care: Examine and provide treatment guidance for common hair and nail-related conditions, including hair loss and fungal nail infections.
5. Prescription: Prescribe appropriate medicines, topical creams and other treatments as per clinical requirements.
6. Skin Health Awareness: Educate patients on personal hygiene, skin care, sun protection and preventive measures against common skin diseases.
7. Early Identification: Identify suspicious skin lesions, infections and other serious dermatological conditions requiring further evaluation.
8. Referral Services: Refer patients requiring advanced investigation or specialised dermatological treatment to appropriate healthcare facilities.
9. Patient Counselling: Provide guidance on medication usage, treatment duration, follow-up and preventive care.
10. Medical Documentation: Maintain patient consultation records, diagnosis, prescriptions and referral details.
Required Qualification & Experience
MBBS with MD/DNB in Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy (DVL).
Valid medical registration.
Relevant experience in diagnosing and managing skin, hair and nail disorders.
Experience in community health camps will be preferred.

Description:
Key Roles and Responsibilities
1. Patient Consultation: Provide medical consultation and examination to beneficiaries with bone, joint, muscle and musculoskeletal problems.
2. Clinical Assessment: Assess patients' medical history, symptoms, joint movements, mobility and physical limitations.
3. Diagnosis & Treatment: Diagnose and provide treatment recommendations for common orthopaedic conditions such as arthritis, back pain, neck pain, joint pain, fractures, sports injuries and musculoskeletal disorders.
4. Bone Health Assessment: Identify patients with suspected osteoporosis, vitamin D deficiency and other bone-related health concerns.
5. Injury Management: Provide initial assessment and management guidance for sprains, strains, fractures and other musculoskeletal injuries.
6. Prescription: Prescribe appropriate medicines and recommend investigations or imaging as clinically required.
7. Rehabilitation Guidance: Advise patients on physiotherapy, exercise, posture correction and mobility improvement.
8. Referral Services: Identify complicated cases requiring surgical intervention, advanced investigations or specialised treatment and refer them to appropriate healthcare facilities.
9. Patient Counselling: Educate beneficiaries on bone health, joint care, injury prevention, posture and lifestyle modifications.
10. Medical Documentation: Maintain patient consultation records, diagnosis, prescriptions, treatment advice and referral details.
11. Coordination: Coordinate with physiotherapists, nursing staff and other medical professionals for effective patient care during the health camp.
Required Qualification & Experience
MBBS with MS/DNB in Orthopaedics.
Valid medical registration.
Relevant experience in managing bone, joint and musculoskeletal conditions.
Experience in community health camps will be preferred.

Description:
Key Roles and Responsibilities
1. Patient Consultation: Provide eye-related medical consultation and examination to beneficiaries attending the health camp.
2. Vision Assessment: Conduct basic vision testing and assess visual acuity to identify vision-related problems.
3. Eye Examination: Examine the eyes and identify common eye conditions such as cataracts, conjunctivitis, glaucoma, refractive errors, dry eyes and other ocular disorders.
4. Diagnosis & Treatment: Diagnose and provide appropriate treatment recommendations for common eye-related conditions.
5. Prescription: Prescribe suitable eye drops, medicines and corrective lenses, wherever clinically required.
6. Eye Screening: Conduct preliminary screening for cataracts, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy and other vision-threatening conditions.
7. Preventive Eye Care: Educate beneficiaries on eye hygiene, eye safety, regular eye check-ups and preventive measures.
8. Referral Services: Identify patients requiring cataract surgery, advanced investigations or specialised eye treatment and refer them to appropriate eye hospitals or healthcare facilities.
9. Patient Counselling: Provide guidance on spectacle usage, eye care, medication and follow-up consultations.
10. Medical Documentation: Maintain patient consultation records, vision screening details, diagnosis, prescriptions and referral records.
11. Coordination: Coordinate with optometrists, ophthalmic assistants and other medical staff to ensure effective eye care services during the camp.
Required Qualification & Experience
MBBS with MS/MD/DNB in Ophthalmology.
Valid medical registration.
Relevant experience in eye examination, diagnosis and treatment.
Experience in community-based eye screening camps will be preferred.

Description:
Job Summary
The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customer in a)Resolving policy service needb)Renewal collection to resolve policy holder s service needs, Cross sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment -Develop various sources of agent hiring build a team of agent agent pipe line.
Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring.
Conduct Career Seminar of prospects.
Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms.
Agent Development -Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training Field demonstration (FOD s).
Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same.
Meet Business Targets -Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc.
Ensure companies product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan.
Customer Centricity -Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion.
Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty.
Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need.
Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.
Measures of Success:-Achievement of business plan GPA.
Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Number MTD Active.
Persistency as per grid.
Number of EC/MDRT agent.


Qualifications and Experience
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience
At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

As a Cloud Platform Engineer, a typical day involves designing and constructing cloud-based application solutions that seamlessly integrate both cloud and traditional infrastructure components. Department: Admissions
Experience: 6-12 Years

Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Admission Officer to manage the end-to-end admission process at Birla School of Engineering and Technology. The candidate should have strong communication, counselling, coordination and student engagement skills, preferably in the higher education sector.

Handle admission enquiries and counsel students and parents about academic programmes.

Proficiency in MS Office and admission management systems.
Strong coordination, follow-up and team management skills.

* Good knowledge of admission procedures, documentation and student database management.

* Strong coordination, follow-up and team management abilities.
Candidates with relevant experience in educational institutions, preferably in handling admissions for engineering programmes, are encouraged to apply.
