Description:
Role & responsibilities
Develop and implement preventive maintenance programs for electrical & Mechanical equipment.
Diagnose and troubleshoot electrical & Mechanical faults and malfunctions.
Respond to emergencies and ensure prompt resolution of electrical & Mechanical.
Ensure that electrical & Mechanical systems and equipment are maintained in a safe and reliable condition
Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, repairs, and inspections.
Prepare reports on the performance of electrical systems and equipment.
Document any issues or problems encountered and recommend corrective actions.
Communicate effectively with stakeholders regarding maintenance activities and issues.
Identify opportunities for improvement in maintenance processes and procedures.
Complete Maintenance & Breakdown visit as per SLA
Project take-over: Inspection of new installations, share open points with the Project, and ensure closure.
Implement upgradation / rebuild work at the site
Operational & maintenance training to User
Improve/Maintain System availability
Ensure replenishment of critical spare parts with the customer.

Preferred candidate profile

Min 2 - 3 years in field of Electro-Mechanical maintenance
Read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, electrical drawings, and service manuals to perform required maintenance work
Basic Knowledge of Switchgear components, Control Panels/Power distribution Panels
Troubleshooting of industrial communication system viz. Profibus, Profinet, AS-I, etc.
Knowledge of configuring & troubleshooting of VFDs, Encoders, PLC,etc.
AboutCompany: Koerber Supply Chain Ltd. is a German company. It is a global technology company for intelligent manufacturing and supply chain solutions in warehouse automation. As a reliable innovation partner, Koerber turns entrepreneurial thinking into customer success by providing leading technology to fuel whats next – from end-to-end pharma production and advanced supply chain solutions to high-tech machinery and process equipment. Koerber combines deep domain expertise with integrated hardware, software, and digital services, to help customers take the next step.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
About the role: The Territory Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for deploying financial solutions across residential and commercial societies to help digitize their accounting and operational functionalities. The role involves direct client engagement, product demonstrations, and driving revenue through effective lead generation and business conversions. The ideal candidate will combine financial understanding with strong communication and sales acumen to deliver impactful results.

Deploy financial solutions to automate and digitize society-level accounting and billing operations.
Conduct product demonstrations for clients, emphasizing features, benefits, and overall solution value.
Connect with committee members of residential societies and apartment associations to identify needs and present suitable solutions.
Prospect, educate, and qualify leads through a consultative approach to improve client satisfaction and business conversion rates.
Engage in calling efforts and on-ground visits to generate leads and convert them into business opportunities.
Achieve assigned revenue and acquisition targets within the allocated territory.
Maintain accurate data of leads, client meetings, and conversions in CRM tools.
Ensure consistent follow-ups and client engagement for renewals and satisfaction.

Preferred candidate profile

Minimum 15 years of proven track record in deploying financial solutions and ability to meet targets
The candidate must have a basic accounting and finance background (e.g. Graduated with BAF degree)
Should have interest in business development for software application products/solutions (B2C)
Must be energetic, well-spoken, and eager to generate revenue for the organization
Should be proficient in Hindi and English
Fluency in the regional language is a plus
Should be comfortable working on weekends
(Saturday & Sunday are compulsory working days, with a week off between MondayThursday)
Effective presentation and negotiation skills
The candidate should have proficiency in Tally and MS Office

Benefits
Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance
Travel Allowance
Monthly R&R awards
Early promotions to outstanding performers
AboutCompany: NoBroker is Indias first and only PropTech Unicorn, transforming the real estate ecosystem with cutting-edge, tech-driven, and capital-efficient solutions. Through NoBrokerHood, our smart society and community management platform, we empower over 21,000+ societies across 15 major cities—offering seamless visitor management, billing, and engagement experiences.

Description:
Business Function
Corporate and Investment Banking provides corporate customers with a full range of commercial banking products and services, including cash management services, current accounts, time deposits, trade finance, working capital finance, term loans and foreign exchange. Through our continued commitment, DBS has cultivated long-standing relationships with its customers in the region that are based on account relationship management, service differentiation, product development and rigorous credit standards.
Responsibilities
Conduct comprehensive credit analysis of IBG2 clients to assess their creditworthiness and financial standing
Interact with clients to gather relevant information and documentation required for credit assessment
Prepare detailed credit proposals and recommendations for new and existing clients. Collaborate with the Credit team to obtain timely approvals for credit facilities
Support Relationship Managers in achieving their business targets by assisting with annual supervision reviews and arranging credit approvals for new-to-bank clients or new deals
Coordinate with the Trade & Operations team and other stakeholders to ensure timely completion of KYC, documentation requirements etc.
Requirements
Relevant experience in credit analysis or a similar role within the banking industry.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret financial statements and assess credit risk
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with clients and internal stakeholders
Proficient in using financial analysis tools and software
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
Education / Preferred Qualifications
An MBA or CA with relevant number of years of experience in Corporate Banking
Core Competencies
Good written and verbal communication skills
Good Analytical skills.
Self-driven and highly ambitious
Results-orientated & the ability to handle pressure
Relationship building & management skills
Understanding of competitor products
Comfortable with tight deadlines
Technical Competencies
Sound understanding of asset products and associated technology platforms and operational procedures
Understanding of regulatory guidelines on banking policies issued by MAS/ RBI/SEBI (local regulations in India) and local laws and regulations that impact businesses in general. Understanding of KYC requirements & Anti-money Laundering Policies are critical.
Knowledge of financial markets, products & competitor offerings to assist in meaningful dialogue with clients
Work Relationship
Close interaction with RMs / Branch Manager to ensure consistent on boarding of good quality customers and thereby assisting in delivery of Sales targets.
Close interaction with various stakeholders to ensure consistent and reliable service delivery to the customer.
DBS India - Culture & Behaviors
DBS is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Expected value driven behaviors are:
Demonstrate Business Performance through PRIDE 2.0 Value Based Propositions
Ensure Customer Focus by Delighting Customers & Reduce Complaints
Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS Reputation
Enhance Self Knowledge, Skills and develop Competencies aimed at continuous improvement

Job Description:
A highly skilled and motivated AI Architect for designing, developing, and implementing artificial intelligence (AI) solutions within an organization. The role focuses on leveraging AI & GenAI technologies, machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and predictive analytics to solve complex business problems and drive innovation. The AI Architect bridges the gap between business objectives and technology, ensuring that AI systems align with the organization's strategic goals.

What we're looking for:
Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in AI projects, data science, or a related field.

Skills:
Expertise in AI & GenAI technologies, frameworks, and methodologies (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision).
Proficiency in programming languages like Python or .Net
Strong understanding of cloud technologies (Azure & GCP), APIs, and microservices.
Knowledge of big data processing tools (e.g., Hadoop, Apache Spark).
Hands on experience with tools and platforms used in AI development (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, Ollama, DataBricks etc.).
Proven experience in managing technical projects, preferably in AI, machine learning, or data-driven technologies.
Experience in architecting AI Solutions using on premise and Cloud technologies.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively.
Experience with agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) for managing technical projects.
Knowledge of AI ethics and regulatory compliance frameworks.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Proficiency with data engineering and cloud architecture principles.

What you'll be doing:
Define and design AI architecture, frameworks, and strategies to meet organizational needs.
Evaluate and select AI tools, platforms, and frameworks to develop innovative solutions.
Supervise or contribute to the development, training, and optimization of Large as well as small language models.
Ensure seamless integration of AI solutions with existing business processes while ensuring that the solution complies with customers internal policies and guidelines.
Design AI solutions that are scalable, secure, and maintainable over time.
Stay updated on the latest advancements in AI and machine learning to propose innovative solutions.
Strong understanding & knowledge about Microsoft Azure cloud and deploying PaaS & SaaS applications on Azure
Strong architecture background especially in AI Solutions and Cloud technologies.
Collaborate with external vendors and partners to leverage their expertise and solutions.
Project Planning and Execution
Define project scope, goals, and deliverables that align with business objectives.
Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and milestones for AI development and deployment initiatives for the inhouse GenAI platform.
Collaborate with business units for ROI determination and identify KPI’s for measuring ROI for each project.
Manage day-to-day project activities to ensure successful execution and timely delivery.
Anticipate potential risks and challenges in AI projects (e.g., data limitations, algorithm performance issues, regulatory concerns).
Proactively implement risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
Ensure that AI projects comply with data privacy regulations, industry standards, and ethical guidelines.
Promote responsible use of AI technologies across all projects.

Team Collaboration and Coordination
Act as the primary liaison between AI research teams, data scientists, engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders.
Facilitate regular meetings and communications between business units and IT to discuss AI project progress, challenges, and opportunities.
Plan and coordinate work between onsite and offshore AI teams.
Foster collaboration among team members and remove obstacles to productivity.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

The ideal candidate will possess strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (B2C Commerce), Salesforce B2B Commerce, integrations, and modern commerce architectures. This role requires collaboration with business stakeholders, architects, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing commerce experiences across multiple channels.
Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain scalable commerce solutions using Salesforce B2C Commerce (SFCC) and Salesforce B2B Commerce.
Build and customize storefront experiences using SFRA, custom cartridges, and Lightning-based B2B Commerce components.
Design and develop commerce capabilities including product catalog management, pricing, promotions, inventory, orders, checkout, customer account management, and self-service portals.
Implement and support complex B2B commerce functionality such as account hierarchies, buyer groups, contract pricing, quote-to-order processes, and approval workflows.
Integrate Salesforce Commerce solutions with external systems including ERP, CRM, OMS, PIM, payment gateways, tax engines, and marketing platforms.
Develop and consume APIs using REST, OCAPI, SCAPI, Apex, and Salesforce platform services.
Optimize application performance, scalability, security, SEO, accessibility, and user experience.
Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to commerce architecture decisions.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement preventive measures.
Conduct code reviews, enforce development standards, and mentor junior team members.
Support CI/CD pipelines, release management, and environment deployments.
Collaborate with QA, Product Management, UX, and business teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Required Skills:

6+ years of experience in eCommerce application development with at least 4+ years of Salesforce Commerce implementation experience.
Strong hands-on experience with both:
Salesforce B2C Commerce (SFCC)
Salesforce B2B Commerce
Expertise in SFRA, ISML, Controllers, OCAPI, SCAPI, Jobs Framework, and Commerce APIs.
Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, Salesforce Platform, and Experience Cloud.
Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, REST APIs, JSON, and AJAX.
Experience implementing:
Product Catalogs
Pricing & Promotions
Checkout & Payments
Order Management
Customer & Account Management
Search & Merchandising
Experience integrating Salesforce Commerce platforms with:
SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or similar ERP systems
Salesforce CRM and Service Cloud
Payment providers such as Adyen, Stripe, PayPal, CyberSource, or Authorize.Net
Tax providers such as Vertex or Avalara
Strong understanding of B2B commerce concepts including corporate accounts, buyer roles, negotiated pricing, procurement workflows, and quote management.
Experience with Git, Bitbucket/GitHub, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar DevOps tools.
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

Salesforce Certifications:
Salesforce B2C Commerce Developer
Salesforce Platform Developer I / II
Salesforce B2B Commerce for Developers
Salesforce Application Architect (preferred)
Experience with Composable Commerce, Headless Commerce, and API-led architectures.
Experience with PWA Kit, Managed Runtime, and modern storefront development.
Hands-on experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, and modern front-end frameworks.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and leading offshore/onshore development teams.
Exposure to multi-site, multi-brand, multi-country commerce implementations.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.

Description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.

Key Responsibilities & KRAs

Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.
Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired portfolios.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.

What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
Position : Associate Director / Director

Department: Tax Restructuring/Succession Planning Team
Designation: Associate Director / Director (10+ years)
Experience: 10+ years post-qualification
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA)
Location: Vadodara (Preferred) | Ahmedabad | Mumbai
Role Overview
We are looking for experienced Chartered Accountants to join its Succession Planning Team. The role involves independently leading succession and estate planning assignments for business families and HNIs, covering the complete process from understanding family objectives to structuring, drafting and implementation.
The candidate should have the ability to understand business strategy, ownership structures and long-term family objectives and design appropriate succession structures beyond conventional tax and legal considerations.

Key Responsibilities
1. Succession & Estate Planning
Lead succession and estate planning assignments for operating businesses, promoter shareholdings, immovable properties, investments, artwork and other family wealth.
Analyse family ownership structures, family dynamics, commercial objectives and long-term goals.
Design succession structures involving private trusts, Wills, family arrangements, family charters, gifts, partition arrangements, holding structures and family governance mechanisms.
Advise on ownership succession, management succession, business continuity and next-generation involvement.
2. Transaction & Corporate Structuring
Consider M&A, business restructuring, business sales and other corporate events while designing succession structures.
Handle succession planning for pre-IPO and IPO-bound businesses, considering DRHP disclosures, promoter contributions, lock-in and holding-period requirements.
Advise on listed company succession matters involving SEBI regulations, promoter and promoter-group requirements, disclosures, transfer restrictions and regulatory approvals.
3. Tax, Legal & Regulatory Advisory
Analyse Indian tax, stamp duty, Companies Act, FEMA, SEBI and succession-law implications.
Handle assignments involving NRIs, non-resident trustees or beneficiaries, foreign trusts, overseas foundations and foreign assets.
Assess overseas taxation, succession laws and inheritance or estate-tax implications, coordinating with specialist teams wherever required.
4. Documentation & Implementation
Draft, review and finalise trust deeds, Wills, family arrangements, shareholder agreements, family charters, partition deeds and other legal documents.
Prepare structure notes, technical opinions and presentations explaining available alternatives, risks and recommended structures.
Lead client and family discussions and translate commercial and family objectives into practical legal and tax structures.
Coordinate with internal specialists and external legal, tax, regulatory and valuation advisers for implementation.
5. Team Management
Supervise junior team members.
Review research, documentation, drafting and technical work.
Ensure quality and timely execution of succession planning assignments.

Job Summary
We are looking for an energetic Business Development Executive to grow AllHomes specifier network in Mumbai - across the AllHome Bharat Platform and its partner brands (ColourCoats, FIAMARC, The Window Factory, Metalia, Shapes, Ledlum, and The House of W). Reporting to the Regional Sales Head - West, you will open doors with architects, interior designers, contractors, and developers, get our brands specified at the design stage, and convert those relationships into project orders across categories. Candidates from any architectural or interior products background are welcome - what matters is that you know how to sell to the design fraternity.

Key Responsibilities
Market Mapping & Lead Generation
Map architects, interior designers, PMCs, contractors, and developers across Mumbai and MMR; build a live project database
Generate qualified leads through daily field visits, referrals, site scouting, and industry networks
Track upcoming residential, hospitality, retail, and office projects in the territory
Specification & Relationship Building
Make studio and site visits to introduce the AllHome portfolio and secure specification at the design stage
Arrange product demos, samples, mock-ups, and experience-centre walkthroughs for design teams
Cross-sell across brands - take more than one AllHome category into the same project, coordinating with the respective brand teams
Sales Support & Order Closure
Support the regional team on proposals, BOQs, and quotations, and follow up from enquiry through tendering to closure
Own conversion of small and mid-ticket opportunities end-to-end; support high-value mandates with the regional team
Coordinate with dealers, supply chain, and accounts on dispatches, deliveries, and post-order support
Process, CRM & Reporting
Maintain daily call reports, funnel stages, and quotation trackers on the CRM with clean data hygiene
Share weekly territory reports - pipeline value, win rates, and competitor activity across categories

Key Requirements
10+ years of B2B sales or business development experience in architectural or interior design products - lighting, hardware & fittings, tiles & surfaces, bathware, modular furniture, flooring, paints, windows, or faades
Demonstrated success in selling to or influencing architects, interior designers, and contractors; an existing Mumbai design and construction network is a strong plus
Working understanding of specification-led selling, BOQs, quotations, and tender basics
Confident communication and presentation skills - able to pitch to design principals and senior consultants
Self-driven, organized, and comfortable with CRM tools and daily field travel across MMR

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or an MBA in Marketing preferred
Exposure to building materials, home improvement, or premium interior product categories is an added advantage
AboutCompany:
About Us
AllHome is a house-of-brands platform for architectural and interior design products, founded by the founding team of PharmEasy and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. We design, manufacture, source, and supply across seven brands Ledlum (architectural lighting & fans), Shapes (hardware & furniture fittings, est. 1992), Colour Coats (wood coatings & paints), House of W (luxury bathware), The Window Factory (high-end windows), Metalia India (metal faades), and Fiamarc (interior & construction products).

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Role & responsibilities
roduction Operations
Assist in operating BOPP film production lines, including extrusion, stretching, winding, and slitting processes.
Monitor machine parameters such as temperature, pressure, speed, and tension.
Support machine startup, shutdown, and grade change activities.
Ensure continuous and smooth production during shifts.
Process Monitoring
Record production data and process parameters.
Identify process abnormalities and report them to supervisors.
Assist in troubleshooting production and quality issues.
Quality Control
Conduct routine checks on film properties such as thickness, width, appearance, and winding quality.
Help identify defects including wrinkles, gels, thickness variation, and surface imperfections.
Follow quality standards and operating procedures.
Material Handling
Monitor consumption of polypropylene resin, additives, and masterbatches.
Assist in raw material feeding and inventory coordination.
Minimize material wastage and scrap generation.
Safety & Housekeeping
Follow plant safety rules, PPE requirements, and standard operating procedures.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the production area.
Participate in safety training and improvement initiatives.
Documentation
Maintain shift logs, production reports, and quality records.
Assist in preparing daily production summaries.
Ensure accurate documentation of process changes and observations.

Preferred candidate profile

Description:
Role: Business Development Manager / Senior Manager
Industry: Power Trading / Energy Trading
Department: Sales & Business Development
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 8-11 Years
Education: B.E./B.Tech (Preferred) | MBA/PGDM (Preferred)
Location: Delhi / NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Calcutta, Chennai, Ahmedabad

About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and result-oriented Business Development Manager / Senior Manager to drive revenue growth in the power trading business. The incumbent will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, acquiring strategic clients, expanding market presence, and achieving revenue and profitability targets across electricity markets. The role requires close collaboration with trading, regulatory, scheduling, risk, and operations teams to maximize commercial outcomes across short-term and long-term power markets.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development & Revenue Growth
Identify, develop, and close business opportunities across power trading markets, including bilateral contracts, power exchanges, and open access transactions.
Own and deliver revenue, trading volume (MU), and profitability targets for assigned regions, products, or customer segments.
Develop and expand relationships with Industrial & Commercial (C&I) consumers, DISCOMs, captive users, renewable energy developers, and power generators.
Execute growth strategies and market expansion initiatives across multiple geographies.
Originate and close strategic transactions such as:
Long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs)
Bilateral power sale agreements
Group Captive Projects
Renewable Energy (Solar/Wind) Power Transactions
Multi-state C&I energy portfolios
Cross-border power trading opportunities
Prepare annual business plans, quarterly revenue forecasts, and sales pipelines.
Market Intelligence & Commercial Strategy
Monitor power market trends, pricing dynamics, demand-supply scenarios, and regulatory developments.
Identify trading opportunities in:
Day Ahead Market (DAM)
Real Time Market (RTM)
Term Ahead Market (TAM)
Bilateral Trading Markets
Provide actionable market insights to trading and risk management teams.
Client Relationship Management
Build and maintain strategic relationships with utilities, power generators, open access consumers, regulators, and market participants.
Lead commercial negotiations and contract execution.
Enhance customer retention, repeat business, and wallet share from key accounts.
Regulatory & Compliance
Stay updated on regulations issued by CERC, SERCs, and power exchanges.
Identify commercial opportunities emerging from policy and regulatory changes.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory guidelines and internal policies.
Cross-functional Coordination
Work closely with trading, scheduling, operations, finance, and risk management teams for seamless transaction execution.
Support deal structuring, pricing strategy, credit assessments, and working capital optimization.
Track deal profitability, revenue realization, and business performance metrics.
Team Leadership (For Senior Manager Role)
Lead and mentor a team of business development professionals.
Set sales targets, monitor performance, and drive capability development.
Develop succession plans and strengthen team effectiveness.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, or related discipline.
MBA/PGDM preferred.
8-11 years of experience in Power Trading, Energy Markets, Renewable Energy, or related sectors.
Minimum 2-3 years of experience managing a team, revenue portfolio, or business segment.
Required Skills
Strong understanding of Indian Power Markets and Trading Mechanisms.
Knowledge of Open Access, Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), and Electricity Market Operations.
Excellent negotiation, commercial acumen, and relationship management skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to interpret market data and develop strategic recommendations.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and business analytics tools.
Preferred Experience
Hands-on experience with power exchanges such as:
IEX (Indian Energy Exchange)
PXIL (Power Exchange India Limited)
HPX (Hindustan Power Exchange)
Exposure to renewable energy trading, green energy, solar and wind power markets.
Experience in Open Access and Cross-Border Electricity Trading.
Existing network with DISCOMs, industrial consumers, generators, and energy sector stakeholders.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Revenue & Margin Growth
Trading Volume Growth (MU)
New Client Acquisition
Market Share Expansion
Deal Conversion Ratio
Sales Pipeline Strength
Customer Retention & Account Growth
Team Performance & Collections Efficiency
Why Join Us?
Opportunity to work in a fast-growing and dynamic power trading environment.
Exposure to evolving electricity markets and renewable energy initiatives.
High-impact role with significant commercial responsibility.
Collaborative work culture with opportunities for career growth and leadership development.

Description:
Wockhardt Hospitals Limited is looking for Critical Care Medicine to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

Patient Assessment : Perform comprehensive assessments of critically ill patients to determine medical conditions and treatment needs. Treatment Planning : Develop and implement individualized treatment plans for patients in the intensive care unit, addressing their specific medical needs. Ventilator Management : Manage and oversee mechanical ventilation for patients requiring respiratory support. Monitoring : Utilize advanced monitoring equipment to assess patients' vital signs and respond promptly to changes in their condition. Diagnostic Procedures : Perform and interpret diagnostic procedures, such as chest X-rays, echocardiograms, and laboratory tests. Collaboration : Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals, including surgeons, nurses, and respiratory therapists, to optimize patient care. Family Communication : Communicate effectively with patients' families, providing updates on the patient's condition, treatment plan, and prognosis. Emergency Response : Respond to medical emergencies within the hospital, particularly in critical care areas. Documentation : Maintain accurate and up-to-date medical records, documenting patient assessments, interventions, and outcomes.

With a strong focus on patient-centric care, innovation, and clinical excellence, Wockhardt Hospitals delivers comprehensive healthcare solutions to improve outcomes and enhance quality of life.

Description:
FOR MALES ONLY

We are looking to hire 3 candidates, one based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, one based in Rajkot, Gujarat and one for Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.

Role & responsibilities
Business Development: Identify and prospect new business opportunities in the industrial sector, specifically for FAG Bearings (Schaeffler products).
Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with both new and existing customers.
Sales Target Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales quotas.
Product Expertise: Develop and maintain a deep knowledge of Schaeffler's product portfolio, including technical specifications and applications.
Sales Activities: Conduct site visits, deliver product presentations, and negotiate contracts to close sales.
Market Analysis: Keep abreast of market trends, competitor activities, and new product developments to identify potential opportunities.

Collaboration: Coordinate with the Back Office team to ensure smooth order processing, delivery, and customer satisfaction.


Preferred candidate profile
Bachelor's degree/ Diploma in Mechanical Engineering
Proven work experience as a Sales Executive or in a similar sales role, preferably in the industrial or manufacturing sector.
Knowledge of bearings or other industrial components is a significant advantage.
Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Highly motivated, target-driven, and a self-starter.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
AboutCompany:
About Us :-

We are bearing distributors, authorised with Schaeffler head quartered at Mumbai and have our branch offices in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Goa.

Our requirement is to consolidate as well as develop the vast and promising portfolio of Schaeffler products (Mechatronics, Bearings, Oil, Plummer blocks) in all types of industries.

Talent Acquisition & Training will be In house by QTBC & Scaheffler and if required Paid Training will be given with extended facility.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Job Title: Loan Officer-Micro Banking
Grade: DM-I
Department: Micro Banking
Location: Branch
Type of Position: Full-time

Job Summary
Drive acquisition of new unsecured loan customers from open market
Identify quality leads from unsecured loans liabilities customers through assessments by analyzing credit histories and performing financial analysis, ensuring compliance with internal and external regulations
Monitor and manage installment payments and collections of assigned customers
Strengthen existing customer relationships through targeted cross-selling Ujjivan's products customer profile needs
Size of the Role
Financial size: 5-7 Cr. loan portfolio
Non-financial size: NA
Key Duties and Responsibilities of the Role Business/ Financials
Develop and execute strategies to acquire new unsecured loan customers
Collaborate with the liabilities team to cross-sell unsecured loans
Follow up on leads provided by team various channels within defined TAT
Achieve monthly loan disbursement targets through acquisition of new customers and conversion of existing customers
Coordinate with Products Marketing department to carry out marketing drives at his/her assigned and catchment areas for unsecured loans
Prospect new customers, maintain database of the leads, meet convert select prospects and manage the relationship thereafter
Attend center meetings to generate leads for Unsecured loans and actively driving conversion of existing borrowing customers into SBL customer
Cross sell other products of Ujjivan and pass quality leads to respective officers/staff
Share customer insights/product related feedback with the Branch Head and Area Manager Microfinance
Provide inputs pertaining to revision of product and credit policies to the respective teams on the basis of geography specific considerations
Customer
Interact with customers in a courteous and professional manner; provide prompt, efficient and accurate services and establish professional relationship with them, with a long-term perspective
Conduct the appraisal process of potential customers in a courteous manner without compromising quality
Guarantee confidential treatment of all the information gathered from customers
Internal Process
Carry out the pre and post-loan activities related to Unsecured loans, perform simple financial analysis, present the loan applications to the sanctioning authority by adhering to the set TAT prioritize repayment of loans to maintain best portfolio quality

Description:
Position- Lab Technician
Location- Bongaigaon || Agartala || Shillong


Role & responsibilities :

To perform assigned analytical testing procedures in an accurate, precise, and timely manner in the assigned lab.
To perform routine and non-routine activities pertaining to laboratory testing and reporting and maintaining external and Internal Quality control.
Maintain required records and documentation.
Follow the laboratory's procedures for specimen handling and processing, test analyses, reporting and maintaining records of patient test result.
Analyze specimens using approved testing procedures as per SOP's, review and release test results.
Adhere to the laboratory's quality control policies, instrument and procedural calibrations and follow safety guidelines as per established organization protocols.


Preferred candidate profile:
Qualification: DMLT, BMLT
Immediate joiners preferred

Interested candidates may email their resume at munmun.chakraborty@lalpathlabs.com or 7980955497
AboutCompany:
Established in 1949, Dr Lal PathLabs today is the largest and most respected diagnostic service provider in the country. It has a proven track record of over six decades for strict adherence to international standards and benchmarks. Dr Lal PathLabs offers widest test menu and has a pan India presence in all important cities and towns of India, in the form of state-of-the-art laboratories and patient service centres.

The company has more than 190 Labs and over 2000 centres across India and international operations in Nepal and Bangladesh.

It serves over 13 million customers every year through its widest test menu and panels in the disciplines of Molecular Diagnostics, Biophysics, Flow Cytometry, Immunophenotying, Cytogenetics, Endocrinology, Genetics, Nutrition and Metabolism, Oncology, Toxicology, Immunohistochemistry, Infectious diseases, Biochemistry, Haematology, Histopathology and Cytology.

Dr Lal Path Labs has internationally accepted external and internal quality assurance programs in place. The Company is India's highest accredited laboratory, with accreditation from College of American Pathologists (CAP), National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL), Ministry of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and ISO 9001:2000 certification.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Check figures, postings, and documents for accuracy. Organize, secure, and maintain all files, records, cash and cash equivalents in accordance with policies and procedures. Record, store, access, and/or analyze computerized financial information. Classify, code, and summarize numerical and financial data to compile and keep financial records, using journals, ledgers, and/or computers. Prepare, maintain, audit, and distribute statistical, financial, accounting, auditing, or payroll reports and tables. Complete period-end closing procedures and reports as specified. Prepare, review, reconcile, and issue bills, invoices, and account statements according to company procedures. Follow-up and resolve past due accounts and vendor invoices until payment in full is received or resolved. Prepare daily consolidated deposits of cash received by all cash handling employees. Document, maintain, communicate, and act upon all Cash Variances. Prepare, maintain, and administer all cashier banks and contracts.
Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to determine if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable. Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Assists in supervising daily shift operations.
- Supervises restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of Restaurants or Restaurant Manager.
- Participates in department meetings by communicating a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality and service levels.
- Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
- Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.
- Opens and closes restaurant shifts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Meets and greets guests.
Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Supervises on-going training initiatives.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

Description:
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Qualifications

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Inspect guest rooms, public areas, pool, etc after being cleaned by Housekeeper to ensure quality standards.
Run sold room reports, verify room status, determine discrepant rooms, prioritize room cleaning, and update status of departing guest rooms.
Assist Housekeeping management in managing daily activities.
Act as a liaison to coordinate the efforts of Housekeeping, Engineering, Front Office, and Laundry.
Document and resolve issues with discrepant rooms with the Front Desk.
Prepare, distribute, and communicate changes in room assignments.
Communicate issues to next shift.
Complete required paperwork.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintece problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications.

Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Move, lift, carry, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 55 pounds without assistance and in excess of 55 pounds with assistance.
Ability to push and pull a loaded housekeeping cart and other work-related machinery over sloping and uneven surfaces.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Stand, sit, kneel, or walk for an extended period across an entire work shift.
Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination.
Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems.
Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (eg, small print).
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Position responsible for assigned food and beverage/culinary operations.
Oversees guest and employee satisfaction, maintaining standards and meeting or exceeding ficial goals.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Food and Beverage Operations
- Creates and nurtures a property environment that emphasizes motivation, empowerment, teamwork, continuous improvement and a passion for providing service.
- Provides excellent customer service to all employees.
- Responds quickly and proactively to employees concerns.
- Uses coaching skills throughout the property.
- Demonstrates self confidence, energy and enthusiasm.

- Develops a relationship with all guests to build repeated clientele internally and externally.
Additional Responsibilities as Assigned
- Complies with all corporate accounting procedures.
- Assists GM as needed with annual Quality audit.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Responsibilities VAPT Engineer
Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) for web applications, APIs, networks, and IT infrastructure.
Conduct authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability assessments to identify security weaknesses.
Execute manual penetration testing to validate vulnerabilities and assess their exploitability.
Use security testing tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Identify and validate security vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10 risks and common network security weaknesses.
Prepare detailed VAPT reports covering identified vulnerabilities, severity levels, technical evidence, risk impact, and remediation recommendations.
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to support vulnerability remediation.
Perform retesting after remediation and verify vulnerability closure.
Support secure code review and application security assessments.
Maintain VAPT documentation, testing procedures, and assessment records.
Support security compliance audits and assessments in accordance with applicable security standards and organizational policies.
Ensure all penetration testing activities are conducted within the approved scope and follow established security testing methodologies.
Required Technical Skills
Hands-on experience in VAPT and manual penetration testing.
Knowledge of web application, API, network, and infrastructure security testing.
Experience with Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG).
Ability to prepare technical VAPT reports and recommend remediation measures.
Experience with vulnerability validation, remediation tracking, and retesting.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with practical experience executing penetration tests, validating vulnerabilities, preparing technical reports, and conducting remediation retesting are preferred. Candidates with experience limited to GRC, compliance, or reviewing third-party VAPT reports may not be suitable for this hands-on role.

Description:
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable.
Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods.
Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction.
Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team
Handles employee questions and concerns.
Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.
Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
Assists in supervising daily shift operations.
Supervises restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of Restaurants or Restaurant Manager.
Participates in department meetings by communicating a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations
Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality and service levels.
Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.
Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.
Opens and closes restaurant shifts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
Strives to improve service performance.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
Meets and greets guests.
Conducting Human Resource Activities
Supervises on-going training initiatives.
Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Provide massage services to guests using props and/or products.
Provide body treatments to guests using body scrubs, wraps, and/or hydrotherapy.
Assess guest needs and inquire about contraindications (eg, allergies, high blood pressure, and pregcy) before beginning service.
Keep up to date with current techniques and modalities related to their field of work.
Escort guests to and from treatment rooms.
Arrange workstation, treatment room, and/or drapes.
Frequently check with guest to promote comfort, safety and security throughout service.
Promote and sell spa/salon services including retail offerings related to the Spa.
Clean, maintain, and sterilize tools.
Maintain cleanliness of workstation and/or treatment room throughout shift, dispose of trash and dirty linens, and secure supplies and equipment at the end of each shift.
Monitor and stick to time schedule throughout the day.
Handle inappropriate guest behavior by following Marriott International standard operating procedures for Inappropriate conduct for guests and therapists, leading up to and including stopping a treatment or service and informing supervisor/manager.
Maintain current skills and licensure in service area as per regional requirements.
Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications.
Follow all company policies and procedures; make sure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation.
Speak with others using clear and professional language.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time; grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance.
Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: Technical, Trade, or Vocational School Degree.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
License or Certification: State or Regional Massage License

Responsible for following established procedures in ordering, receiving, storing, distributing and payment of items.
Formulates an approved vendors list encompassing all categories.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
4-year bachelors degree in Fice and Accounting or related major.
or a minimum of 2 years experience in Purchasing or a related field.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Work, Projects, Policies, and Standards for Purchasing Across Departments
- Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc
- Compiles, codes, categorizes, calculates, tabulates, audits, or verifies information or data.
- Assures sanitation compliance.
- Assists Executive Chef in all aspects of purchasing (eg, Food, Beverage and Controllable) to ensure quality and profitability.

- Delegates and enforces first in/first out inventory rotation for all storeroom products.

- Ensures that proper safeguards are in effect for the security of the food and beverage storeroom assets.

- Communicates with kitchen, restaurant management and vendors to ensure timing of deliveries satisfies advanced food production needs.
