Demonstrating and Applying Accounting Knowledge to Purchasing Operations
- Demonstrates knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.

- Reviews reports and ficial statements to determine operations performance against budget.

- Takes proactive approaches when dealing with customers and guest concerns.
- Extends professionalism and courtesy to customers and guests at all times.
- Responds timely to customer service department request.
- Ensures all team members meet or exceed all hospitality requirements.
Supporting Profitability
- Supports annual quality audits.
- Reviews ficial statements, sales and activity reports, and other performance data to measure productivity and goal achievement and to determine areas needing cost reduction and program improvement.
Supporting Safety Standards and Work Procedures
- Implements property emergency plan.
- Provides a safe working environment in compliance with Occupational Safety and Health Administration/MSDS.
- Implements and sustains property accident prevention programs.
- Follows property-specific recovery plans.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Demonstrates self confidence, energy and enthusiasm.
- Manages group or interpersonal conflict.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Manages time and possesses organizational skills.
- Presents ideas, expectations and information in a concise, organized manner.
- Uses problem solving methodology for decision making and follow up.
- Makes calls if necessary.

Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance
Job Title: Manager - Training

The Manager - Training will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing training programs aimed at enhancing the skills and knowledge of employees within the organization. This role involves conducting training needs assessments, designing training materials, and delivering engaging training sessions. The Manager will work closely with various departments to ensure alignment of training programs with company objectives and employee performance metrics. Additionally, the role requires tracking and reporting on training effectiveness and participating in continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Conduct training needs assessments to identify gaps in employee skills and knowledge.
2. Design and develop training programs and materials tailored to various employee groups.
3. Deliver engaging and effective training sessions using various instructional techniques.
4. Collaborate with department heads to ensure training aligns with business goals.
5. Evaluate training effectiveness through surveys, assessments, and performance metrics.
6. Provide coaching and support to employees to reinforce learning outcomes.
7. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in training and development.
8. Manage training budgets and resources efficiently.

Skills and Tools Required:
1. Strong communication and presentation skills.
2. Ability to design and develop training materials and programs.
3. Knowledge of adult learning principles and training methodologies.
4. Proficiency in using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and training software.
5. Analytical skills to assess training effectiveness and make data-driven decisions.
6. Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
7. Project management skills to oversee training initiatives and meet deadlines.
8. Familiarity with performance management systems and tools.
9. Innovative thinking to create engaging and effective training solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:
1. Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
2. Proven experience in training and development within the insurance or financial services industry.
3. Certification in training or instructional design is a plus.

Description:
Position responsible for all the food and beverage operations, which includes all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
Oversees guest and employee satisfaction, maintaining standards and meeting or exceeding ficial goals.
Demonstrates knowledge and proficiency of all applicable food and beverage laws and regulations.
Develops and implements business plan for food and beverage.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Developing and Maintaining Budgets
- Develops and manages all ficial, employee engagement and guest satisfaction plans and actions for Food and Beverage departments.
- Maintains a positive cost management index for kitchen and restaurant operations.
- Utilizes budgets to understand ficial objectives.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Manages the Food and Beverage departments (not catering sales).
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Oversees all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
- Creates and nurtures a property environment that emphasizes motivation, empowerment, teamwork, continuous improvement and a passion for providing service.
- Provides excellent customer service to all employees.
- Responds quickly and proactively to employees concerns.
- Provides a learning atmosphere with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Provides proactive coaching and counseling to team members.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Monitors and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Sets clear expectations with the employees and team leaders and verifies that appropriate rewards are given if expectations are exceeded.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides excellent customer service.
- Responds quickly and proactively to guests concerns.
- Understands the brands service culture.
- Drives alignment of all employees, team leaders and managers to the brands service culture.
- Sets service expectations for all guests internally and externally.
- Takes ownership of a guest complaint/problem until it is resolved or it has been addressed by the appropriate manager or employee.
- Verifies all banquet functions are up to standard and exceed guests expectations.
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Manages day-to-day operations, drives quality, and verifies standards are meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Conducts performance reviews in a timely manner.
- Promotes both Guarantee of Fair Treatment and Open Door policies.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Develops an action plan to attack need areas and expand on strengths based on employee engagement and guest satisfaction results.
Additional Responsibilities
- Complies with all corporate accounting procedures.
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Drives effective departmental communication and information systems through logs, department meetings and property meetings.

Description:
We are looking for a skilled Attendant Operator to join our team at Tagros Chemicals India Ltd., responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of our chemical plant. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in chemical plant operations and be able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Roles and Responsibility


Operate and maintain chemical plant equipment, including reactors, distillation columns, and centrifuges.

Monitor and control chemical processes to ensure product quality and safety.

Collaborate with other operators and maintenance personnel to troubleshoot issues and optimize performance.

Implement safety procedures and protocols to prevent accidents and injuries.

Conduct regular inspections of equipment and facilities to identify potential hazards or defects.

Develop and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs.


Job Requirements


Diploma or degree in Chemical Engineering or related field.

Minimum 2 years of experience as an operator in a chemical plant setting.

Strong knowledge of chemical plant operations, including safety procedures and protocols.

Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly with colleagues.

Familiarity with chemical plant software and instrumentation is desirable.

Must pass a pre-employment physical and drug-alcohol screening.

Complete closing duties, including storing all reusable goods, breaking down goods, cleaning all equipment and areas, returning equipment to proper locations, locking refrigerators, restocking items, turning off lights, locking doors, and completing daily cleaning checklist.

Inspect the cleanliness and presentation of all china, glass, and silver prior to use.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications.

Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance.
Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination.
Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Description:
Prepare special meals or substitute items.
Regulate temperature of ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters.
Pull food from freezer storage to thaw in the refrigerator.
Ensure proper portion, arrangement, and food garnish.
Maintain food logs.
Monitor the quality and quantity of food that is prepared.
Communicate assistance needed during busy periods.
Inform Chef of excess food items for use in daily specials.
Inform Food & Beverage service staff of menu specials and out of stock menu items.
Ensure the quality of the food items.
Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist.
Prepare cold foods.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintece needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications.
Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Anticipate and address guests service needs.
Speak with others using clear and professional language.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: Technical, Trade, or Vocational School Degree.
Related Work Experience: At least 3 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Direct and assist Stewards in order to make clean up more efficient.
Ensure water temperature, and chemical levels are appropriate for cleaning and documented.
Assist with Banquet plate-ups.
Assist cooks and kitchen staff with various tasks as needed.
Provide cooks with needed items.
Support banquet and buffet by transporting and ensuring adequate stock.
Return cleaned items to proper locations.
Operate and maintain cleaning equipment and tools, including the dish washing machine, hand wash stations pot-scrubbing station, and trash compactor.

Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To ensure efficient operation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and breakdown maintenance of mechanical equipment in the cement plant, with specific responsibility for crushers and associated material-handling equipment to minimize downtime and ensure smooth plant operations.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. Crusher Operation and Maintenance
Perform preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of crushers, including jaw crushers, hammer crushers, impact crushers, and other crushing equipment, as applicable to the plant.
Monitor crusher performance, vibration, temperature, noise, lubrication, and equipment condition to identify potential faults.
Inspect and maintain crusher components, including hammers, blow bars, liners, jaw plates, bearings, shafts, rotors, and drive assemblies.
Identify and troubleshoot mechanical issues related to crushing equipment and ensure timely rectification of breakdowns.
Monitor wear parts and coordinate their replacement to maintain crushing efficiency and equipment availability.
Assist in maintenance and troubleshooting of crusher feed systems, belt conveyors, vibrating screens, feeders, and associated material-handling systems.
Ensure proper alignment, clearance, lubrication, and assembly of crusher components after maintenance activities.
B. Mechanical Maintenance
Execute scheduled preventive maintenance and equipment inspections as per the maintenance plan.
Maintain and troubleshoot mechanical equipment such as conveyors, gearboxes, motors, pumps, fans, bearings, couplings, and hydraulic systems.
Assist in equipment erection, installation, alignment, dismantling, and commissioning activities.
Identify recurring mechanical failures and support root cause analysis to prevent repeated breakdowns.
Ensure the availability of critical spares and maintain records of maintenance activities, breakdowns, and equipment history.
C. Safety and Compliance
Follow plant safety procedures, Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and applicable PPE requirements.
Ensure safe execution of maintenance activities, particularly during crusher inspection, cleaning, and repair.
Identify unsafe conditions and report equipment abnormalities, hazards, and near misses.
Maintain good housekeeping and ensure compliance with plant safety standards.
D. Coordination and Reporting
Coordinate with production, electrical, instrumentation, and other maintenance teams for planned maintenance and breakdown resolution.
Maintain daily maintenance reports, inspection checklists, and breakdown records.
Support efforts to improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and optimize maintenance costs.
2.. Educational Qualification
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
Relevant technical qualifications in mechanical maintenance may be considered based on experience and company requirements.
3. Required Technical Skills
Practical knowledge of crusher maintenance, wear parts, bearings, shafts, lubrication, and drive mechanisms.
Understanding of preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and basic troubleshooting techniques.
Knowledge of conveyors, feeders, gearboxes, couplings, and material-handling equipment.
Ability to read mechanical drawings, equipment manuals, and maintenance checklists.
Basic knowledge of maintenance planning, spare parts management, and root cause analysis.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and maintenance reporting systems.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with hands-on experience in crusher maintenance within a cement manufacturing plant, particularly limestone/raw material crushing, are preferred. The candidate should possess sound mechanical troubleshooting skills and the ability to support preventive and breakdown maintenance activities independently under the guidance of the senior maintenance team.

Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: Thiepkseh SC- West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator

1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with English, Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Role & responsibilities:
1. To oversee Daily mining operations like Drilling, Blasting, Breaking and Loading Ore.
2. To carry out Mines Development Activities.
3. To ensure compliance with Safety Regulations, Increase Productivity and Manage Resources efficiently.
4. To lead the Team of Mining Foremen, Mining Mates, Mine Supervisors and HEMM Operators.

15. Deal and Laise with Local Stake Holders for smooth production.
16. Strongly control the team members (60-80Nos) of manpower through Mine Foremen, Mining Mate and Supervisors.
17. Track and analyse key performance indicators (KPIs) for Mine operations, implement strategies to improve efficiencies, reduce costs, and enhance safety.
18. Do RCAs and implement findings on ground.
19. Promote and Enforce Safe & Best practices among Team Members, Develop and implement safety training programs at regular intervals.
20. Prepare and implement safe operation procedures at work site.

Job Summary
The Project Manager will provide overall leadership and coordination for the implementation of a maternal and newborn health strengthening project across selected health facilities in East Khasi Hills, Meghalaya.
The Project Manager (PM) serves as the backstopping to field programs and provides technical support for project design, implementation, monitoring, and documentations. Focused monitoring suggestions for activities the PM interfaces between the field staff, government of India, and other key stakeholders. The role requires program facilitation on key public health programming. The role also requires the ability to engage government, corporates, foundations and other key stakeholders for program execution. and Training and Capacity building of Project Team, All Kind of Physical and Financial Tracking of the project, The position works in collaboration with the Senior leadership, Program Managers and field team.


Responsibilities
Manage the Project: Clear articulation to lead the program/ project in light of outcome indicators and program goals. Manage program budgets, ensuring efficient use of resources and cost control. Vendor alignment, work screening and work reporting. Ensure assessments are aligned with relevant LaQshya and Kayakalp standards and project requirements.
Community members Sourcing: Identify and source potential candidates from various channels, including rural communities, educational institutions, and other relevant networks. Conduct outreach programs to engage with potential candidates.
Training Coordination: Collaborate with training partners to organize skill development programs in the state. Ensure the training curriculum is aligned with industry requirements and project goals.
Monitor and evaluate training progress, making necessary adjustments as required.
Community Participation Facilitation: Develop partnerships with employers and organizations to create job opportunities for project participants. Provide guidance and support to candidates during the job placement process.
Monitor candidates progress in their employment roles.
Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate records of candidate information, training schedules, and employment outcomes. Prepare regular reports for stakeholders, highlighting project achievements, challenges, and recommendations for improvement.
Project Management: Manage project budgets, ensuring efficient use of resources and cost control. Vendor alignment, work screening and work reporting


Requirements
Masters degree in Business Administration/ Agriculture/ Social Work/ Social Studies or related field.
Minimum Experience is required for 5 years

Description:
At Saturday Art Class (SArC), we believe that every child deserves the tools to imagine, express, and grow. Saturday Art Class is a non-profit organization that provides visual arts and social-emotional learning (SEL) education to children from low-income communities in India. By creating safe spaces for students to express themselves, we help them build essential skills to thrive during their formative years.
Join us as we continue to make creativity a right, not a privilege, for every child, everywhere.
Role Overview
The Manager will play a critical role in anchoring the organization\'s work in Meghalaya by serving as a key bridge between the Mumbai-based team and state government stakeholders. The role will ensure seamless coordination across partnerships, training initiatives, curriculum contextualisation, and on-ground implementation. Working closely with government officials, school systems, and internal teams, the Manager will enable effective communication, alignment, and execution, ensuring that program design is responsive to the local context while staying aligned with organizational goals.
Roles and Responsibilities
Government Liaisoning and Partnerships
Act as a key point of coordination with government stakeholders, including DERT, the Directorate of School Education, and the MPower team
Support communication, scheduling, and follow-ups for meetings, reviews, and program updates
Build and maintain strong working relationships with state and district-level stakeholders to ensure alignment and continuity
Prepare briefs, reports, and communication materials for government engagements
Proactively engage with government stakeholders to understand priorities, evolving needs, and policy directions, and translate these into program actions
Ensure timely sharing of updates, data, and reports with government officials to build trust and transparency.
Support the preparation and facilitation of review meetings, presentations, and field visits with government stakeholders.
Track key decisions, approvals, and action points from government interactions, ensuring timely follow-through.
Identify opportunities to deepen the partnership, including scale-up, integration into existing systems, and long-term collaboration.
Training Coordination and Support
Plan and coordinate teacher training programs in collaboration with internal teams and government partners
Manage logistics, communication, and on-ground facilitation support for training sessions.
Track participation, engagement, and feedback from educators to inform ongoing improvements.
Support documentation of training processes and outcomes.
Curriculum Contextualisation
Act as a key bridge between government stakeholders and the internal curriculum team to co-develop a contextually relevant and effective well-being curriculum
Work closely with the curriculum team to adapt and contextualise the visual arts curriculum for Meghalaya

Description:
Job Summary
The Civil Engineer will be responsible for planning, technical assessment, execution monitoring and quality supervision of construction, renovation, repair and infrastructure-development works undertaken by the Organisation. The role will ensure that civil works are completed in accordance with approved designs, specifications, budgets, timelines, safety requirements and organisational procurement and financial procedures. The position will also provide technical documentation and measurement-based verification to support transparent project implementation and payment processing.
Meghalaya


Responsibilities

A. Site Assessment and Technical Planning
Conduct site visits and assess existing infrastructure, site conditions and project requirements.
Prepare technical feasibility reports, layouts, drawings and specifications, as required.
Prepare detailed cost estimates, quantity calculations and Bills of Quantities (BOQs).
Identify material, labour, equipment and resource requirements and highlight technical risks.


B. Project Execution and Site Supervision
Supervise construction, renovation, repair and maintenance works at assigned locations.
Monitor contractors and vendors to ensure work is carried out as per approved drawings, BOQs, specifications and work orders.
Track site progress against approved timelines and budgets and submit periodic updates.
Identify delays, deviations and additional-work requirements and obtain written approval before execution of variations.
Coordinate with project teams, contractors, architects and other technical personnel.


C. Quality Control and Compliance
Inspect construction materials and workmanship at different stages of execution.
Ensure quality of materials and work conforms to approved specifications and applicable engineering standards.
Identify defects and recommend corrective measures within agreed timelines.
Monitor compliance with applicable building regulations, site-safety requirements and relevant standards.


D. Measurement and Contractor Bill Verification
Verify physical measurements and quantities of work completed at site.
Prepare or check Measurement Books (MBs) and item-wise measurement sheets.
Verify running and final contractor bills against actual work completed, approved BOQ and agreed rates.
Provide technical certification of work completed for payment processing, subject to organisational approval.
Document quantity variations, deductions and additional items with supporting justification.


E. Budgeting and Cost Monitoring
Prepare project-wise cost estimates and provide technical inputs for budget preparation.
Monitor expenditure and identify potential cost overruns or savings.
Review technical proposals for additional work and recommend cost-effective alternatives.
Ensure that work is not undertaken beyond the approved scope without prior written authorisation.


F. Procurement and Vendor Coordination
Prepare technical specifications and BOQs for procurement of civil works and materials.
Review vendor quotations for technical compliance and support preparation of technical comparisons.
Participate in technical evaluation of contractors and vendors, as required.
Coordinate with Procurement and Finance teams to ensure complete supporting documentation.


G. Safety, Documentation and Reporting
Monitor site-safety arrangements and report unsafe conditions or incidents promptly.
Maintain site inspection reports, progress records, approved drawings, BOQs and measurement records.
Maintain stage-wise and before-and-after photographs of civil works.
Prepare completion reports and technical completion certificates after verification of work.
Provide technical clarifications and records required for management reviews, audits or donor reporting.


Qualifications and Experience
Graduate degree or diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
Relevant experience in construction, renovation, infrastructure development or civil-work supervision.
Experience in preparing BOQs, cost estimates, technical drawings and measurement books.
Working knowledge of construction materials, quality standards, site supervision and contractor bill verification.
Experience in NGO, development-sector or institutional projects will be an advantage.


Skills and Competencies
Strong technical knowledge of civil construction and renovation works.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOQs and technical specifications.
Good measurement, estimation, costing and analytical skills.
Strong coordination, communication and vendor-management skills.
Ability to prepare clear site reports and maintain accurate documentation.
Proficiency in MS Office; knowledge of AutoCAD and relevant estimation tools will be an advantage.
Ability and willingness to travel to project sites, as required.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance Area: Timely completion; Expected Result: Civil works completed within approved timelines.
Performance Area: Budget adherence; Expected Result: Actual cost monitored against approved estimate and budget.
Performance Area: Quality; Expected Result: Compliance with approved specifications and timely closure of defects.
Performance Area: Measurement accuracy; Expected Result: Accurate and complete MBs and quantity verification.
Performance Area: Bill verification; Expected Result: Contractor bills technically checked against actual work and approved rates.
Performance Area: Documentation; Expected Result: Timely submission of site reports, photographs and completion records.
Performance Area: Safety and compliance; Expected Result: Prompt reporting and resolution/escalation of site-safety and compliance issues.


Working Relationships
The Civil Engineer will work closely with Project/Programme teams, Administration, Procurement, Finance, contractors, vendors and other stakeholders to ensure effective planning, execution, monitoring and documentation of civil works.


Authority and Accountability
The Civil Engineer is responsible for technical assessment, site supervision, measurement and technical recommendations. The Engineer shall not independently approve budgets, vendor selection, scope variations or payments unless specifically authorised in writing. All procurement, financial and administrative approvals shall follow the Organisations delegated-authority matrix and policies.

AboutCompany:
Woodland Hospital is a Multi-Specialty Hospital situated at the heart of the city at Dhankheti, Shillong which was established in 21st March 1991 as a Proprietary concern. Considering the paucity of standard medical facilities available in the state, Dr. W. Kharshiing and his wife Mrs. Margret Wahlang decided to start a Nursing Home offering better alternatives to the patients of the medically deficient state. It was such a dream that few may have been imagined to see in its present form.
The hospital was started with 28 Indoor beds, two Operation Theatres viz; One Major & One Minor, along with the very basic Diagnostic facilities likes: Pathology, X-Ray, Ultra-Sonography etc. The Departments were limited to General Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics and ENT. During the year 1994, the hospital was expanded to 56 bed capacity. The New Operation Theatre Complex, a CT Scan Machine and four bedded Intensive Care Unit were also added to meet the increasing demands of the people. The CT scan was the first one the State had ever seen in1995.
The hospital went on to Expand to 120 beds during the year 2001 with the addition of an annexed building. Woodland Hospital has always strived to introduce the latest advancements of medical technology and it introduced the Medical Resonance Imaging (MRI) the first one in the state in 2002. At present the hospital expanded to 160 beds with the addition of another annexed building in 2013. The Hospital is the only Hospital in the state which is well equipped with the ultra modern facilities.
In 2006 the Department of Pathology has been accredited by the National Accreditation Board for Testing & Calibration Laboratories (NABL) for Medical Testing and has been given the Certificate Number M-0213 in accordance with the ISO 15189:2007. The Department of Pathology of the Hospital is the first one in the entire state and the only fourth institution in the entire North East India to be accredited in the field of Medical Blood Testing by NABL at that point of time. This stature is not only the recognition of our expertise in the field for the past works done but is also the boost for the Department of Pathology to continue doing the same for ever. Woodland Hospital, Shillong is also NABH pre accredited.
On 15th September 2020, Woodland WK Hospital was inaugurated at Jowai in West Jaintia Hills District of Meghalaya. It is a 100 bedded Multispecialty Hospital having General beds, Semi-private beds and Single rooms. It is equipped with 14 I.C.U beds and 6 Neonatal I.C.U beds. It also has 3 Operation Theatres, 12 Dialysis beds, Endoscopy, X-Ray, CT- Scan, U.S.G, Department of Pathology and Department of Microbiology. Other services include O.P.D and I.P.D and round the clock Emergency Services. All Doctors quarters are within the Hospital premises.
Our other diagnostics centres are Woodland Medical Centre, Ladthalaboh, Jowai, Bell View Diagnostic Clinic, Mawkhar, Shillong, Woodland Diagnostic Centre, Nongkseh, Upper Shillong and Woodland Institute of Nursing, Latikor, Shillong

Description:
You will be the main point of contact for a small group of 3 to 5 client accounts. You run their client calls, plan and track their monthly work with our specialist teams, check the work before it reaches the client, and make sure every client gets what we promised, on time. You dont do the execution yourself. Our SEO, social media, ads, design, video and tech specialists do. You make sure it happens, and that its right.


What this Role Is
youve handled client accounts at a digital marketing agency, you understand marketing well enough to brief and check the work, and youre very organised.


What this Role Is Not
your background is IT project management, sales only, or SaaS customer support without marketing.


Responsibilities
Own your clients. Be the main contact for your 3 to 5 accounts. Lead the weekly and monthly client calls, and bring in a specialist when something technical needs explaining.
Plan the month. Take each clients agreed monthly plan and turn it into dated tasks, one task per line, on your client dashboard.
Track every day. Know whats happening on every task, spot delays early, and follow up with the team before a date slips.
Check before it goes out. Make sure every deliverable matches what the client asked for and what was agreed, after our team leads have approved the craft.
Report. Send each client a weekly update and a monthly report that explains results clearly.
Handle changes properly. Know the difference between a revision and new work. Log extra requests and get them priced, rather than quietly absorbing them.
Chase client inputs. Get the approvals, access and content you need from the client, early and in writing.
Keep and grow your accounts. Look after renewals, and spot where a client would benefit from more of our services.
Know your numbers. Understand the revenue and cost of your client group, and help keep it healthy.


Requirements
3 to 6 years of experience, with at least 2 years in client servicing or account management at a digital marketing agency
Has handled at least 3 clients at the same time
Understands social media, ads, SEO and content, and design and video well enough to brief and check the work

Consistent and calm under deadlines

Both B2B and B2C brands

Briefs designers and video editors clearly
Experience with social media ad creatives
Comfortable with Canva, Figma, Meta Business Suite and scheduling tools

Calendars approved and posts going live on time, every week
Fewer designs and posts sent back by clients
Better engagement and leads from social for each client
Clients happy and staying with us
A team that gets better under you

Job Summary
You will run hiring, onboarding, attendance and day-to-day HR for a growing marketing agency of 20+ people.


Responsibilities
Run hiring. Post jobs on Naukri, LinkedIn, Internshala, Instagram and through referrals, within a day of a role being approved.
Screen candidates. Review applications, make first screening calls, check portfolios for creative roles, and shortlist for interviews.
Keep the process moving. Schedule interviews, collect feedback, follow up with candidates, and keep the hiring tracker updated every day.
Close hires. Coordinate offer letters, documents and joining.

Hands-on hiring experience: posting, screening calls, scheduling and follow-ups
Comfortable on the phone with candidates every day
Organised, with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
Calm and firm, and good with young teams
Good written and spoken English


Nice To Have
Hiring for creative or marketing roles
Experience at a startup, agency or small company
Has hired interns in volume
Has built onboarding checklists or hiring trackers


KPIs
Jobs posted within 24 hours of approval
Applicants reviewed within 2 to 3 days, and shortlisted candidates contacted within 24 hours
No open role left stuck
Every new joiner set up on day one
Attendance and leave records always current


Job Type
Full-time


Working Hours
Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 6 PM, at our Mohali or Shillong office. Some Saturdays may be working days.

Job Summary
You will write and run marketing for our B2B and B2C clients: blogs, LinkedIn posts, website copy and emails, plus SEO and cold email campaigns.


Role Overview
you write clearly, youre curious about SEO and email marketing, and youre careful with facts.


What the role is not
you mainly want to do social media posting, graphic design or paid ads.


Experience
1 to 3 years (freshers with strong writing samples are welcome)


Responsibilities
Write. Blogs, LinkedIn posts, website copy and email copy, in each clients voice.

Clear, accurate writing with few rewrites needed
No unsourced claims in published work
Email campaigns that go out correctly, with fast replies
Tasks completed on time

Digital Marketing Executive, then Senior Executive, then Growth Marketing Lead.

Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 6 PM, at our Mohali or Shillong office. Some Saturdays may be working days.

Full-time

Job Summary
You will shoot and edit video for our B2B and B2C clients: reels, shorts, founder videos, podcasts, customer stories, ads and event coverage.
Job Type: Full-time


Responsibilities
Plan shoots. Shot lists, locations, timings and what the client needs to prepare.
Shoot. Founder videos, talking heads, brand content, testimonials, events and podcasts. Youll handle framing, lighting and clean audio.
Edit. Reels, shorts, YouTube videos, podcasts and ads, with strong hooks, good pacing and captions, ready for each platform.
Repurpose. Turn one long shoot into several short clips, in every size each platform needs.
Keep each clients style consistent. Follow the agreed style for each brand: fonts, colours, captions and pace.
Make video ads. Edit ads for our paid ads team, in the versions and sizes they need.
Stay organised. Keep footage and project files organised and backed up, so anything can be found later.
Raise the standard. Review edits from freelancers or junior editors, and suggest better ideas for shots, hooks and stories.
Requirements
3 to 6 years of video editing and shooting, with brand or business content
A portfolio with reels, shorts and talking-head work for real clients
Strong in Premiere Pro, Final Cut or DaVinci Resolve
Comfortable shooting with a DSLR or mirrorless camera, lights and mics
Fast, reliable turnaround
Takes feedback well
Nice To Have
Motion graphics (After Effects)
Podcast or multi-camera shoots
An eye for thumbnails and covers
Video ads experience
Has guided a junior editor
KPIs
Videos delivered on time
Few revisions needed
Consistent quality and style for each client
Video results like views and watch time improving
Perks
Shoot and edit for a wide range of B2B and B2C brands
Room to shape our in-house video style
Work alongside designers, social media and ads teams

Description:
Job Type
Full-time


Job Summary
You will lead SEO, content and outbound (cold email and LinkedIn) for our B2B and B2C clients in India, the UK, the UAE and the US. You plan the strategy, guide a small team to deliver it, and own the results: more traffic, more leads and more sales meetings for our clients.


What this role is
You have done hands-on SEO and outbound for clients, and you are ready to lead a team.


Responsibilities
Plan the strategy. Build SEO, content, LinkedIn and cold email plans for each client, with clear targets you can stand behind.
Lead the team. Decide who works on what, brief them clearly, review their work and help them improve.
Run SEO. Audits, technical fixes, content plans, link building, and getting clients found in AI search tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity.
Run outbound. Set up and manage cold email and LinkedIn campaigns, from domains and deliverability to lists, copy and replies. Make sure campaigns follow email laws in each country.
Own website projects. Plan pages and content, and see sites through to launch, working with our design and tech teams.
Check quality. Nothing goes to a client until it meets the standard: accurate, well written, every fact checked.
Work with clients. Join client calls, explain results honestly, and say no politely when a request is outside the agreed work.
Report results. Share weekly and monthly progress with our delivery team.


Requirements
4 to 7 years in B2B and B2C marketing, at an agency, a consultancy or an in-house team
Hands-on SEO and content experience
Hands-on cold email or LinkedIn outbound experience
Has managed or guided at least 1 or 2 people (team members or freelancers)
Comfortable talking to clients, including when the news is not good
Clear written English


Nice to Have
Experience with tools like Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, Apollo, Instantly, Smartlead or Lemlist
Worked with international clients (UK, US, UAE)
Worked on website builds or redesigns
Uses AI tools well, and checks their output properly


KPIs
Client work delivered on time and to a high standard
More traffic, leads and meetings for clients, against the targets you set
Fast replies to every lead from outbound campaigns
A team that gets better under you
Clear, on-time progress reports


Working Hours
Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 6 PM, at our Mohali or Shillong office. Some Saturdays may be working days.

Description:
A. About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Manager/ Senior Analyst Management Consulting (Commercial) to support the execution of a consultancy assignment with Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) and its subsidiaries viz. Meghalaya Power Generation Corporation Limited, Meghalaya Power Transmission Corporation Limited and Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited. The role involves supporting the Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited in supporting in day to day commercial activities such as monitoring the billing, collections, identification of energy and revenue leakages etc.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on Commercial function. Key responsibilities include:

Business Process Re-engineering
Review the existing process of reporting of key commercial parameters of the Distribution utility.
Prepare a Standard Operating Procedure for reporting of the key parameters along with responsibility matrix.
Engage with all the Stakeholders and get the feedback from them on the proposed SOP including middle and lower management.
Assist in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure within timeframes as approved by the Management.
Provide on recommendations on digital interventions along with the probable solutions along with the cost benefit analysis.
Formulate standardized daily, weekly and monthly reporting formats on key parameters with diagnostic analysis along with probable interventions to capture adverse deviations.

Billing and Collection
Monitoring the effective of billing and facilitating in ensuring 100 % billing.
Formulating Process of Billing Quality check. like- Under billed consumers, Overbilled, never billed.
Preparing of Billing, Collection & customer data Management Information reports from the billing Master data.
Billing & Collection Analysis of consumers of various categories.
Suggesting Changes & improvement of Billing system to minimize errors and system gaps.
Work in close coordination with the Unified Billing System provider.
Analyze the data of Smart Metered Consumers in terms of key parameters and prepare a report on the deviations along with the corrective actions. The report is to be circulated to all lower, middle and top management and vigilance team for corrective actions.
Suggesting the utilities on best practices in the industry for billing and collection checks.
Coordinate with Distribution Franchisee operator for submission of monthly MIS as per the contract document.

Management Review
Prepare presentation at sub-division level for the review meeting by management highlighting the key parameters along with the diagnostic analysis and suggestions for improvement.
Coordinate with the sub-divisions level officers for the Action Taken Report after each review meeting.

C. Required skill set:
Strong technical and commercial knowledge about the power distribution business.
Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
Experience in handling smart meter data
Working knowledge of key regulatory interventions effecting the commercial parameters of DISCOM.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
BE/ B. Tech/ MBA/ M. Tech (Candidates with B. Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
Knowledge of advanced MS Excel and Microsoft Power point is highly preferred.
Atleast 5 Years experience in Commercial Matters of DISCOM or consultancy company.

E. Location:
Shillong, Meghalaya.
The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.
AboutCompany:
Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. Since the beginning of its operations in India in 2008, Mercados has been supporting clients across the energy sector value chain. We strive to promote efficient and sustainable energy markets; design effective regulations and assist energy businesses to succeed. Our approach integrates innovative, state-of-the-art techniques with practical, tailor-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurugram, Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Lucknow and various Project offices across India.
Mercados has a dedicated team of over 185+ (and counting) professionals and has successfully completed 800+ assignments for its esteemed clients. Mercados operates under two broad verticals, namely Management Consulting and ‘Enterprise SaaS’. While the Management Consulting Vertical provides leading edge Advisory solutions to generation companies with over 42 GWs of conventional and renewable energy-based capacities, distribution companies with over 54 million consumers and large industrial consumers: the Enterprise SaaS Vertical aims at offering tailor-made digital solutions, power portfolio management, generation planning and algorithmic trading solutions – “jouleOS” - to Utilities in India.
Our Consulting portfolio envelopes diverse segments like ‘Strategy and Business Growth’, ‘Policy, Economic Analysis and Regulations’, ‘Planning, Energy Markets & Simulation Models’, ‘Transaction Advisory Services’, ‘Integrated Energy Supply Services’ and ‘Performance Improvement (Utility Management Services)’.

Description:
A. About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Manager/ Senior Analyst Management Consulting (Procurement &Tendering) to support the implementation of a consultancy assignment with Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) and its subsidiaries viz. Meghalaya Power Generation Corporation Limited, Meghalaya Power Transmission Corporation Limited and Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited. The role involves supporting procurement and tendering activities for utility projects, ensuring compliance with procurement procedures, facilitating bid management, vendor coordination, contract finalization, and monitoring procurement-related project deliverables.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on procurement and tendering functions. Key responsibilities include:

Procurement & Tendering Support
• Provide day-to-day support to MeECL and its subsidiaries on procurement and tendering activities.
• Review the existing Operating Procedure of MeECL for bidding of services and goods.
• Prepare Request for Proposals (RFPs) for procurement of materials and services as per client requirements and in line with the State and Central Procurement Guidelines.
• Coordinate with the State E Procurement management team.
• Advise the client from time to time on updation of the procurement process and digital intervention in the procurement.

Vendor Identification & Bid Management
• Identify and facilitate the selection of suitable vendors in line with MeECL procurement processes.
• Support release of RFPs and tender documents.
• Coordinate pre-bid meetings and manage clarifications with prospective bidders.
• Facilitate all procurement activities through to contract award.

Bid Evaluation
• Review all the technical and commercial bids.
• Find out the deviations in the submitted bids from the conditions in the RfP.
• Prepare comparative statements, bid evaluation reports, and recommendations for tender finalization.
• Support evaluation committees during the bid assessment process.

MIS & Reporting
• Prepare, review, and validate MIS reports, dashboards, progress reports, and periodic submissions.
• Prepare a database for the bids with details of technical requirement, deviations allowed, revisions in the tenders done if any etc.
• Maintain procurement documentation and ensure timely reporting to the Client.
• Ensure quality and accuracy of reports, presentations, and Minutes of Meetings (MoMs).

Stakeholder Coordination
• Coordinate with officials MeECL, contractors, vendors, and internal consulting teams.
• Monitor procurement milestones and facilitate timely resolution of issues.

Additional Responsibilities
• Prepare a Standard Operating Procedures with timelines for each type of procurement and ensure compliance of the approved procedure.
• Support any other procurement and tendering activities assigned by the Client.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives and procurement best practices within the project.

C. Required skill set:
• Strong understanding of procurement and tendering processes in the Power Sector including, distribution, generation and transmission.
• Experience in preparation of RFPs, bid evaluation, vendor selection, and contract award processes.
• Knowledge of public procurement procedures and utility procurement practices.
• Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
• Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
• Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
• BE/ B. Tech or MBA (Candidates with B.Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
• Atleast 5 Years experience in Procurement, Tendering & Contracts Management in a Power Utility / Discom company or Power utility consultancy company.

E. Location:
• Shillong, Meghalaya.
• The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
• We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.
AboutCompany:
Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. Since the beginning of its operations in India in 2008, Mercados has been supporting clients across the energy sector value chain. We strive to promote efficient and sustainable energy markets; design effective regulations and assist energy businesses to succeed. Our approach integrates innovative, state-of-the-art techniques with practical, tailor-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurugram, Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Lucknow and various Project offices across India.
Mercados has a dedicated team of over 185+ (and counting) professionals and has successfully completed 800+ assignments for its esteemed clients. Mercados operates under two broad verticals, namely Management Consulting and ‘Enterprise SaaS’. While the Management Consulting Vertical provides leading edge Advisory solutions to generation companies with over 42 GWs of conventional and renewable energy-based capacities, distribution companies with over 54 million consumers and large industrial consumers: the Enterprise SaaS Vertical aims at offering tailor-made digital solutions, power portfolio management, generation planning and algorithmic trading solutions – “jouleOS” - to Utilities in India.
Our Consulting portfolio envelopes diverse segments like ‘Strategy and Business Growth’, ‘Policy, Economic Analysis and Regulations’, ‘Planning, Energy Markets & Simulation Models’, ‘Transaction Advisory Services’, ‘Integrated Energy Supply Services’ and ‘Performance Improvement (Utility Management Services)’.

Description:
Job Summary
You will be the senior point of contact for our clients, and the person who checks every piece of work before it reaches them. Social posts, ads, blogs, videos, websites, reports: if it goes to a client, you make sure it is right, on time, and what we promised.


Role Overview
You have handled clients at a digital marketing agency for several years, you can tell good marketing work from average work, and you are ready to be the final say on quality.


Role Is Not
Your background is IT project delivery, sales only, or corporate roles outside marketing.


Responsibilities
Check and approve client work. Review work from our SEO, social media, ads, design, video and web teams before it goes out. Send it back with clear feedback when it isnt good enough.
Be the senior client contact. Build strong relationships with our clients, lead monthly review calls, and be the person they call when something matters.
Make sure we deliver what we promised. Track every client against what was agreed. Spot problems early and fix them before the client notices.
Handle the hard conversations. Delays, results below target, requests outside the agreed work. Handle them calmly and honestly.
Lead our team leads on client matters. Work with the leads of each team. Hold them to quality and deadlines, and make the call when two teams need the same people at the same time.
Keep clients and grow accounts. Look after renewals, notice where a client would benefit from more of our services, and help us scope new work realistically.
Report to the founders. Give them a clear picture of every client: whats going well, whats at risk, what youve decided.


Requirements
5 to 8 years of experience, with at least 3 years in client servicing or account management at a digital marketing agency
Has handled multiple clients at once, including senior client contacts
Can judge the quality of marketing work across several areas: social media, ads, content and SEO, design and video
Has worked with several teams (creative, performance, content) to get client work delivered
Calm and direct in difficult client conversations
Excellent written and spoken English


Nice to Have
International clients (UK, US, UAE)
Has led or managed a small team
Understands marketing numbers: leads, cost per lead, traffic, engagement
Experience with both B2B and B2C clients


Job Type
Full-time

Job Type: Full-time
Summary: You will run paid ads for our B2B and B2C clients on Meta, Google, YouTube and LinkedIn, and own the results: leads, sales and cost per lead.
Experience: 4 to 7 years in performance marketing
Role overview: you have personally run Meta and Google Ads for several clients, managed real budgets, and been accountable for the numbers.

whatThisRoleIs: you have personally run Meta and Google Ads for several clients, managed real budgets, and been accountable for the numbers.

Both B2B and B2C clients

Familiarity with safety protocols and regulations.

Familiarity with industry regulations and standards.

Description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Attendant Operator to join our team at Sumitomo Chemical India Private Limited. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in chemical plant operations and be able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Roles and Responsibility


Operate and maintain chemical plant equipment for safe and efficient production.

Monitor and control chemical processes to meet quality and quantity standards.

Collaborate with other operators and maintenance staff to troubleshoot issues.

Implement safety procedures and protocols to prevent accidents and injuries.

Conduct regular inspections of equipment and facilities to identify areas for improvement.

Develop and implement process improvements to increase productivity and reduce costs.


Job Requirements


Strong knowledge of chemical plant operations and safety procedures.

Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly with colleagues.

Familiarity with chemical plant software and instrumentation.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Ability to lift heavy objects and stand for long periods.

High school diploma or equivalent required; degree in a relevant field preferred.

Job Responsibilities for field geologist:

1. Conduct geological reconnaissance, field investigations, and detailed geological mapping.

2. Identify lithological units, mineral occurrences, geological structures, and alteration zones.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Project Planning & Execution
Lead end-to-end execution of Greenfield and brownfield projects.
Develop detailed project schedules, milestones, budgets, and execution strategies.
Ensure projects are completed within approved timelines and budgets.
Monitor project progress and resolve execution bottlenecks proactively.
Prepare weekly and monthly project progress reports for management.
Engineering & Technical Coordination
Coordinate with Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Instrumentation, and Production teams.
Review engineering drawings, layouts, BOQs, and technical specifications.
Supervise installation, commissioning, and performance testing of plant equipment.
Ensure compliance with engineering standards and project specifications.
Vendor & Contractor Management
Identify and evaluate contractors, consultants, and suppliers.
Manage tendering, techno-commercial evaluations, and contract execution.
Monitor contractor productivity, quality, billing, and resource deployment.
Ensure timely delivery of equipment and project materials.
Cost & Budget Control
Prepare CAPEX budgets and monitor project expenditures.
Control project costs through effective planning and procurement.
Verify contractor bills and recommend payments.
Maintain strict control over project budgets and resource utilization.
Safety & Compliance
Ensure adherence to statutory regulations and industrial safety standards.
Implement HSE policies throughout project execution.
Coordinate approvals with government departments and regulatory authorities.
Ensure compliance with environmental norms and quality standards.
Project Monitoring & Reporting
Track project progress using MS Project or Primavera.
Conduct daily, weekly, and monthly project review meetings.
Maintain project documentation, DPRs, MIS, risk registers, and progress dashboards.
Report project status, risks, delays, and mitigation plans to senior management.
Cross-Functional Coordination
Work closely with Purchase, Stores, Finance, Production, and Maintenance, HR, and Administration teams.
Coordinate with consultants, EPC contractors, OEMs, and government authorities.
Resolve interdepartmental issues affecting project execution.

Preferred candidate profile
1015 years of project management experience in Ferro Alloys, Steel, Mining, Power Plant, Metals, Cement, or Heavy Engineering industries.
Proven experience in plant expansion, equipment installation, commissioning, and infrastructure development.
Experience handling projects valued at 25 Crores or above will be preferred. Industry employers typically seek experience in large CAPEX execution, multidisciplinary coordination, and cost control for such roles.

Description:
Position: Community Program & Skill Development Officer
Department: Hospital Administration / Community Outreach
Reporting To: Medical Superintendent
Location: Tura, Meghalaya
Gender: Male or Female (Both can apply)
Position Summary
The Community Program & Skill Development Officer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing community outreach programs, health awareness campaigns, and skill development initiatives in villages and surrounding areas of Tura, Meghalaya. The role requires building strong relationships with local communities, government agencies, NGOs, schools, and village leaders to improve public health awareness and healthcare accessibility.
Key Responsibilities
Community Outreach & Awareness
Plan and conduct health awareness programs in villages, schools, community centres, and local institutions.
Organize health camps, screening programs, and preventive healthcare awareness drives.
Educate communities on topics such as maternal and child health, nutrition, sanitation, hygiene, communicable and non-communicable diseases.
Develop strategies to increase community participation in hospital-led health initiatives.
Design and implement skill development and capacity-building programs for community members.
Conduct training programs for community volunteers, healthcare workers, and self-help groups.
Identify local skill gaps and create relevant development initiatives.
Coordinate with government departments and development agencies for training support.
Build and maintain relationships with village heads, local authorities, NGOs, schools, and community-based organizations.
Liaise with government departments and healthcare agencies for collaborative programs.
Represent the hospital in community meetings and public events.
Develop IEC (Information, Education, and Communication) materials for awareness campaigns.
Promote hospital services and healthcare initiatives within target communities.
Utilize local languages and culturally appropriate communication methods to maximize outreach impact.
Required Qualifications
Graduate degree in Social Work, Community Development, Public Health, Sociology, Rural Development, Healthcare Management, or related field.
Postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in community development, healthcare outreach, CSR projects, rural development, skill development, or social sector initiatives.
Experience working with rural communities in Meghalaya or the Northeast region is preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and public speaking abilities.
Ability to conduct community mobilization and awareness programs.
Good networking and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational and reporting capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Ability to travel extensively to villages and remote locations around Tura and Meghalaya.
Knowledge of local languages and cultural practices will be an advantage.
Preferred Attributes
Passion for community service and public health improvement.
Leadership skills and ability to work independently.
Problem-solving and initiative-taking mindset.
Strong interpersonal and team-building abilities.
Those interested can share their cv to hrgen@acarehospitals.com

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.
Compensation & Benefits
Competitive base salary: ${salary}
Performance-based commission and bonus structure
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
Company-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

Block Functional Specialist Financial Inclusion
Shillong, Meghalaya
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Block Functional Specialist Financial Inclusion to drive financial access, literacy, and empowerment initiatives for rural communities and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
Key Responsibilities
Bank Linkage & Loan Facilitation: Facilitate SHG-bank linkages, streamline loan application processing, and monitor sanctioning, disbursement, and repayment.
Stakeholder Coordination: Liaise closely with local banks, Bank Sakhis, and Business Correspondents (BCs) to improve financial delivery networks.
Financial Literacy & Awareness: Conduct structured awareness programs on financial management and promote key government social security schemes (PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY).
Enterprise Support & Insurance: Assist SHG members in securing financial access for local enterprises, and support insurance enrollment and claim settlements.

Description:
Job Summary
Programme Lead - Community Libraries
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya, India
Contract: Fixed term consulting contract
Based on previous CTC and experience
Project Background
Sauramandala Foundation is an NGO founded in 2018 with a vision to bring about systemic change in the lives of remote communities through empathetic, collaborative, and contextual solutions that are co-created with the communities themselves.
About the Project (CM Youth Center):
The Government of Meghalaya, in partnership with Sauramandala Foundation, has established 22 rural community centres for youth, called the Chief Ministers Youth Centers (CMYC) with an aim to build resilience, agency and problem-solving skills in the community. The key programmes in the CMYCs are - Self Designed Learning, Entrepreneurship Development, Sports Coaching, Arts and Theatre and a Community Library Programme. The learning is open to all ages to have more involvement from the community. The CMYCs are set to expand from 22 centers to cover all 55 blocks of Meghalaya over a 2 year period.
Objective of the Engagement
To design and operationalize well-resourced, welcoming libraries in CMYCs that:
Build a culture of reading by working closely with children, young adults and youth in the community.
Serve as learning hubs supporting adolescent well-being and development.
Scope of Work
Curation
Build vibrant, culturally rooted, multilingual collections for children, young adults and youth.
Curate collections across themes of well-being, mental health, coming of age, gender, environment, sci-fi, indigenous knowledge and local culture and so on.
Ensure enough reading materials for beginner to confident and advanced readers.
Programme Design
Support the design of libraries and child and youth-friendly spaces.
Design a joyful community library programme that makes reading social, engaging and meaningful.
Create spaces for dialogue and self expression - reading circles, book discussions, open mics, writing labs, movie screenings and debrief reflections.
Integrate life skills and SEL into the library programme to build empathy, self-confidence, critical thinking etc.
Design for the library activities to travel to nearby villages around the Youth Center and to engage with existing Youth Clubs.
Building Community Ownership
Position the CMYC and the libraries as a community asset by engaging the community especially the adults to build a connection with the space.
Organise reading festivals, youth showcases, and community celebrations.
Create systems to encourage youth to play an active role in shaping the libraries - youth volunteers, library leaders and so on.
Strengthening libraries as safe, welcoming, learning hubs
Develop a simple monitoring framework for smooth operations.
Train first-time libraries with tools and techniques on youth engagement, creating safe spaces, facilitating shared reading experiences in the libraries.
Bring in low-cost digital tools and offline e-resources where possible.
Document learnings and adolescent and youth stories from the libraries.
Expected area of expertise
Master's Degree in Education/Library & Information Science or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
8-9 years of experience in setting up community libraries, training librarians and educators to build a culture of reading.
Any certifications on library science or engagements with organisations working in the field is preferred.
Strong knowledge of curation for different age groups from children to young adults and youth.
Ability to design and facilitate training workshops for first-time librarians.
Adaptability to an agile, cross-functional, collaborative working environment.
