Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Job Summary
Recruitment Associate. Location: Meghalaya, India. Contract type: Fixed term consulting contract up to . Negotiable as per experience.


Role Overview
The Recruitment Associate will assist the Recruitment Manager in managing recruitment processes. This role involves coordinating candidate interviews, assisting with onboarding processes, maintaining recruitment databases and ensuring smooth recruitment operations. The Associate will also provide administrative support to the HR team as needed.


What will you do as the Recruitment Associate

Supporting a Positive Work Environment
Assist in implementing practices that support a safe, inclusive, and respectful workplace.
Help coordinate staff recognition efforts and team engagement activities.
Support efforts to gather employee feedback and share insights with the HR team for cultural improvements.


Recruitment & Onboarding Support
Assist with posting job openings, screening resumes, scheduling interviews, and preparing interview documentation.
Coordinate reference checks and support onboarding logistics for new hires.
Maintain accurate records of recruitment and onboarding processes.


Employee Relations Assistance
Support the HR Team in handling employee concerns and maintaining clear documentation.
Help coordinate and document discussions related to workplace issues or grievances.
Promote open communication by helping to manage feedback tools and suggestion channels.


Performance Management Support

Help track the completion of employee KRAs and appraisals.
Provide administrative support for performance discussions and performance improvement processes.


Training & Development Coordination
Support the planning and logistics of training sessions (e.g., booking venues, managing attendance, sharing materials).
Collect participant feedback and compile summaries for review.
Assist in the development of basic training content related to values, inclusion, and workplace conduct.


HR Administration
Prepare and maintain HR documents such as offer letters, contracts, and confirmation letters.
Keep employee records up to date, including attendance, leave, and personnel files.
Assist in the administration of employee benefits, leave tracking, and policy communication.


Who are we looking for
Experience: 2-3 years of experience in recruitment or HR support roles.
Qualifications: Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related fields.
Strong organizational, communication and administrative skills.
Experience in recruitment processes, interview scheduling and candidate coordination.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Project Identification and Scope
Build and maintain a pipeline of stores, markets or business areas that may require focused project intervention.

2. Business Diagnosis and Opportunity Assessment
Analyse sales, target achievement, market potential, competitor performance, product mix, stock availability, promoter productivity, display, finance penetration and retailer engagement when relevant to the project.
Conduct field visits and structured discussions with store owners, promoters, TLs, Sales, Retail and other teams to identify the actual causes of weak performance.

3. Project Planning
Prepare practical 30-day, 60-day or 90-day project plans with targets, activities, owners, deadlines, resources and expected results.
Recommend project-specific interventions involving manpower, stock, product mix, display, training, finance, retailer schemes, local activation, relationship improvement or process correction.

4. Retailer Negotiation and Stakeholder Alignment
Present the business opportunity and proposed solution to store owners, distributors and other external partners.
Negotiate measurable commitments related to sales, stock investment, display space, promoter placement, branding, finance, local activity or other project requirements.

5. Cross Functional Execution
Coordinate with Sales, Retail, GTM, Marketing, Branding, Training, Affordability, Supply Chain and branch teams according to the needs of each project.

6. Fortress Store and Core Store Projects
Support the opening, ramp-up, performance improvement and turnaround of Fortress Stores.
Lead structured breakthrough projects for high-potential core outlets where vivo has a meaningful opportunity to improve sales or share.

7. Monitoring and Project Closure
Maintain a project tracker covering the baseline, target, actions, owners, deadlines, risks, support required and current status.
Review performance weekly and distinguish completed activity from actual business impact.
Provide concise management updates focused on results, major risks, unresolved dependencies and decisions required.

Preferred candidate profile
Graduate degree in Business, Marketing, Retail Management or a related discipline. An MBA is preferred but not essential.
Four to seven years of relevant experience in smartphones, consumer electronics, telecom, FMCG, retail operations, channel development or field-project execution.
At least two years of experience independently managing store improvement, channel development, territory improvement or another measurable business project.
Evidence of completing projects with a clear baseline, personal actions and measurable before-and-after results.
Experience working with retailers, distributors, promoters or field-sales teams.
Ability to analyse store-level or territory-level data and convert findings into practical actions.
Strong communication, retailer negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple departments even when the project owners do not report directly to the role holder.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including project trackers and business-review presentations.
Willingness to travel frequently and spend significant time in the market.
Good English and Hindi communication. Knowledge of Assamese or other Northeast Indian languages will be an advantage.
AboutCompany:
Rongsheng Mobile India Private Limited is the Super Distributor of vivo Smartphones for the North-East region of India. Established on 24 November 2014 and operational since December 2014, the company has consistently played a vital role in strengthening vivo's presence across the region through an extensive distribution network and customer-focused operations.

Over the years, Rongsheng Mobile India Pvt. Ltd. has expanded its business operations across Assam and the North-Eastern States, including Sikkim, creating significant employment opportunities and contributing to the growth of the region's retail and distribution ecosystem.

Our North-East Head Office is strategically located at First Floor, Nikita Pinnacle, Khanapara, Guwahati, Assam, providing a comfortable, collaborative, and professional environment for our employees.

To ensure seamless supply chain operations, our central warehouse is located at Lokhra, Guwahati. Equipped to support efficient inventory management and timely product distribution, the warehouse works in close coordination with our Marketing Distributors (MDs), branch offices, and sales teams across the region.

At Rongsheng, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We are committed to fostering a culture of integrity, teamwork, innovation, and continuous learning while providing rewarding career opportunities for professionals who aspire to grow in the dynamic mobile and consumer electronics industry.

Join Rongsheng Mobile India Pvt. Ltd. and be a part of a fast-growing organization driving innovation and connectivity across North-East India.

Job Description

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals and youth on rural development, agriculture, skilling and economic inclusion, along with 15+ central and state government partners.

Our economic inclusion journey for 25 million Indians, has reached 10 states with $250M of government funding to cover 1.25M people. Our incubator, accelerator and grand challenges have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs including 17 Forbes 30U30, 3 EarthShot Prize winners, 1 Time Magazine cover and more.

Set up with support from 90+ eminent philanthropists , 40+ corporates and 15+ foundations including Gates, Mackenzie Scott, Vinod Khosla, Nandan Nilekani, Tata Trusts, Skoll, Meta, LinkedIn, HDFC, Mphasis, KPMG and LOreal, we are contributing towards a "poverty-free India, within our lifetime".

What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals a contributing member to the economy:

Enable govt to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iterate the design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale with quality.

What will you do
The/Nudge is working with various state SRLMs to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting vulnerable rural women through community institutions.
To understand and practice the Spirits of The/Nudge Institute and the respective SRLMs
Ensure all project activities are implemented on time with utmost quality as per approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP)/ Standard Operating Procedure (SoP)/ Package of Practice (PoP)/ Community Operational Manual (COM) in the respective districts.
Support the district in projects under PVTG Domain.
Coordinate with DMMU and BMMU to ensure smooth implementation of the project .
Coordinate and facilitate in organizing capacity building training of project team and community.
Coordinate and lead in organizing any project related event at regional and district.
Coordinate and support in any field visits of dignitaries and officials.
Ensure timely planning and implementation of project activities.
Ensure proper documentation and reporting related to the project to respective offices.
Facilitate the timely collection/ entry, processing and reporting of data.
Support and practice monitoring evaluation of projects.
Good stakeholder management at the grassroots level.

Who are we looking for in this role
Candidate must be graduate; post-graduate will be preferred, in relevant streams like rural development, rural management, agriculture, forestry, social work, anthropology etc.
Candidate must have 4-6 years of relevant experience in the development sector/ rural development projects/ poverty eradication projects/ livelihood promotion projects/ tribal development projects.
Candidate with work experience working in district-level positions in National Rural Livelihood Mission/ State Rural Livelihood Missions in Institution Building, Capacity Building, Social Inclusion, Social Development, and Livelihood promotion will be preferred.
The candidate must have her/his own two-wheeler with a valid driving license as it is a field job.
The Location for this role is based in Eastern West Khasi Hills

What s in it for you

Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

You can learn more about what we do and how we do it through this deck .

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics

Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development. The role requires a candidate with practical knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic products market and experience in handling channel sales.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers.
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.
For a Team Lead position, guide team members, monitor field activities, and support achievement of territory-level targets.
Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Candidates must have experience in Pharma / Pharma OTC / Generic products.
Candidates with experience as Medical Representatives (MRs) may be considered only if their experience includes retail, distributor, dealer, stockist, or channel sales.
Experience in dealer/distributor handling and market development is mandatory.
Experience in local store/pharmacy visits and product promotion will be preferred.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
Candidates with B.Pharm / D.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / equivalent qualifications may be preferred, depending on relevant sales experience.
Key Skills
Pharma Sales Business Development
Dealer Distributor Management
Retail/Local Market Visits
Brand Product Promotion
Channel Sales Market Development
Sales Target Achievement

The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market, good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets.

Description:
About the Role
CitiusTech is looking for a motivated and customer-focused Desktop Support Engineer to join our IT Operations team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing end-user support, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, managing IT assets, and ensuring seamless IT services for employees and business stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Install, configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair desktops, laptops, printers, peripherals, and mobile devices.
Provide technical support for Windows and Mac operating systems.
Support Microsoft Office 365, Outlook, Exchange, VPN, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Single Sign-On (SSO).
Manage user accounts and access through Active Directory (AD) and related tools.
Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, networking, and system issues.
Provide remote and on-site support to end users, including senior management and executive users.
Handle support tickets and ensure timely resolution within defined SLAs.
Perform desktop imaging, software installations, upgrades, and patch management.
Maintain IT asset inventory and participate in periodic audits.
Create and maintain technical documentation and knowledge base articles.
Collaborate with Desktop Engineering, Network, Security, and Enterprise Application teams for issue resolution and project execution.
Ensure compliance with security policies, antivirus updates, and system patching requirements.
Required Skills
Knowledge of Windows 10/11 and Mac OS troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience with Active Directory, Office 365, Outlook, and Exchange.
Experience in Desktop Support, IT Helpdesk, End User Support, and Remote Support.
Basic understanding of networking concepts such as LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and DNS.
Exposure to ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of ITIL best practices.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-oriented environment.

Eligibility
Graduation in IT
6 months to 2 year of experience in Desktop Support, Technical Support, IT Helpdesk, or End User Support.
Willingness to work in rotational shifts and provide occasional weekend support.
Initially contractor later contractor get converted
Immediate/ 30 days

location- Navi Mumbai(Airoli)
Rotational shift( 5 days working)

If you are interested then revert on same email.

Description:
Company
Qualcomm India Private Limited
Job Area
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering
Job Summary
Qualcomm graphics is the best in the mobile GPU world with the best perf/watt, perf/area and in raw performance. The GPU team has well established RnD teams from Architecture and Design to Post Silicon Validation and Functional Debug in Bangalore. The team delivers on products from the Snapdragon 800 series to the low tier 200 series. You will be joining a successful engineering department whose deliveries can be found in billions of smartphones, wearables.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
Experience
3 Years
Eligibility
Fresh graduates and early-career engineers from
Education
B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science, ECE, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related disciplines
Role Overview
Qualcomm's GPU team is looking for highly motivated fresh graduates and early-career engineers interested in next-generation GPU, AI/ML, computer architecture, and high-performance computing technologies.
You will work alongside architecture, design, software, and validation teams on performance analysis, system-level debugging, research, automation, and development of future computing platforms.
Key Responsibilities
Work on next-generation GPU and compute architectures.
Contribute to architecture analysis, performance studies, validation, and debugging.
Investigate complex hardware/software and system-level issues and perform root-cause analysis.
Develop tools, automation, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.

About the programme:
This 12-month apprenticeship, under India's National Apprenticeship Training Scheme, provides valuable on-the-job training; Please note, there is no obligation for permanent employment with Deutsche Bank Group upon completion of the Apprenticeship Training tenure.
Role Description
About DWS
DWS, publicly listed asset management division of Deutsche Bank, is one of the world's leading investment management organizations with assets under management. DWS provides flexible products and solutions to a wide range of investment opportunities across all asset classes from pooled funds to highly customized portfolios for a wide range of investors and offers individuals and institutions traditional and alternative investments across all major asset classes.
About the team
The Platform Sustainability function is a cross-divisional function, linked to both the investment and product divisions of DWS Group. It coordinates and steers the business implementation of DWSs Sustainability Strategy as well as the sustainability related regulatory requirements in the product and investment areas. Its focus is on the liquid product range of DWS Group and the product-related sustainability activities for alternative investments. Its activities comprise the development of sustainability-related frameworks as well as their integration into engagement processes, ESG integration processes and product-specific investment policies.
The Product Infrastructure & Standards team is part of Platform Sustainability within the Product Division.
The team is responsible for developing the sustainability-related product infrastructure including data management and contributing to product disclosure processes.
In this responsibility, the team plays a key role in designing efficient processes for a technology-driven future. In addition, the team actively contributes to navigating regulatory developments that are shaping the industry. To achieve this, it works closely together with colleagues across the Product Division and other relevant sustainability experts at DWS globally.
Your key responsibilities
As a Product Sustainability Analyst of the Product Sustainabilitys Infrastructure & Standards Team, you will be jointly responsible for
Analysing and conceptualizing the sustainability-related data and process flow from product development to the monitoring of investment guidelines compliance
Coordinating and overseeing the implementation of systematic changes in close collaboration with business and infrastructure teams
Developing a workflow tool for product launches
Automating existing processes related to fund disclosures
Supporting development of sustainability-related product infrastructure with exposure to sustainability specialists and close
collaboration with sustainability investment experts
Your skills and experience
Essential skills:
University degree in Commerce/Science or similar
Candidates with full time exp refrain from applying
Candidates with Master degree refrain from applying
Candidates holding PF/UAN no. not eligible to apply
Fresh graduates only can apply
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) for documentation purposes

Description:
Incoming, In-Process & Final Inspection: Conduct thorough quality checks of raw materials (steel bars), in-process components (turning, grinding, induction hardening, hard chrome plating), and finished piston rods as per Control Plans and Customer Drawings.
Precision Metrology & Testing: Measure critical dimensions, geometric tolerances, surface roughness (Ra/Rz), and plating thickness using standard and advanced inspection instruments.
Non-Conformance & Rejection Control: Identify, tag, segregate, and quarantine non-conforming products (NC) to prevent unintended use or dispatch.
Documentation & Quality Records: Prepare and maintain accurate Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI) reports, First Piece Approval (FPA) records, Daily Rejection/Rework logs, and Statistical Process Control (SPC) charts.
Calibration & Gauge Management: Ensure all measuring instruments and gauges are properly handled, stored, and within valid calibration schedules.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement: Participate in daily shop-floor quality meetings, assist in Why-Why Analysis, CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action), and support 5S and Kaizen initiatives to reduce internal rejection and rework.
Customer & Audit Support: Assist senior engineers during customer audits, ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 internal audits, and customer complaint investigations.Role & responsibilities


Preferred candidate profile
Education: Diploma or B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (Freshers from 2024 / 2025 / 2026 batches are encouraged to apply).
Drawing Interpretation: Strong foundational knowledge of reading engineering drawings, tolerances, and GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing).
Measuring Instruments: Familiarity with Vernier Calipers, Outside/Inside Micrometers, Dial Gauges, Height Gauges, Bore Gauges, Thread/Plug Gauges, Surface Roughness Testers, and Profile Projectors.
Process Knowledge (Preferred): Basic understanding of machining processes (CNC Turning, Centerless/Cylindrical Grinding), Heat Treatment (Induction Hardening), and Surface Treatment (Hard Chrome Plating) and their common defects (e.g., chatter marks, ovality, taper, plating pits, peeling).
Quality Concepts: Awareness of 7 QC Tools, 5S, Kaizen, and basic MS Excel for data entry and reporting.
Soft Skills: Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, willingness to work on the shop floor in shifts, and good communication skills.

Perks and benefits
Structured on-the-job training in precision metrology and industrial quality systems.
Opportunity to work directly with modern manufacturing technologies (CNC, Induction Hardening, Chrome Plating).
Clear career progression path from Trainee/Junior Engineer to Senior Quality Engineer.

We have a vast network of customers worldwide for supplying the best quality materials at an affordable price .

SUMMARY
Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners, including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. This position demands consistent performance, proactive engagement, and a hands-on approach to achieve and exceed sales targets. The ideal candidate will conduct daily site visits, maintain a strong presence at assigned retail outlets, organize shop meetings, and ensure accurate reporting all contributing to enhanced market penetration and brand visibility. With a focus on customer-centric strategies and performance excellence, this role is essential to sustaining growth and strengthening market position across the assigned territories.

Location: Mumbai ( Vasai)

Achieve and consistently exceed assigned sales targets.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key stakeholders.
Conduct a minimum of two site visits per day to identify new opportunities and support customer needs.
Dedicate at least two hours daily to on-site presence at assigned retail stores to drive sales and customer engagement.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to promote product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports through the designated online portal.








Requirements
Valid two-wheeler license is mandatory for field operations.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build relationships.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and highly driven by performance goals.
Minimum educational qualification: Graduation (preferred).
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants, building materials).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with demonstrated sales aptitude are encouraged to apply.




Benefits
Net Take Home: 18k to 23k (Negotiable)
MWA: 5,000/ -
Lucrative performance-based incentives
Absorption after 1 year based on performance
Travel allowance: 5,000 per month, depending on profile

Description:
Looking after PAN India automation equipment including Sorters and DWS systems of varying types, working principles & different vendors in terms of Maximizing uptime by minimizing Downtimes of the equipment due to breakdowns.
Keeping consistent track of Breakdowns ticketing system with respect to timely attending and closure of tickets with proper RCA of the issues and deriving actionable items for prevention of future breakdowns.
Closely monitoring the adherence to Scheduled maintenance of the equipment which needs to be done on daily, weekly & monthly basis with the help of a team of Sorter Operators and the respective vendor teams.
Monitoring the Open issues at site and actively closing them to ensure proper functioning of the systems and improve reliability of the equipment.
Looking for scope of improvements in the existing systems to improve the productivity, efficiency, safety, health & reliability of the equipment.
Monitoring the productivity and efficiency of the equipment based on key parameters like Rejections, Breakdowns, Dimensioning and weighing accuracies etc.
Defining the work content, roles & responsibilities of the Sorter operations team giving due regard to maintenance of the equipment by daily maintenance, pointing out and closing the open issues, monitoring the key performance parameters & troubleshooting the equipment during breakdowns to reduce downtime.
Training of the Sorter operators and the operations team regarding proper handling of the systems and operations of the automation equipment to maximize utilization and productivity and prevent breakdowns due to mishandling.
Regular interaction with the site teams, sorter operators & vendor team to ensure seamless coordination and operations of the system align with implementation of the improvement and taking care of trouble cases.
Tracking and maintaining of Spare parts procured for the equipment at site by regular auditing and maintaining consumption list of the spares used up during breakdowns.
Tracking of the Spare replenishment from the vendors for the faulty spares to ensure regular availability of spares at site.


Freshers from Mechanical Engineering can apply.

POSITION SUMMARY
Complete closing duties, including storing all reusable goods, breaking down goods, cleaning all equipment and areas, returning equipment to proper locations, locking refrigerators, restocking items, turning off lights, locking doors, and completing daily cleaning checklist. Set up, stock, and maintain work areas. Inspect the cleanliness and presentation of all china, glass, and silver prior to use. Maintain cleanliness of work areas throughout the day, practicing clean-as-you-go procedures.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

About the Role: We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented GSOC Analyst to join our Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for monitoring security systems, identifying potential threats, responding to incidents, and supporting business continuity and safety initiatives. Key Responsibilities:
Monitor security systems, CCTV feeds, alarms, and incident management platforms.
Identify, assess, and escalate security incidents as per established protocols.
Maintain situational awareness of global events that may impact business operations, personnel, or assets.
Conduct incident tracking, documentation, and reporting.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders, emergency services, and security vendors during incidents.
Support crisis management, emergency response, and business continuity activities.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly security reports.
Assist in investigations related to security breaches, workplace incidents, and threats.
Ensure accurate record-keeping and adherence to security procedures.

Preferred Skills:
Attention to detail and ability to multitask.
Ability to remain calm and professional during critical incidents.
Strong team collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
Knowledge of CCTV monitoring, access control systems, or security technologies is a plus.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Data Entry Operator to manage daily accounting and operational data entry using Tally software. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience working with Tally, strong typing speed and accuracy, and the ability to maintain well-organized records.
Key Responsibilities
Enter daily financial transactions, invoices, vouchers, receipts, and payments accurately into Tally (Tally.ERP 9 / TallyPrime).
Update and maintain customer, vendor, and inventory records in the system.
Cross-check source documents (bills, bank statements, purchase orders) against Tally entries to ensure 100% accuracy.
Assist with basic billing, ledger reconciliation, and generating routine reports from Tally as needed.
Organize and maintain both physical and digital copies of invoices and accounting records.
Identify and resolve data discrepancies or duplicate entries promptly.
What we expect
Required Skills Qualifications
Technical Skills: Working knowledge of Tally (Tally.ERP 9 or TallyPrime) and basic MS Excel / computer operations.
Typing Speed: Fast and accurate typing speed (minimum 30 / 35 WPM with high accuracy).
Attention to Detail: Strong focus on accuracy when handling numbers, dates, and billing codes.
Role details
Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra
Role level: Executive Data Entry
Experience: 0 - 2 years
Education: Minimum 12th Pass or Graduate (B.Com or commerce background preferred, though not mandatory).
Reports to: Department Head
Travel: No travel
Employment: Full-time

Description:
Job description
Customer Service Executive
Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales?
Join our team at Nobroker as an Inside Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and sell properties !!!
Location : Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore) • Position Type : Full-time
Salary Range : Up to 2 LPA to 3 LPA

About Us NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.
Specific Responsibilities:
Handle inbound customer calls and address their queries. Understand and fulfil customer needs for satisfaction. Build trust through clear and interactive communication. Provide accurate information using proper tools. Resolve complaints promptly and offer appropriate solutions. Follow up to ensure issue resolution. Maintain records of customer interactions and accounts. Adhere to communication guidelines and policies. Go the extra mile to engage and delight customers.
Perks & Value Proposition: Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company. . Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter. Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers. Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years. Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers: Education: Graduation or HSC qualified. Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills, numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills. Languages: English and Hindi mandatory; Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred. Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word). Work schedule: Flexible for a day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.
AboutCompany: NoBroker is Indias first and only PropTech Unicorn, transforming the real estate ecosystem with cutting-edge, tech-driven, and capital-efficient solutions. Through NoBrokerHood, our smart society and community management platform, we empower over 21,000+ societies across 15 major cities—offering seamless visitor management, billing, and engagement experiences.

Position overview: ZCCL is seeking a skilled and experienced Retail Customer Service Associate to drive retail sales within one of our 100+ company-owned, company-operated stores across India. This role is pivotal in maintaining the prestige of our brand and ensuring customer satisfaction, while driving sales.
Key Responsibilities:
Greet customers and assist with product inquiries and purchases.
Provide accurate information on pricing, features, and after-sales services.
Cross-sell products and inform customers about discounts and offers.
Ensure shelves/racks are stocked and manage merchandise returns.
Coordinate with the team for seamless customer service and share feedback with the Store Manager.
Stay updated on new products and services.

Education: High school diploma or equivalent; further education in sales preferred.
Experience: At least 18 months of retail sales experience, preferably in the apparel, fashion or luxury sectors, in a customer facing environment.
Skills:
Strong fluency in English; multilingual abilities are a plus.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
Proficiency in basic computer use and the ability to manage sales figures and stock movements.
A proven ability to solve problems creatively and effectively.
Must be a good team player, pleasant, service oriented with good communication skills.

Health insurance of Rs 1 lakh per year, with the premium covered by the company.

Promotions every year based on performance.

Description:
We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Part-Time Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. You understand that the Apple Store is dedicated to delivering a customer experience thats unlike any other. It starts with you discovering customers needs. And with the support of your store team members, you match those needs with the right products. Every day is an opportunity for you to turn another Apple Store visitor into a loyal Apple customer.


Role & responsibilities

Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products.
Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apples products, services, purchase options and Product Zone sales processes.
Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apples products, services and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities. Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.
Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each others differences and having the curiosity to learn.
Demonstrate Apples values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.



Preferred candidate profile

Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
Personalise solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apples core values.
You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

This is a Part-Time opportunity, requiring you to work 4 Days in a week for 5 hours each day i.e 20 hours in a week.


Location

Bangalore , Delhi, Noida


Perks and benefits

Locations: Bangalore / Jaipur / Mumbai

Salary: 2-3 LPA

Working Days: 6 Days a Week
About Groww
Groww is a financial services platform focused on making financial services accessible to every Indian. It offers a multi-product investment platform that helps customers take control of their financial journey.
The company focuses on customer-centricity, transparency, simplicity, ownership, and making informed financial decisions easier for millions of Indians.
About the Role
We are looking for dynamic and customer-oriented individuals to join Groww's Customer Support Team as Customer Support Agents – Inbound.
The selected candidates will handle inbound customer calls, assist customers with queries related to the Groww platform and its financial products, provide accurate information, and ensure a smooth customer support experience.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, conversational Hindi, basic English proficiency, and a customer-first attitude.
Key Responsibilities
Handle a high volume of inbound customer calls and queries.
Assist customers with questions related to the Groww platform and its financial products.
Provide accurate information and resolve customer concerns effectively.
Offer technical support and guidance to customers using the platform.
Explain product features and functionalities in simple and understandable language.
Educate customers about available product features and possible upgrades.
Understand customer concerns, demonstrate empathy, and provide appropriate solutions.
Maintain excellent service standards and ensure customer satisfaction.
Collect customer feedback and identify recurring issues.
Coordinate with internal teams to help address customer concerns and improve the customer experience.
Required Skills
Strong conversational Hindi communication skills (mandatory).
Basic English communication skills.
Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Customer support and customer-handling abilities.
Active listening and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage inbound voice calls.
Customer query resolution and relationship management.
Positive attitude and willingness to learn basic financial concepts.
Educational Qualifications
Bachelor's degree is mandatory.
B.Com and BCA graduates preferred.
BBA, BBM, BA, B.Sc and other undergraduate/postgraduate qualifications are also considered as per eligibility.
Minimum 50% marks in 10th, 12th and Graduation.
No academic backlogs.
No education gaps during studies.
Preferred Knowledge
Basic knowledge of the following financial products and concepts will be an added advantage:
Mutual Funds
Systematic Investment Plans (SIP)
Stocks and Equities
NSDL and CDSL
Prior knowledge of financial products is not mandatory. Freshers are welcome to apply.
Mandatory Eligibility Criteria
Must have completed a Bachelor's degree.

Description:
Company: Qualcomm India Private Limited
Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Systems Engineering
Job Summary
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital and RF transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Systems Engineer, you will design a complete framework or system that influences the shaping of state-of-the-art mobile, edge, auto, AR/VR, compute, IoT, wearable products. Qualcomm Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., design, software, testing teams, etc.) to identify hardware testing needs and integrate components into products or systems.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field.
Job Overview
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital and RF transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Board design Engineer, you will be part of a team that designs hardware platforms or system that influences the shaping of state-of-the-art IoT products. Qualcomm Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., design, software, testing teams, etc.) to identify hardware testing needs and integrate components into products or systems.
Job description
1-3 years of relevant experience and keen interest towards Hardware design, System architecture. Should have good product level knowledge in the IoT products.
Opportunity to be part of team designing Evaluation boards, Internal platform designs for IoT chipsets.
Experience in High-speed board design, schematic design, layout reviews, test and integration, and maintaining hardware through the product cycle.
Platforms incorporate Processors, graphics engines, digital audio, USB OTG, Bluetooth, GPS, SPI, I2C, DDR, MIPI, MDDI, and LAN functionality and candidate should have knowledge on these interfaces and should have knowledge on Power supply design for the platforms.

Assisting global teams with financial guidance.
Performing research and analysis as required.
Updating Financial system with the latest data.
Work closely with global region teams with regular interaction to reviews, drive transition calls, process documentation for all activities.
Engage in driving automation of finance process via AI and other possible automations to bring efficiency
Ensuring compliance with financial guidelines, company policies, and relevant legal regulations.

Bachelor's in commerce / economics and/or, MBA in finance from reputed B school or Qualified CA/CMA
2 to 4 years of experience in understanding and analysis of financial statements like Balance Sheet/Cash Flows/ Statement of Profit Loss.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and SAP, Oracle, or related financial systems.
Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills to communicate with both internal and external partners.
Detail-oriented and able to perform in a high-pressure environment.
Ability to present financial information to a non-financial audience.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Ability to review process and support team.
Positive attitude and willingness to learn and upskills with tools Tableau, Power BI , AI etc.
Flexible for Late Evening/Early Morning calls for reviews and transition calls on regular basis with global teams.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree.

Job Summary
Join Qualcomm's Multimedia Audio Systems Group to contribute to the architecture, design of audio system solutions and audio hardware blocks. The role focuses on hardware-aware system design, data-path definition, interface integration, and performance optimization for next-generation Snapdragon platforms across mobile, XR, Compute and IoT applications. Strong understanding of Audio hardware architecture
Key Responsibilities
Define and support the design of audio hardware, software, audio data paths, audio codecs and associated processing blocks.
Analyze hardware and system trade-offs across power, performance, latency, memory, precision, and audio quality.
Work with Architecture, Systems and Software teams to translate product requirements into hardware specifications and implementation requirements.
Support hardware-software interface definition, control flows and power-state transitions to design low power solutions

Document architecture, design decisions, interface requirements, validation plans, and technical findings.

Strong understanding of digital hardware design concepts and audio hardware architectures.
Experience with audio hardware, audio blocks such as VAD, digital filters, interpolation, decimation, sample-rate conversion, or related DSP hardware.
Good understanding of digital signal-processing fundamentals
Experience analyzing hardware constraints and trade-offs involving power, performance, latency, memory, clocking, and precision.
Understanding of fixed-point arithmetic, quantization, rounding, saturation, and bit-accurate modelling.
Familiarity with embedded systems, hardware-software interfaces, and real-time audio data paths on any DSP architecture HiFi/Hexagon/ARM/MCU
Programming in C/C++, Python, MATLAB
Preferred Qualifications
Understanding of digital interfaces such as SoundWire and SDCA interfaces is a plus.
Familiarity with audio codec design, DAC/ADC signal paths, and low-power design is a plus.
Exposure to Qualcomm audio architectures, frameworks, SDKs, or development tools is a plus.
Educational Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's or PhD in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Communications, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

Description:
Job Summary
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives communication and data processing transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm ASIC Engineer, you will define, model, design (digital and/or analog), optimize, verify, validate, implement, and document IP (block/SoC) development for a variety of high performance, high quality, low power world class products. Qualcomm Engineers collaborate with cross-functional groups to determine product execution path.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 5+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
This role seeks a senior-level Power Integrity Engineer to lead power delivery network design, simulation, optimization, and validation for advanced semiconductor packages used in AI and data center systems. The position spans die, package, and PCB interactions and requires close collaboration across ASIC, layout, signal integrity, thermal, and system engineering teams.
Responsibilities
Power Integrity Analysis: Responsibilities include DC and AC analysis, IR drop and current-density assessment, frequency-domain impedance evaluation, transient simulations, chip power modeling, and analysis of VRMs, decoupling, package parasitics, and on-die capacitance.
Package Optimization: The engineer will optimize power and ground distribution, substrate stackups, planes, vias, bump assignments, BGA maps, and decoupling solutions for low-voltage, high-current supplies and multiple power domains. Work includes 2.5D and 3D integration, chiplets, interposers, embedded capacitors, and tradeoffs involving thermal performance, manufacturability, cost, and schedule.
AI and Data Center Systems: The role supports AI accelerators, GPUs, CPUs, networking ASICs, and data center switches with demanding transient and voltage-noise requirements, including packages using 112G, 224G, and 448G SerDes, PCIe Gen6 and Gen7, UCIe, DDR, and HBM.
Qualifications and Progression
Candidates should understand electromagnetic theory, PDNs, package construction, target impedance, die-package-PCB co-design, and transient analysis; use tools such as Cadence Sigrity, Ansys SIwave and HFSS, Cadence Clarity 3D Solver, and SPICE; and apply scripting for automation.
A relevant graduate degree is preferred, while experience expectations range from 58 or more years for Senior Engineer to 12 or more years with technical leadership for Principal Engineer.
Note: This description reflects content relevant to the role and does not include boilerplate, application process details, or contact information.

Description:
Job Summary
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives communication and data processing transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm ASIC Engineer, you will define, model, design (digital and/or analog), optimize, verify, validate, implement, and document IP (block/SoC) development for a variety of high performance, high quality, low power world class products. Qualcomm Engineers collaborate with cross-functional groups to determine product execution path.
Job Area: Engineering Group, ASICS Engineering
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
Role Overview
We are seeking a motivated and technically strong DDR PHY Staff Digital Design Engineer to join our team working on next-generation memory interface IPs. The candidate will be responsible for the architecture, RTL implementation, verification support, synthesis, low-power design, DFT, and silicon bring-up of high-performance DDR PHY solutions used in leading-edge SoC products.
Responsibilities
Design and develop digital components of high-performance DDR PHY for LPDDR/DDR memory interfaces.
Participate in micro-architecture definition, RTL coding, integration, and debug of complex digital IPs.
Drive RTL quality and signoff through lint, clock-domain crossing (CDC), reset-domain crossing (RDC), low-power, and design rule checks.
Collaborate with the functional verification team to develop verification plans, review coverage closure, and debug design issues.
Develop synthesis and timing constraints, analyze timing reports, and deliver high-quality netlists for physical design implementation.
Create and maintain UPF-based low-power intent and perform equivalence checking, and low-power signoff.
Implement and validate Design-for-Test (DFT) features, support scan insertion, ATPG generation, and optimize stuck-at and transition fault coverage.
Work closely with physical design, STA, DFT, verification, and SoC integration teams to achieve project milestones and quality targets.
Support pre-silicon and post-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and issue resolution across multiple product programs.
Contribute to methodology improvements, automation, and design flow enhancements to improve engineering productivity and quality.
Required Qualifications
B.Tech/M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
8+ years of experience in digital design and front-end implementation of complex ASIC/SoC/IP designs.
Strong understanding of digital design fundamentals, RTL development using Verilog/SystemVerilog, and micro-architecture concepts.
Hands-on experience with front-end design flows, including:
Lint
CDC/RDC
Low-power verification
Synthesis
Static Timing Analysis (STA)
Design-for-Test (DFT)
Familiarity with industry-standard EDA tools used for RTL design, verification, synthesis, and timing closure.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
Excellent teamwork, communication, and collaboration skills with global engineering teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in Ddr/lpddr PHY, high-speed interface, or mixed-signal IP development.
Knowledge of UPF, power-aware design methodologies, and low-power architecture techniques.
Familiarity with scan insertion, ATPG, and silicon debug activities.
Exposure to post-silicon bring-up, validation, and characterization.
Experience working across multi-functional teams, including verification, physical design, DFT, firmware, and system engineering.
What You'll Work On
LPDDR5/LPDDR6 and future-generation memory PHY solutions.
High-performance, low-power digital architectures for mobile, compute, XR, automotive, and AI platforms.
State-of-the-art design methodologies spanning RTL design through silicon validation.

Job Summary
We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Domestic IT Recruiter to join our recruitment team. The candidate will be responsible for handling end-to-end recruitment for IT positions across India, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and candidate onboarding.
Key Responsibilities
Understand client/hiring requirements and identify suitable candidates.
Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, databases, and social media.
Use Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques to identify relevant IT candidates.
Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic/HR screening.
Evaluate candidates based on technical skills, experience, communication, location, CTC, and notice period.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Process all guest check-ins, check-outs, room assignments, and room change/late check-out requests. Secure payment; activate/reissue room keys. Ensure rates match market codes, document exceptions. Verify/adjust billing for guests. Communicate to appropriate staff when guests are waiting for an available room. Advise guest of messages. Clear departures in computer system. Coordinate with Housekeeping to track room status and guest concerns. File guest paperwork or documentation. Operate telephone switchboard station. Run and check daily reports, contingency lists, and credit card authorization reports. Supply guests with directions and information. Answer, record, and process all guest calls, requests, questions, or concerns; follow up to ensure each has been met to guests satisfaction. Arrange transportation for guests/visitors. Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift. Cash-guests checks, process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, charges, and provide change. Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any reports of theft.
Follow company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of employees. Comply with quality assurance standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Job Description
Role based in BSv organisation. Leveraging deepening knowledge of one or more R2A processes (record, report, analyze etc), Record to Analyze Process Experts participate of in or lead the achievement of service levels, key measurement targets of the team and delivers a high quality and cost-effective service that drive compelling business outcomes. Description:
First impressions are everything.
When guests arrive at our hotels, we want that impression to be memorable.
The same goes for departures.
When guests leave, we want them to go with a smile and a feeling that we were there for them throughout their stay.
We want to build an experience that is memorable and unique from start to finish.
Our Guest Arrival Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their arrival and departure experiences.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Arrival Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Arrival Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing more than 75 pounds with assistance.
.
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Arrival Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
First impressions are everything.
When guests arrive at our hotels, we want that impression to be memorable.
The same goes for departures.
When guests leave, we want them to go with a smile and a feeling that we were there for them throughout their stay.
We want to build an experience that is memorable and unique from start to finish.
Our Guest Arrival Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their arrival and departure experiences.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Arrival Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Arrival Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing more than 75 pounds with assistance.
.
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Arrival Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Description
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Google sheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our Spa Specialists play an important role in support of a number of vital Spa functions. At our hotels these associates work to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with Spa services on the side. Our Spa Specialists take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their experience. Whether promoting Spa services or retail, scheduling reservations and confirming appointments, providing answers about services, checking in guests, or processing payments, the Spa Specialist makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Spa Specialists will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing reservation software (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance and 25 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Spa Specialists - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

Description:
We take our housekeeping standards seriously. So, we re searching for a Room Attendant with an exceptional eye for detail and a passion for perfection to make sure every guest enjoys a truly memorable experience.

A little taste of your day-to-day:

Every day is different, but you ll mostly be:
Making sure every single room is at its absolute best for our guests
Helping our guests in any way you can - whether they ve forgotten their toothbrush or just need to find the elevator
Keeping your supervisor in the loop by advising them of any progress or problems
Monitoring and controlling supplies to minimise waste
Doing your best to reunite guests with any lost or misplaced items
Regularly assisting with deep clean projects

What We need from you:
It s a physical role and you ll be on your feet most of the day, so fitness is important
Occasional lifting of items up to 50 pounds / 23 kilograms and or push/pulling heavy objects
You may need to bend and kneel to complete some activities
Literacy skills - reading, writing and basic maths skills
Flexible attitude to shifts - you may be required to work nights, weekends and/or holidays

What you can expect from us:

We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life - including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well - both inside and outside of work - and through our myWellbeing
framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary:
We are seeking dynamic and customer-focused professionals to join our Greenlight Hub team in Gurgaon as Customer Support Specialists. This role is central to empowering new driver partners by delivering exceptional in-person support, guiding them through onboarding, and equipping them with the tools and knowledge needed to succeed. As a key member of our operations team, you will play a vital role in shaping the driver experience, ensuring smooth onboarding, resolving issues efficiently, and fostering a positive brand presence. The ideal candidate is a self-driven communicator with a passion for helping others, strong problem-solving abilities, and a proactive mindset. This is a temporary, contract position with potential for extension, offering a unique opportunity to be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven organization.

Experience: 0-1 year

Responsibilities:
Deliver high-quality, in-person support to driver partners during onboarding and ongoing operations.
Guide new drivers through the onboarding process and introduce them to essential tools and resources.
Troubleshoot and resolve driver-related issues promptly and effectively.
Serve as a brand ambassador by promoting the company’s values and building enthusiasm among drivers.
Stay updated on company processes, tools, and policies to ensure accurate and consistent support.
Collaborate with the Driver Operations team to identify and implement process improvements.


Requirements

Strong verbal communication skills in both English and Hindi.
Graduate degree.
Proven ability to handle in-person interactions with empathy, patience, and professionalism.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a resourceful mindset when addressing challenges.
Highly organized, self-motivated, and team-oriented with a passion for empowering others.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.



Benefits
CTC: 22k
NTH:17k
+6K  performance based incentive.
