Description:
Dear Pankaj,
Greetings from Axtria! (Axtria is a global provider of cloud software and data analytics to the Life Sciences & Healthcare industry).
As discussed,  please find below the generic job specifications for your reference.
Location Hyd | Bangalore | Noida | GGN | Pune
About The Role
We are looking for a Data Governance Consultant to drive core data governance engagements for our clients. This role combines hands-on governance program design with client-facing consulting and pre-sales responsibilities, working closely with business and IT stakeholders to stand up sustainable governance operating models.
Key Responsibilities
Data Governance Program Delivery
Define and own the data governance charter, including scope, guiding principles, roles & responsibilities, and success metrics
Partner with business and IT teams to design and implement escalation matrices for data issues, policy exceptions, and change requests
Establish and facilitate the Data Governance Council, including cadence, decision rights, and reporting structures
Formulate, document, and maintain SOPs covering data quality, stewardship, issue resolution, and data ownership processes
Define data ownership and stewardship models (data owners, stewards, custodians) across business domains
Design and roll out data policies, standards, and metrics/KPIs to track governance maturity and adoption
Tools & Technical Fluency
Demonstrate working proficiency in leading data governance/catalog platforms such as Collibra, Atlan, and Alation
Support tool evaluation, configuration recommendations, and policy/workflow design within these platforms
Collaborate with data engineering and analytics teams to align governance policies with underlying data platforms
Client Engagement & Business Development
Lead or support client discovery sessions, workshops, and governance maturity assessments
Own or contribute to RFP/RFI responses, including solutioning, effort estimation, and proposal narrative
Build client-facing deliverables (decks, SOPs, charters, maturity frameworks) and present to senior stakeholders
Act as a trusted advisor to client governance leads, balancing pragmatic delivery with long-term governance maturity
Stakeholder & Project Management
Drive cross-functional alignment between business, IT, compliance, and data teams
Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies for governance workstreams within larger data management programs
Mentor junior consultants and contribute to CoE assets and reusable governance frameworks
Required Qualifications
12+ years of experience in data governance or related consulting roles
Proven experience defining data governance charters, councils, and operating models in a real client/enterprise setting
Hands-on exposure to at least one major data governance/catalog tool (Collibra, Atlan, or Alation); familiarity with multiple is a plus
Experience responding to RFPs/RFIs and supporting pre-sales or proposal development
Strong understanding of data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK) and concepts such as data lineage, data quality, and stewardship
Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with experience engaging both business and IT audiences
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience building executive-ready presentations
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in life sciences/pharma or other regulated data environments
Prior consulting/CoE experience with both offshore and onshore delivery models
Relevant certifications (DAMA CDMP, Collibra/Alation/Atlan certifications)
Why Axtria: -
Axtria (www.Axtria.com) is truly a New-Age Software Product Unicorn, a first of its kind in providing the cloud software and data analytics to the Life Sciences industry globally. We help Life Sciences companies transform the product commercialization journey to drive sales growth and improve healthcare outcomes for patients. We are acutely aware that our work impacts millions of patients and lead passionately to improve their lives.
Since our founding in 2010, technology innovation has been our winning differentiation, and we continue to leapfrog competition with platforms that deploy Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Ecommerce Developer (Magento 2) to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people.
You will be responsible in developing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing our eCommerce platform based on Magento 2 on hyper scaler cloud environment including underlying components.
You will identify new and exciting functionalities and develop new modules.
If you are the person who can design and develop web / mobile platforms securely at an unbelievable pace, we would like to meet you.
To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a self-starter, top-notch communicator and passionate hands-on programmer.
Responsibilities
Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus

Description:
Role & responsibilities


Strategic Account Manager (SAM)
Company: G4S Secure Solutions India (An Allied Universal Company)
Locations: Delhi, Bangalore, Hyderabad
Experience: 8 15 Years
Department: Business Development Strategic Accounts
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About the Role
Are you a senior B2B sales leader who loves growing large corporate accounts and dealing with top executiveswithout getting stuck in daily operational firefighting?

G4S Secure Solutions India is hiring a Strategic Account Manager (SAM) to manage, retain, and grow a focused portfolio of 7 to 8 major national enterprise accounts.
You will focus on growing revenue, pitching new solutions, protecting profit margins, and renewing multi-year contracts.

Role Snapshot
Role Level: Senior Manager / General Manager (Individual Contributor Expert Track)
Reporting To: Sales Director – India
Core Focus: 100% Account Growth (Grow) & Client Retention (Keep)
What You Will Do

1. Grow Existing Accounts & Sell More Services (45%)
Create and run 3-year growth plans for your 7–8 assigned enterprise clients across India.
Track client business expansions early—such as new offices, data centers, and corporate campuses—to win new site contracts.
Prepare winning commercial proposals for new locations, tech upgrades, and expanded services.
Cross-sell integrated G4S solutions, including remote monitoring (SROC), access control, Electronic Security Systems (ESS), and Facilities Management (FM).
2. Renew Contracts & Improve Profit Margins (35%)
Manage multi-year contract renewals well in advance to ensure zero preventable client loss (Target: 95%+ retention).
Negotiate annual statutory wage revisions, management fee hikes, and contract restructurings with clients.
Keep a close eye on account profitability, fix margin leaks, and renegotiate underpriced contracts.
3. Build C-Suite & Senior Client Relationships (10%)
Build strong, long-term relationships with client decision-makers—CSOs, Procurement Heads (CPOs), CFOs, and Real Estate Directors.
Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and annual strategy meetings with client leadership.
Act as the main point of contact to resolve major commercial or contract issues.
4. Work Closely with Operations & Finance (10%)
Hold weekly sync-ups with your paired Operations KAM to track service quality (SLAs) and catch any client risks early.
Partner with Finance and Operations teams to solve major billing issues and speed up overdue payments.

What We Are Looking For
Experience & Education:
Experience: 8–15+ years of experience managing and growing large B2B corporate accounts (in Security, Facility Management, Industrial Services, Telecom, or Enterprise Solutions).
Proven Track Record: Experience retaining and expanding multi-million-dollar corporate accounts across multiple cities in India.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or Engineering (Required). MBA / PGDM in Sales, Marketing, or International Business is strongly preferred.

Key Skills:
Financial & Pricing Sense: Good understanding of contract P&L, costing sheets, profit margins, and labour compliance rules.
Executive Confidence: Comfortable pitching to and negotiating with CXOs and central procurement teams.
Solution Selling: Experience selling bundled manpower and technology solutions.
CRM Skills: Regular, disciplined use of Salesforce CRM to track sales pipelines and opportunities.

Why Join G4S (An Allied Universal® Company)?
Zero Daily Operations Hassle: Your paired Operations KAM handles day-to-day site delivery so you can focus 100% on commercial growth and deals.

Global Brand & Career Growth: Work with the world’s leading security solutions company with clear growth paths into National Account Leadership or Hub Commercial Director roles.
AboutCompany:
G4S in India: 
Founded in 1989, G4S India is the leading security solutions group in the country. The company today has more than 1,35,000 employees with 4 Hubs and a strong network of over 100+ offices spread throughout India. Besides its core business of Secure Solutions, Integrated Facilities Management Services and Electronic Security Systems, G4S also offers a range of services including; Training (29 Training Schools across India), Event Security, Executive Protection, Security Consultancy & Risk Management, Central Monitoring Services, Fire Alarm and Emergency Evacuation System, People Transport Solutions, CCTV Surveillance Solutions etc. G4S has an impressive clientele in various sectors including business process outsourcing, retail, healthcare, infrastructure, IT, banking, diplomatic missions & embassies, residential facilities, hospitality establishments, communications etc. We have a diverse range of services to meet our customers requirements and have a broad geographic footprint to meet the demand for security globally.
In 2021, G4S, a London-based global security company, was acquired by Allied Universal®, a leading security and facility services company that provides proactive security services and cutting-edge smart technology to deliver tailored, integrated security solutions. This acquisition expands Allied Universal’s footprint and infrastructure on a global and local level. Through the company’s vast network of more than 800,000 employees, we leverage global best practices in communities all over the world. With revenues of $18 billion, we are supported by efficient processes and systems that can only come with scale to help deliver our promise locally: keeping people safe so our communities can thrive. In Asia Pacific, we have an extensive network of offices and more than 192,000 employees to support our local communities and customers. We believe there is no greater purpose than serving and safeguarding customers, communities, and people in today’s world. Allied Universal is There for you™. For more information, please visit  www.g4s.com or www.aus.com

Description:
Role & responsibilities-
We are seeking an experienced Oracle CX Cloud Manager with strong techno-functional expertise in Oracle Sales Cloud, Partner Relationship Management (PRM), and Oracle Incentive Compensation. The candidate will lead end-to-end Oracle CX implementations, drive solution architecture, manage delivery teams, and engage with client leadership to deliver scalable business solutions. The role requires strong functional knowledge, technical capabilities, project management expertise, and a proven track record of successful Oracle CX transformations.
Must-Have Functional and Technical Skills
**Oracle Sales Cloud / Sales Force Automation**
- Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Sales Cloud implementation and configuration.
- Expertise in Lead, Opportunity, Account, Contact, Territory, Sales Forecasting, Pipeline, and Quote Management.
- Experience in Sales Planning, Assignment Rules, Approval Workflows, and Sales Hierarchies.
- Knowledge of Customer Data Management (CDM), Customer 360, and data quality management.
- Experience with CX Mobile, Microsoft Office 365, and Gmail integrations.
**Partner Relationship Management (PRM)**
- Experience in Partner Onboarding, Registration, Partner Profiles, and Lifecycle Management.
- Knowledge of Deal Registration, Partner Lead Distribution, Opportunity Sharing, and Channel Sales.
- Experience in Partner Hierarchies, Territory Assignment, Access Management, and Partner Performance Reporting.
- Understanding of partner incentive programs and integration with Sales Cloud.
**Oracle Incentive Compensation**
- Experience in Compensation Plan Configuration, Participant Management, Credit Allocation, and Commission Processing.
- Knowledge of Quota Management, Rate Tables, Incentive Calculations, and Performance-Based Compensation.
- Experience in Commission Adjustments, Dispute Management, Approvals, and Compensation Reporting.
- Understanding of integrations with Sales Cloud, Order Management, and financial applications.
**Technical Expertise**
- Strong experience with Application Composer, Page Composer, Object Customization, Groovy Scripting, and Workflow Management.
- Knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, and integration architecture.
- Experience in OTBI, BI Publisher Reports, Dashboards, and Analytics.
- Expertise in Data Migration, Import/Export Management, Sandbox Management, and Configuration Migration.
- Experience in Security Configuration, Role-Based Access Control, User Management, and Organizational Hierarchies.
- Knowledge of Oracle Redwood UX, Visual Builder Studio, and AI-enabled Oracle CX capabilities is desirable.
- Experience integrating Oracle CX with Fusion ERP, CPQ, Subscription Management, and third-party applications.

Description:
We are seeking an experienced Zuora Senior Manager Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Zuora Billing, Zuora CPQ, and Zuora Revenue implementations across the complete Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Zuora Billing and Revenue solutions, with extensive experience in subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, revenue recognition, financial integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
As a trusted advisor to clients, the Senior Manager will lead business transformation initiatives by translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Zuora solutions aligned with industry best practices. The role requires a strong blend of functional, technical, and consulting expertise, with the ability to engage executive stakeholders, lead cross-functional teams, and deliver large-scale digital transformation programs across diverse industries.
The successful candidate will be responsible for end-to-end solution ownership, including solutioning, enterprise architecture, business process design, fit-gap analysis, functional and technical design, Zuora configuration, customizations, integrations, data migration, development oversight, proof of concepts (POCs), testing strategy, deployment planning, user enablement, and post-go-live support. The role also requires strong leadership in project management, delivery governance, team management, quality assurance, risk management, stakeholder communication, and driving successful project milestones while ensuring delivery excellence.
Additionally, the Senior Manager will play a strategic role in practice growth by leading pre-sales engagements, solution demonstrations, estimations, client workshops, AI-enabled delivery initiatives, capability development, mentoring, reusable solution accelerators, and thought leadership. The individual will collaborate closely with client executives, business stakeholders, product teams, enterprise architects, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver end-to-end Zuora Q2C solutions that optimize revenue operations, accelerate digital transformation, and support long-term business growth.
Years of Experience: 12 - 18 Years
Position Requirements:
Own the end-to-end solution architecture and design for enterprise Zuora Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) transformation programs across Zuora Billing, Zuora CPQ, and Zuora Revenue, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, revenue recognition, and financial integrations.
Lead large-scale Zuora implementation programs by overseeing project planning, solution architecture, fit-gap analysis, functional and technical design, configuration, customizations, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, hypercare, and post-production support while ensuring successful delivery within scope, budget, and timeline.
Partner with client executives, business stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, facilitate discovery workshops, define solution roadmaps, recommend industry best practices, and provide strategic guidance for enterprise Q2C transformation initiatives.
Define enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, integration strategy, and implementation roadmaps while ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performing Zuora solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards and business objectives.
Lead the design and implementation of Zuora Billing, CPQ, and Revenue capabilities, including product catalog, subscription lifecycle management, pricing models, billing schedules, invoice generation, taxation, payment processing, collections, revenue recognition, and accounting integrations.
Design and oversee integrations between Zuora and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, Workday, payment gateways, tax engines (Avalara, Vertex), CRM platforms, middleware, and data warehouse solutions, leveraging Zuora APIs, Workflow, Events, and integration frameworks.
Provide technical leadership and solution governance by reviewing architecture, configurations, customizations, integrations, code quality, and delivery artifacts while ensuring adherence to best practices, security standards, and scalable design principles.
Lead business discussions with clients to discover requirements, define problem statements, facilitate solution workshops, evaluate solution alternatives, and drive executive-level architecture decisions throughout the project lifecycle.
Establish delivery governance by managing project risks, dependencies, quality assurance, issue resolution, stakeholder communication, and milestone tracking while ensuring teams follow defined delivery methodologies, documentation standards, and implementation best practices.
Mentor and lead multidisciplinary teams of solution architects, functional consultants, technical consultants, and developers by providing technical guidance, conducting design and code reviews, supporting capability development, and fostering delivery excellence.
Drive innovation and practice growth by contributing to pre-sales, solution demonstrations, estimations, proposals, AI-enabled delivery accelerators, reusable solution assets, capability building, thought leadership, and go-to-market initiatives that enhance delivery efficiency and business growth.
Technical Skills:
API, SQL, Liquid, HTML
Certifications:
Zuora Billing Solution Architect
Zuora Revenue Solution Architect
Zuora Implementation Manager

As a Databricks + Agentic AI - Senior Associate you will lead client support work within our Data and Analytics Engineering practice, focused on data engineering solutions that turn raw data into usable insights and support data pipelines, integration, and transformation efforts. As a Manager you will lead teams, coach junior professionals, manage performance, and guide delivery across multiple workstreams while bringing judgment, business knowledge, and a practical approach to technology and innovation. In this role at PwC, you will help shape work around Databricks and agentic AI, coordinate deliverables, support client needs, and contribute to solutions that strengthen data infrastructure and analytics capabilities within PwC Acceleration Center Bangalore.
Responsibilities
- Leading data engineering workstreams that design and build Databricks and Azure-based data pipelines for client solutions
- Managing project planning, prioritization, and delivery across data integration, transformation, and validation efforts
- Guiding teams through development of data lake, data warehouse, and lakehouse architectures that support analytics use cases
- Reviewing solution designs for data modeling, performance tuning, query optimization, and database reliability
- Coaching team members on Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, and Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform implementation methods
- Translating business requirements into scalable data infrastructure and pipeline designs that support AI-enabled workflows
- Coordinating delivery across technical stakeholders to address data quality, security, and operational issues
- Applying analytical thinking to identify dependencies, risks, and opportunities across complex data environments
- Supporting client-facing engagements by communicating technical progress, design choices, and delivery milestones
- Promoting responsible use of agentic AI, automation, and cloud data tooling in modern data engineering solutions
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Mathematical Statistics
- Demonstrating Databricks platform delivery across data modernization initiatives
- Applying Agentic AI concepts to client-facing data engineering solutions
- Managing project planning, budgeting, execution, and delivery
- Mentoring teams through complex data architecture decisions
- Translating business needs into scalable analytics design
- Navigating ambiguity while advancing quality and timelines

Strong experience in MLOps, DevOps, CI/CD, Terraform, automated testing, security, and production monitoring for AI applications.
Demonstrated real-world, end-to-end production delivery experience, including architecture, development, deployment, scalability, performance optimization, and operational support.

Position: MLOps
Experience: 5-9 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for talented MLOps with 5-9 years of experience to design, automate, deploy, and maintain scalable cloud-native applications and machine learning platforms. The ideal candidate should have expertise in cloud technologies, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, containerization, monitoring, and operational excellence across multi-cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
MLOps
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for model development, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
Automate machine learning workflows using MLOps best practices.
Deploy and manage ML models in production environments.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Platform teams.
Implement model monitoring, performance tracking, and drift detection mechanisms.
DevOps
Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
Manage code repositories, branching strategies, and release processes.
Implement DevSecOps practices and security controls.
Improve deployment efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
CloudOps
Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Monitor cloud resources, performance, cost, and availability.
Troubleshoot infrastructure and application issues.
Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Implement infrastructure-as-code and cloud governance standards.
AboutCompany:

Description:
Hi
PFB Job description and kindly connect and let me know if interested or Share your CV on sairam.m.naik@pwc.com or if you have any references it will be helpful.

Responsibilities:
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and identify opportunities to apply Agentic AI and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions to solve complex enterprise problems.
Design, develop, and implement advanced GenAI and Agentic AI systems, including ReAct agents (Reasoning + Acting frameworks), multi-agent architectures, and autonomous AI workflows.
Build and deploy intelligent AI-powered chatbots and conversational agents using LLMs, tool-calling frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory modules, and agent orchestration patterns.
Ensure consistency, reliability, and alignment in AI-generated outputs through prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring mechanisms.
Develop and implement machine learning models and algorithms to support GenAI applications, including fine-tuning, embeddings, and hybrid AI architectures.
Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, and feature engineering to prepare structured and unstructured data for machine learning and GenAI pipelines.
Collaborate with data engineers to design efficient data pipelines and integrate ML/LLM systems into scalable production environments.
Validate and evaluate model and agent performance using appropriate metrics (accuracy, latency, hallucination rate, consistency scoring, human evaluation frameworks).
Develop and deploy production-ready AI applications using object-oriented programming principles, ensuring modularity, scalability, maintainability, and robustness.
Implement containerized AI solutions using Docker and Kubernetes for orchestration, scaling, and cloud-native deployments.
Design and implement tool-augmented agents, API-integrated workflows, and autonomous decision-making systems using modern AI agent frameworks.
Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate AI insights and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously stay updated with advancements in GenAI, Agentic AI, multi-agent systems, LLM orchestration, and emerging AI frameworks, recommending innovative approaches to enhance enterprise AI capabilities.
Requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
7+ years of relevant technical/technology experience, with a focus on GenAI projects.
Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, R, or Scala.
Proficiency in machine learning libraries and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and data wrangling techniques.
Solid understanding of statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and experimental design.
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Knowledge of data visualization tools and techniques.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Experience with object-oriented programming languages such as Java, C++, or C#.
Experience developing and deploying machine learning applications in production environments.
Understanding data privacy and compliance regulations.
Relevant certifications in data science or GenAI technologies.
Development experience in system designing, proven track record of software delivery through all phases of development, critical thinking, ability to clearly communicate, present and lead.
Nice to Have Skills:
Experience with Azure AI Search, Azure Doc Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, AWS Textract, AWS Open Search, AWS Bedrock.
Familiarity with LLM backed agent frameworks such as Autogen, Langchain, Langgraph Semantic Kernel, etc.
Experience in chatbot design, frontend and development.
Certification of cloud or Genai
Designed and implemented enterprise-grade GenAI solutions using Databricks Mosaic AI, enabling scalable LLM deployment and governance.
Built Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using Mosaic AI Vector Search and Foundation Models for domain-specific knowledge querying.
Fine-tuned and deployed LLMs using Mosaic AI Model Serving, optimizing inference latency and cost.
Implemented secure LLM workflows with Unity Catalog governance and model tracking via MLflow.
Strong background in the Healthcare domain, with deep understanding of Payer operations and working knowledge of Provider ecosystems.
Experience in consulting engagements, including direct interaction with client stakeholders and managing client relationships.
Demonstrated leadership experience managing and mentoring teams of 510 members.
If you are passionate about GenAI technologies and have a proven track record in data science, join PwC US - Acceleration Center and be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future of GenAI solutions. We offer a collaborative and innovative work environment where you can make a significant impact.
Preferred Qualifications:
BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc / M.E / M.Tech /Master’s Degree /MBA from reputed institute

Description:
Position/Role: Sr Test Engineer for Power Path Protection Devices (4+ years exp).
Location: Bangalore, India
Description

Linear Power team is looking for bright engineers to drive our next generation of cutting-edge power products across Automotive, Industrial, Data Center, and Personal Electronics markets. As traditional power architecture rapidly transitions toward higher power, higher voltage, and functionally safe systems, our team is actively developing highly differentiated solutions by pushing the boundaries of silicon process, advanced packaging, IP design, and test engineering. We believe in acquiring deep end-equipment knowledge, solving complex high-voltage challenges to achieve the best performance for the application. Our teams define, design, verify, validate, and take products to high-volume manufacturing through deep involvement with customers and a thorough understanding of the market - across a broad portfolio of Power Path Protection, High-Side Switches, Precision References, Power Monitoring Solutions, and best-in-class LDOs. Join this team if you want to be at the forefront of power design and shape the future of semiconductors.

Sr Test Engineer
Summary
This role owns test solution for new product development of power path protection devices. Engineer will work with cross functional team during system definition, DFT planning, project plan, product release and support solving post production issues. The engineer leads root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and cross-functional problem solving across design, quality, and operations teams.

What You Will Do
As Test lead for your device, you will own quality and test cost entitlement for your product (test solution including hardware and software releases) and leading cross functional team to make decision, resolving critical manufacturing, test, yield, and reliability issues with urgency while eliminating recurring problems through rigorous root-cause and permanent corrective action and meet customer demand requirements. You will also be responsible to drive other projects and lead young engineers.
You will develop and execute strategies to continuously improve yield and reduce test cost across the product portfolio, working directly with factory teams to implement solutions and sustain gains on the production floor. You will partner closely with Test, Product, Design, Quality, Manufacturing, and Operations teams to close complex issues and build a structured feedback loop that transfers sustaining learnings into development to improve future designs and test strategies.

What We Are Looking For
We are looking for 4+ years experienced engineer with hands-on ATE test experience - including expertise in hardware and software (ETS or V98K tester platforms (software and hardware)). Ideal candidate combines deep technical judgment, strong analog fundamental skills and pcb design experience with cross-functional leadership - able to work across design, quality, factory, and operations teams, influence without direct authority, and build systems and processes that scale
Qualifications
Minimum requirements:
Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering
4+ years of relevant experience
ATE experience on Teradyne Eagle or equivalent analog ATE (iFlex, LTX, VLCT), although Eagle experience is preferred and is a differentiator
Characterization test program and hardware development experience.
Production test program and hardware development experience
Strong technical knowledge of electronic devices and circuits, and Analog test techniques
Data analysis skills.
Experience with product engineering activities such as yield improvement and test time reduction
Strong understanding of the analog electronics, IC product development process, from concept to volume production
Preferred qualifications:
Analog/Mixed signal test techniques and experience
Experienced with test program and hardware offload to TI offshore manufacturing sites
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem solving skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment
Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

Description:
Amazon Connect Solution Architect | 8 to 15 yrs

Job Description
We are seeking an experienced Amazon Connect Professional with 8-15 years of overall IT experience and strong expertise in cloud-based contact center solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Amazon Connect solutions, IVR platforms, and customer engagement applications.

Roles & Responsibilities
Design and implement end-to-end contact center solutions using Amazon Connect.
Develop and configure IVR flows, call routing strategies, queues, and customer engagement workflows.
Integrate Amazon Connect with AWS services, CRM platforms, APIs, and enterprise applications.
Lead migration and modernization initiatives from legacy contact center platforms to Amazon Connect.
Work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Optimize contact center performance, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide technical guidance to development and support teams.
Mentor junior team members and drive best practices in contact center architecture.
Technical Requirements
8-15 years of IT experience with at least 8+ years of hands-on Amazon Connect experience.
Strong expertise in Amazon Connect, Contact Flows, Lex Bots, and IVR Concepts.
Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, SNS, and Kinesis.
Knowledge of contact center technologies including ACD, CTI, IVR, Routing Strategies, Workforce Optimization, and Omnichannel Support.
Experience integrating Amazon Connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk, or Microsoft Dynamics.
Proficiency in REST APIs, web services, and cloud integrations.
Understanding of contact center reporting, analytics, and monitoring solutions.
AWS certifications are desirable.

Description:
Position: PLM Support Engineer
Experience: 3 to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad (or as applicable)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support
Provide support for CAD integrations with Siemens NX, CATIA, and related engineering applications.
Troubleshoot CAD data loading, synchronization issues, and integration failures.
Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support
Troubleshoot workflow integration issues, dispatcher failures, workflow processing delays, and PDF generation errors.
Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.
Required Technical Skills
PLM Technologies
Strong experience in at least one or more PLM applications:
Teamcenter
Aras Innovator
SmarTeam
Functional Knowledge
Engineering Change Management (ECR/ECO/ECN)
Product Structure Management
BOM Management
Workflow Management
Release Management
Document Management
CAD Integration
Siemens NX
CATIA
CAD Data Management
Technical Skills
SQL Queries and Database Fundamentals
PLM Data Model Understanding
Workflow Configuration and Troubleshooting
Dispatcher Monitoring
PDF Generation Processes
Job Server and Vault Management
Application Log Analysis
Support Tools
ServiceNow / Jira / Remedy
Incident & Change Management Tools
Monitoring and Reporting Tools
Desired Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3 to 8 years of experience in PLM application support.
Experience in global production support environments.
Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
ITIL certification is preferred.
Required Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work with global and cross-functional teams.
Customer-focused approach with strong ownership mindset.
Ability to work in rotational shifts and provide production support when required.
Strong documentation and reporting skills.
Preferred Skills
Teamcenter BMIDE knowledge.
Teamcenter Active Workspace exposure.
Aras administration/support experience.
Understanding of manufacturing and engineering business processes.
Exposure to deployment and release management activities.
Experience in performance tuning and application monitoring.

Description:
What You Must Have
- Expertise in ClaimCenter and working knowledge on Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ContactManager - leading requirement gathering sessions, conduct analysis, develop functional specifications and perform business walkthroughs;
- User story creation/updation, developing process flows, UI mock ups, and developing data mapping in the standard Guidewire recommended user stories;
- Familiarity with Use case, SWOT analysis, Mindmapping, PESTLE analysis; Product Designer
- Usage of Tools JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, Splunk and familiarity with SQL
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4-9 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Demonstrates expert abilities identifying and addressing client needs by: Developing and sustaining impactful client relationships using networking, negotiation and persuasion skills to identify and sell potential new service opportunities; Preparing and presenting complex written and verbal materials; and, Defining resource requirements, project workflow, budgets, billing and collection;
- Demonstrates expert abilities guiding team and motivating, creating a community of high performing professional consultants, creating an atmosphere of trust, leveraging diverse views, coaching staff, and encouraging improvement and innovation;
- Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for utilization and learning perspective of the team. Mentoring and helping to upskill junior resources will be critical in this role;
- Demonstrates intimate abilities and/or a proven record of success developing strategy as well as writing, communicating, facilitating, and presenting cogently; to and/or for all levels of industry audiences, clients and internal staff and management, such as presentation slides, practice marketing materials, change management plans and/or project plans, workshops and whitepapers, practice, methodologies and tools, policies and procedures, and/or other standard business communications;
- Be comfortable, thrive, and available during sustained period of time of instability with client's Guidewire solution and escalations; and,
- Key contributor and thought leader internally and externally with white papers, blogs, and training.
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Actuarial Science, Business Administration/Management, Business Analytics, Commerce, Computer and Information Science, Computer Applications, Computer Engineering, Computer Engineering & Accounting, Data Processing/Analytics/Science, Economics, Electrical Engineering, Engineering, Engineering and Business, Finance, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Mathematics, Mechanical Engineering, Operations Management/Research, Risk Management, Software App, Statistics
- At least one of the following: Guidewire and Scrum Master Certification
- Demonstrating Guidewire ClaimCenter configuration and support skills
- Applying business analysis skills within insurance technology delivery
- Translating client needs into workable functional requirements
- Collaborating across teams on integrations and enhancements
- Mentoring junior team members through complex workstreams

The Opportunity
When you join PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), you step into a pivotal role focused on actively
supporting various Acceleration Center services, from Advisory to Assurance, Tax and Business
Services. In our innovative hubs, youll engage in challenging projects and provide distinctive
services to support client engagements through enhanced quality and innovation. You’ll also
participate in dynamic and digitally enabled training that is designed to grow your technical and
professional skills.
As part of the Business Application Consulting team you are responsible for implementing
Oracle Cloud Financials and managing client relationships. As a Senior Associate, you guide the
execution of complex projects, leveraging your technical strengths and problem-solving skills to
deliver exceptional client solutions.
Responsibilities
- Conduct thorough analysis of financial processes and systems
- Guide junior team members in project execution and delivery
- Facilitate adherence to professional standards and compliance
- Collaborate with clients to understand their financial needs
- Identify areas for enhancement within financial operations
- Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis
- Foster a collaborative team environment for impactful problem-solving
- Stay updated on industry trends and leading practices
What You Must Have
- Master's Degree
- 5 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Process knowledge of Oracle modules
- Experience in writing functional specifications
- Ability to perform configuration based on client requirements
- Exposure to coordinating with third-party vendors
- Experience in conducting client demos on Oracle modules
- Experience in at least one implementation of Cloud Financials
- CA/MBA (Finance)

Role & responsibilities
1. Minimum 4+ years of experience implementing and managing IAM solutions.
2. Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting the Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud (EIC) platform in enterprise environments.
3. Design, configure, and deploy Saviynt EIC solutions tailored to client-specific identity governance and compliance requirements.
4. Experience onboarding applications using Saviynt's out-of-the-box connectors, including Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD, Workday, Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, and Oracle DB.
5. Experience with REST APIs, SCIM, and JIT provisioning for real-time identity orchestration.
6. Hands-on scripting using Groovy, JavaScript, and SQL within Saviynt.
7. Knowledge of Saviynt's Risk-Based Access, Segregation of Duties (SoD) policies, and Compliance Campaigns.
8. Understanding of Saviynt's Delegation Framework, Workflow Engine, and Custom Attributes Mapping.
9. Experience integrating Saviynt with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow and cloud platforms including Azure, AWS, and GCP.
10. Saviynt Certified Professional (SCP) or Saviynt Certified Advanced Professional (SCAP) certification is highly desirable.
AboutCompany:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an AES Salesforce Developer – Senior Associate- Operate, you will focus on connecting Salesforce with other systems, applications, or databases to enable seamless data flow and process automation. Within our Commercial & Service Excellence practice, you will design, develop, and implement integration solutions using various technologies and tools, such as Salesforce APIs, middleware platforms, and web services. This role involves analyzing client needs, implementing software solutions, and providing training and support to help clients optimize operational efficiency and achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections and learn how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions even when the path forward is unclear. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your skills to respond effectively to diverse perspectives and use a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. This position offers an opportunity to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving.

Description:
Role / Job Title- Manager - Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant
Experience - 8 - 14 years

Key Skills -Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, US Payroll, Payroll Configuration, Elements, Calculation Cards, Balances, Fast Formulas, Payroll Flows, Retro Processing and Costing
Location - Bangalore/Hyderabad/ Pune /Gurugram

Role & responsibilities

8 - 14 years of experience in Oracle HCM applications, with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll.
Must have worked on at least two end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, with strong Oracle US Payroll experience; Canada Payroll experience is a plus.
In-depth hands-on configuration across Legislative Data Groups, payroll definitions and calendars, Payroll Statutory Units / Tax Reporting Units, elements, input values, element eligibility, calculation cards, balances, payment methods and payroll costing.
Strong knowledge of QuickPay, payroll flows, retroactive processing, proration, balance adjustments, costing and payment processing.
Hands-on expertise in Payroll Fast Formulas and troubleshooting complex payroll calculation and configuration issues.
Strong understanding of US payroll processing, including federal, state and local taxation, quarter-end / year-end activities and legislative updates.
Experience with HDL / payroll data conversion, payroll extracts and reporting, with the ability to collaborate with technical teams on integrations and extensions.
Ability to perform fit-gap analysis, translate business requirements into scalable configuration, and lead unit testing, UAT / regression testing, quarterly release readiness and production issue resolution.
Strong client-facing communication and delivery leadership, including risk / escalation management, team guidance and working knowledge of Core HR and related HCM touchpoints.
As a Manager, you will serve as the functional lead and client-facing subject matter expert for Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, combining deep payroll configuration expertise with delivery leadership across implementation, enhancement and production support engagements.
Lead the Oracle HCM Payroll functional workstream across solution design, configuration, testing, cutover, hypercare and ongoing support.
Lead client requirement and design discussions, translate payroll policies into Oracle configuration, and provide clear recommendations on solution options and impacts.
Own complex payroll functional issues from analysis through resolution, driving root-cause analysis and sustainable fixes.
Review payroll configurations, functional designs and deliverables for quality, accuracy, controls and adherence to agreed standards.
Manage incidents, service requests, changes and problem records in line with SLAs / KPIs, including prioritization, risks, escalations and stakeholder communication.
Coordinate with Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Time and Labor, Integrations, Reporting and Finance teams, and lead quarterly release impact assessment and regression testing.
Mentor functional consultants, provide configuration oversight, build team capability and drive continuous improvement while maintaining strong client relationships.

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Description:
Designation - Assistant Manager HR (Area HR) - Warehouse
Education - Diploma/Degree , MBA
Age - Up to 38 ( Only Male Candidate )
Experience - 10 to 15 years
Job Description -
1 Talent Acquisition and Onboarding
Manage hiring for all on-roll and contractual roles as per the approved manpower plan.
Coordinate with contractors for daily/weekly manpower availability and ensure the same.
Drive joining formalities, documentation, ID creation, induction and plant orientation.
2. Employee Life Cycle Management (End-to-End)
Maintain employee records, personal files, contract staff muster, shift rosters.
Ensure timely confirmation, transfers, promotions, increments, and separations.
Drive exit formalities, full & final settlement coordination, and attrition control.
3. HR Operations & Payroll Coordination
Ensure accurate inputs for attendance, incentives, weekly off etc.
Verify contractor bills and ensure compliance with MW and Payment of wages & PF/ESIC etc.
Coordinate with the payroll team for timely disbursal and issue resolutions if any.
4. Contract Labour Management
Oversee onboarding, attendance, wage compliance and statutory records for all off-roll employees.
Conduct monthly contractor audits: PF/ESIC challans, wage slips, muster, bonus, leave etc
Ensure CLRA license, RC, and documentation are valid.
5. Statutory Compliance & Audits
Ensure compliance with Factories Act, CLRA, Minimum Wages Act, Bonus Act, Gratuity Act, and other state-specific regulations.
Maintain statutory registers and ensure readiness for inspections.
Support external audits: FSSAI etc
6. Industrial Relations & Discipline
Handle shop floor discipline issues, grievances, counselling, and issue of notices/charge sheets where needed.
Support healthy employee relations in close coordination with the Factory Manager and Area HR Head.
Maintain harmonious relations between staff, operators, contract workforce, and contractors.
7. Training & Capability Building
Identify unit-level training needs (food safety, GMP, safety, HR policy awareness).
Conduct daily/weekly briefing talks or coordinate functional training.
Maintain training records and skill-matrix for operators.
8. Employee Engagement & Welfare
Drive engagement calendar: festivals, R&R, skip-levels, suggestion programs.
Ensure availability of welfare facilities: drinking water, rest area, washrooms, PPE, first-aid, canteen.
Monitor hygiene, safety and morale on the shopfloor.
9. HR MIS, Analytics & Reporting
Prepare and maintain monthly HR dashboards:
Attendance, attrition, overtime, contractor compliance score, open positions, training records, statutory status.
Share daily/weekly MIS with Factory Manager & Area HR Head.
10. Support to Business & Operations
Partner with production, quality and shift leads to ensure manpower efficiency.
Support productivity, food safety and operational performance through timely HR interventions.
Drive culture of discipline, safety, responsibility and performance.

Job Location - Bangalore,Mumbai{Kalyan , Bhiwandi (padgha)} Maharashtra,Hyderabad

Database Administrator (DBA) Responsibilities:
Database Management: Installing, configuring, and maintaining databases, including backups, recovery, and performance tuning.
Data Security: Implementing and maintaining security measures to protect data from unauthorized access and breaches.
Performance Optimization: Analyzing and optimizing database performance to ensure efficient data retrieval and processing.
Data Integrity: Ensuring the accuracy and consistency of data stored in the database.
Database Design: Designing and developing database structures to meet organizational needs.
User Support: Providing technical support and guidance to users regarding database usage and troubleshooting.
Middleware Lead Responsibilities:
Middleware Implementation:
Designing, implementing, and configuring middleware solutions, including application servers, messaging systems, and integration platforms.

Ensuring the ongoing availability, performance, and reliability of middleware infrastructure.
Troubleshooting and Resolution:
Investigating and resolving complex technical issues related to middleware components.
Performance Tuning:
Monitoring and tuning middleware performance to optimize system responsiveness and efficiency.
Integration Management:
Managing the integration of various systems and applications using middleware technologies.
Team Leadership:
Leading and mentoring a team of middleware engineers or administrators.

Skills Required:
Database Management: SQL, database design, performance tuning, security, backup and recovery.
Middleware: Application servers (e.g., WebLogic, WebSphere), messaging systems (e.g., JMS, RabbitMQ), enterprise service buses (ESB), and integration platforms.
Operating Systems: Windows, Linux, Unix.
Networking: TCP/IP, HTTP, web services.
Scripting: Python, Java, shell scripting.
Problem-solving and analytical skills .
Communication and leadership skills .

Description:
Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.

Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.

Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Description:
Network Engineer

Experience : 5 to 10 years
Location : Bangalore

We are seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer with deep expertise in Routers, Switches, Wireless Access Points, Wireless Controllers, and Firewalls to design, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure. This role is responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, and security of the organizations network fabric across LAN, WAN, wireless, and perimeter security domains, supporting business continuity and enabling seamless connectivity.
Responsibilities

Router Administration & WAN Management
Design, deploy, and manage enterprise routers (Cisco, Juniper, or equivalent) across LAN, WAN, and SD-WAN environments
Configure and maintain dynamic routing protocols including OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP for optimal path selection and redundancy
Manage WAN connectivity including MPLS, leased lines, broadband, and SD-WAN overlays
Implement and maintain QoS policies to prioritize business-critical traffic across WAN links
Perform router hardening, IOS/firmware upgrades, and lifecycle management
Troubleshoot routing issues, packet loss, and latency affecting network performance and application availability
Switch Administration & LAN Management
Deploy, configure, and administer enterprise-grade switches (Cisco Catalyst, Nexus, or equivalent) in access, distribution, and core layers
Design and manage VLAN architecture, trunking (802.1Q), and inter-VLAN routing to support network segmentation
Configure and maintain spanning tree protocols (STP, RSTP, MSTP) to prevent loops and ensure redundancy
Implement link aggregation (LACP/PAGP), port security, and storm control across the switching infrastructure
Perform switch stack management, firmware upgrades, and hardware lifecycle activities
Monitor switch performance, port utilization, and MAC address tables to proactively identify and resolve issues
Wireless Access Point Deployment & Management
Deploy, configure, and manage enterprise Wireless Access Points (Cisco, Aruba, Meraki, or equivalent) across campus, branch, and remote sites
Perform RF site surveys, channel planning, and transmit power optimization to ensure seamless wireless coverage
Configure SSIDs, band steering, roaming policies (802.11r/k/v), and QoS for wireless clients
Monitor AP health, client association metrics, and interference sources to maintain optimal wireless performance
Perform firmware upgrades, configuration audits, and hardware replacement for access point lifecycle management
Support high-density wireless deployments for conference rooms, auditoriums, and open-plan office environments
Wireless Controller Administration
Administer and manage centralized Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC) and cloud-managed wireless platforms (Cisco WLC, Aruba Mobility Controller, or equivalent)
Configure and maintain controller-based policies for mobility, roaming, load balancing, and client exclusion
Manage WLAN profiles, RF groups, mobility groups, and guest access portals across controller clusters
Implement and maintain wireless security policies including WPA3, 802.1X/EAP, certificate-based authentication, and NAC integration
Perform controller software upgrades, redundancy failover testing, and disaster recovery validation
Integrate wireless controllers with AAA platforms (RADIUS/TACACS+) and network management systems for centralized visibility
Firewall & Perimeter Security Administration
Design, implement, and manage enterprise firewalls (Cisco ASA/FTD, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, or equivalent) for perimeter and internal segmentation
Create and maintain firewall rule sets, security zones, NAT policies, and application-layer inspection policies
Manage VPN configurations including site-to-site IPSec VPN and remote access VPN (SSL/TLS) for secure connectivity
Implement and maintain Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) policies, URL filtering, and threat intelligence feeds
Conduct periodic firewall rule base reviews, policy optimization, and compliance audits
Respond to security events flagged by firewall logs, and coordinate with the SOC team for threat investigation and remediation

Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field preferred
Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in enterprise network administration and engineering
Strong proficiency in routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) and switching technologies (VLANs, STP, LACP)
Proven experience with enterprise wireless platforms (Cisco, Aruba, or Meraki) including controller and AP management
Hands-on expertise with enterprise firewall platforms (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco FTD, or Check Point)
Experience with network security standards including 802.1X, WPA3, IPSec VPN, and SSL/TLS VPN
Familiarity with network automation tools and scripting (Python, Ansible, Netmiko, or NAPALM)
Strong working knowledge of ITIL principles and ITSM practices
Industry certifications preferred: CCNA / CCNP, PCNSE, NSE 4+, Aruba ACMP, or equivalent
Current understanding of industry trends including SD-WAN, SASE, Zero Trust Networking, and cloud networking
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to detail
Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with ability to work under pressure during critical incidents
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams

We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

Forward Deployed Engineer (AI, Hyperscaler Cloud & DevOps)
Role Summary
We are seeking a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) with expertise in Generative AI, Hyperscaler Cloud Platforms, DevOps, and Platform Engineering. The role involves designing, deploying, integrating, and operationalizing AI agents and cloud-native solutions across enterprise environments while ensuring reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy AI/GenAI agents using Agentic AI frameworks and LLM technologies.
Build and operationalize agent workflows for automation, incident response, RCA, deployment validation, and reliability engineering.
Deploy and manage AI solutions across hyperscaler cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and Kubernetes environments.
Integrate agents with CI/CD pipelines, observability tools, ITSM platforms, code repositories, and enterprise systems.
Develop reusable APIs, connectors, prompt templates, and automation frameworks.
Implement AI governance controls including guardrails, access controls, audit logging, monitoring, cost optimization, and rollback mechanisms.
Own deployment, troubleshooting, observability, and continuous improvement of AI agent platforms.
Collaborate with DevOps, SRE, Security, Platform, and Engineering teams to deliver production-ready solutions.
Required Skills & Experience
5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, SRE, AI/ML Engineering, or related roles.
Strong programming skills in Python with experience building AI/GenAI applications.
Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, Agentic AI frameworks, and LLM technologies.
Experience deploying AI/GenAI solutions in production environments.
Strong understanding of:
Prompt Engineering
RAG
Vector Databases
Tool Calling
Agent Orchestration
Structured Outputs
Strong experience with one or more Hyperscalers: Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Hands-on experience with:
Kubernetes (AKS/EKS/GKE)
Docker
Terraform
GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps / Jenkins
CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Splunk, Dynatrace, or Datadog.
Understanding of DevOps, SRE, cloud reliability, security, and operational best practices.
Preferred Skills
Multi-cloud architecture and deployment experience across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
Experience with AI Reliability Engineering, LLMOps, MCP, Agent Gateways, and Responsible AI practices.
Exposure to .NET or Java application development.
Experience working in enterprise or regulated environments.
Certifications in Azure, AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, AI Engineering, or DevOps.
Behavioral Attributes
Strong ownership mindset with a "get things done" attitude.
Excellent problem-solving and multitasking abilities.
Ability to work directly with client and platform teams.
Curious, adaptable, and eager to learn emerging AI and hyperscaler technologies. & responsibilities

Role Summary
Designs and builds web-based GIS applications and widgets on ArcGIS Enterprise, delivering intuitive
map-centric experiences for utility users.
Key Responsibilities
Develop web mapping applications using the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript, Experience
Builder (Developer Edition) custom widgets and React/TypeScript.
Consume and publish map, feature and utility network services; implement editing, tracing,
querying and reporting functions.
Build integrations with REST APIs and enterprise systems; handle authentication via ArcGIS
identity, OAuth 2.0 or SAML.
Optimise application performance and ensure responsive, accessible UI design.
Write unit and integration tests and participate in code reviews and CI/CD processes.
Collaborate with UX, business analysts and testers to translate requirements into working features.
Required Skills & Experience
Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS and a modern framework (React preferred).
Hands-on experience with ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript (4.x) and ArcGIS REST APIs.
Experience with Experience Builder or Web AppBuilder customisation.
Familiarity with Git, npm and build tooling.
Preferred / Nice to Have
Experience with Utility Network web tracing and editing.
Knowledge of Calcite Design System, ArcGIS Dashboards, Field Maps or Survey123.
Backend skills in Node.js, Python or .NET.
Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geoinformatics, Geography, Computer Science, Engineering or a related
field, or equivalent practical experience

Experience in working with different file formats like JSON, Parquet, AVRO, ORC and XML.

Proficiency in data analysis, data profiling, and data lineage
Strong oral and written communication skills
Experience working in Agile projects.


What You will Love About Capgemini
You can shape your with us. We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini group. You will also get personalized career guidance from our leaders.

Were committed to ensure that people of all backgrounds feel encouraged and have a sense of belonging at Capgemini. You are valued for who you are, and you can .

About Capgemini
Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries.
