Company Profile:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
Job Title: SAP CIP Consultant
Position: Senior Software Engineer
Experience: 5-10 Years
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
Shift: General
Main location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai
Employment Type: Full Time
Education Qualification: Bachelors degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 5 years of relevant experience.
Position Description:
We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer/Sr. Software Engineer – SAP- to join our team. The ideal candidate should be passionate about coding and developing scalable and high-performance applications.
Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and support integrations using SAP CIP / SAP Integration Suite
Manage and monitor integrations between SAP and non-SAP systems
Work closely with SAP Basis and functional teams for system connectivity and performance
Handle deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting of integration scenarios
Support S/4HANA system landscapes including transport management and integration flows
Perform root cause analysis and resolve incidents via tools like JIRA and ServiceNow
Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives)
Ensure system availability, performance, and data consistency across interfaces
Work on SAP HEC/cloud environments for maintenance and operations
Document integration processes, technical designs, and support procedures
Must-Have Skills
5–10 years of SAP experience with strong exposure to SAP CPI / SAP Integration Suite (CIP)
Experience with SAP S/4HANA systems
Strong understanding of SAP Basis fundamentals
Hands-on experience in integration technologies (REST, SOAP, IDoc, RFC, APIs)
Exposure to SAP HEC (HANA Enterprise Cloud) or similar cloud environments
Experience with monitoring and troubleshooting integration flows
Familiarity with JIRA and ServiceNow for incident and change management
Understanding of Agile methodologies
Strong problem-solving and communication skills
Good-to-Have Skills
Experience with SAP PI/PO (Process Integration/Process Orchestration)
Exposure to SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) services
Knowledge of API Management and Event Mesh
Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
Scripting knowledge (Groovy, Java, or similar used in CPI)
Exposure to security protocols (OAuth, SAML, SSL)
SAP certifications in CPI / Integration Suite / S4HANA
Experience working in multi-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP)
CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.
Life at CGI:
It is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons
Come join our team, one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world

Description:
Job DescriptionPosition Requirements:


Job Overview
In this role, you will work with PwC and client team members to design and deliver efficient Financial Close, Consolidation and/or FP&A processes. You will lead key aspects of OneStream implementations, including planning, solution design, configuration, build, testing, training, change management, go-live and post-go-live support. This position may require you to work directly with clients from an offshore location and at client sites.


Responsibilities Include
Knowledge Preferred: The candidate is expected to have strong knowledge of OneStream and functional expertise in FP&A, Financial Close and Consolidation, or both.
•  Strong knowledge of OneStream and functional expertise in FP&A, Financial Close and Consolidation, or both.
•  Strong understanding of OneStream application design, metadata, workflows, security, business rules, reporting and integrations.
•  Experience implementing planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial close, consolidation and management reporting solutions.
•  Good knowledge of Multi-GAAP, multi-entity and multi-currency applications.
•  For consolidation-focused candidates, good understanding of intercompany eliminations, consolidation adjustments, ownership accounting, currency translation and group reporting.
•  For FP&A-focused candidates, good understanding of integrated planning, driver-based forecasting, allocations, scenario modelling and management reporting.
•  Experience developing Cube Views, dashboards, reports and Excel Add-In solutions, and using/configuring relevant OneStream Marketplace Solutions.
•  Good understanding of data integration, data validation, reconciliation and financial reporting processes.
•  Ability to lead requirement-gathering and solution-design activities, support testing and deployment, establish best practices, guide team members and client stakeholders, and build prototypes or proof-of-concept applications.


Job Requirements
The candidate should be able to demonstrate abilities and proven success in end-to-end implementation of OneStream CPM/EPM projects:
•  8+ years of overall experience in CPM/EPM, finance transformation, financial systems or related consulting roles.
•  Minimum 6 years of hands-on OneStream experience, with at least two end-to-end implementation projects.
•  Strong functional expertise in FP&A or Financial Close and Consolidation; experience across at least one or both areas is preferred.
•  Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and sustainable OneStream solutions.
•  Experience designing and configuring metadata, workflows, security, business rules, integrations, reports and dashboards, including relevant OneStream Marketplace Solutions.
•  Ability to identify process-improvement opportunities and recommend standardized, automated and scalable solutions.
•  Experience managing system integration testing, user acceptance testing, data validation, cutover, deployment and hypercare activities.
•  Ability to manage multiple workstreams and coordinate activities across business, functional, technical and integration teams.
•  Experience managing project deliverables, timelines, dependencies, risks, issues and stakeholder communication.
•  Ability to lead teams involving multiple territories in Onshore-Offshore Model
•  Demonstrated people-management skills, including leading and mentoring team members, allocating work effectively, providing regular coaching and performance feedback, and fostering a collaborative and inclusive team environment.
•  Ability to review solution designs and project deliverables for quality, consistency and alignment with OneStream best practices.
•  Ability to guide business users during planning, forecasting, month-end, quarter-end or year-end reporting cycles, based on the candidate's area of expertise.
•  Experience leading and mentoring project team members, with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation and documentation skills.
•  OneStream certification and prior consulting experience are preferred.
Additional Job DescriptionAdditional Job DescriptionThe Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Manager in OneStream Implementation for Finance Solutions, you will lead the design and delivery of efficient financial processes, focusing on Financial Close, Consolidation, and FP&A. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to enhance financial operations, streamline processes, and implement solutions that improve decision-making and financial performance for our clients.

As a Manager, you will guide and develop teams, manage client accounts, and drive strategic planning. You will be responsible for mentoring junior staff, confirming project success, and maintaining standards. Your role will involve identifying opportunities, embracing technology, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will collaborate with both PwC and client teams to implement OneStream solutions, manage project deliverables, and provide guidance on financial systems and process automation.

Responsibilities

- Leading the design and delivery of efficient Financial Close, Consolidation, and FP&A processes using OneStream
- Managing end-to-end OneStream implementations, including planning, solution design, configuration, and testing
- Guiding teams in change management, training, and post-go-live support for OneStream solutions
- Coordinating with client stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable OneStream solutions
- Overseeing the development of Cube Views, dashboards, reports, and Excel Add-In solutions
- Implementing process improvements and recommending automated solutions to enhance financial operations
- Managing system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and data validation activities
- Leading multiple workstreams and coordinating activities across business, functional, and technical teams
- Providing mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment
- Reviewing solution designs and project deliverables for quality and alignment with OneStream standards
- Supporting business users during planning, forecasting, and reporting cycles based on area of expertise
- Utilizing financial data mining and modeling skills to enhance decision-making and financial strategy development

What You Must Have

- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 8+ years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

- Possessing OneStream certification
- Demonstrating prior consulting experience
- Excelling in financial data mining and analysis
- Utilizing advanced financial modeling techniques
- Developing comprehensive financial forecasting strategies
- Managing complex financial reporting processes
- Leading cross-functional teams in finance operations

Description:
Job DescriptionGrowing as a strategic advisor, you leverage your influence, expertise, and network to deliver quality results. You motivate and coach others, coming together to solve complex problems. As you increase in autonomy, you apply sound judgment, recognising when to take action and when to escalate. You are expected to solve through complexity, ask thoughtful questions, and clearly communicate how things fit together. Your ability to develop and sustain high performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, and your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our Firm.


Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:


Craft and convey clear, impactful and engaging messages that tell a holistic story.
Apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems and/or opportunities.
Validate outcomes with clients, share alternative perspectives, and act on client feedback.
Direct the team through complexity, demonstrating composure through ambiguous, challenging and uncertain situations.
Deepen and evolve your expertise with a focus on staying relevant.
Initiate open and honest coaching conversations at all levels.
Make difficult decisions and take action to resolve issues hindering team effectiveness.
Model and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.
Additional Job DescriptionAdditional Job DescriptionThe Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Senior Manager - Treasury Management System Implementation, you will specialize in enhancing financial operations and strategies within our Finance practice. You will assess financial processes, identify areas for improvement, and design solutions to streamline operations, enhance controls, and reduce costs. As a Senior Manager, you will leverage your skills and professional networks to deliver quality results, motivate and coach teams, and solve complex problems. You will apply sound judgment, recognize when to take action, and communicate effectively to drive project success.

In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on implementing financial systems, process automation, and financial shared services. You will craft and convey clear, impactful messages, apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems, and validate outcomes with clients. Your ability to lead teams through complexity and demonstrate composure in challenging situations will contribute to the success of our firm. You will initiate open and honest coaching conversations, make difficult decisions, and model professional standards, reinforcing the firm's code of conduct and independence requirements.

Responsibilities


- Lead end-to-end Treasury Management System (Kyriba, FIS Quantum, FIS Integrity, GTreasury) implementations, including design, configuration, testing, and go-live, along with bank/ERP integrations.
- Drive treasury transformation initiatives covering cash management, forecasting, investments, debt, risk (FX/IR/Commodity), in-house bank, and payment factory setup, while optimizing treasury processes.
- Manage client delivery and team performance by providing TMS product support, supporting business development, and coaching/mentoring team members to ensure high-quality outcomes.
- Leading the implementation of treasury management systems to enhance financial operations
- Analyzing client financial processes to identify areas for improvement and cost reduction
- Designing and implementing solutions to streamline financial operations and enhance controls
- Providing strategic guidance on financial systems implementation and process automation
- Coaching and motivating teams to solve complex financial challenges and drive project success
- Applying systems thinking to uncover underlying financial problems and opportunities
- Validating outcomes with clients and incorporating feedback to refine financial strategies
- Directing teams through complex and uncertain situations with composure and clarity
- Developing and sustaining diverse and inclusive high-performing teams
- Crafting and conveying clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic financial story
- Initiating open and honest coaching conversations to foster team development
- Making informed decisions to resolve issues affecting team effectiveness
- Modeling and reinforcing professional and technical standards within financial operations

What You Must Have


- An undergraduate degree from top institutes followed by relevant work experience (Core Consulting experience would be an added bonus), or
- MBA in Finance from a premium B-School / Qualified CA / CPA/ ICWA / CMA with relevant consulting experience
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 12 years of experience
- At least one of the following: Certified Public Accountant
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

The Client Manager is responsible to understand the business and most important be a bearer of relationship with Enterprise Customer, with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for the assigned Enterprise Customers. Job Title: SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant

Location: Bangalore / Pune / Mumbai / Gandhinagar
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant to join our growing SAP practice. As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant at Capgemini, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate business processes and enhance operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with functional consultants, business users, and technical teams to deliver innovative workflow-based solutions across SAP landscapes.
As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant, you will:
Design, develop, and implement SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate end-to-end business processes.
Configure and develop workflow components including Tasks, Standard Tasks, Workflows, Events, Methods, Rule Resolution, and Agents.
Create and enhance Business Objects (BOR) and ABAP OO-based workflow objects.
Develop custom workflow functionalities using ABAP programming techniques, User Exits, BAdIs, Enhancements, and Function Modules.
Configure event management and workflow triggering mechanisms using change documents, business transactions, and custom events.
Develop and troubleshoot workflow notifications, work items, inbox configurations, and approval processes.
Integrate workflows with SAP modules such as MM, SD, FI, CO, HCM, and SRM based on business requirements.
Perform workflow administration activities including monitoring, debugging, error handling, and performance optimization.
Work with functional consultants and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical workflow solutions.
Ensure adherence to SAP development standards, best practices, and quality processes throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in SAP ABAP Workflow Development.
Expertise in SAP Business Workflow configuration and development.
Experience with BOR (Business Object Repository) and ABAP OO Workflow.
Good knowledge of Workflow Administration, Event Management, Agent Determination, and Rule Resolution.
Strong ABAP development skills including Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, User Exits, Function Modules, and Object-Oriented ABAP.
Experience in workflow debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA workflow framework will be an added advantage.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.Role & responsibilities

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Lead SAP PM functional consulting activities across requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
Conduct workshops with business stakeholders to understand maintenance processes, asset management requirements, and operational challenges.
Configure and implement SAP Plant Maintenance functionalities including Technical Objects, Functional Locations, Equipment Masters, Work Centers, Maintenance Notifications, Maintenance Orders, Task Lists, Maintenance Plans, and Measuring Points/Counters.
Design and optimize preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance processes aligned with business objectives.
Analyze business requirements and prepare functional specifications for custom developments, reports, forms, enhancements, interfaces, and workflows.
Perform fit-gap analysis and recommend SAP best practices to improve maintenance efficiency and asset reliability.
Work closely with ABAP, Basis, Data Migration, and Integration teams to implement business requirements.
Configure and support calibration management, refurbishment processes, warranty tracking, and maintenance costing processes.
Manage SAP PM integration with MM, QM, PP, SD, PS, and FICO modules to support end-to-end business processes.
Support inventory and spare parts management through PM-MM integration.
Define authorization requirements and assist in security role testing related to maintenance functions.
Participate in data migration activities involving equipment masters, functional locations, maintenance plans, task lists, and historical maintenance data.
Develop and execute unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), and regression testing scenarios.
Prepare configuration documents, functional design documents (FDD), business process documents (BPD), test scripts, and end-user training materials.
Support cutover planning, go-live activities, hypercare support, and production stabilization.
Analyze and resolve production issues, ensuring adherence to SLAs and business continuity requirements.
Collaborate with business users to drive continuous process improvements and system optimization initiatives.
Provide guidance on SAP S/4HANA PM functionalities and Fiori applications related to maintenance operations.
Support implementation of asset management strategies focused on equipment reliability, maintenance compliance, and cost optimization.
Participate in project estimation, effort planning, risk assessment, and change request management.
Mentor junior consultants and provide functional expertise during project execution.
Work directly with client leadership, plant maintenance teams, operations teams, and external stakeholders in a customer-facing consulting role.
Ensure solutions comply with industry standards and maintenance best practices across Manufacturing, Automotive, Pharma, Chemicals, Utilities, Oil & Gas, and Engineering sectors.
Must have hands-on experience in at least one complete end-to-end SAP PM implementation lifecycle covering Blueprint, Realization, Testing, Go-Live, and Hypercare phases.

Preferred candidate profile

Minimum 6+ years of strong SAP PM functional consulting experience.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline.
Completed at least one full-cycle end-to-end SAP PM implementation project with active involvement across all project phases.
Strong hands-on expertise in SAP PM configuration and business process design.
Experience working on SAP S/4HANA PM implementations, migrations, or transformation projects.
Good understanding of Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and maintenance management best practices.
Proven experience in maintenance planning, preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, shutdown management, and asset lifecycle management.
Strong integration knowledge with SAP MM, QM, PP, PS, and FICO modules.
Experience in preparing functional specifications and coordinating with technical teams for developments and enhancements.
Exposure to Fiori applications and SAP S/4HANA innovations in Plant Maintenance.
Ability to independently interact with business stakeholders and translate business requirements into SAP solutions.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in client-facing consulting environments and global delivery models.
SAP PM or SAP S/4HANA Asset Management certification will be an added advantage.
Prior experience in Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical, Automotive, Utilities, Chemicals, EPC, or Oil & Gas industries preferred.
Ability to work from Mumbai, Pune, or Bangalore and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Candidates with implementation plus support/rollout experience will be highly preferred.
Immediate joiners or candidates with short notice periods are preferred.

Description:
Job description

SAP MDG Consultant
Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)
Experience:
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.
Mandatory Skills
SAP MDG
Data Governance
Data Quality Management
Data Replication
Data Validation
Material Master
Business Partner Master
Customer Master
Vendor Master
Financial Master Data
Good to Have
SAP Information Steward
SAP Data Services (BODS)
SAP MDG on S/4HANA
Workflow Configuration
Business Rules Framework (BRF+)
Data Modeling
Master Data Consolidation
Data Cleansing
Data Harmonization
SAP S/4HANA Integration
Master Data Management Processes
SAP Migration Cockpit
SAP Cloud Integration
SAP Fiori for MDG
SAP BTP Exposure
Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.

Description:
Territory Sales Manager (TSM)
About NoBroker Technologies Private Limited
NoBrokerHood, a part of NoBroker Technologies Pvt.Ltd. Our founders understood the need to have a tech-enabled
visitor and community management system, that aims to make life convenient, hassle-free, and secure for the
residents of a gated community. Thus, NoBrokerHood was launched. NoBrokerHood is a smart visitor, society and
accounting management system. From our start in late 2018, NoBrokerHood is currently securing 20,000+ societies
under its hood. From catering to all the society needs like complaint management, gate entry, maintenance bill
payments, digital notice board, it also has features like Marketplace, home services and more. NoBrokerHood goes
beyond visitor and gate management delivering an end-to-end community experience that empowers residents
and management committees with digital convenience, revenue growth, and future-ready innovation.
To know more about NoBrokerHood, visit our website - https://www.nobrokerhood.com/
About the role:
We are currently looking to hire an energetic, highly motivated, can-do attitude individual who is willing to join our
team as a Territory Sales Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for acquiring leads and generating revenue
by onboarding new apartment complexes and societies into NoBrokerHood by meeting with prospective clients in
person and explaining the product.
Job Description:-



Minimum 1-5 years of proven sales track record and ability to meet targets.
Lead generation through prospecting referral and web researches
Should have an interest in Business Development (B2C/ B2B) for Software Application Products
/solutions.

Meet prospective clients, execute effective product demonstrations, and emphasize product features and
benefits with a focus on the value of the solution.


Capabilities of selling Hardware IOT devices
Meet with Committee Members of Apartments and Societies,accounting services partners and builders to
understand the scope of business and their expectations.




Prospect, educate, qualify, and generate interest for Sales Opportunities and lead conversions.
Ability to do product demonstrations to higher level authorities
Onboarding new apartments on the NoBrokerHood platform will be a major KRA.
Researching potential leads from the open market, web searches, or digital resources.
Mandatory requirements for this position





Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Should be proficient in English and Regional language (knowing the regional language of the job location
will be a plus).






Should be comfortable working on weekends(Sat & Sun compulsory working), with a week off on Monday.
Effective presentation and negotiation skills.
Hands-on MS Office Excel, Word & PPT, etc.
Ability to handle CRM softwares
A valid drivers license(DL) with a two-wheeler/four-wheeler as this role requires you to be on the field.
Geographical knowledge of the job location is an added advantage.
What we have to offer!

Working directly with the leadership team; having a high level of work independence, autonomy, and
empowerment to lead company-wide changes


Flexible working hours
Being part of a start-up from an early stage, lead your area of expertise and be a part of this exciting growth
journey of changing the real estate world


Excellent platform for learning how to build teams, achieve goals and handle high-growth situations. Ideal
for people with entrepreneurial ambitions.
Uncapped variables based on performance
Benefits





Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance
Travel Allowance
Monthly R&R awards
Early promotions for the outstanding performers

Through NoBrokerHood, our smart society and community management platform, we empower over 21,000+ societies across 15 major cities—offering seamless visitor management, billing, and engagement experiences.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Solutions Architect / Solutions Manager
Role Overview
We are hiring a Solutions Architect / Solutions Manager to own technical pre-sales and deal pursuit in our Data Engineering, Data Analytics and AI practice. You will lead client conversations from first discovery call to signed proposal, design the target architecture, and shape the commercial response. This is a client-facing role for someone who is equally comfortable at a whiteboard and in a deal review.
Role
Solutions Architect / Solutions Manager
Experience
58 years
Location
Pune / Mumbai / Bangalore
Work setup
Hybrid
Domain
Data Engineering, Data Analytics and AI
Preferred background
IT Services
Key Responsibilities
Client engagement and discovery
Lead technical and business discovery conversations with CXOs, data leaders and architects to understand goals, constraints and the current data landscape.
Drive credible, consultative technical discussions on data platforms, analytics and AI use cases, and position our point of view against client priorities.
Solution architecture
Design end-to-end solutions and reusable frameworks across data ingestion, lakehouse, data modelling, governance, BI and AI/ML on Azure + Databricks or AWS + Databricks.
Define target-state architectures, migration and modernisation roadmaps, and effort and delivery approaches that delivery teams can execute.
Run solution reviews, proof-of-concepts and demos with technical and business stakeholders.
Deal ownership, discovery to closure
Own the pursuit end to end: discovery, solution design, estimation, proposal or RFP response, pricing inputs, negotiation support and closure.
Work with Sales, Delivery, Practice and Finance leaders to build winning, deliverable and profitable proposals.
Maintain pipeline hygiene, deal qualification and win/loss insights.
Practice and delivery enablement
Build solution accelerators, reference architectures, case studies and pitch material for the practice.
Hand over won deals smoothly to delivery, and stay engaged as a trusted advisor to protect scope, quality and client relationships.
Track hyperscaler and Databricks roadmap changes, and work with partner teams on joint pursuits.
Required Qualifications and Skills
5–8 years of experience, with a strong IT Services or consulting background preferred.
Proven experience in pre-sales, solutioning or solution management for Data Engineering, Data Analytics and AI engagements.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture: lakehouse, ELT/ETL, streaming, data modelling, data governance and BI.
Working experience with Azure + Databricks or AWS + Databricks (for example Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Spark, workflows and MLflow).
Demonstrated ability to architect solutions and frameworks, not just describe them.
Track record of owning deals end to end: discovery, solution, proposal, pricing and closure.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to lead technical conversations with client architects and senior business stakeholders.
Strong written skills for proposals, RFP responses and solution documents.
Ability to work across Sales, Delivery and Practice teams and manage multiple pursuits at once.
Good to Have
Hands-on technical experience: PySpark, SQL, Python, or building PoCs and demos on Databricks.
Exposure to Generative AI, ML and MLOps use cases on Databricks, Azure or AWS.
Databricks, Azure or AWS certifications (for example Databricks Data Engineer / Architect, Azure Data Engineer, AWS Data Analytics).
Experience with tools such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse or Fabric, AWS Glue or Redshift, dbt, Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with cloud migration and data modernisation programmes, such as moving from legacy warehouses to a lakehouse.
Exposure to Databricks or hyperscaler partner ecosystems and co-sell motions.
What Success Looks Like
Discovery conversations that lead to a clear, client-validated problem statement and solution direction.
Proposals that are technically sound, competitively priced and delivered on time.
A healthy pipeline and a strong win rate on qualified Data, Analytics and AI deals.
Reusable architectures and accelerators that shorten future pursuits.
Smooth handover to delivery and repeat business from the clients you won.

Description:
Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
About us and our teams

Position Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Manager for SAP CO (Controlling) with expertise in SAP S/4 HANA. The Senior Manager will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of the SAP Controlling module within our SAP S/4 HANA environment. This role requires both technical and functional expertise in SAP CO, along with strong leadership abilities to manage a team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
SAP CO (Controlling) Implementation & Optimization:
Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of SAP CO modules (Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Drive system enhancements and process optimizations in SAP CO in the context of SAP S/4 HANA, aligning them with business requirements.
Work closely with business users and other SAP functional teams (e.g., FI, MM, SD) to ensure seamless integration and data consistency across modules.

Project Management:
Manage end-to-end SAP CO module projects including planning, requirements gathering, design, testing, and go-live support.
Oversee SAP CO HANA transformation and migration projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and in budget.
Manage and mentor a team of functional consultants and business analysts.

Team Leadership & Collaboration:
Lead and develop a high-performing team of SAP CO professionals.
Provide guidance on troubleshooting, performance tuning, and solution optimization.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into system functionality.

System Maintenance & Support:
Ensure the continued smooth operation of the SAP CO module by providing technical support and troubleshooting.
Oversee regular system upgrades, patches, and performance tuning for SAP HANA.
Monitor and ensure data integrity and consistency across financial and controlling modules.

Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities to enhance SAP CO processes and tools for greater efficiency and accuracy.
Stay updated on the latest SAP innovations, particularly SAP S/4 HANA and best practices in CO and finance modules.

Qualifications:
Experience:
8-12 years of hands-on experience with SAP CO, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership or senior management role.
Extensive experience with SAP S/4 HANA implementation, migration, or optimization in a Controlling context.
Proven track record in managing SAP CO projects, end-to-end implementations, or system enhancements.

Skills:
Strong expertise in SAP CO configuration (Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Experience with SAP FICO integration (FI, MM, SD, etc.).
In-depth knowledge of SAP S/4 HANA features and capabilities related to CO.
Strong project management skills with a solid understanding of Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certifications (e.g., SAP certifications, PMP) are a plus.

Additional Skills/Desirable:
Experience with other SAP modules (e.g., SAP MM, SD, and FI).
Knowledge of financial reporting and compliance requirements.
Ability to work effectively with business users and senior leadership.

Description:
Role: EY- Assurance Manager ( Audit )
Experience: 5 to 9 years
Notice Period - Immediate to 30 Days
Location: Pune and Bangalore
Mode of work - Hybrid

As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.

The opportunity:

Were looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles

Your key responsibilities:

Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement teams expectations
Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team.
Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team’s skills.
Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.

Skills and attributes for success:

Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience
Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience
Articleship with other top or mid -tier accounting firms
Experience in either:

a) Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters.

b) MNC or larger Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service
Environment.

c) Big 4 Firms - Indian & Global practice.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.

What we look for:

A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

What we Offer:

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY:

EY | Building a better working world:

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

Job Description: Data Modeler Developer
Location: Bangalore / Pune

Role Purpose
Design and maintain high-quality enterprise data models for Private Banking and Wealth platforms, ensuring consistent, governed, and scalable data structures across client, portfolio, and transaction domains. • Ensure all data models comply with data governance, quality, and control frameworks
• Maintain data model documentation, standards, and reusable artefacts
• Support data lineage and traceability through well-structured modelling practices
• Collaborate with engineering teams to support implementation of data models into databases and data platforms
• Ensure consistency of data models across multiple systems and platforms
• Contribute to enterprise data standards, modelling guidelines, and best practices
• Participate in design reviews and architecture governance forums
• 5-8 years of experience in data modelling
• Strong experience in Private Banking / Wealth Management domain
• Understanding of wealth data structures (client lifecycle, portfolio, transactions, products)
• Experience working with multi-system banking environments

Job Title: Senior Java Developer
Experience: 7-12 Years
Location: Pune / Mumbai / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior Java Developer with 7-12 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing enterprise-grade applications using Java and related technologies. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices architecture, REST APIs, cloud technologies, and modern software development practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable and high-performance enterprise applications.
Build and maintain Microservices-based applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Develop RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and external systems.
Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
Implement security, logging, monitoring, and observability best practices.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, QA teams, and DevOps engineers.
Perform code reviews and mentor junior developers.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Follow Agile/Scrum methodologies and participate in sprint planning, estimations, and retrospectives.

Strong experience in Java 8/11/17

Experience with Hibernate/JPA
Proficiency in SQL databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server
Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB/Cassandra preferred)
Knowledge of Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or JMS Messaging
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
Strong understanding of Git, Maven, Gradle
Experience with AWS/Azure/GCP Cloud Platforms
Knowledge of Design Patterns, SOLID Principles, and Clean Code practices

Preferred Skills
Experience with Event-Driven Architecture
Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
Experience with Monitoring tools (Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus)
Knowledge of OAuth2, JWT, SAML, and Identity Management
Certification in AWS, Azure, or Java technologies is a plus
Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
7-12 years of experience in Java application development.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Nice to Have
Experience in Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Telecom, Retail, or Healthcare domains.
Experience leading technical teams or serving as a Technical Lead.
Cloud-native application development experience.

Spring Boot
Microservices

Agile/Scrum

Description:
Job Title - Associate Scientific Writing
Bangalore, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi , Hyderabad, Noida, Gurgaon
Employees work in a hybrid mode
Contract (6 months - 8 months) might extend depends on your performance.

Company Description
We are a technology-led healthcare solutions provider. We are driven by our purpose to enable healthcare organizations to be future-ready. We offer accelerated, global growth opportunities for talent thats bold, industrious, and nimble. With Indegene, you gain a unique career experience that celebrates entrepreneurship and is guided by passion, innovation, collaboration, and empathy. To explore exciting opportunities at the convergence of healthcare and technology, check out www.careers.indegene.com Looking to jump-start your career? We understand how important the first few years of your career are, which create the foundation of your entire professional journey. At Indegene, we promise you a differentiated career experience. You will not only work at the exciting intersection of healthcare and technology but also will be mentored by some of the most brilliant minds in the industry. We are offering a global fast-track career where you can grow along with Indegenes high-speed growth. We are purpose-driven. We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision-making, and industrious in the way we work.
We are a rapidly growing global organization and are scouting for the best talent for this phase of growth. With us, you are at the intersection of two of the most exciting industries of healthcare and technology. We offer global opportunities with fast-track careers while you work with a team that is fueled by purpose. The combination of this will lead to a truly differentiated experience for you.
If this excites you, then apply below.
Who are you?
We are looking for a talented professional with Dutch and English copywriting skills focused on the Medical Industry, who can work on developing copy content for brand deliverables. This role would complement the design team, while working for our client in the pharmaceutical industry.
The focus of the role will be to create promotional communication content. You should be recognized as a brand expert with an ability to translate the science and data into compelling promotional copy complying with medical, regulatory, legal and compliance guidelines. The aim is to make the complex simple’ adapting larger pieces of content to create smaller, easy-to-read materials for digital and non-digital channels, maintaining key medical messaging and being able to anchor medical literature references.
Creativity, innovative thinking, and problem-solving should be at the heart of all you do.
Job Description:
The role and responsibilities of the Medical Copywriter includes the following:
The main focus is to develop and update content for various commercial assets, with an additional focus upon omnichannel implementation on digital channels (including but not limited to banner ads, emails, sales rep materials such as i-detail, social media posts/content and websites) – as well as printed material (including but not limited to posters, slide kits, patient guidelines, sales content, leaflets and conference materials).
The role works within medical, regulatory, and legal guidelines to ensure compliance with legislation and regulations in the Netherlands, including the client's internal policies. It also ensures that all content is supported by authentic, current, and up-to-date references. A working understanding of the CGR Code (Code Geneesmiddelenreclame) and the Dutch Medicines Act is required.
There may be occasional opportunities to be involved in creative projects involving ideation and moving image for campaign level activity.
Working in partnership with a graphic design team (on the needs for copy and content), with the brand and production teams on briefs, workshops and project deliveries.
Ensuring compliance to local legislation and regulations including client internal policies, ensuring that content development & activities are supported by authentic and up-to-date references.
Follow best practices in the department regarding processes, communication (internal and external), project management, documentation and technical requirements such as language, grammar, stylization, content search, summarizing, data conflicts, and referencing
Adherence to the highest editorial standards is expected while creating copy drafts
Participating in assigned training programs and working on assignments as per requirement.
Participating in client calls as per project requirements
Use of, overseeing and harnessing the advantages of AI tools in providing accurate and relevant copy content.
Being compliant to quality, confidentiality, and security; adhering to and following quality systems, processes, and policies; and being compliant to training and specifications.
Ideal Profile:
Education— related healthcare Degree/Masters or equivalent qualification preferable
Minimum of 3+ years of experience, including an in-house creative or agency role working with Pharma sector clients
Awareness of local and country/region specific regulatory requirements
Familiarity with / intermediate understanding of, the fields of medicine and good to have respiratory & immunology, cardiovascular, renal & metabolic, oncology therapy areas
Be open to developing such knowledge, outlined immediately above, further working with relevant Medical teams
Strong flair, skills and passion for writing with conceptual ability and a solid knowledge of the digital landscape
Strong written and verbal communication/presentation skills
To have had relevant experience and being skilled in SEO copywriting, pairing best practices that drive traffic (keyword research), with compelling copy, encouraging a desired action, is a distinct advantage.
Passion for networking and stakeholder engagement.
Being up to date with the latest technical/scientific developments and relating them to various projects
Client-oriented attitude with focus on creating strong long-term relationships with clients and encouraging others to work toward this goal
Ability to assure timely completion of assignments
Skilled in problem identification and problem solving
Detail oriented, well organized and timeline driven with the ability to multitask.
Experience working within a large multi-national company in a matrix corporate environment preferable.
Should have both strong written and verbal communication skills in native Dutch language and good business English language skills.
Qualifications
(Lifescience BSC/ MS/ MSC) + MBA

We leverage the depth of our scientific expertise, scale of our operations, our hybrid delivery model, global footprint and intellectual property to deliver value across multiple dimensions. We are 500 plus professionals spread across various locations.

Medical Education, Marketing and e-marketing programs
Medical Affairs-Publication writing, Medical Information Management, Medical Communications
Training and eLearning
Research, Analytics and Intelligence
Patient Compliance and Adherence program management Virtual Sales Organizations
Clinical trial analytics and benchmarking platform
KOL Management & Medical Science Liasioning

Role: Workday Compensation Consultant
Exp: 2 to 5 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on stock grants and updates, Processing Bonus Events, One-time payments, Future payments, consolidated Merits.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Recruiting, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Compensation modules.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Compensation areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Recruiting, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai. About the Role: As an Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.

Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.

Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand.

Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).

Key Competencies:
Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

Description:
About the Role
Were building and growing our hyperlocal (on-demand) logistics business within Delhivery, and are for someone who can take ownership from day zero acquiring customers, shaping the GTM motion, and building a repeatable revenue engine.
You will operate as a full-stack sales owner — from identifying opportunities within SMEs and enterprises to closing deals and ensuring long-term account success. The role requires a mix of hunting (acquisition) and farming (growth & retention), with a strong bias toward building from scratch.

What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end sales cycle: prospecting pitching closing account growth for leads with monthly wallet potential of 5L to 10L
Acquire and onboard SMEs and enterprise customers onto Delhivery’s hyperlocal logistics platform
Build a strong pipeline through outbound efforts, partnerships, and market mapping
Work closely with operations to ensure a seamless fulfillment experience for customers while providing top-notch customer assistance
Drive account expansion and retention, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities
Develop a deep understanding of customer supply chains and last-mile needs
Contribute to GTM strategy, pricing inputs, and product feedback as an early member of the business
Lay the foundation for scaling this business line and becoming a trusted + reliable logistics partner for our customers
Who We’re Looking For
2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, with a strong focus on acquisition-led roles
Prior experience in logistics, on-demand delivery, or supply chain platforms
Strong exposure to both SME and enterprise sales
Hands-on experience with solution selling (not just transactional sales)
High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in 0-1 environments
Strong understanding of last-mile logistics, fulfillment challenges, and operational nuances

What Makes This Role Different
You’re not inheriting a book of business — you’re building it
Direct impact on shaping a new vertical within Delhivery
Opportunity to scale into a larger role as the business grows
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Description:
Job Title: Intern
Department: Operations
About Business line/Function: The Operations team includes different business units such as Securities Services, Wealth Management, Global Banking Operations, Markets Operations (back office & middle office) and Client engagement & Financial Securities.
These business units provides services to global clients across Asia, Europe & US region offering a wide range of services, which include custody operations, fund accounting, middle-office operations, static data management, trade clearing and settlement operations, securities lending, corporate action, Tax Operations, AML / KYC and other transversal services.
Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe. 
The incumbent will be managing the daily operations/workflow within the business group and helps the Leads in achieving the process deliverables. 
Responsibilities
Processing of transactions within the agreed timelines
Ensure all the transactions are completed and approved in the system within the TAT /SLA
Ensure all the transactions are processed with at most care without errors/mistakes.
Prioritize the work and conduct investigation with due diligence on all the discrepancies.
Taking corrective measures/action in consultation with the Leads
Escalate unresolved open items to the Leads
Maintain Communication Channels with internal peer groups.
Participate in Cross Training and ensure the Knowledge transfer between the team and processes is happening on periodic basis.
Participate in Brainstorming Sessions and share the best practices and ideas with the peer groups and team members.
Consistently evaluate and update documented procedures to ensure they are complete, accurate and current
The position interfaces with other Process Associates, Mid Office Staff, Relationship Managers and Clients
The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management policies and procedures. Identify and report any potential risks or compliance issues.
Quality Assurance: Conduct regular self-checks to ensure that all processes and transactions meet the required standards and guidelines.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in French language
Strong analytical skills, detail orientation, service commitment, solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in shifts as required.
Specific Qualifications:
Graduation in any discipline
DELF B1 and above certification in French language
Location: Mumbai/ Chennai/ Bangalore
About BNP Paribas Group:
BNP Paribas is the European Unions leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Groups commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
About BNP Paribas India Solutions:
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, color, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.
