Description:
Overview
Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecyclefrom concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore & Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.

Your Role
Roles & Responsibilities
Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks (Dry and Wet), Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices & methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
Use of Vehicle tracking

Software Skills
Autodesk Civil 3D
AutoCAD
Navisworks
MicroStation, ORD (Preferred )
ProjectWise / Forma
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Required Skills & Competencies
Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
Good communication and coordination skills
Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Advisory.
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
The Technology Strategy & Advisory Practice is a part of and focuses on the clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
We provide you with a great learning ground, deep-rooted in , where you will get an opportunity to advice and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth. As a part of this high performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will drive:
Transaction Advisory and Strategy (Tech): Lead and support M&A transactions (Carve Outs / Separation / Mergers/ Integrations) with a focus on the technology sector, including IT infrastructure, software, cybersecurity, cloud computing, SaaS, AI, and emerging tech trends. IT Due Diligence and Financial and Financial Analysis: Manage and lead IT due diligence processes, evaluating financial, operational, technological, and legal aspects of technology companies / organizations being considered for acquisition. Industry & Technology Infrastructure Assessment:Understanding of client technology operations to grasp the context of global, industry, economic, technology, and social trends Draw Roadmaps for IT implementations: Pinpoint the right data-driven Digital, IT or Cloud technology strategy solutions for practical implementation road maps Monitor Digital, IT & Cloud Strategy: Managing change, monitoring, and gauging processes, and taking remedial steps
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Leverage your deep experience across technology strategy areas such as tech M&A Advisory, IT Separation / Integration Planning / Execution, Digital & Technology Strategy, Operating Model Design, Agile Operating Model Design, Workforce Transformation, Sourcing Strategy, IT Shared Services Strategy, Process Transformation, Value case/ business case formulation, Enterprise Architecture and Application Portfolio Strategy Excel as a long-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends. Understand and deploy the key value drivers of a business, how they impact the scope and approach of the engagement Create expert content and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions. Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership. Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and build financial proposals
Qualification
Your experience counts!
MBA from a tier 1 institute
Your prior experience-
5-8 years of M&A Advisory, Strategy Consulting or Investment banking experience
Experience in the example offerings:M&A advisory (tech), Separation planning & execution, Integration Planning & Execution, IT Due Diligence,
Experience in at least 2 of the example offerings:Tech Strategy, Tech Operating Models, IT Shared Services Strategy, Cloud Transformation, Industry & New Technology, Technology ROI/Cost Take Out, Modern Architecture, Data-Driven Enterprise
3+ years of experience in financial modeling, valuation analysis, scenario testing and writing business cases (quantitative and qualitative) to support strategic business initiatives, process improvement initiatives, or IT transformation
2+ years of experience leading or managing large teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations
Good knowledge of technology and enterprise architecture concepts through practical experience and knowledge of technology trends e.g. Mobility, Cloud, Digital, Collaboration
A strong understanding in any of the following industries is preferred:Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, Mining and Resources or equivalent domains
Exposure to industry frameworks e.g. TOGAF, DODAF desirable but not essential.

Your Role

As a Data Analytics Architect, you will be responsible for designing end-to-end data architectures, establishing data standards and frameworks, and enabling business-driven analytics solutions. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and governance functions to deliver scalable, secure, and high-quality data ecosystems.



In this role, you will:

Define, design, and lead the implementation of end-to-end scalable data architectures from concept through production deployment.
Ensure alignment of data solutions with enterprise architecture standards, business objectives, and industry best practices.
Collaborate with compliance, privacy, risk, security, platform, and operations teams to incorporate all business and regulatory requirements into data solutions.
Develop data strategies, architectures, and policies covering:
Data Governance
Master Data Management (MDM)
Metadata Management
Data Quality
Data Security and Privacy
Provide technical leadership and act as a trusted advisor for data-related initiatives across programs.
Define and establish scalable, reusable standards, frameworks, and best practices for data architecture and analytics.
Lead data analysis activities including data profiling, transformation design, integration requirements, and quality assessments.
Design, document, and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
Oversee the complete data lifecycle, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and maintainable data solutions.
Guide development teams on architecture, implementation approaches, governance, and continuous improvement practices.
Conduct advanced analytics to generate actionable insights, identify trends, and measure key business outcomes.
Design visual analytics and dashboards that enable effective decision-making across stakeholders.
Apply statistical and analytical techniques to solve complex business problems and uncover business value.
Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, scientists, and platform teams to implement scalable analytics solutions.
Drive quality, governance, and delivery excellence across data and analytics initiatives.
Manage and optimize large-scale structured and unstructured datasets for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases.



Your Profile

Mandatory Skills
12+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Analytics, and Enterprise Data Management.
Strong expertise in Data Architecture and Data Modeling techniques.
Hands-on experience in Data Engineering and Data Integration (ETL/ELT).
Deep understanding of Data Warehousing and Lakehouse Architecture.
Experience implementing Data Governance, Data Quality, and Master Data Management frameworks.
Strong capabilities in Data Analysis, Data Profiling, and Data Transformation.
Experience designing Business Intelligence and Data Visualization solutions.
Expertise in Statistical Analysis, Predictive Analytics, and Data Mining methodologies.
Experience working with Big Data platforms and distributed data processing frameworks.
Proficiency in SQL and programming languages such as Python and PySpark.
Strong understanding of Cloud Data Platforms and modern analytics architectures.
Experience in Data Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Regulatory requirements.
Knowledge of DataOps, CI/CD practices, and automation frameworks.
Strong stakeholder management, consulting, and technical leadership skills

Description:
Job Title: GenAI / Agentic AI Architect
Experience: 14 - 24 Years
Location: Pune, Mumbai, Noida, Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced GenAI Lead / Agentic AI Architect with 14+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, NLP, Generative AI and enterprise solution architecture.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in designing and developing enterprise-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions using Azure and/or AWS ecosystems. The role involves architecting scalable AI solutions, designing multi-agent systems, implementing advanced RAG architectures, developing Python-based applications, and providing technical leadership to engineering teams.
The candidate should be capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure and production-ready AI architectures while guiding customers and stakeholders on GenAI transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
1. GenAI & Agentic AI Architecture
Architect and design end-to-end Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for enterprise applications.
Design and implement multi-agent systems supporting planning, reasoning, memory management, tool invocation and complex workflow orchestration.
Hands-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, MCP and other agent orchestration frameworks.
Design and develop advanced RAG architectures, including:
Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
Knowledge Graph RAG
RAG Fusion
Context Augmented Generation (CAG)
Multi-agent RAG and context enrichment pipelines.
Evaluate and select appropriate commercial and open-source LLMs, SLMs and VLMs based on business requirements.

2. Cloud AI Platforms Azure / AWS
Experience with at least one major cloud ecosystem is mandatory.
Microsoft Azure:
Azure OpenAI Service
Azure AI Foundry
Azure AI Agents / Agent Service
Microsoft Agent Framework
Azure Machine Learning
Azure AI Search / Cognitive Search
Cosmos DB, Redis, pgvector
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions
Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor, Application Insights
Amazon Web Services (AWS):
Amazon Bedrock
AWS AgentCore
Strands SDK / Multi-Agent Framework
Agents for Amazon Bedrock
Knowledge Bases and Guardrails for Bedrock
Amazon SageMaker
Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS
ECS / EKS, DynamoDB, API Gateway
CloudWatch and AWS X-Ray

3. Python Development & Application Engineering
Strong hands-on Python programming experience is mandatory.
Develop Python-based microservices and GenAI applications using FastAPI / Django.
Build LLM-powered applications, agent orchestration workflows, embeddings pipelines and tool integrations.
Develop reusable components, frameworks and accelerators.
Establish coding standards, review code and mentor development teams.

4. RAG, LLMOps & Data Engineering
Design enterprise-grade RAG pipelines for structured and unstructured data across multiple file formats and data lakes.
Experience with vector databases, embeddings, vector indexing and hybrid search.
Implement LLMOps/MLOps pipelines, model evaluation, fine-tuning and deployment workflows.
Experience with CI/CD, Kubernetes, serverless deployments and cloud-native architectures.
Implement observability, monitoring, logging, performance optimization and cost governance.

5. Security, Governance & Responsible AI
Design and implement LLM guardrails, prompt security and content filtering.
Establish agent governance, responsible AI practices and secure model invocation.
Experience with private endpoints, IAM/RBAC, cloud security and enterprise compliance.
Conduct architecture reviews, threat modelling and performance benchmarking.

6. Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management
Lead architecture discussions, solution design and technical assessments with customers.
Translate business requirements into scalable GenAI solutions.
Mentor developers and engineering teams on GenAI, Agentic AI, Python and cloud technologies.
Define architecture blueprints, reusable frameworks and engineering best practices.
Support pre-sales, PoCs, technical demonstrations and enterprise GenAI transformation initiatives.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications
14+ years of overall experience in Data Science, AI/ML, NLP and software engineering, with substantial hands-on experience in Generative AI and Agentic AI.
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI, LLMs, NLP and enterprise AI architecture.
Expertise in Agentic AI frameworks LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, MCP or equivalent.
Strong experience designing and implementing RAG-based solutions and multi-agent architectures.
Experience with commercial and open-source LLMs, including Azure OpenAI and/or AWS Bedrock.
Strong hands-on Python programming experience.
Experience with Azure and/or AWS cloud ecosystems.
Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search and hybrid retrieval.
Strong understanding of prompt engineering, LLM evaluation and guardrails.
Experience in Kubernetes, microservices, serverless deployment and observability.
Excellent architecture, technical leadership and customer-facing communication skills.

Preferred Skills
Azure AI Foundry, Azure Agents, Microsoft Agent Framework.
AWS AgentCore, Strands SDK and Agents for Bedrock.
FastAPI, Django, Azure ML and Amazon SageMaker.
Elasticsearch, MarkLogic, NoSQL databases, Redis, Cosmos DB and OpenSearch.
Pharma / Life Sciences / Regulatory domain experience.
Knowledge Graphs, VLMs, SLMs and advanced RAG techniques.
Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect Associate/Professional certification.
Research publications, technical presentations and contributions to the AI community.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
We are seeking experienced individuals with previous exposure on Aviation schemes to join our land development team to work on diverse projects that deliver coordinated designs for landside and airside schemes. This role expects exposure to hydraulic design, utilities modelling and design, road and pavement design.
Your role
Minimum 12+Years of experience
Strong knowledge of the fundamental concepts, principles, and theories of system integration as applied to multi-disciplinary designs and own discipline of wet utilities (Storm Water, Foul water, Potable water and Treated Sewage Effluent).
Knowledge of international codes for US, Canada, UK, Middle East will be preferred.
Understanding of sustainable solutions, sustainability requirements in the countries mentioned above.
Leading projects from concept design stage through the life cycle of project.
Able to understand a client's requirements and bring the different technical solutions to influence.
Acts as a Project Technical Leader or Technical Reviewer for large/complex projects.
Attending/arranging multi-disciplinary project technical/financial review calls, client presentation meetings, internal lesson learned and strategic/technical workshops.
Must have knowledge in bid proposals and management.
Should be flexible and open to new ideas and ways of delivering the building places projects in a digital way.
Should be proactive to implement digital tools/systems in projects for a more effective way to deliver projects.
Strong understanding of management processes related to technical integration and associated analytical / investigative approaches.
Strong knowledge and understanding of supporting pan design disciplines such as Engineering Safety Management, Human Factors and Sustainability.
High level of accountability for Technical Delivery
Takes a leadership role and trusted to make decisions, typically at group / team level or within a specific area of the business.
Works autonomously within established procedures and practices.
Welcomes those with different or distinct perspectives, seeking to engage and harness disparate views at all levels of the organization.
About you
Detailed knowledge of the fundamental concepts, principles, and theories of system integration as applied to multi-disciplinary designs.
Project Technical Leader on large or complex multi-disciplinary projects.
Consistently produces concept and feasibility solutions.
Works as a Project Technical Leader on large complex projects / Project Technical Reviewer on large complex projects Driving the right behaviours within organization for digital initiatives to improve business performance productivity.
Professional Head of Discipline or possibly leading a subset technology as Technical Authority.
Track record of delivering projects of increasing complexity to time, cost, and quality.
Coordination and development of innovation on a divisional basis.

Description:
CCNA CISCO Certification is mandatory. (Candidate must have claer the exam , training certified will not help.)

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.


Location Pune /Noida/Chennai/Bangalore
Shift – 24*7
Work Mode – Work from office
Looking for immediate joiners

Description:
Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks & financial instruments. To further enhance merchant & business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm Payment PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India's largest digital lending story is brewing here. It's your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Description:
Job Title: Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-2/P4-1
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist will provide operational visibility across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Hot Cut and related provisioning activities. The role will focus on data validation, identifying aging orders and operational risks, analyzing trends and ensuring the right issues are escalated to the right teams at the right time.
The role will work across provisioning teams, Operations, internal stakeholders and external carriers/vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor operational data across network provisioning activities.
Validate order, milestone and provisioning information for accuracy and completeness.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, recurring issues and delivery risks.
Analyze operational trends and highlight areas requiring attention.
Identify data discrepancies and work with the responsible team to correct them.
Determine which issues require escalation based on aging, customer impact, due date and operational risk.
Drive the right escalation to the right team at the right time.
Track escalated issues through closure rather than only raising the escalation.
Coordinate with Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations and other internal teams.
Coordinate with carriers/vendors regarding provisioning delays and unresolved dependencies.
Provide clear operational insights and status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Support root-cause analysis for repeat issues.
Identify process gaps based on data and operational trends.
Recommend improvements to reduce aging, exceptions and repeated escalations.
Support reporting and dashboard automation to improve operational visibility.
Required Skills
Good understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Experience working with operational data, reports or dashboards.
Strong analytical and data-validation capability.
Ability to identify trends, exceptions and operational risks.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning/order escalations.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies and dependencies.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Confidence to raise risks and communicate issues to stakeholders.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
Good to Have
Experience across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design or Network Provisioning.
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience.
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom systems.
Advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and formulas.
Power BI/dashboard development experience.
SQL knowledge for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience.
Experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.

Description:
Requisition Id: 1747346 React Developer ( Remote )
Job Title: Senior React.js Front-End Developer
Location: Remote
Experience: 4 - 8 Years
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners
About the Role:
We are looking for a talented and experienced React.js Front-End Developer to join our dynamic web development team. You will be responsible for building high-quality, scalable, and performant web applications using React.js, working closely with cross-functional teams including UX/UI designers, backend developers, and product managers.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop, maintain, and enhance responsive web applications using React.js and related front-end technologies.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement pixel-perfect, user-friendly interfaces.
Optimize components for maximum performance across a wide range of devices and browsers.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices.
Integrate RESTful APIs and manage state using Redux or Context API.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and continuous integration.
Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing applications as needed.
Mentor junior developers and help improve front-end development processes.
Required Skills Qualifications:
4 - 8 years of professional experience in front-end development using React.js .
Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 , and modern front-end build tools (Webpack, Babel, etc.).
Experience with state management libraries like Redux , Context API , or similar.
Familiarity with RESTful APIs, asynchronous programming, and handling API integrations.
Knowledge of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility standards.
Experience with version control tools such as Git .
Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team.
Good communication skills to coordinate with remote and on-site teams.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with TypeScript is a plus.
Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) or server-side rendering frameworks like Next.js.
Work Environment:
Hybrid working model with a combination of in-office (Mumbai/Bangalore) and remote work.
Collaborative and fast-paced environment focused on innovation and continuous learning.

Job Description: MS Power Platform Developer

Experience: 4-6 years || Preferred Domain: BFSI / Banking

Primary Skills:
Power Apps, Power Automate (Desktop/Cloud), Copilot Studio, Dataverse, Connectors, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 Integration, AI Builder, Generative Answers, Solution Packaging, ALM, Security Roles, DLP Policies and Deployment Support
We are looking for an MS Power Platform Developer at B2 level with hands-on experience in building low-code business solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and Copilot Studio. The resource should be able to translate business requirements into scalable apps, automated workflows, chatbot experiences, and Microsoft 365 integrated solutions.
The role will involve working with solution architects, business SMEs and project teams to design, configure, test, and deploy Power Platform solutions. BFSI / Banking experience is preferred, while exposure to shared services, operations, HR, IT support, finance, procurement, or enterprise support functions will also be relevant.

Required Expertise
Hands-on experience in Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 integrations.
Ability to build canvas/model-driven apps, cloud flows, approval workflows, notifications, data lookups, and system integrations.
Experience configuring Copilot Studio topics, generative answers, knowledge sources, actions, and fallback handling.
Working knowledge of SharePoint, standard/custom connectors, environments, solutions, security roles, and deployment practices.
Good understanding of data privacy, access control, DLP policies, responsible AI, and enterprise governance expectations.

Key Responsibilities
Understand business requirements and convert them into Power Platform solution designs.
Develop Power Apps, Power Automate cloud flows and Dataverse-based solution components.
Configure Copilot Studio bots using approved knowledge sources, topics, and workflow actions.
Integrate solutions with SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, APIs, and business systems using connectors.
Perform testing, defect fixes, deployment support, UAT assistance and post-go-live stabilization.
Prepare concise configuration notes, test evidence, handover inputs, and support documentation.

Required Experience & Skills
46 years of IT experience with Power Platform delivery.
Hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 services.
Exposure to Copilot Studio, virtual agents, generative answers, or conversational AI use cases.
Ability to troubleshoot flow failures, connector issues, access restrictions, and deployment challenges.
Good communication skills to work with business users, technical teams, and project stakeholders.

Good to Have
Microsoft certifications such as PL-900, PL-100, PL-200, PL-400, or AI-900.
Exposure to AI Builder, Azure OpenAI, chatbot analytics, Power BI or enterprise reporting use cases.
Understanding of ALM, solution packaging, audit requirements, and Power Platform governance.

Role & responsibilities :
Change Communications Consultant
Job Description
A Change Communications Consultant is responsible for developing and implementing communication strategies that support organizational change initiatives. During periods of change, this role helps keep stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned with organizational goals, ensuring a smooth and successful transition.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with change management teams to understand the impact of change initiatives and develop communication strategies that reduce resistance and drive adoption.
Design and tailor communication approaches for different audiences, translating complex concepts into clear, engaging, and impactful messages.
Create and deliver communication materials to support change programs, including presentations, newsletters, email campaigns, and leadership communications.
Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of communication efforts, gathering stakeholder feedback and refining strategies as needed.
Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure communication activities are aligned across the organization.
Facilitate communication between leadership, project teams, and employees to maintain transparency and engagement.
Required Skills & Experience
Proven experience in developing and executing communication strategies for organizational change initiatives.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong project management and organizational capabilities.
Experience using communication and collaboration tools/platforms.

Description:
SQL DBA Azure
Pune / Bangalore / Noida:
5 Days – Work from Office
What does a successful SQL DBA – Azure do at Fiserv?
We are looking for a skilled SQL DBA with hands-on Azure experience to join our team and support the administration, performance, availability and security of critical database environments. In this role, you will manage SQL Server databases across on-premises and cloud environments, support production systems and help ensure reliable, scalable, and high-performing database operations.
A successful candidate brings strong SQL Server database administration experience, practical knowledge of Azure services and the ability to work across infrastructure, application, and development teams. This role is important to maintaining database stability, supporting cloud initiatives and driving operational excellence.
What you will do
Administer, monitor and maintain SQL Server database environments across development, test and production systems
Manage databases in Azure environments, including support for cloud-hosted database services and related platform operations
Perform database installation, configuration, upgrades, patching and migration activities across on-premises and Azure platforms
Monitor database health, performance, storage and availability and take proactive action to prevent issues
Perform backup, recovery, restoration and disaster recovery support for business-critical databases
Troubleshoot database issues and optimize performance through tuning, indexing, query analysis and configuration improvements
Support high availability and disaster recovery solutions for SQL Server environments
Ensure database security, user access management and compliance with operational and security standards
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, cloud and application support teams to resolve issues and support new initiatives
Automate routine database administration tasks where appropriate
Support production releases, environment readiness and operational transitions
Maintain technical documentation, standards, support procedures and runbooks
Participate in incident management, root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts
What you will need to have
4 to 10 years of experience in SQL Server database administration
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments
Hands-on experience with Azure, including Azure SQL Database, Azure virtual machines or other Azure data services
Experience in database backup and recovery, performance tuning, security and monitoring
Strong knowledge of SQL Server installation, configuration, patching and upgrade processes
Experience supporting high availability and disaster recovery configurations
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience working in cross-functional support and delivery environments
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, work and military experience
What would be great to have
Experience with Snowflake
Familiarity with Azure automation, scripting or infrastructure support
Experience with PowerShell or other scripting tools
Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps or infrastructure-as-code practices
Experience in financial services, payments or other regulated environments
Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and alerting tools

Location: Pune, India

What does a successful MS Dynamics Developer do at Fiserv?

In this role, you will design, develop and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions that help drive operational efficiency, improve user experience and support business growth. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, configure and customize solutions, and deliver scalable, high-quality applications that align with enterprise standards.
What you will do:
Design, develop, customize and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions based on business and technical requirements
Work with stakeholders to gather, analyze and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications
Configure and customize Dynamics modules, workflows, forms, dashboards and integrations
Develop plugins, custom workflows, reports and enhancements within the Microsoft Dynamics environment
Integrate MS Dynamics with other enterprise applications and third-party platforms
Support data migration, system upgrades, deployments and environment management activities
Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes and provide timely resolution
Perform unit testing, system testing and support user acceptance testing

Provide ongoing production support and continuous improvement recommendations

What you will need to have:

4 to 10 years of overall IT experience
Hands-on experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Microsoft Dynamics CRM
Strong experience in customization, configuration and development within MS Dynamics
Create and manage copilot agents
Experience with C#, .NET, JavaScript, plugins, workflows and web services
Experience in integrating Dynamics with external systems using APIs or middleware
Good understanding of Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps
Experience with SQL Server and data migration activities
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field

What would be great to have:
Experience with Dynamics 365 CE, CRM or ERP modules based on business need
Knowledge of Azure services and cloud-based integrations
Experience in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and release management
Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards
Microsoft Dynamics certifications
Experience working in an enterprise environment with global teams
Understanding of Agile delivery methodologies

Client Advisor Job Description
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBroker’s plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.

Axtria
Axtria is a global provider of award-winning cloud software and data analytics to the life sciences industry. Our people are our core strength, and they make us proud of our work; this has helped us grow exponentially and make tremendous strides toward developing great products. Job Title: Patient Analytics
Requisition ID: TBD
Job Location: -Gurgaon/Noida/Bangalore/Pune/Hyderabad
Job Summary: -
This role will be responsible for in-patient journey analysis and working with patient-level data to develop a robust solution for the client's teams. An expert in Patient Analytics who can guide and lead the team supporting pharma clients
Job Responsibilities: -
Effectively manage the client/ onshore stakeholders, as per the business needs, to ensure successful business delivery.
Work closely with the project manager to define the algorithm, break down the problem into execution steps, and run the analysis
Ensure high-quality analytics solutions/reports to the client
Delivery role will include project scoping, solution design, execution, and communication of the analysis in the client-ready formats
Contribute towards Axtria tools and capabilities as per the business requirements.
Build organization capabilities by participating in Hackathon, solution design, and process automation
Effectively communicate with onshore/ client (as per business needs)
Job Requirements: -
Overall, 4-10 years of rich experience in the Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences Domain.
We are looking for experts in the space of commercial pharmaceutical analytics- HCP analytics, payer analytics, and patient analytics.
Worked on advanced analytics in the pharma domain throughout the patient journey like the line of therapy, switch analysis, source of business, segmentation, persistence & compliance, adherence, and patient identification, etc using various data sources
Experience using various patient-level data like APLD, EMR, patient registries, Prescription data, formulary data, etc
Can work across a variety of projects from advanced analytics, ad-hoc analysis, and reporting
Strong in logical reasoning, structuring of analysis, asking the right questions, and logical approach to analyze data, problems, and situations.
Experience in pharmaceutical sales and marketing analytics would be preferred
Effectively communicate with onshore/ client (as per business needs)
Relevant experience in Statistical/ modeling knowledge, ability to transform data to insights, good data visualization/ reporting skills
Good to have work experience in building statistical modeling and/or AI/ML models using Python, RStudio, PySpark, Keras, and TensorFlow.
Strong communication, project management, and storyboarding skills
Technical knowledge- R/ Python/ SQL. Knowledge of self-service analytics platforms such as DataiKU/ KNIME/ Alteryx will be an added advantage. MS Excel knowledge is mandatory.
Qualification: -
BE/ B. Tech/ B. Pharma/M. Pharma/M Tech/MBA
Must have Skills: -
Expertise in pharma real-world data like APLD, EMR, Prescription data, formulary data, etc
Skills that give you an edge: -
Good to have work experience in building statistical modeling and/or AI/ML models using Python, RStudio, PySpark, Keras, and TensorFlow
We will provide: -
An inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
A challenging and unique opportunity to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
Vast opportunities for self-development: online Axtria Institute, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
Possibility to relocate to any Axtria office for short and long-term projects
Benefit package:
Health Insurance benefits
Retirement benefits
Paid time off
Flexible Benefits
Hybrid working

Job Title: Network Provisioning Lead
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P4-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Lead will provide day-to-day operational leadership for telecom provisioning activities covering Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASR, and circuit implementation. The role will ensure workload is effectively managed, provisioning milestones are achieved, quality standards are maintained, and operational issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.
Key Responsibilities
Lead day-to-day activities across the assigned provisioning workstream.
Manage work allocation, priorities, aging orders and critical due dates.
Monitor productivity, quality, SLA/TAT and delivery performance.
Support team members with telecom, provisioning, process and tool-related questions.
Review complex provisioning issues and guide the team toward resolution.
Coordinate with Planning, Order Management, ASR, Design, Operations and other internal teams.
Work with carriers/vendors where support or follow-up is required.
Identify delivery risks and take appropriate action before committed dates are impacted.
Ensure process adherence, documentation and inventory updates are completed correctly.
Support knowledge transfer and readiness as activities transition to the India team.
Coach team members and identify skill or knowledge gaps.
Drive process improvement and automation opportunities across the workstream.
Provide regular operational updates to management and stakeholders.
Required Skills
Strong understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Working knowledge of Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design and/or network implementation.
Good understanding of telecom circuits, carrier provisioning and network operations.
Experience leading or coordinating an operational team.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making capability.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deliverables.
Strong stakeholder/vendor coordination.
Good communication and confidence in leading operational discussions.
Positive attitude, ownership and adaptability.
Good to Have
Experience as a Team Lead, SME or senior provisioning engineer.
Exposure to Granite/XNG, carrier portals or telecom OSS/BSS systems.
Knowledge of SLA/TAT, aging and operational KPI management.
Excel, Power BI or dashboard/reporting experience.
Power Automate, VBA, Python or other automation experience.

Description:
About IIFL Finance
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Job Title Customer Care Executive (Gold Loans)
Job Description -
Responsible toacquire New Customers for generating Gold Loan business and for other cross sell products

Participate in field- marketing activities toimprove the brand visibility of IIFL Finance Limited branch in the catchment areas and generate leads of prospective customers

Drive ensure continuous customer engagement through various channels

Maintaining quality portfolio by trackingcontrolling ROI

Provide after salesservice to existing customers and obtain references from them to increase thecustomer base

Strong follow up on interest collectionsto keep NPAs (non-performing assets) under control

Desired Candidate Profile (CCE) -
Candidateswith 6 months of sales experience in Banking Financial Services can applyfor the role

Fresherswith flair in Sales can also apply

In summary,the role focuses heavily on sales - acquiring new customers, engaging withexisting ones, ensuring portfolio quality, and collecting payments to minimizedefaults

Brand building through field marketing is also a key component

CTC Upto 2

37 Lacs ( for Non Metro) / 2

8Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Job Introduction:
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergencies, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.
Protect premises, property, and information
Reporting daily to the supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorised person
Write appropriate reports as required
Benefits and Advantages of Joining G4S
Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves
Annual Bonus of max 1-month salary
Gratuity (after 5 years of service)
Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from the employer and 12% from the employee
ESI Health Coverage for self family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years of age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits
Ideal Candidate
Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass
Minimum Height 5 feet and 7 inches (5 7 ) for men and 5 ft for women
Age between 18 and 35 for a fresher and up to 40 for an experienced security guard
Physically and medically fit and look like a mature person

Urgent Hiring || HR Executive (Talent Acquisition & Operations)
Greetings from iEnergizer!
We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated candidates to join our Talent Acquisition team at iEnergizer, Noida.

Job Title: HR Executive
Experience: Freshers and Experienced Candidates
Qualification: Graduate in any discipline
Salary: Up to 25,000 per month
Location: Sector 60, Noida
Shift: Day Shift | Working Days: 5 Days a Week
Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred

Key Responsibilities:
Source and screen candidates through various recruitment channels.
Coordinate interviews and follow up with candidates.
Communicate interview schedules, updates, and feedback.
Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
Assist with end-to-end recruitment activities.
Required Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Good coordination and interpersonal skills.
Interest in recruitment and talent acquisition.
Graduation is mandatory

Walk-In Interview Details:
Dates: 23rd and 24th November 2026
Time: 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM
Venue: iEnergizer, A-37, Block A, Sector 60, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301 Entry : Gate No. 2

Candidates are requested to carry a hard copy of their updated resume and Aadhaar card. Please mention Vanshika Kakkar HR on your CV for smoother coordination.

Interested candidates may share their updated CV via WhatsApp at 9289640609 for any queries.
Visit: www.ienergizer.com

We look forward to meeting you!

Best Regards,
Vanshika Kakkar
AM - HR

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance - Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
We re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, you ll also have
Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Role of an Admission Counselor in a School

1. Lead Generation & Inquiry Handling
Handle walk-in, telephonic, and online inquiries efficiently.
Maintain inquiry databases and ensure timely follow-up.
Convert leads into confirmed admissions through effective communication and counseling.
Participate in school outreach and promotional activities to attract prospective parents/students.
2. Counseling & Communication
Counsel parents and students regarding school curriculum, facilities, teaching methodologies, and admission procedures.
Build a positive rapport with prospective parents, addressing queries with patience and professionalism.
Ensure every visitor has a pleasant and informative experience that reflects the schools ethos.

About Fractal
Fractal is one of the most prominent providers of Artificial Intelligence to Fortune 500 companies.Fractals vision is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and bring AI, engineering, and design to help the worlds most admired companies.Fractal currently has 4000+ employees across 16 global locations, including the United States, UK, Ukraine, India, Singapore, and Australia.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud projects and digital transformation programs.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

Description:
Its fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
Building the machine learning production System(or MLOps) is the biggest challenge most large companies currently have in making the transition to becoming an AI-driven organization. This position is an opportunity for an experienced, server-side developer to build expertise in this exciting new frontier. You will be part of a team deploying state-of-the-art AI solutions for Fractal clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
As MLOps Engineer, you will work collaboratively with Data Scientists and Data engineers to deploy and operate advanced analytics machine learning models. You ll help automate and streamline Model development and Model operations. You ll build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations. You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines
Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry
Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.
QUALIFICATIONS: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
5-10 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
EDUCATION:
B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent.

Description:
Location: Bangalore, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Thales India Engineering Competency Center in Bangalore is seeking a HW Test bench Lead- maintenance role.
In this role, you will manage Test Bench/ Automated Test Equipments maintenance and sustenance activities, which includes conducting scheduled maintenance procedure, inspecting, and troubleshooting test bench equipment.
These test benches primarily support various Thales defense applications and its products.

Essential skills:
Test Bench Hardware systems knowledge such as COTS Test and measurement instruments from different OEMs including NI Hardware including PXI systems, Industrial PC (PICMG SBC ) and VME systems.
5 +yrs Experience in handling various interface form factors such as PCI, PCIE, PCIe, CPCI, PXI, PXIe, VME etc.
Experience in Test Bench development or maintenance using COTS test measurement equipment, custom designed interface test adapters, PCBAs
Experience of testing avionics communication interfaces/buses such as MIL-STD-1553B, ARINC 429 , Serial RS 485 / 422, CAN etc is desirable.
Experience on interface cards such as Discrete IO, Analog, serial (RS232/422/482), synchro etc on various form factors listed above.
Problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
Experience in testing and knowledge of test equipment for measurement and control.
Hands on experience in handing various measuring tools such as Digital Oscilloscope, Function / wave generators up to 18GHz, Spectrum Analyzers, RF power meters etc.
Experience in analyzing / understanding electrical schematics, Cable Harness drawings and block diagrams.

Responsibilities:
As a maintenance engineer you will be responsible for undertaking periodic maintenance procedure and ensure the test system / bench are reliable.
Identify faults, efficiency and safety issues.
Respond to equipment breakdowns, provide first line diagnostic and arrange repairs or replacements.
Execute functional tests and validate the results against established standards
Perform quality inspections to ensure compliance with safety regulations.
Should work closely with multi discipline teams and organize to fix the issues.
Preparation of the associated report and log maintenance to keep track of tasks
Collaborative work applying quality standards and internal processes
Should be able to estimate and monitor costs of maintenance.

Your role
Perform a role bringing together hydraulic modelling (1D-2D) and engineering aspects of the project. You will have to understand the engineering constraints and opportunities associated with modelling solutions to drainage problems to ensure model outputs are realistic.
Undertake technical work including hydraulic modelling like model build (1D - 2D), model verification, evaluation, feasibility, optioneering and outline design of solutions.
Understand the client requirements and deliver the work in smarter way by developing some automation tools along with high quality.

Good working knowledge or experience of Infowork ICM, Mapinfo, QGIS, Sewer Gems, HEC-RAS, MicroDrainage or similar.
