Description:
Job Description


Overview


Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.




Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.
Proficiency in coding/programming (R, VBA, Python) is a plus.


About you
A strong academic background with a degree in Civil Engineering and/or a master's degree in Water Management/Hydrology, with 8 to 15 years of experience in the water industry.
Experience in 2D modelling using TUFLOW.
Significant experience with 1D-2D modelling using FMP-TUFLOW, ESTRY-TUFLOW, Infoworks ICM, especially with UK clients.
Build, refine and analyse hydraulic models (1D, 2D, and 1D2D) to represent river channels, floodplains, and potentially pipe networks.
Experience in leading flood modelling projects and managing a small team.
Provide modelling inputs and analysis to support the production of Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) for planning applications.
Perform sensitivity testing to quantify uncertainty in model parameters and components.
Proficiency in GIS, including QGIS, MapInfo, ArcGIS, and open-source GIS tools.
An understanding of the overall fluvial model development process.
Experience in undertaking Flood Risk Assessments and developing drainage strategies.
Familiarity with FEH (Flood Estimation Handbook) methods.
Working towards achieving Chartered status.
Ability to produce clear and concise technical reports in English.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with colleagues and clients via video conferencing.
Adherence to quality procedures and maintaining high standards in your work.
Enthusiasm for learning new skills and work procedures.


Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.


About AtkinsRalis
We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Worker Type Employee
Job Type Regular
At AtkinsRalis , we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Role MDM Architect
Locations – Pune | Bangalore | NCR | Hyderabad
Your Responsibilities includes, but not limited to:
Understand the technical landscape current as well as desired future state Assess the current state architecture & understand current business processes for managing Master Data Management solutions.
Assess the functional and non-functional requirements of desired future state MDM solution Prepare the to-be architecture including data ingestion, data quality rules, data model, match/merge, workflows, UI, batch integration and real-time services.
Extensive hands-on experience in installation and configuration of core Informatica MDM Hub components such as Hub console, Hub Store, Hub Server, Cleanse/Match Server and Cleanse Adaptor.
Ability to deliver full lifecycle MDM projects for clients including Data modeling, Metadata management, design and configuration of matching and merging rules, design and configuration of standardizing, cleansing and deduplication rules.
Create Design Document and data models addressing business needs for the client MDM environment - Contribute to creating reusable assets and accelerators for MDM platforms.
Will also be involved in integration/transfer of data across multiple systems, streamlining data processes and providing access to MDM data across the enterprise.
Make technology decisions related to the Client MDM environment & Interpret requirements and architect MDM solutions.
Provide subject matter expertise on data architecture and data integration implementations across various downstream system.
Coordinate with Project Managers and participate in project planning and recurring meetings.
Collaborate with other team members to review prototypes and develop iterative revisions.
Must have Skills:
12+ years of experience & should have hands on experience of working in MDM Projects and hands on experience in one or more MDM tools like Informatica or Reltio and has expertise in defining matching/ merging & survivor-ship rules.
Should have strong commercial knowledge of key business processes & compliance requirements within Pharma Industry across multiple master data domains like Physician & Product
Hands on experience in industry data quality tools like Informatica IDQ, IBM Data Quality.
Must be proficient reading and understanding data models and experience working with data and databases.
Strong technical experience in the areas of Master Data Management, Meta data management, Data Quality, Data Governance, Data Integration (ETL) and Data Security
Experience with (all stages of MDM SDLC) planning, designing, building, deploying and maintaining scalable, highly available, mission critical enterprise-wide applications for large enterprises
Should have experience in integrating MDM with Data Warehouses and Data Lakes
Excellent query writing skills with Working knowledge of Oracle, SQL server, and other major databases
Good knowledge of SOA/Real-time integration, Pub-Sub Model and Data Integration with Various CRM systems like Veeva, Siebel.
Expertise in engaging with business users to understand the business requirements and articulate the value proposition.
Should have experience working with 3rd Party Data Providers like IQVIA, SHS, Veeva etc
Solid experience in configuring 3rd Party Address standardization tools Like or Tools Similar to Address Doctor, Loqate
Provide subject matter expertise on data architecture and data integration implementations across various downstream systems
Possesses excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, innovative presentation skills
Experience with RFP/RFI and pre-sales
Education:
BE/B.Tech/MCA/BCA/BSC CS with 60%+
Why Axtria: -
Axtria (www.Axtria.com) is truly a New-Age Software Product Unicorn, a first of its kind in providing the cloud software and data analytics to the Life Sciences industry globally. We help Life Sciences companies transform the product commercialization journey to drive sales growth and improve healthcare outcomes for patients. We are acutely aware that our work impacts millions of patients and lead passionately to improve their lives.
Since our founding in 2010, technology innovation has been our winning differentiation, and we continue to leapfrog competition with platforms that deploy Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Our cloud-based platforms - Axtria DataMAX™, Axtria InsightsMAX™, Axtria SALESIQ™, Axtria CUSTOMERIQ™ and Axtria MarketingIQ- enable customers to efficiently manage data, leverage data science to deliver insights for sales and marketing planning and manage end-to-end commercial operations. With customers in over 20 countries, Axtria is one of the biggest global commercial solutions providers in the Life Sciences industry. We continue to win industry recognition for growth and are featured in some of the most aspirational lists - INC 5000,

EXP: 2 TO 10 YEARSLocation: PAN INDIA ETL Testing - Datawarehouse testing , Bigdata testing Skills:Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, source-to-target mappings, and data models.
Design and execute ETL test cases, test plans, and test strategies.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading processes.
Perform source-to-target data validation and reconciliation testing.
Execute database testing using complex SQL queries.
Verify data quality, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Conduct data warehouse, migration, and reporting validation testing.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and data engineers to resolve data-related issues.
Validate incremental loads, batch jobs, and scheduling processes.
Support end-to-end testing in Data Warehouse and BI environments.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to quality improvement initiatives.
Required Skills
3 to 8 years of experience in ETL Testing and Data Warehouse Testing.
Strong expertise in writing and executing complex SQL Queries.
Hands-on experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, Talend, SSIS, DataStage, Pentaho, or similar tools.
Experience in validating ETL workflows, mappings, transformations, and data pipelines.
Knowledge of Data Warehouse concepts, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact and Dimension tables.
Experience with databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Teradata, or Snowflake.
Strong understanding of Data Migration and Data Validation techniques.
Hands-on experience with defect tracking tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps.
Understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.
Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Big Data Testing using Hadoop, Hive, Spark, or Databricks.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Experience in testing data lakes and modern data platforms.
Knowledge of automation tools for ETL validation.
Familiarity with BI reporting tools like Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or Business Objects.
Experience with Python or Shell scripting for data validation.

Please find the job description below. 

Experience: 3+ years of relevant experience
Company: Mastek Limited
Location:Ahmedabad/Mumbai/Noida/Chennai/Trichy/Hyderabad/Bangalore/Pune (Hybrid)
Shift and Schedule: UK/US/AMEA Shift

About Us:
Mastek Limited is a trusted digital engineering and cloud transformation partner for enterprises across the globe. The company focuses on delivering business value through technology, combining deep domain expertise with modern engineering practices. Teams at Mastek collaborate in an inclusive environment that values integrity, learning, and innovation. Mastek is committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture where every individual is respected, supported, and empowered to contribute. Candidates from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. We are looking for a Workday HCM Functional Consultant with 5+ years of experience and strong expertise in the Workday Payroll module

Key Responsibilities
Configure and support Workday HCM and Payroll modules.
Gather requirements and translate business needs into Workday solutions.
Configure Business Processes, Security, Compensation, Absence, and Time Tracking.
Handle Payroll configuration, processing, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.
Support Workday implementations, enhancements, testing, and production support.
Collaborate with HR, Payroll, IT, and technical teams on integrations and EIBs.
Support UAT, regression testing, Workday releases, and issue resolution.

Required Skills
3+ years of hands-on Workday HCM experience.
Strong Workday Payroll experience is mandatory.
Knowledge of Core HCM, Business Processes, Security, Compensation, and Absence.
Experience with Workday Reports, EIBs, and Integrations.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Workday HCM/Payroll certification preferred.
AboutCompany:
At Mastek, were on a journey "to Decomplex Digital with Trust, Value and Velocity"—a mission-driven promise that empowers our customers, colleagues, and communities to thrive in the digital age.
Here’s what makes us unique—and why you’re joining at such an exciting time:
AI-First Momentum
We’ve recently delivered over 25+ new AI-led deals in Q2 FY26, reinforcing our status as a trusted AI-first digital engineering and cloud transformation partner.
We’ve launched pioneering AI platforms like ADOPT.AI and Lightbeam, backed by an AI Engineering Centre of Excellence & AI Academy.
Strong Financial and Operational Performance
Q2 FY26 revenue rose by 8.4% YoY to 940 crore, with a healthy operating EBITDA of 145.5 crore and a 13.2% increase in 12-month order backlog.
Our global presence spans 40+ countries, supported by 5,000+ Mastekeers dedicated to transforming industries across the UK, Europe, US, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
Values-Driven Culture
At Mastek, our culture is shaped by VECTOR—our core values of Velocity, Empowerment, Collaboration, Trust, Ownership, and Respect. These guide everything from decision-making to team interactions.
Employees consistently highlight our “supportive work culture,” collaborative teams, and numerous opportunities for learning and growth.

Description:
About Us
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company and a pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution. Paytm builds technologies that empower small businesses with payments and commerce solutions.
Our mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy through technology.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer a world-class, frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups, including well-known unicorns. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler to a driver of revenue and growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI, and this team is responsible for growing penetration of Paytms PA–PG business across Indian merchants.

About the Role
Handle merchant escalations and resolve them on a high-priority basis. Proactively assist merchants to ensure timely and effective resolution of issues. Deliver exceptional merchant satisfaction through ownership and accountability of cases.

Key Responsibilities / Expectations
Resolve merchant complaints received through RBI, nodal officers, social media channels, or senior management escalations.
Understand the nature of each query, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and ensure resolution within defined TATs.
Prepare Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for escalations received.
Ensure adherence to agreed turnaround times to meet productivity and quality benchmarks.
Maintain high CSAT scores and ensure no repeat escalations for handled cases.
Demonstrate flexibility to work in rotational shifts.
Exhibit innovation and clarity in both written and verbal communication.

Description:
Job Description


Overview
The BIM Designer/Lead Designer role at AtkinsRalis GDC Transportation focuses on delivering advanced BIM and CAD designs for major global rail and bridge infrastructure projects. Based in Bangalore or Gurgaon, the position involves creating and managing 3D models, producing detailed 2D drawings, coordinating multidisciplinary BIM workflows, and ensuring compliance with AtkinsRalis standards and international BIM practices. The role requires strong modelling expertise, understanding of BIM standards, experience with tools like MicroStation, OpenBuildings, ProjectWise/ACC, and the ability to collaborate within large engineering teams. It offers excellent growth opportunities within a world-leading infrastructure consultancy.


Your role
Should be able to develop CAD/BIM 3D Models / 2D Drawings to the standards codes
Should be able to produce medium to complex 3D modelling for bridges Rail structures
Competent in producing GA and RC detailing drawings for bridges and Rail structures.
Work with the Information Manager and project teams to assist in the development and implementation of BIM strategies, BIM Execution Plans, workflows and processes on projects in accordance with AtkinsRalis Corporate Standards, Client requirements and industry best practice.
Should be able to produce 3D models and extract information directly from models to create 2D drawings, schedules, setting out, quantities and other deliverables.
Should be able to develop models and technical content including clash detection and compliance with BEP.
Should be able to follow OCRA process in EDMS workflow
Should have strong written verbal communication in English
Experience of working in Common Data Environment (CDE) like ProjectWise / ACC
Apply AtkinsRalis Quality, Safety Environmental (QSE) standards and Business Management System (BMS).


About You
Requirements
Must have Civil Engineering background with preferable Rail domain experience.
Experience of Bridge Detailing, reinforcement detailing, structural steel detailing and schedules.
Hands-on experience of industry standard Rail BIM Platforms such as OpenBuildings Designer, MicroStation Connect (3D).
Proven experience of a range of CAD and BIM industry standards including an understanding of UK BIM Level 2 requirements. Understanding of BIM Standards such as BS1192 and PAS1192 Part 2 is also desirable.
I-Twin or Bentley Cloud Services with capabilities to federate individual discipline BIM Models. Setup, maintain and run clash rules and clash tests across federated BIM Models
Working experience in Revit Structures including 3D RC detailing would be an added advantage
Qualifications and attributes
Excellent time management skills.
3 to 5 years of relevant experience
Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Diploma/Degree holder in Civil Engineering with sufficient and relevant experience.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment
Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.
Working knowledge of British / American Standards


Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.


About AtkinsRalis
We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Worker Type Contingent Worker
Job Type Loan of Personnel
At AtkinsRalis , we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Job Title: Embedded UI Software Engineer
Experience: 4-9 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Embedded UI Software Engineer to design and develop graphical user interfaces for embedded products. The candidate should have strong expertise in Embedded C/C++, LVGL, TouchGFX, or similar embedded GUI frameworks, along with hands-on experience in ARM-based embedded systems.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop embedded graphical user interfaces using LVGL, TouchGFX, Embedded Wizard, Qt for MCU, or similar frameworks.
Develop UI applications for LCD/TFT touch displays on embedded platforms.
Integrate UI software with embedded platform services and device drivers.
Work on ARM Cortex-M based microcontrollers (STM32, NXP, ESP32, etc.).
Develop and debug embedded firmware using C/C++.
Support display, touch, communication, and peripheral interfaces.
Collaborate with hardware, firmware, validation, and product teams.
Participate in software testing, debugging, and product releases.
Mandatory Skills
4-6 years of Embedded Software Development experience.
Strong programming skills in Embedded C/C++.
Experience with LVGL (mandatory preferred).
Hands-on experience with TouchGFX, GUIX, emWin, Embedded Wizard, Qt/QML, or similar Embedded GUI frameworks.
Experience with ARM Cortex-M platforms (STM32/NXP).
Experience in RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, QNX, VxWorks, or Embedded Linux).
Knowledge of Display Technologies, LCD/TFT Touchscreens, HMI Development.
Experience with UART, SPI, I2C, CAN communication protocols.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.

Collaborative work environment with global teams and industry experts.
Continuous learning, certification, and career development opportunities.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive employee benefits.
Opportunity to contribute to strategic finance and treasury transformation initiatives.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) Canada Business is looking to appoint a number of Highways BIM Designer's to support the delivery of complex civil engineering and multidisciplinary designs across a range of major projects.
Drawing upon a diverse skill set and a proven track record of delivery, AtkinsRalis GTC's Canada business is playing an integral role in some of the most challenging and exciting engineering projects in the Transportation realm. We pride ourselves in offering a truly multi-disciplinary capability and bring exciting opportunities to influence major projects from beginning to end. Our vision is to be the world's best Infrastructure Consultancy by leveraging BIM and embracing the digital future to bring about transformational benefits for the Transportation Engineering industry.
This key post will be based out of Bangalore where we have thriving AtkinsRalis office, which deliver to all AtkinsRalis regions across the world. Our portfolio of work continues to grow, and we will offer a challenging and rewarding opportunity to apply knowledge, experience, and problem-solving skills.
Your Role
Responsibilities
Produce AutoCAD and MicroStation 2D drawings and other deliverables.
Actively contribute to project design development by contributing to internal coordination.
Produce all types of Highways discipline 2D Drawings and other deliverables. Perform self-assurance of all Highways discipline drawing and model deliverables.
Provide quality control for compliance to company/project standards of deliverables.
Maintain a high level of competency of all BIM software tools used at AtkinsRalis.
About You
Requirements
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 4 to 6 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.
Must be an advanced user or expert user in Autodesk AutoCAD, Civil3D, and Bentley MicroStation with a minimum of 2 to 3 years.
AutoCAD experience must, detailed understanding of the CAD user interface and all its features to perform.
MicroStation experience must, detailed understanding of the MicroStation user interface and all its features to perform.
Technical proficiency in the use of the latest common CDE systems: Bentley ProjectWise and Autodesk Vault.
Must be well versed in best practices for use of Autodesk AutoCAD, and Bentley MicroStation and other industry standard BIM platforms.
Track record in BIM design and coordination including multidisciplinary projects and ideally demonstrable experience within a Civil Engineering Design environment particularly the Highways domain.
Technical awareness/knowledge of engineering design issues including awareness of health and safety risks.
Qualifications and attributes
Excellent time management skills.
Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 4 to 5 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.
Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation
Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.
Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.
About AtkinsRalis
We're AtkinsRalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Find out more.
Worker TypeContingent Worker
Job TypeLoan of Personnel
At AtkinsRalis, we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Description:
Job Title: Circuit Design Engineer
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM
Job Summary
The Circuit Design Engineer will be responsible for designing and augmenting network circuits to support existing and new voice network connectivity. The role requires a good understanding of telecom network architecture, DS0/DS1/Ethernet circuits, POI connectivity, Network product requirements, and circuit inventory.
Key Responsibilities
Proficient in basic telecom and transmission concepts.
Good understanding of Transmission architecture and Network connectivity.
Design and augment DS0/DS1/Ethernet/IP circuitry for existing and new Customer /Network connectivity.
Translate network and transport requirements into appropriate circuit designs.
Review engineering requirements and validate circuit design information.
Coordinate with Planning, ASR, Implementation, Operations, and vendor teams for circuit provisioning.
Support new circuit installation, augmentation, migration, and disconnect activities.
Maintain accurate circuit and network inventory in Granite/XNG/PRO or applicable inventory systems.
Analyze network design issues and provide timely recommendations or solutions.
Maintain engineering documentation and update order/design status.
Support Customer Sales and network optimization activities when required.
Required Skills
Experience or good understanding of telecom circuit design.(SDH/SONET/WAVE)
Knowledge of DS0, DS1/T1,IP/Ethernet transport circuits, and Network architecture.
Understanding Network connectivity and circuit configurations.
Ability to interpret network diagrams, circuit information, and engineering requirements.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Microsoft Excel knowledge including PivotTables, formulas, and lookups.
Good to Have
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom inventory systems.
Understanding of Access Service Requests (ASR) and carrier provisioning.
Experience supporting network migrations, grooming, optimization, or decommissioning.
Power BI, VBA, Power Automate, Python, or other automation skills.

Description:
Job Title: ASR Engineer
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM
Job Summary
The ASR Engineer will be responsible for creating, submitting, tracking, and completing Access Service Requests with telecom carriers/LECs to support network provisioning requirements. The role requires good knowledge of carrier ordering processes, circuit configurations, and end-to-end ASR lifecycle management.
Key Responsibilities
Create and submit Access Service Requests (ASRs) using carrier/LEC web portals.
Translate engineering and transport requirements into accurate ASR submissions.
Understand ASR ordering requirements for DS0, DS1/T1,Ethernet and Customer Circuits and associated access services.
Validate ASR information before submission to minimize carrier clarifications and rejections.
Track submitted ASRs and follow up with carriers/LECs through completion.
Review and process carrier responses, including FOCs and DLRs.
Coordinate with Design, Planning, Implementation, Operations, and carrier teams to resolve ASR-related issues.
Monitor order milestones, due dates, jeopardies, and exceptions.
Maintain accurate order status and documentation throughout the ASR lifecycle.
Escalate carrier delays and provisioning issues as required.
Support circuit installs, changes, migrations, and disconnect requirements.
Maintain appropriate circuit/order information in Granite/XNG or applicable systems.
Required Skills
Hands-on Access Service Request experience.
Knowledge of ASR ordering requirements and carrier/LEC processes.

Job Title: Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-2/P4-1
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist will provide operational visibility across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Hot Cut and related provisioning activities. The role will focus on data validation, identifying aging orders and operational risks, analyzing trends and ensuring the right issues are escalated to the right teams at the right time.
The role will work across provisioning teams, Operations, internal stakeholders and external carriers/vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor operational data across network provisioning activities.
Validate order, milestone and provisioning information for accuracy and completeness.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, recurring issues and delivery risks.
Analyze operational trends and highlight areas requiring attention.
Identify data discrepancies and work with the responsible team to correct them.
Determine which issues require escalation based on aging, customer impact, due date and operational risk.
Drive the right escalation to the right team at the right time.
Track escalated issues through closure rather than only raising the escalation.
Coordinate with Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations and other internal teams.
Coordinate with carriers/vendors regarding provisioning delays and unresolved dependencies.
Provide clear operational insights and status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Support root-cause analysis for repeat issues.
Identify process gaps based on data and operational trends.
Recommend improvements to reduce aging, exceptions and repeated escalations.
Support reporting and dashboard automation to improve operational visibility.
Required Skills
Good understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Experience working with operational data, reports or dashboards.
Strong analytical and data-validation capability.
Ability to identify trends, exceptions and operational risks.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning/order escalations.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies and dependencies.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Confidence to raise risks and communicate issues to stakeholders.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
  Good to Have
Experience across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design or Network Provisioning.
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience.
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom systems.
Advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and formulas.
 Power BI/dashboard development experience.
SQL knowledge for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience.
 Experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.

Job Title: Network Provisioning Lead
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P4-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Lead will provide day-to-day operational leadership for telecom provisioning activities covering Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASR, and circuit implementation. The role will ensure workload is effectively managed, provisioning milestones are achieved, quality standards are maintained, and operational issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.
Key Responsibilities
Lead day-to-day activities across the assigned provisioning workstream.
 Manage work allocation, priorities, aging orders and critical due dates.
Monitor productivity, quality, SLA/TAT and delivery performance.
Support team members with telecom, provisioning, process and tool-related questions.
 Review complex provisioning issues and guide the team toward resolution.
Coordinate with Planning, Order Management, ASR, Design, Operations and other internal teams.
 Work with carriers/vendors where support or follow-up is required.
 Identify delivery risks and take appropriate action before committed dates are impacted.
Ensure process adherence, documentation and inventory updates are completed correctly.
Support knowledge transfer and readiness as activities transition to the India team.
Coach team members and identify skill or knowledge gaps.
Drive process improvement and automation opportunities across the workstream.
Provide regular operational updates to management and stakeholders.
  Required Skills
Strong understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Working knowledge of Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design and/or network implementation.
Good understanding of telecom circuits, carrier provisioning and network operations.
Experience leading or coordinating an operational team.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making capability.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deliverables.
Strong stakeholder/vendor coordination.
Good communication and confidence in leading operational discussions.
Positive attitude, ownership and adaptability.
  Good to Have
Experience as a Team Lead, SME or senior provisioning engineer.
Exposure to Granite/XNG, carrier portals or telecom OSS/BSS systems.
Knowledge of SLA/TAT, aging and operational KPI management.
Excel, Power BI or dashboard/reporting experience.
Power Automate, VBA, Python or other automation experience.

Roles and Responsibilities
Manage sales performance by achieving targets, identifying new business opportunities, and expanding existing customer relationships.
Develop and maintain a strong understanding of NBFC products to effectively communicate value proposition to customers.
Conduct field visits to meet with potential clients, understand their needs, and provide tailored solutions.
Collaborate with internal teams to resolve customer issues and improve overall service delivery.
Desired Candidate Profile
0-1 year of experience in Sales or related field (NBFC preferred).
Strong communication skills for effective client interaction.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while meeting deadlines.
Proficiency in Two Wheeler financing operations would be an added advantage.
AboutCompany:
Mahindra Finance is Indias leading financial services provider committed to the needs of underserved customers in rural and semi-urban markets. We are on a journey to transform lives and uplift communities through financial growth.
Our assets under management exceed Rs. 82,770 crores and our extensive network of over 1386+ offices nationwide serves our growing base of 9 million customers. With a strong local presence across the pulse of India, we pride ourselves on being able to anticipate market needs and offer unique solutions.
Our comprehensive range of financial products include Vehicle Loans, SME Finance, Personal Loans, Insurance Broking, Housing Finance, Fixed Deposits and Mutual Fund schemes. As the sole non-banking Indian financial company to be listed on the Dow Jones Sustainability Index for Emerging Markets, we are invested in sustainable growth and support our customers by opening up opportunities and simplifying finance.

Job Summary
Function SummaryThe agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customer in a)Resolving policy service needb)Renewal collection to resolve policy holder s service needs, Cross sale opportunity.


Key Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment -Develop various sources of agent hiring build a team of agent agent pipe line.
Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring
Conduct Career Seminar of prospects
Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms
Agent Development -Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training Field demonstration (FOD s)
Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same
Meet Business Targets -Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc
Ensure companies product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan
Customer Centricity -Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion
Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty
Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need
Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard
Measures of Success:-Achievement of business plan GPA
Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Number MTD Active
Persistency as per grid
Number of EC/MDRT agent


Qualifications
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience , At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Description:
Job Details
Job Title: Loan Officer-Micro Banking
Grade: DM-I
Department: Micro Banking
Location: Branch
Type of Position: Full-time
Reports To: CRM
Reporting Into: NA
Job Summary
Drive acquisition of new unsecured loan customers from open market
Identify quality leads from unsecured loans liabilities customers through assessments by analyzing credit histories and performing financial analysis, ensuring compliance with internal and external regulations
Monitor and manage installment payments and collections of assigned customers
Strengthen existing customer relationships through targeted cross-selling Ujjivan's products customer profile needs
Size of the Role
Financial size: 5-7 Cr. loan portfolio
Non-financial size: NA
Key Duties and Responsibilities of the Role Business/ Financials
Develop and execute strategies to acquire new unsecured loan customers
Collaborate with the liabilities team to cross-sell unsecured loans
Follow up on leads provided by team various channels within defined TAT
Achieve monthly loan disbursement targets through acquisition of new customers and conversion of existing customers
Coordinate with Products Marketing department to carry out marketing drives at his/her assigned and catchment areas for unsecured loans
Prospect new customers, maintain database of the leads, meet convert select prospects and manage the relationship thereafter
Attend center meetings to generate leads for Unsecured loans and actively driving conversion of existing borrowing customers into SBL customer
Cross sell other products of Ujjivan and pass quality leads to respective officers/staff
Share customer insights/product related feedback with the Branch Head and Area Manager Microfinance
Provide inputs pertaining to revision of product and credit policies to the respective teams on the basis of geography specific considerations
Customer
Interact with customers in a courteous and professional manner; provide prompt, efficient and accurate services and establish professional relationship with them, with a long-term perspective
Conduct the appraisal process of potential customers in a courteous manner without compromising quality
Guarantee confidential treatment of all the information gathered from customers
Internal Process
Carry out the pre and post-loan activities related to Unsecured loans, perform simple financial analysis, present the loan applications to the sanctioning authority by adhering to the set TAT prioritize repayment of loans to maintain best portfolio quality
CompanyAddress: No.27, Grape garden, 3rd A Cross, 18th Main road Koramangala 6th block, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India

Title: Service Supervisor
Skills: elevator systems, troubleshooting, testing and commissioning, AES and Safety Tests, PM Audits, customer relationship management, spare parts inventory control, MIS reports, Service Operations Technical Leadership
Description:
Job Details
Company: Birla Elevators Limited - Birla Group
Location: Guwahati, Assam
Job Type: Full time
Language: English, Hindi


Responsibilities
Service Operations Technical Leadership: Plan, allocate and supervise daily PM schedules, breakdown call, route rationalization/route loading to ensure timely and high-quality service delivery.
Monitor response time, shutdown duration, call-back trends and implement corrective actions to improve reliability and cost efficiency.
Guide technicians in troubleshooting and repair activities, providing on-site technical support for complex faults.
Conduct AES and Safety Tests, PM Audits, ensure proper documentation of all the audits and safety tests, equipment inspections and other statutory requirements.
Reporting of Incidents and Near Missed in line with the company s process.
Organize service inspections of new installation units prior to handover to customers and ensure that incomplete jobs are not handed over.
Business Development - AMC, Repair Modernization Support Service Sales Team to drive revenue growth through proactive selling of AMCs, Spares, Repair and Modernization packages to new and existing customers.
Identify upgrade and modernization opportunities during AES and service visits, prepare inputs for proposals, book the SRM orders and ensure timely closure.
Improve service quality to ensure timely AMC renewal follow-up, collection of pending dues and promotion of OEM spares and value-added services to enhance customer loyalty.
Customer Relationship Management: Act as the single point of contact for key customers in the territory, handling escalations, service reviews and communication on equipment performance.
Conduct regular review meetings, non-price visits and performance presentations to strengthen long-term partnerships and understand future customer needs.
Coordinate internally to ensure commitments on response time, uptime and quality are met, and that customer complaints are resolved promptly and effectively.
People Management, Training and Vendor Development: Organize, mentor and develop the service team, including technicians, through regular coaching, performance reviews and skill-gap analysis.
Plan and conduct technical, safety and behavioural training for field staff, ensuring adherence to safe work practices and service standards.
Process, Inventory Compliance: Implement and sustain company service processes, documentation standards and digital tools for call logging, work order closure, billing and collection.
Oversee spare parts planning, ordering, inventory control and consumption analysis to support uptime targets and cost optimization.
Prepare and present MIS reports and periodic reviews to the Head Office team covering service KPIs, revenue performance, safety, quality and improvement plans.


Qualifications
Diploma in Electrical Engineering is mandatory.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering preferred.


Experience
Minimum 15 years of experience in the elevator industry for Diploma Engineers or 10 Years for Graduate Engineers with strong exposure to service, repairs and modernization.
Thorough knowledge of elevator systems, troubleshooting, testing and commissioning across multiple control and drive technologies.
Proven track record of leading service teams and delivering results in a demanding field environment.

elevator systems
troubleshooting
testing and commissioning
AES and Safety Tests
PM Audits
customer relationship management
spare parts inventory control
MIS reports
Service Operations Technical Leadership

Job Details
Job Title: Loan Officer-Micro Banking
Grade: DM-I
Department: Micro Banking
Location: Branch
Type of Position: Full-time
Reports To: CRM
Reporting Into: NA
Job Summary
Drive acquisition of new unsecured loan customers from open market
Identify quality leads from unsecured loans liabilities customers through assessments by analyzing credit histories and performing financial analysis, ensuring compliance with internal and external regulations
Monitor and manage installment payments and collections of assigned customers
Strengthen existing customer relationships through targeted cross-selling Ujjivan's products customer profile needs
Size of the Role
Financial size: 5-7 Cr. loan portfolio
Non-financial size: NA
Key Duties and Responsibilities of the Role Business/ Financials
Develop and execute strategies to acquire new unsecured loan customers
Collaborate with the liabilities team to cross-sell unsecured loans
Follow up on leads provided by team various channels within defined TAT
Achieve monthly loan disbursement targets through acquisition of new customers and conversion of existing customers
Coordinate with Products Marketing department to carry out marketing drives at his/her assigned and catchment areas for unsecured loans
Prospect new customers, maintain database of the leads, meet convert select prospects and manage the relationship thereafter
Attend center meetings to generate leads for Unsecured loans and actively driving conversion of existing borrowing customers into SBL customer
Cross sell other products of Ujjivan and pass quality leads to respective officers/staff
Share customer insights/product related feedback with the Branch Head and Area Manager Microfinance
Provide inputs pertaining to revision of product and credit policies to the respective teams on the basis of geography specific considerations
Customer
Interact with customers in a courteous and professional manner; provide prompt, efficient and accurate services and establish professional relationship with them, with a long-term perspective
Conduct the appraisal process of potential customers in a courteous manner without compromising quality
Guarantee confidential treatment of all the information gathered from customers
Internal Process
Carry out the pre and post-loan activities related to Unsecured loans, perform simple financial analysis, present the loan applications to the sanctioning authority by adhering to the set TAT prioritize repayment of loans to maintain best portfolio quality
CompanyAddress: No.27, Grape garden, 3rd A Cross, 18th Main road Koramangala 6th block, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India

Description:
Job Summary
Relationship Associate plays a pivotal role in driving business growth by managing branch relationships and collaborating with Axis Bank sellers. The role involves lead conversion, ensuring process adherence, and supporting operational excellence. The incumbent will be responsible for meeting business targets and maintaining customer satisfaction. This position requires consistent coordination with stakeholders and adherence to company guidelines.
Manages branches, collaborates with the objective to support and contribute to Axis bank strategy, achieve operations excellence, ensure systems are deployed and help build the channel WITHIN the company guidelines and the achieve business targets.


Key Responsibilities
Managing relationship with Axis Branch Sellers and thereby meeting target through Bank s FOS
Responsible for managing the leads generated from Branch and thereby convert into quality business.
Must adhere to the process set and timely coordinate with Cluster Manager and Operations HUB. Ensuring minimal customer complain.
Shall adhere to agree TATs on first customer contact and follow-ups from the date of the lead being registered.
Ensuring 15month persistency on track and thereby ensure a robust follow up mechanism with the customers.
Coordinating with Cluster Training manager to ensure bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.
Shall be responsible for making active the branch banking sellers and thereby achieving the activation target
Ensuring LMS usage as Tracking Mechanism on line and follow up Calls


Key Competencies / Skill required
Excellent Relationship Skill
Managing Various level of Bank Management
Adherence to Process


Desired qualification and experience
Graduate in Any Discipline from a UGC / AICTE approved College and University.
1 to 2 years of experience in sales, experience in Insurance will be preferred.
Experience in the fields of Life insurance sales management, Retail bank distribution, and Channel Management and/or DSA relationship

Description:
Ambulance Operations Management
Monitor daily ambulance operations and ensure uninterrupted service delivery.
Ensure proper deployment and availability of ambulances at designated locations.
Monitor ambulance movement, response time and operational performance.
Coordinate with the control room for efficient ambulance allocation and dispatch.
Manpower Supervision
Supervise EMTs, drivers and other ambulance personnel at assigned locations.
Monitor staff attendance, duty rosters, punctuality and shift management.
Ensure adequate manpower availability and arrange replacements in case of absenteeism.
Conduct regular briefings and guide field staff on operational requirements.
Vehicle & Equipment Management
Ensure ambulances are maintained in good working condition.
Monitor vehicle cleanliness, fuel availability, maintenance schedules and documentation.
Ensure the availability and functionality of medical equipment and emergency supplies.
Coordinate with the concerned teams for vehicle repairs and maintenance.
Quality & Compliance
Ensure adherence to project guidelines, SOPs and safety protocols.
Conduct regular field visits and inspections of ambulances and operational sites.
Identify operational gaps and take corrective action.
Ensure proper maintenance of operational records and documentation.
Reporting & Coordination
Prepare and submit daily, weekly and monthly operational reports.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including ambulance availability, response time and manpower deployment.
Coordinate with Project Managers, Regional Teams and Control Room personnel.
Escalate operational challenges and critical incidents to the reporting authority.

Description:
Job Summary
The Sr. Technician/Technician is responsible for the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of elevators and escalators. The role ensures safe and efficient operation of equipment while maintaining high standards of customer service and compliance with safety regulations.


Key Responsibilities
Perform preventive and breakdown maintenance of elevators and escalators.
Carry out installation, testing, and commissioning activities as assigned.
Ensure equipment operates safely and efficiently.
Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults.
Attend service calls and rectify issues within stipulated timelines.
Replace defective components and perform corrective maintenance.
Follow company safety policies and site regulations.
Conduct routine safety inspections and report hazards.
Maintain service records and documentation accurately.
Coordinate with customers regarding maintenance activities.
Address customer concerns professionally and promptly.
Ensure high customer satisfaction through quality service delivery.
Submit daily service reports and maintenance checklists.
Update supervisors on pending issues and site requirements.


Qualifications
ITI / Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, or related discipline.


Experience
Technician: 0-3 Years
Sr. Technician: 3-8 Years


Required Skills
Elevator Escalator Maintenance
Electrical Mechanical Troubleshooting
Preventive Maintenance
Safety Compliance
Customer Handling
Teamwork Communication


Preferred Industry
Elevator Escalator Industry
Building Services
Industrial Maintenance
Facility Management

Description:
Job Summary
Function Summary: The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience, especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customers in a) resolving policy service needs; b) renewal collection to resolve policy holder's service needs; cross-sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment - Develop various sources of agent hiring; build a team of agent pipeline.
Agent Recruitment - Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referrals for new agent hiring.
Agent Recruitment - Conduct Career Seminar of prospects.
Agent Recruitment - Follow agent hiring mechanism and other hiring norms.
Agent Development - Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training; Field demonstration (FODs).
Agent Development - Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Agent Development - Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Agent Development - Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same.
Meet Business Targets - Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Meet Business Targets - Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc.
Meet Business Targets - Ensure company's product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Meet Business Targets - Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan.
Customer Centricity - Be AMLI brand ambassador, a customer champion.
Customer Centricity - Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty.
Customer Centricity - Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need.
Customer Centricity - Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.
Measures of Success - Achievement of business plan GPA.
Measures of Success - Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Measures of Success - Number MTD Active; Persistency as per grid; Number of EC/MDRT agent.


Qualifications
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience, At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria: 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Position: TSM
Function: Retail Sales

Purpose of Role:
The Sales Officer Retail Sales will be responsible for expanding the dealer network, driving sales growth, strengthening market penetration, and ensuring product availability across the assigned territory. The role involves managing dealer relationships, implementing sales strategies, executing promotional activities, and monitoring market and competitor performance to achieve business objectives.

Reporting to:
This role reports to the Area Sales Manager.

Key accountabilities:
Identifying and appointing dealer for deeper market penetration and reach in depth market share.
Analyze and compare sales plans with the last year base and implement appropriate sales activities to achieve targeted sales.
Overseeing the sale activities of products thereby achieving increased sales growth/ maximized volume and value growth in depth.
Assisting the dealers in achieving the targets and providing them with training
Ensuring the seeding of new product in right Channel.
Ensuring the SKU range availability at key outlets
Conceptualizing and implementing sales promotional programs for brand building
Ensuring profitability of dealers, in alignment with organization's policies and interest
Making a territory monitoring report every month including competitor's activities.
Conducting the retail audit to assess market potential, estimation of sale of competitors with a view to adopt suitable strategies for sale.
Solving all the issue of dealer for making smooth business relation.

Behavioral Competencies:
Highly energetic, motivated, confident candidates with good communication and selling skills.
Should have the ability to get the 'feel' of the market and to convert products into business.
Must be a go-getter with high drive and initiative.
Should be a local candidate.

Educational Qualification:
UG : B. Tech/B.E. - Any Specialization, B.Sc - Any Specialization, B.Com - Commerce

Experience:
Candidate should be a Graduate and a Post Graduate Degree / Diploma in Marketing Management with an experience of 3-6 years in Channel Sales preferably from Paints or Building material industry.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.

Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
Designation :Relationship Manager
Qualification : Graduation
Industry : Medical IVF Hospital only
Experience : 2 to 7 years

Job Description:

1. Guide and counsel patients on treatment plans, with a primary focus on financial aspects as advised by the consulting doctor.
2. Clearly explain the cost structure involved throughout the IVF treatment journey.
3. Ensure proper documentation of financial counselling, including obtaining signed acknowledgements from patients.
4. Act as a single point of contact for patients recommended for IVF treatment.
5. Support patients across the entire life cycle from initial counselling to treatment initiation and completion.
6. Build trust and maintain strong patient relationships through continuous engagement.
7. Ensure timely and consistent follow-ups with patients to encourage continuity of care.
8. Schedule appointments and provide reminders at least one day prior to patient visits.
9. Track and update patient visit status regularly.
10. Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of patient consultations, counselling sessions, and treatment decisions.
11. Record patient feedback and follow-up outcomes systematically.
12. Prepare periodic reports on patient engagement and follow-up status.
13. Work closely with doctors and internal teams to ensure effective patient handholding and engagement.

Role Overview:
The Territory Executive will be responsible for driving sales growth within the assigned territory by identifying new business opportunities, developing strong customer relationships, and promoting the company's product portfolio.

Key Responsibilities -
Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers, including hospitals, nursing homes, healthcare institutions, and distributors.
Promote and demonstrate company products to healthcare professionals and key decision-makers.
Generate product demand through regular field visits and customer engagement activities.
Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to territory revenue growth.
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with doctors, surgeons, nursing staff, purchase managers, biomedical teams, OT technicians, and other key stakeholders.
Provide product-related training, demonstrations, and support to customers.
Ensure consistent follow-up with existing customers to strengthen business
Ensure timely secondary sales generation and coordinate with internal teams for efficient order processing and product delivery.
Monitor inventory availability and support demand forecasting activities.
Follow up on outstanding payments and ensure timely collections in line with company policies.
Maintain accurate sales records and submit periodic sales and market reports as required.

Preferred candidate profile -
Minimum 4 years experience in sales of Medical Devices / Pharma industry.
Experience working with specialists such as Anesthesiologists, Pediatricians, Neonatologists, Oncologists, and Surgeons will be preferred.
Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.

Description:
Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYOs hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:

Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.
AboutCompany: OYO is a global platform that aims to empower entrepreneurs and small businesses with hotels and homes by providing full-stack technology products and services that aims to increase revenue and ease operations; bringing easy-to-book, affordable, and trusted accommodation to customers around the world. OYO offers 40+ integrated products and solutions to patrons who operate over 157K hotel and home storefronts in more than 35 countries including India, Europe, and SEA. OYO operates a unique business model that helps its patrons transform fragmented, unbranded and underutilized hospitality assets into branded, digitally-enabled storefronts with higher revenue generation potential and provides its customers with access to a broad range of high-quality storefronts at compelling price points

Job Title: Business Head

Company: PRISM(Parent of OYO)

Role Overview:
As a Business Head, you will be responsible for driving the overall business performance of your assigned region. The role involves leading the serviced properties business by managing supply, operations, revenue, and sales while ensuring sustainable growth and profitability. You will lead cross-functional teams and be accountable for business expansion, operational excellence, and revenue delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

* Own the P&L and overall business performance of the assigned region.
* Lead the supply, operations, sales, and revenue functions for serviced properties.
* Drive business growth by increasing occupancy, revenue, and profitability.
* Ensure operational excellence and maintain quality standards across all serviced properties.
* Lead and mentor Business Development Managers, Area Revenue Heads, and other regional teams.
* Develop market expansion strategies and strengthen relationships with hotel owners and key partners.
* Monitor business KPIs, identify improvement areas, and implement corrective action plans.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Ensure achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual business targets.

Team Reporting:
Business Development Managers, Area Revenue Heads, and other regional business teams will directly report to the Business Head.

Preferred Candidate Profile:
* Strong experience in business leadership, sales, operations, or hospitality.
* Experience in handling multi-city or regional business operations.
* Proven ability to manage large teams and deliver revenue and growth targets.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Data-driven decision-making with strong analytical abilities.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
