AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

AboutCompany:
Bajaj Electricals Limited is a globally renowned Indian Consumer Appliances and Lighting Solutions company (its Power Transmission and Distribution projects business has been demerged to form Bajel Projects Limited). Headquartered in Mumbai with a turnover of INR 4641 crores (FY 23-24), it is a part of the $100 bn multinational conglomerate Bajaj Group founded by Shri Jamnalal Bajaj. The Company was established in 1938 and has stood the test for almost 85 years. It continues to enjoy consumer trust across various sectors it operates in and remains at the forefront of developing modern, technologically superior and aesthetic products and solutions.

Bajaj Electricals’ business portfolio spans Consumer Products (Appliances, Fans, Cookware) and Lighting Solutions (Consumer and Professional Lighting). They are a front runner in the industry with their key brand offerings comprising BAJAJ, Nirlep, Morphy Richards and Nex. They have an expansive network of 18 branch offices, 660+ distributors, and ~ 2 lakh retail outlets across India, combined with over 620 consumer care centres reaching 19,000 pin codes, fortifying their dominant presence in the consumer products sector. Under their Lighting Solutions business, they offer a wide range of innovative LED lamps and fixtures, including panels and battens, to consumers and are known for their prowess in street lighting, sports lighting, industrial commercial and infrastructural lighting, and undertaking specialised illumination projects on a turnkey basis amongst other solutions.

The Company executes its CSR and philanthropic initiatives through Bajaj Electricals Foundation by focusing on the key areas like ensuring environmental sustainability & promoting its education, rural transformation, promotion of education, vocational skills and livelihoods, promoting preventive health care and promoting Indian arts & culture. Additionally, they run a large-scale Employee Volunteering Program where each employee contributes time and efforts towards uplifting the community through various self-started activities.

Designation - Product Sales Executive - Institutional Sales

Responsibilities
Identify and develop new institutional customers and business opportunities.
Manage relationships with existing institutional clients and ensure repeat business.
Conduct regular customer visits and understand product requirements.
Generate leads through market visits, references, networking and other business-development activities.
Present and demonstrate products to institutional customers as required.
Prepare and submit quotations, proposals and commercial offers.
Coordinate with internal teams for pricing, product availability, dispatch and delivery.
Follow up on enquiries, quotations and orders to ensure timely conversion.
Negotiate with customers within approved company guidelines.
Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
Maintain an updated database of institutional customers, prospects and sales activities.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer requirements.
Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments in coordination with the finance team.
Handle customer queries and coordinate for resolution of complaints.
Maintain regular sales reports, visit reports and pipeline updates.
Support the organization in developing new territories, accounts and product opportunities.


Key Accountabilities / KPIs
Achievement of assigned sales targets.

Revenue and product-wise sales growth.
Enquiry-to-order conversion.
Number and quality of customer visits.
Development of active sales pipeline.
Customer retention and repeat orders.

Corporates and large organizations
Educational institutions
Hospitals and healthcare institutions

Target-oriented and self-motivated approach.

Description:
Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of Spare Parts by increasing penetration in assigned territory. It involve ensuring the availability of genuine parts throughout designated territories and by closely working with retail network. It also involves creating awareness and educating the channel on benefits of genuine spare parts.
Job Responsibility
Sales Execution and Planning
Drive sales strategy through innovative activities and relationship building to garner maximum market share of Tata Genuine Parts.
Drive achievement of retail sales, institutional sales, product range and total sales targets by demand generating schemes and initiatives
Achieve distributor targets for primary and secondary sales by driving order generation activites
Develop and plan appropriate stock levels with distributers and execute plans for order generations. Monitor fulfilment of orders to ensure targets are achieved. Ensure distributers have the proper funding to support sales
Ensure the timely handling of channel partners and customer complaints including resolving payment issues, claims settlements and product availability
Actively coordinate with channel partner and procurement, warehouse & finance team to achieve high fill rates
Actively explore growth opportunities to increase market share and expanded the network to meet business objectives
Develop a deep understanding of the market and competition in assigned territory and use insights on competition pricing and distribution strategies to help improve organizations own strategies and tactics
Develop market potential matrix of Tata Genuine Parts through different methods: retailer wise, product group wise, district wise potential
Financial Management
Coordinate and monitor the availability of finances for distributors in assigned territory
Ensure competitive customer pricing by negotiating with channel partners to creating a win-win distribution pricing.
Monitor over dues of dealers and distributers in assigned area and take actions when required
Relationship Management
Deliver sales targets by working collaboratively with channel partners, participate in customer contact programs to capture voice of the customers, and providing timely solutions to the market, dealers, distributors and customers
People Management
Maintain up to date product knowledge and actively provide training and educate to the retailers, mechanics, fleet operators and channel partners regarding product and the usage of genuine spare parts.
Instilling the importance of resolving customer complaints received by distributors and guiding them on best practices for handling tricky situations in a timely manner. Also training them on importance of stock keeping and timely ordering of parts
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal
Warehouse
Servicing of Orders, providing e-permits.
Central Logistics team.
Tracking shipments
Tech Cell
Technical support for NPI
ASM/CSM
Joint Audits of workshops.
External
Dealer
For order planning, Payments, DPM review on regular basis
Transporter
For claims and timely delivery of consignments.
Desired Candidate Profile
Education MBA from renowned B school along with B E (Mechanical / Automobile Engg)
Relevant Experience: 3 - 4 Years
Experience in Business to Business Sales or Channel Sales or Auto Component Sales
Skills & Competencies
Sales Skills
Technical knowledge
Analytical Skills
Interpersonal Skill
Negotiations skills
Local language knowledge
Customer Orientations

Note: This is an walk in interview at Tezpur, Berger Depot

Interview Date - 26th Nov'26
Time - 11 AM to 3 PM

Address: Near all India Radio Centre, Adjacent to Chand Ford Showroom, Village Gotlong, PO: Kaliabhomora, Tezpur- 784024, Sonitpur.

Contact Person - Sandip Kumar Sinha

Position: TSM/AASM
Function: Retail

Purpose of Role:
The Sales Officer Retail Sales will be responsible for expanding the dealer network, driving sales growth, strengthening market penetration, and ensuring product availability across the assigned territory. The role involves managing dealer relationships, implementing sales strategies, executing promotional activities, and monitoring market and competitor performance to achieve business objectives.

Reporting to:
This role reports to the Area Sales Manager.

Key accountabilities:
Identifying and appointing dealer for deeper market penetration and reach in depth market share.
Analyze and compare sales plans with the last year base and implement appropriate sales activities to achieve targeted sales.
Overseeing the sale activities of products thereby achieving increased sales growth/ maximized volume and value growth in depth.
Assisting the dealers in achieving the targets and providing them with training
Ensuring the seeding of new product in right Channel.
Ensuring the SKU range availability at key outlets
Conceptualizing and implementing sales promotional programs for brand building
Ensuring profitability of dealers, in alignment with organization's policies and interest
Making a territory monitoring report every month including competitor's activities.
Conducting the retail audit to assess market potential, estimation of sale of competitors with a view to adopt suitable strategies for sale.
Solving all the issue of dealer for making smooth business relation.

Behavioral Competencies:
Highly energetic, motivated, confident candidates with good communication and selling skills.
Should have the ability to get the 'feel' of the market and to convert products into business.
Must be a go-getter with high drive and initiative.
Should be a local candidate.

Educational Qualification:
UG : B. Tech/B.E. - Any Specialization, B.Sc - Any Specialization, B.Com - Commerce

Experience:
Candidate should be a Graduate and a Post Graduate Degree / Diploma in Marketing Management with an experience of 3-6 years in Channel Sales preferably from Paints or Building material industry.
CompanyAddress: Near all India Radio Centre, Adjacent to Chand Ford Showroom, Village Gotlong, PO: Kaliabhomora, Tezpur- 784024, Sonitpur.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

The Marketing Executive will be responsible for creating and executing innovative branding strategies that align with our company's goals and objectives. Stay up-to-date with industry trends and incorporate best practices into branding strategies

Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or a related field
2+ years of experience in branding or marketing
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong project management skills and ability to prioritize multiple projects
Creative thinking and ability to develop innovative branding strategies
Two-wheeler required with motorcycle with gear license
Willingness to travel for field visits - DAILY FIELD WORK & Outstation travel required.

ASSC (Authorized Sales Service Center), Serving the existing external walk in customers at dealers and Increasing business opportunities.

- Graduation / Post graduation
- Strong analytical skills to drive channel performance and drive profitability
- People Relationship Management skills

- Graduation / Post graduation with 4 to 6 years and MBA with 3-4 years of relevant experience in sales

Description:
About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate

Description:
Job Description
We are seeking a strategic and professional Senior Executive - HRBP to join our organization in Noida, India. In this pivotal role, you will serve as a trusted business partner to senior leadership and cross-functional teams, driving organizational effectiveness through strategic HR initiatives, employee engagement, and organizational development. You will be responsible for aligning HR strategies with business objectives while ensuring compliance with Indian labor laws and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and employee growth.
Partner with business leaders and department heads to understand organizational needs and develop customized HR strategies that support business goals and drive organizational performance
Manage employee relations matters, including conflict resolution, performance management guidance, and disciplinary actions, while maintaining confidentiality and ensuring fair and consistent application of policies
Lead talent management initiatives including succession planning, high-potential identification, and career development programs to build organizational capability and retain top talent
Design and implement organizational development programs, change management initiatives, and training interventions to enhance employee capabilities and organizational effectiveness
Analyze HR metrics, workforce data, and trends to provide actionable insights and recommendations for improving organizational efficiency and employee engagement
Ensure full compliance with Indian employment laws, labor regulations, and company policies; stay current with regulatory changes and advise leadership on compliance requirements
Collaborate with the recruitment team to develop talent acquisition strategies, define competency frameworks, and support the hiring of key positions
Facilitate communication between HR and business units to ensure consistent messaging, policy implementation, and alignment on people-related initiatives
Contribute to the development and refinement of HR policies, compensation structures, and benefits programs that attract and retain talent
Support employee onboarding, engagement initiatives, and cultural development programs to create a positive and inclusive workplace environment Qualifications
8+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, with a minimum of 5 years in a strategic HRBP or similar business partnership role
Proven expertise in employee relations, talent management, organizational development, and change management
Strong knowledge of Indian employment laws, labor regulations, and compliance requirements
Experience with HR information systems (HRIS), HR analytics tools, and data-driven decision making
Demonstrated ability to analyze HR metrics, workforce trends, and provide strategic recommendations
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to build credibility and influence across all organizational levels
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate complex HR concepts to diverse audiences
Experience in performance management systems, compensation and benefits administration, and recruitment processes
Proficiency in customizing HR solutions to meet organizational needs while maintaining policy consistency
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and work effectively in matrix organizational structures
Preferred experience in multi-site or large organization environments with diverse workforce populations
Preferred experience with HR systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, or similar platforms

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are currently seeking dedicated and detail-oriented individuals to serve as Off-Role Quality & Process Control Representatives (OPC) for a leading paints manufacturing firm across various locations throughout India. This role offers an excellent opportunity for professionals with a background in quality control, production, or manufacturing operations to contribute to maintaining high standards within a respected industry name. The position is pivotal in ensuring product integrity and operational compliance from raw material sourcing through to final dispatch.

Responsibilities
Oversee the quality of raw and packaging materials at vendor sites to ensure they meet established standards.
Execute quality inspections, sampling procedures, and testing protocols in strict accordance with approved specifications.
Supervise production workflows to guarantee adherence to approved formulations and recipes.
Validate batch charging procedures, premix measurements, and the accuracy of production records.
Manage token systems effectively and reconcile them against finished goods shipments.
Perform final quality assessments on completed goods and maintain comprehensive batch-specific documentation.
Track filling weights, verify laboratory equipment calibration, and monitor critical quality parameters.
Generate and submit daily activity reports via a mobile application equipped with geo-tagging capabilities.
Detect any deviations in quality standards and promptly escalate significant findings to management.
Assist in scheduled quality audits and ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory and internal activities.


Requirements

Possess a Graduate degree or Diploma in Science, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
Have between 0.6 to 3 years of professional experience in quality control, production, manufacturing, or conducting plant and vendor audits.
Demonstrate practical knowledge of quality testing methods, sampling techniques, and documentation processes.
Exhibit strong observational, reporting, and analytical capabilities.
Be willing and able to work at external vendor or plant locations and utilize mobile applications for reporting tasks.

Location: Guwahati

* Eligibility Criteria:
Graduate/Diploma in Science, Chemistry or a related discipline.
0.6 3 years of experience in Quality Control, Production, Manufacturing or Plant/Vendor Audits.
Knowledge of quality testing, sampling and documentation
Good observation, reporting and analytical skills.
Comfortable working at vendor/plant locations and using mobile applications.

Salary & Benefits:
18,000 22,000 In-Hand per month
PF
Insurance

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Resource Management Associate
As a Resource Management Associate, you will be part of an industry leading, high performing team of workforce management professionals providing exceptional client service to our stakeholders and helping our employees gain differential experiences that are aligned to their career aspirations.
We provide learning and growth opportunities to build your ability to analyze, innovate, think and act globally. You ll be part of an organization that is focused on optimization, is solution oriented, innovates and provides best in class services to the client serving teams.
The opportunity
EY Global Delivery Services (EY GDS) is a dynamic and global service delivery network of over 50,000 professionals working across borders, to provide innovative and strategic business solutions to EY member firms and EY clients globally. Experience Management plays a vital role in the firm s Next Wave strategy and it s purpose of building a better working world.
We offer a great place to work for every person joining EY. At GDS, you will have the opportunity to develop your professional skills in a truly global environment. You will learn and gain experiences from industry leading WFM professionals and a path breaking leadership team.
We invest in your learning and development. We ll help you develop the technical and soft skills you need. We support your professional development with a combination of learning, networking, experiences, and coaching. As part of a 300+ member team, supporting 4 unique Service Lines, you will always have opportunities to showcase your skills and contribute to the firm s strategic initiatives.
Your key responsibilities
As an Resource Management Associate, you will be responsible for managing staffing demands, monitor the demand intake channels, review demand projections, schedule individuals on projects, optimize employee utilization and bench management.
Some of your key responsibilities include:
Calculate staff requirements based on demand projections.
Create staff schedules to maximize service and minimize cost.
Timely update of resource schedules on the schedule management tool (Retain).
Timely review and resolution of scheduling conflicts.
Proactive review of resource availability/future project demands.
Minimize open, unfulfilled demand.
Mailbox management.
Optimization of resource utilization through effective resource deployment.
Basic reporting and analysis.
Skills and attributes for success
Graduates with 0-1 year of relevant workforce management experience. Non-resource management professionals with 1 year of general work experience in any field of work, that display required skillset competencies can also be hired as Associate in resource management team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel.
Excellent teaming and interpersonal skills.
Positive attitude and ability to excel under tight timelines.
Ideally, you ll also have
Experience on workforce management concepts, resource deployment and scheduling.
What we look for
We are looking for go-getters with a solution oriented and analytical mindset. Someone who is passionate about numbers and has the willingness to learn. The successful candidate will be one who combines computer skills and mathematical ability with a working knowledge of the business and the negotiation skills of a salesman.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you : We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership : We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Job Title - Solution Architect - AI - Manager - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 7 -Manager
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore
Must have skills:Generative AI,Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI, , Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills:Model Context Protocol (MCP)/ Agent2Agent (A2A)
Experience:10 - 15 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.


Roles and Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Minimum 3 years of experience designing or implementing AI-based solutions, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI.
Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Cloud Architect, AI Architect, or equivalent senior architecture role.
Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions involving multiple applications, platforms, integrations, and data sources.
Hands-on architecture experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, document retrieval, and enterprise knowledge bases.
Strong hands-on architecture experience with at least one major cloud platform:
AWS - for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker,
Microsoft Azure - for example Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search,
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - for example Vertex AI, Gemini, BigQuery
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, serverless architectures, containers, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, API gateways, authentication and authorization, OAuth/OIDC, networking, secrets management, encryption, and enterprise security architecture.
Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, relational databases, NoSQL databases, vector databases, and streaming platforms.
Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture including Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, and secure API design.
Strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, scalability, security, maintainability, complexity, and time to market.
Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies.
Experience designing integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems using APIs, messaging platforms, event buses, queues, workflow engines, and integration platforms.
Experience designing highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant, secure, and cost-effective enterprise solutions.
Experience taking technology solutions through multiple lifecycle stages including discovery, architecture, proof-of-concept, implementation, deployment, and production support.
Experience with prompt engineering, context management, grounding techniques, model selection, model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and AI guardrails.
Experience defining deployment strategies for AI applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Experience working with enterprise security, risk, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
Experience estimating solution complexity, cloud infrastructure requirements, implementation effort, technical dependencies, and architecture risks.
Understanding of common AI orchestration and development frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or equivalent technologies.
Understanding of AI production monitoring including model/application performance, latency, token consumption, cost, prompt and response tracing, model failures, retrieval quality, and system availability.
Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including AI agents, planning and reasoning workflows, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
Understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, containerization, Kubernetes, and automated deployment practices.
Understanding of data ingestion, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data quality, metadata management, data governance, and data security concepts.
Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, model risk management, data privacy, prompt security, content moderation, explainability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Knowledge of emerging AI interoperability patterns and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication is desirable. Any experience with UCP is also a plus.
Familiarity with observability platforms and technologies such as OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent tools.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively with business leaders, product owners, enterprise architects, engineering teams, security teams, and senior management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple technical approaches and clearly articulate architectural trade-offs.
Ability to provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to cross-functional engineering teams without necessarily being responsible for direct people management.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business problems, challenge assumptions, identify technical risks, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
Ability to work across multiple projects and technology domains while maintaining consistency with enterprise architecture principles and standards.

Additional Information
Relevant cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified:Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent certifications.
AI/ML or Generative AI certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Google, Databricks, NVIDIA, or other recognized technology providers are advantageous.
Experience working in large enterprise environments, consulting organizations, or complex multi-cloud transformation programs.
Experience defining or contributing to organizational AI architecture standards, Generative AI platforms, AI Centers of Excellence, or enterprise AI governance frameworks would be advantageous.

Description:
US Outbound Calling (IT Services)
Company: Novizco Infotech Pvt. Ltd.
Experience: 2 to 4 years
Shift: US shift, 7:30 PM 4:30 AM IST (Monday to Friday)
This shift follows US Eastern business hours, so it moves to 6:30 PM 3:30 AM IST during US daylight saving time (March to November).
Employment Type: Full-time

About Novizco
Novizco Infotech is a software services and IT resource augmentation company based in Kerala. We place skilled engineers with clients across the US, Canada, Australia, the UK and the Middle East. We also build software projects end to end, including web and mobile apps, AI/ML solutions, QA and testing, and production support.

We're looking for a confident, target-driven Business Development Executive to make outbound calls to US prospects. You'll open conversations with decision-makers such as CTOs, engineering heads, IT managers and founders. You'll qualify their needs and book discovery meetings for our IT staffing and software services.

Key Responsibilities
Make high-volume outbound calls to US-based prospects to generate new business for IT staff augmentation and software development services
Qualify leads on need, budget, timeline and decision-making authority, then set up meetings with the senior sales team
Follow up calls with personalised emails and LinkedIn touchpoints
Research target accounts and contacts using LinkedIn, Lusha, Apollo or similar tools
Pitch our available engineering resources (AI/ML, full-stack, mobile, QA/testing) to matching client requirements
Handle objections professionally and build rapport with US clients
Keep call logs, lead status and pipeline up to date in the CRM
Meet weekly and monthly targets for calls, connects, qualified leads and meetings booked
Share market feedback and prospect insights with the sales and delivery teams

Requirements
2–4 years of outbound calling or inside sales experience in IT services, IT staffing or software sales, with a focus on the US market
Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent; comfortable speaking with senior US stakeholders
Good understanding of IT services models: staff augmentation, dedicated teams, T&M and fixed-scope projects
Familiar with common technology roles and stacks, enough to discuss client requirements credibly
Hands-on experience with a CRM (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce or similar) and prospecting tools
Proven record of meeting or beating calling and lead-generation targets
Willing to work US shift hours on an ongoing basis
Bachelor's degree in any discipline (MBA or BBA a plus)

Good to Have
Experience selling into the US, Canada or UK markets
A working network of contacts at US tech companies
Experience with email outreach sequences and LinkedIn Sales Navigator
What We Offer
Hybrid work setup
Competitive fixed salary plus performance incentives
Direct exposure to international clients and a fast-growing services business

Description:
Position Overview
The NOC L2 Engineer is responsible for providing advanced technical support, monitoring, troubleshooting and maintenance of enterprise IT infrastructure and network environments. The role involves handling escalated incidents from Level 1 support, identifying root causes, resolving complex technical issues and ensuring the stability, availability and performance of customer infrastructure.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in networking and IT infrastructure, with the ability to troubleshoot across multiple technology domains. Exposure to cybersecurity technologies will be considered an added advantage.
Key Responsibilities

Network Operations & Troubleshooting
Monitor, maintain and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, WLAN and VPN environments.
Troubleshoot routing, switching, VLANs, connectivity, DNS, DHCP and network performance issues.
Support and configure network devices such as routers, switches, wireless controllers and access points.
Handle Level 2 escalations from the NOC L1 team and ensure timely resolution of incidents.
Perform network health checks, performance monitoring and preventive maintenance.
Assist in implementing network changes, upgrades and configuration improvements.


IT Infrastructure Support
Provide Level 2 support for enterprise IT infrastructure, including servers, virtualization platforms and storage environments.
Troubleshoot Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy and related infrastructure services.
Support virtualized environments such as VMware and Hyper-V.
Assist with server deployment, patching, upgrades, backup monitoring and infrastructure maintenance.
Troubleshoot hardware, operating system and infrastructure-related issues across customer environments.
Support Microsoft 365 and other enterprise infrastructure platforms, where applicable.


Incident & Escalation Management
Manage technical escalations from L1 support and take ownership of incidents until resolution.
Analyse recurring incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA) and recommend corrective actions.
Ensure incidents and service requests are properly documented in the ticketing system.
Adhere to SLA requirements and ensure timely communication with customers and internal teams.
Escalate critical incidents to L3, vendors or relevant technical teams when required.
Maintain accurate technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures and incident reports.


Security Support Added Advantage
Assist in troubleshooting and supporting network security devices, including firewalls and VPN solutions.
Provide support for firewall rule reviews, connectivity troubleshooting and basic security configuration changes, subject to approved procedures.
Support security technologies such as endpoint protection, IDS/IPS and security monitoring solutions.
Assist in identifying potential security incidents and coordinate escalation to the relevant security team.
Participate in security patching, vulnerability remediation and infrastructure hardening activities.


Monitoring, Reporting & Documentation
Monitor infrastructure availability, performance and alerts using NOC monitoring tools.
Identify potential service disruptions and take proactive action to prevent incidents.
Maintain network diagrams, infrastructure records, configuration backups and technical documentation.
Prepare incident reports, operational updates and maintenance reports as required.
Coordinate with vendors, internal engineering teams and customer IT teams for troubleshooting and service restoration.


Required Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree or diploma in IT, Computer Science, Networking or a related field.
3-5 years of hands-on experience in Network Operations, IT Infrastructure Support or a similar technical support role.
Strong practical knowledge of enterprise networking, including routing, switching, VLANs, VPNs and network troubleshooting.
Experience supporting Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualization and core IT infrastructure services.
Familiarity with network and infrastructure monitoring tools.
Experience working in a NOC, IT operations or managed services environment.
Good understanding of incident management, escalation procedures and SLA-driven support operations.


Preferred Technical Skills

Technology Area
Required Knowledge
Networking
TCP/IP, VLAN, Routing, Switching, DNS, DHCP, VPN
Network Vendors
Cisco, Aruba, HPE or similar
Firewall & Security
Fortinet, Cisco, Palo Alto or similar advantage
Server Infrastructure
Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy
Virtualization
VMware vSphere / ESXi, Hyper-V
Monitoring
ConnectWise, NinjaOne, Auvik, Nagios or similar
Backup
Veeam or similar backup solutions
Cloud
Basic exposure to Azure /AWS or other cloud platforms advantage
ITSM
ServiceNow, ManageEngine, Jira Service Management or similar
Certifications (Preferred)
CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate)
CompTIA Network+
Microsoft Windows Server / Azure certifications
VMware certifications
Fortinet NSE / FCP, Palo Alto or other firewall certifications
ITIL Foundation


Key Competencies
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to work independently and manage technical escalations.
Customer-oriented approach with good communication skills.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Ability to work under pressure in an SLA-driven environment.
Good documentation and reporting skills.
Willingness to work in shifts, on-call rotations or extended hours when required.


Reporting Structure

Department: Technical Services / Network Operations
Position : NOC Engineer Level 2
Reports To: NOC Manager / Technical Services Manager
Level : Technical Support L2
Primary Focus
Networking & IT Infrastructure
Security Exposure
Preferred / Added Advantage
Role focus: Recruit a strong infrastructure and networking L2 engineer rather than a purely monitoring-based NOC operator, with security knowledge as a desirable supplementary skill.
Note :
This vacancy is for Kochi office and prefers candidatesfrom Kerala.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Inspect guest rooms, public areas, pool, etc. after being cleaned by Housekeeper to ensure quality standards. Run sold room reports, verify room status, determine discrepant rooms, prioritize room cleaning, and update status of departing guest rooms. Assist Housekeeping management in managing daily activities. Act as a liaison to coordinate the efforts of Housekeeping, Engineering, Front Office, and Laundry. Document and resolve issues with discrepant rooms with the Front Desk. Prepare, distribute, and communicate changes in room assignments. Communicate issues to next shift. Complete required paperwork.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 55 pounds without assistance and in excess of 55 pounds with assistance. Ability to push and pull a loaded housekeeping cart and other work-related machinery over sloping and uneven surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Stand, sit, kneel, or walk for an extended period across an entire work shift. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Discipline
Client Industries

Role Type
Industry Group Enabler
The opportunity - About the GDS Strategy Execution and Operations team role
The GDS Global Industry Group Enablement team plays a pivotal role in supporting onshore industry group leaders and sector operations leadership across all industry groups, sectors, and geographies. The team is responsible for translating strategic priorities set by the Market Board into actionable initiatives. We help operationalize these strategies and drive execution to enhance performance and support the achievement of defined goals and targets.
By working closely with leadership, each MSE ensures alignment, consistency, and impact across global markets, making it a key enabler of success for the broader organization.
As a Industry Group Enabler (Rank 65) you will be expected provide an operational foundation for Industry Group strategic initiatives execution. This role is designed for individuals with strong analytical skills, commercial curiosity, and a disciplined approach to execution.
You will be responsible for ensuring pipeline hygiene, maintaining accurate CRM data, and delivering baseline reporting that supports leadership decision-making. The role also offers exposure to strategic priorities through insight brief preparation, and go-to-market support - positioning you for growth within the team.
Your key responsibilities
Reporting Dashboarding
Deliver daily, weekly, and periodic performance reports on key KPIs.
Develop and maintain standard dashboards and templates using Power BI, Excel, newsletters, and other reporting tools.
Support pipeline reporting and hygiene management, including forecast tracking, account movement updates, and unassigned account reporting.
Prepare baseline reports and first-level analysis on pipeline, revenue, and pursuits to support performance reporting.
Research Insights
Conduct targeted analysis and secondary research on key performance metrics, strategic accounts, industries, and stakeholders.
Generate insights for stakeholders on revenue, margin, pipeline, and NBD performance.
Perform research on clients, executives, and events, and track executive movements to support strategic planning.
Act as a reliable support resource for translating data into insights that inform strategic execution.
Content Coordination
Share sector newsletters and summarize thought leadership content for internal distribution.
Update meeting materials and participate in meetings to capture call notes and action items.
Manage document uploads to SharePoint, Teams channels, and shared drives.
Coordinate with internal teams and represent the market board within GDS for cross-functional collaboration.
Track progress on projects and initiatives, ensuring timely execution and follow-up.
Ad-hoc Executive Support
Respond to requests from the Sector Operations Leader and other market board leaders.
Provide scaled support for core accounts and business development initiatives.
Offer foundational support for leadership meetings, reporting cycles, and communication materials.
Automation Data Hygiene
Develop automated reporting solutions to streamline recurring tasks and improve efficiency.
Maintain data accuracy across internal tools such as ARD and Mercury, ensuring CRM hygiene and integrity.
Support revenue reconciliation and data clean-up to ensure reporting reliability.
Sector Knowledge Commercial Awareness
Build sector knowledge and commercial awareness to strengthen contributions to leadership discussions.
Skills and attributes for success
Proven ability to be a team player with exposure to working with multi-cultural teams and collaborating virtually
Business acumen and commerciality
Builds internal relationships - identifies opportunities and encourages/ influences internal teams to understand and achieve account goals
Exhibits drive and determination - able to overcome internal and external barriers and get results from people
Is above average [to market] in fundamental competencies like Data analysis, Business Research, Writing Presentation, MS Tools, Communication Diction, etc.
Proactively to learn and adapt to advancements in technology relevant to the role.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A Master s degree or bachelors degree with relevant experience
3+ years of relevant work experience
Experience in a large Global organization preferred
Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
Ideally, you ll also have
Exposure to tools like Tableau, PowerBi etc.
Credible experience working in a fast-moving, client-driven environment
Technologies and Tools
Microsoft 365 Products, Apps, and Services
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
A professional with strong interpersonal skills - confidence, maturity ability to build strong client relationships
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success, as defined by you : We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership : We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Platform Operations Manager to lead a team responsible for the reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective operation of enterprise machine learning and generative AI platforms. The role combines people leadership, service delivery management, stakeholder engagement, and strong technical oversight across MLOps, LLMOps, model deployment and monitoring, APIs and endpoints, model pipelines, prompt and model configuration, observability, and incident resolution. The Manager will be accountable for meeting agreed SLAs and KPIs, managing operational risk and critical escalations, developing team capability, and driving continuous improvement across production AI services.
Your key responsibilities
Lead, coach, and develop a team of AI/ML Platform Operations Engineers, establishing clear responsibilities, objectives, support coverage, competency plans, and performance expectations.
Own end-to-end service delivery for machine learning and generative AI platforms, ensuring incidents, requests, problems, changes, releases, access activities, and model lifecycle events are managed within agreed SLAs and controls.
Define, monitor, and report KPIs including platform and endpoint availability, inference success rate, response latency, error rate, mean time to detect, mean time to recover, incident recurrence, change success rate, model and prompt deployment success, token usage, cost efficiency, model quality, drift, safety events, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Review operational dashboards, model and service telemetry, support backlogs, demand trends, and risk indicators, and drive recovery plans, corrective actions, automation, and measurable service improvements.
Act as the senior escalation point for critical issues involving model deployments, LLM services, APIs and endpoints, model pipelines, prompt and model configuration, observability, security controls, quotas, latency, scaling, and cloud dependencies.
Provide technical governance for MLOps and LLMOps practices covering experiment tracking, model registration, validation, approval, promotion, deployment, rollback, retirement, prompt versioning, evaluation, and operational monitoring.
Lead major incidents, including business-impact assessment, technical coordination, executive communication, service restoration, root cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking.
Drive problem management for recurring endpoint failures, performance degradation, model-quality regression, drift, unsafe responses, pipeline instability, quota constraints, and cost anomalies.
Oversee production API and endpoint operations covering authentication, authorization, throttling, quotas, retries, timeouts, autoscaling, load management, high availability, private networking, and secrets management.
Ensure effective observability across logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, service-level indicators, model quality, groundedness, safety, hallucination risk, user feedback, token consumption, and cost.
Govern prompt templates, system instructions, model parameters, routing rules, guardrails, content filters, retrieval configuration, tool connections, and environment-specific configuration through approved change controls.
Manage team capacity, shifts and on-call coverage, work allocation, cross-training, succession planning, demand forecasting, and operational readiness for new AI use cases.
Establish and enforce runbooks, SOPs, monitoring and evaluation standards, known-error records, architecture and dependency documentation, escalation paths, and knowledge-management practices.
Provide technical oversight for Python-based automation, API integrations, operational tooling, evaluation workflows, health checks, and incident diagnostics.
Provide regular leadership and service reviews covering SLA and KPI performance, risks, major incidents, model and prompt changes, capacity, spend, technical debt, and improvement actions.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong people-management and service-delivery leadership, with experience managing AI/ML, platform engineering, DevOps, or cloud operations teams supporting business-critical services.
Deep operational understanding of MLOps and LLMOps, including model lifecycle management, deployment strategies, prompt configuration, evaluation, observability, reliability, security, and cost controls.
Strong technical knowledge of model APIs and endpoints, authentication, rate limits, quotas, autoscaling, latency, high availability, monitoring, and incident troubleshooting.
Working knowledge of OpenAI services, AWS Bedrock, and Python sufficient to guide investigations, review designs, and challenge technical findings or remediation plans.
Demonstrated ability to translate SLAs, risk requirements, and business expectations into measurable KPIs, operational dashboards, team goals, and improvement roadmaps.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an SAP EWM Senior to join the EY GDS Team. As part of our EY GDS - TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing functional support for SAP Sourcing and Procurement across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize design to meet business requirements.
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global 500 companies through best-in-class solutions, automation and innovation.
Your Key Responsibilities
Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
As an SAP EWM Consultant, you will play a key role in designing and implementing SAP EWM solutions on S/4HANA to optimize warehouse operations and improve supply chain efficiency.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP EWM solutions and designs.
Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.
Mentor and train junior SAP EWM Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on issues and troubleshooting techniques.
Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation
Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
Bachelor's degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
4+ years of experience required in one or more areas within SAP Extended Warehouse Management, preferably with a global client.
Proven experience in designing complex integrations, cloud applications, and security architectures.
Responsible for providing support for SAP EWM module incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
Support incident resolution by analyzing incidents raised by users and providing solutions.
Working closely with customers and teams to ensure issues and requests are followed up and addressed in a timely manner.
Handle change requests with a clear understanding of new business requirements.
Proficient in business process mapping, configuration, and end-user training.
Understand business needs and deliver solutions to make processes more efficient and simpler whenever possible.
Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onsite model.
Defect resolution and defect analysis related to EWM.
Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time-critical environment.
Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional team environment.
Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements
Ideally, you'll also have
Functional Expertise: Deep understanding of warehouse processes, including inbound and outbound logistics, stock management, storage bin strategies, warehouse task optimization, and integration with SAP; Transportation Management (SAP TM).
Well versed with Sourcing Procurement process:
SAP Certification in SAP EWM

Description:
The opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Data Platform Engineering Support Manager to lead a team responsible for the reliable, secure, and cost-effective operation of enterprise Databricks and data engineering services. The role combines people leadership, service delivery management, stakeholder engagement, and strong technical oversight across Databricks jobs, notebooks, clusters, pipelines, Python and PySpark workloads, ETL and ELT processing, SQL and data issues, performance optimization, and platform administration. The Manager will be accountable for meeting agreed SLAs and KPIs, managing critical incidents and operational risks, developing team capability, and driving continuous improvement across the data platform support service.
Your key responsibilities
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Platform Engineering Support Engineers, establishing clear responsibilities, objectives, support coverage, competency plans, and performance expectations.
Own end-to-end service delivery for Databricks platform and engineering support, ensuring incidents, requests, problems, changes, releases, and access activities are managed within agreed SLAs and controls.
Define, monitor, and report operational KPIs such as platform availability, job and pipeline success rate, SLA attainment, response and resolution time, backlog ageing, first-time resolution, recurrence rate, change success rate, mean time to recovery, compute utilization, cost efficiency, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Act as the senior escalation point for critical Databricks issues involving jobs, notebooks, Workflows, Lakeflow or Delta Live Tables pipelines, clusters, SQL warehouses, Unity Catalog, permissions, libraries, runtimes, and integrations.
Provide technical oversight for Python, PySpark, Spark, ETL and ELT troubleshooting, data reconciliation, SQL defects, schema changes, data-quality issues, and performance bottlenecks.
Lead major incidents, including business-impact assessment, technical coordination, stakeholder communication, service restoration, root cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking.
Drive problem management for recurring job failures, platform instability, performance degradation, data issues, and operational gaps, ensuring permanent fixes and preventive monitoring.
Oversee Databricks platform administration, including workspace configuration, identity and access, service principals, cluster policies, compute governance, runtimes, libraries, secrets, tokens, Unity Catalog, and secure data access.
Ensure controlled deployment and promotion of notebooks, code, jobs, pipelines, configurations, and platform changes using Git, CI/CD, testing evidence, approvals, rollback plans, and post-implementation validation.
Manage team capacity, shifts and on-call coverage, work allocation, cross-training, succession planning, demand forecasting, and support readiness for project transitions.
Establish and enforce runbooks, SOPs, monitoring standards, reconciliation controls, known-error records, knowledge management, and operational quality reviews.
Partner with data engineering, cloud platform, DevOps, security, database, architecture, FinOps, application, and business teams to resolve issues and improve reliability and cost efficiency.
Manage vendor and product-support engagement, ensuring complete diagnostic evidence, timely follow-up, and effective resolution of Databricks or cloud-platform defects.
Provide regular service reviews and leadership updates covering SLA and KPI performance, risks, major incidents, capacity, cost, technical debt, improvement actions, and planned releases.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong people-management and service-delivery leadership, with experience managing technical support or data engineering teams in business-critical environments.
Deep operational understanding of Databricks jobs, notebooks, Workflows, pipelines, clusters, SQL warehouses, Spark UI, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and production support.
Strong technical knowledge of Python, PySpark, Spark architecture, ETL and ELT patterns, data-quality controls, SQL troubleshooting, and workload performance optimization.
Demonstrated ability to translate SLAs and business expectations into measurable KPIs, operational dashboards, team goals, and structured improvement plans.
Experience leading major incidents, escalations, root cause analysis, problem management, change governance, release management, and senior stakeholder communication.
Strong knowledge of Databricks platform administration, identity and access, cluster policies, compute governance, runtime and library management, secrets, service principals, and Unity Catalog.
Good SQL skills and working knowledge of Oracle and SQL Server for validation, reconciliation, access investigation, query analysis, and issue diagnosis.

Description:
The Opportunity
We are looking for an SAP MM Senior Consultant to join the EY GDS Team. As part of our EY GDS - TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing functional support for SAP Sourcing and Procurement across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize design to meet business requirements.
To qualify for the role, you must have:
Bachelor's degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
3-7 Years of experience required in one or more areas within SAP Material Management preferably with Global client
Your Key Responsibilities
Responsible for providing support SAP MM module incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
Support incident solving by analyzing incidents raised by users and provides solutions.
Working closely with customers and teams to ensure issues and requests are followed-up and addressed timely.
Handle change requests with a clear understanding of new business requirements.
Understand business needs and deliver solutions to make processes more efficient and simpler whenever possible.
Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onsite model.
Defect resolution and defect analysis related to MM.
Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time critical environment.
Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, you'll also have:
Well versed with Sourcing Procurement process:
Material Management (Purchase Requisition, Purchase Order, Goods Receipt, Invoice Receipt, Vendor Payment)
Service Procurement (Service Entry Sheet- SES)
Contract Management (Value/Quantity Contract)
Stock Transfer Order (STO)
Master Data (LTMC, Migration Cockpit)
Experience in MM integration points with other SAP modules like FI, SD, PM.
SAP Certification in SAP MM
What you will do
Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP MM solutions and designs.
Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.
Mentor and train junior SAP MM Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on issues and troubleshooting techniques.
Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation
