Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
ANAPLAN SENIOR CONSULTANT
Job description/Key Responsibilities:
An Anaplan Senior Consultant in our Anaplan Practice will be responsible for being an integral part of delivering Anaplan Solutions for our clients. This role requires techno - Functional expertise to create Anaplan models, ability to handle different data sets and upload them into Anaplan and good functional business understanding. This role also entails participating in teams to estimate project tasks, elicit requirements from clients, design the application, complete design documentation, and conduct end user training.
Good understanding of Anaplan focused on FPA, Sales/Incentive Compensation Planning or Supply Chain Planning is expected based on projects done to be able to converse and understand the requirements better. Individuals in this role are expected to be able to work effectively and resourcefully independently as well as part of the team to accomplish tasks laid by team lead.
Required Experience:
4-8 years of hands-on Modelling Experience in ANAPLAN (with exposure to a minimum of 3 end-to-end implementations on Anaplan) focused on but not limited to Financial Forecasting, Supply Chain Planning and HR/Sales/Incentive Compensation Management or similar use cases.
4+ years of strong background and experience in consulting roles focused on Sales Performance Planning / Supply chain / Financial Planning.
Familiarity with SCRUM/Agile.
Hands on in MS Excel using advanced formulae to develop Mock Ups for clients
Certified Solution Architect in Anaplan is Must
Strong expertise and deep understanding of multi-dimensional modelling
MBA in Finance or Operations and Supply chain is preferred
Technical Skills:
Must have had 4+ years Hands on Modelling experience in ANAPLAN projects, including implementations, upgrades, roll outs and/or support.
Comfortable with creating Model, Modules, Lists, Line Items, Subsets, Line-Item Subsets, Usage of Calculation functions and dashboards using best practices.
Been introduced or worked with Anaplan Optimizer, PlanIQ, Integration methods and ALM within Anaplan.
Ability to have direct discussions with clients to understand their needs and then design, develop, maintain, and elaborate planning models.
Master Anaplanner Certification is a plus.
Assist to Conduct, Document and Signoff Business Requirement with clients. Assign the User stories and assist in Sprint Planning
People Skills:
Ability to effectively communicate with client team and in client facing roles across various time zones based on client location
Ability to work in Hybrid model (WFH and Office)
Strong sense of responsibility and positive attitude
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
FINTECH - OneStream - Senior Consultant
The opportunity
We re looking for Senior Consultants with expertise in OneStream to join our Technology Consulting practice where we provide a one-stop solution for end-to-end project implementation enabled by expertise in financial transformation using EPM or Fintech products.
Your key responsibilities
Support client needs by delivering OneStream consolidation or Planning modules.
Support client needs by delivering integrating OneStream with multiple source systems.
Merge, Customize and Deploy OneStream as per client business requirements
Experience working with clients throughout various parts of implementation lifecycle
Proactive with Solution oriented mindset, ready to learn new technologies for Client requirements.
Skills and attributes for success
Deliver large/medium OneStream programmes, demonstrate expert core consulting skills.
Perform an appropriate role in business development in terms of presales and practice development. for example, presales, internal engagement and / or knowledge management
Demonstrate man management and an ability to conduct and lead consultancy assignments
Should be open to adopt new technologies.
To qualify for the role, you must have
4-7 years of relevant experience in implementation planning and Consolidation modules. Should have 1-3 years in OneStream products.
Develop and maintain solid knowledge on consolidations in OneStream
Should have worked in designing the workflow and metadata design in OneStream
Independently provide system solutions to OneStream issues and enhancements; act as an escalation point to FAST support/Operation team for complex issues
Lead the team in effective handling of Financial Planning / Consolidation month-end close
Act as a techno-functional OneStream solution architect.
Perform functional and technical testing of system projects; bug fixes and enhancements
Should have written OneStream codes/Rules
Participate in prioritizing system issues for development team; Participate in regular calls with development team to keep track of progress
Independently identify areas of improvement and makes recommendations
Ideally, you ll also have
Strong understanding of data close process. Proficient in building and extending metadata functionalities
Maintaining end-to-end accountability and expectations for customer satisfaction and overall delivery excellence
Prioritize deliveries in conjunction with implementation team
Adopt a proactive, logical and organized approach to problem resolution
What we look for
The incumbent should be able to drive OneStream technical and functional assignment.
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 10000 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What working at EY offers
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an SAP Basis Senior Consultant to join the EY GDS - SAP TechOps Team. As part of our EY GDS - SAP TechOps team, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, performance, and availability of the SAP systems across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize system performance to meet business requirements.
Responsibilities
Extensive experience with SAP system installation, configuration and upgrade procedures, including experience with SAP Basis tools and utilities.
Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyze and resolve complex technical issues in a timely manner in a multi-region environment.
Experience working in a global setting with multi-regional teams, understanding cultural nuances and time zone differences.
Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
What you will do
Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
Provide senior level support for SAP Basis Activities including system administration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting across SAP landscapes.
Perform System Monitoring, Capacity Planning and Tuning to optimize system performance and ensure high availability and scalability.
Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP infrastructure/Basis solutions.
Develop and maintain technical documentation including system configuration, installation procedures and guidelines.
Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
At least 3 to 5 years of experience in SAP Basis domain.
Minimum of 2 years working experience in SAP Basis administration with focus on Level 3 support and Global operations
Skills
Broad knowledge of SAP ERP IT systems, processes and integration with legacy systems.
Good understanding on Roles and Authorization - SAP Security.
Experience with different Cloud platforms (i.e., Azure, AWS, GCP).
Experience in SAP Rise and/or SAP Cloud Solutions
Database (Sybase/SAP - ASE, Oracle, and Microsoft SQL, S4HANA)
Knowledge on SAP Fiori, SAP BusinessObjects, and other SAP technologies and applications
Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools for SAP such as SAP Cloud ALM and SAP Solution Manager
SAP Certification in SAP Basis Administration or SAP HANA Administration

Description:
Job Summary
Position Title: ITSM Process Specialist -Senior


Your Key Responsibilities
Process Governance: Ensure Compliance with incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management processes.
SLA Management: Monitor SLA performance, identify imminent breaches and drive corrective actions to closure.
Ticket Hygiene: Ensure accurate categorization, prioritization, documentation, updates and timely ticket closure.
Stakeholder Management: Coordinate with Service managers, delivery teams and customer leadership on process gaps and improvement plans.
Customer Collaboration: Engage proactively with customer stakeholders to review process effectiveness, gather feedback and jointly identify improvement opportunities.
Process Transformation: Challenge existing practices, eliminate inefficiencies and redesign workflows to improve operational effectiveness and SLA performance.
Joint Governance: Conduct periodic process reviews with the customer, agree on improvement actions and track implementation through measurable outcomes.
Best Practice Adoption: Recommend and implement industry best practices, standardisation and automation opportunities in alignment with customer requirements.
Reporting Analysis: Publish daily operational reports, weekly KPI dashboards and Monthly business review (MBR) metrics.
Continuous Improvement: Identify automation opportunities, reduce recurring incidents, improve MTTR and eliminate repetitive tickets.
Audit Compliance: Ensure process adherence, maintain evidence and address audit findings
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong knowledge of ITIL processes, including incident, Problem, Change, request and Knowledge Management
Expertise in ITSM tools, with proficiency in developing dashboards and reports to track SLAs, KPIs, ticket trends and operational performance
Experience in process standardisation, SOP development and ITSM governance across application teams
Proficiency in SLA monitoring, breach prevention performance improvement
Expertise in operational reporting, KPI dashboards and monthly business reviews
Ability to collaborate with customers to identify process gaps and implement improvements
Strong analytical skills to identify recurring incidents, root causes and automation opportunities
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and end-to-end ownership of continuous improvement initiatives


To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
8-10 years of experience in ITSM process governance, service management and process improvement
ITIL4 Foundation Certification; Advance ITIL certifications are an advantage
Proficiency in Excel, Power BI or equivalent reporting and analytics tools.
Hands-on experience with ITSM tools, including ServiceNow for process management and workflow configuration
Proven ability to standardize ITSM processes, develop SOPs and drive process compliance across teams.
Experience in SLA management, operational reporting, KPI dashboards and performance analysis
Strong customer engagement skills to identify process gaps and implement continuous improvement initiatives
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.


Ideally, you ll also have

Technologies and Tools
ITSM Platforms: ServiceNow , Jira Service Management
Knowledge management :Confluence, Sharepoint
Reporting Dashboards: ServiceNow, Performance Analytics, Power BI Advanced Microsoft excel

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Discipline
Client Experience

Role Type
CX Program Lead
The opportunity
We are looking for CX Program Lead - Supervising Associate who can oversee Client Experience program within the Region. The focus is on embedding regular, robust client feedback that delivers insights that results in executed actions across the client life cycle to continually improve the experience for our clients. Build strong relationships with leadership and work with account teams to embed client experience into Account management activities. Equip our client serving teams with a continuous improvement mindset and the capability to conduct highly effective CXM (ASQ)/CXE (ESQ) and WLRs. Provide regular voice of the client insight to leadership which will assist development of go-to market strategies, minimize the risk of client losses, and maximize revenue growth opportunities.
Your key responsibilities
Provide quality service delivery, maintaining the focus on exceptional client service through quality management and operational rigor
Manage workload and work under minimal supervision and prioritize tasks effectively
Become a subject matter expert and go to person on CX program and tools/systems
Develops relationships with business teams in the Region to embed client feedback
Responsible for driving increased feedback and high-quality feedback across account portfolio
Monitors trends and insights from Client feedback and shares best practice with CX leadership
Provides regular voice of the client reporting to leadership which will assist development of go-to market strategies, minimize the risk of client losses, and maximize revenue growth opportunities
Drive innovation, automation and process streamlining of with strong focus on building efficiencies with Region s requirements in mind
Ensure compliance with the KPIs, SLAs and Region priorities
Skills and attributes for success
Demonstrated success in building internal and external relationships at a senior level with a proven track record of success in business development and client interactions.
Establishes procedures to monitor the progress of the client relationship and ability to address any concerns about satisfaction.
Makes stakeholders and their needs a primary focus; initiates, builds and sustains productive relationships resulting in delivering quality service and client satisfaction
Ability to identify and resolve complex problems with creative solutions
Excellent project management, interpersonal and team building skills
Strong executive presence (perceived as equal in status to CEO/CFO)
Excellent written and verbal communications skills
Ability to provide constructive criticism and coaching
Ability to coordinate multiple complex initiatives at any time
Excellent logic and thinking capabilities with an ability to understand, source, and profile data.
Client Interviewing skills (good to have)
Strong influencing skills are required to work with other departments or Business Unit Leaders
Expert hands-on experience on data visualization tools - PowerBI, MS Excel, PPT, etc.
Excellent oral written communication
Prior knowledge on generating insights
Market research preferred
Excellent in Project management
To qualify for the role, you must have
University/Master s degree
Approximately 8+ years plus of previous customer experience, program management, consulting or marketing experience
Experience managing complex client relationships
Worked in a large Global organization
Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
Ideally, you ll also have
This role might expect to also interface with C-level executives at EY clients through client feedback interviews. Must have commercial mindset and the ability to influence and drive change in the behaviours needed to enhance client interactions.
This position is responsible for setting and accomplishing Regional goals related to Client experience, with a focus on effective penetration of accounts and sufficient quality of feedback to drive action that improves client experience. The individual shall work with account teams to drive consistent adoption and activate accounts to establish and execute strategic client experience plans.
Strategic leader with client facing experience. Must be able to make decisions and overcome obstacles with minimal supervision. This person must have strong influencing skills to work with business teams.
Technologies and Tools
Expert hands-on of data visualization tools like PowerBI, MS Excel, PPT, etc.
Exposure to data visualization tools like Tableu, Qualtrics will be preferred.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success, as defined by you : We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership : We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Process all guest check-ins, check-outs, room assignments, and room change/late check-out requests. Secure payment; activate/reissue room keys. Ensure rates match market codes, document exceptions. Verify/adjust billing for guests.

Communicate to appropriate staff when guests are waiting for an available room. Advise guest of messages. Clear departures in computer system. Coordinate with Housekeeping to track room status and guest concerns. File guest paperwork or documentation.

Operate telephone switchboard station. Run and check daily reports, contingency lists, and credit card authorization reports. Supply guests with directions and information. Answer, record, and process all guest calls, requests, questions, or concerns; follow up to ensure each has been met to guests satisfaction. Arrange transportation for guests/visitors. Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift. Cash-guests checks, process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, charges, and provide change. Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any reports of theft.

Follow company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of employees. Comply with quality assurance standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will supervise and guide your team members closely, ensuring the service sequence is flawless and goes beyond guest expectations. As an F&B Executive, you re not just creating unforgettable dining moments - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
High school diploma or equivalent; proven experience in a similar role.
Excellent communication, grooming, and interpersonal skills
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage
Friendly, professional, and guest-focused
Able to work flexible shifts
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Operational Oversight: Support daily outlet operations to ensure smooth service and adherence to brand standards.
Team Leadership: Supervise, train, and motivate staff to deliver exceptional guest experiences and maintain high performance.
Guest Experience Management: Ensure personalized service, handle guest feedback, and resolve issues promptly to enhance satisfaction.
Inventory & Cost Control: Monitor stock levels, manage ordering, and control costs to optimize profitability.
Sales & Revenue Support: Drive upselling initiatives, monitor sales performance, and support revenue targets.
Compliance & Hygiene: Ensure adherence to health, safety, and hygiene regulations across all outlet areas.
Coordination & Communication: Collaborate with kitchen, housekeeping, and other departments for seamless service delivery.
Food Safety Regulations: Ensuring that all food safety standards are met.

Job Title: Sr. Project Manager
Position Summary:
A project manager is responsible for delivering IT projects to schedule, budget and quality. The role requires mastery of the technical knowledge of project management inter-related process stages i.e., initiate, plan, execute, monitoring control and close, and the supporting processes e.g., scope, cost, time, issue, risk, resource, communication, stakeholder management. Proficiency in related processes such as portfolio management, program management, methods and tools and quality assurance are also required. Senior project manager must have excellent stakeholder relationship management skills to successfully lead and manage the project team and project stakeholders, and have expertise recognized and requested by customers.
Essential Functions of the Job:
Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget, and scope
Perform the relevant project management processes - i.e., initiate, plan, execute, monitor and control and close, and the supporting processes e.g., scope, cost, time, issue, risk, resource, communication, stakeholder management
Plan the project based on a defined need - results in detailed scope/budget/schedule baseline
Monitor and control the work to ensure that the project remains on track and in control
Plan for and manage change
Reports on variances to the approved project baseline
Close the project to formalize acceptance of the project result and release project resources
Interface and communicate with project team, management and stakeholders
Manage project work and resources to enable successful and timely completion of the project
Performs gate reviews and quality assurance reviews with all aspects of IT organization and business sponsors
Delivery of projects aligned to overall business and technology strategies and architectures
Work within defined governance processes
Manage external contracts and suppliers where required
Support development of business cases with the customer team including leading on the solutions estimate
Lead the development of the project charter and scope, and ensure delivery of the solution to schedule, budget and scope
Develop objectives, phasing and content of the project to deliver on the business case benefits, budget and timescales
Manage to the objectives and plan by thorough risk, issue and change management across both business and IT parts of the project
Ensures that quality project standards are met as prescribed by IT Services through the effective implementation or use of approved processes, methodologies and deliverables
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:
Monitors and manages project baseline to ensure activities are occurring as planned - scope, budget and schedule - manages variances
Proactively performance monitoring and reporting on project/program scope, time, cost, quality, risks and overall project/program health.
Leading the project/program team, working with global executives, management teams and IT Services Teams to ensure project/program success.
Proactively identify risks and issues on projects - leading team to develop risk management and issues management plans
Identifies potential points of contention for missed deliverables; creates and implements strategy to mitigate shortfalls in timeline and budget
Anticipates problems before they occur; defines the problem or risk; identifies possible causes; works with team to identify solutions; selects and implements most appropriate solution
Develop and manage plans to address project strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats
Ability to balance both the "science" of how to perform project management and the "art" of project management, which is learned through experience and skill training/application
Analytical skills and problem-solving skills needed to manage multiple factors on a project simultaneously
Demonstrate business analytics to manage and meet sponsor and customer needs
Knowledge and Skills Requirements:
Experience of managing IT projects with personal accountability for delivering to time and cost for large, complex projects typically from $100,000 up to $5 M in value and 6 to 18 months in duration
IT Infrastructure Management Knowledge - Networking, Sever Management, End User Computing, Voice VoIP, etc.
Mastery of project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
Track record of customer focus, based on openness, trust, and delivering on promises
Not mandatory but desirable - management skills to manage one or more large, complex projects simultaneously
IT background with experience across the systems development life cycle with experience in all project phases - plan, initiate, elaborate, design, build, test, implement.
Knowledge and use of industry-standard project methods, tools, and techniques e.g., RAIDS, budget, communication
Strong team working skills across matrixed client, supplier, and geographically dispersed virtual teams
Strong communication and interpersonal skills (including negotiation)
Excellent written and verbal communication skills - must be able to communicate fluently in English both verbally and in writing
Leader in the use of IT methodologies, processes, and standards for project management
Experience in working with Global teams - internal resources, contracting resources, suppliers/hardware software vendors
Not mandatory but desirable - experienced in managing to contract; ensuring clients and suppliers alike perform in accordance with original agreement
Supervision Responsibilities:
Direct supervision provided by an experienced program manager or sub-lead; frequency on a weekly or as needed basis
Project manager is expected to act independently to deliver project to schedule, budget and scope; support provided as required and requested, and is self-driven and motivated
The project manager leads project teams consisting of cross functional, global, and virtual groups; assigns responsibility to members; monitors progress; no direct supervision responsibility.
Job Requirements:
Education:
A degree in Computer Science or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience
Experience:
12 - 18 years of working experience in the IT industry.
5 to 10 years of experience in project management
Other relevant experience in a related technical field (application development, deployment/implementation, and infrastructure)
Work experience in a professional services industry, and in multinational company/global firm is preferred
Certification Requirements:
Project management certification is preferred (PMI/PMP - PMI/CAPM )
Agile certification would be advantageous
Familiarity with ITIL v3 or v4 would be advantageous
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Prepare special meals or substitute items. Regulate temperature of ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters. Pull food from freezer storage to thaw in the refrigerator. Ensure proper portion, arrangement, and food garnish. Maintain food logs. Monitor the quality and quantity of food that is prepared. Communicate assistance needed during busy periods. Inform Chef of excess food items for use in daily specials. Inform Food Beverage service staff of menu specials and out of stock menu items. Ensure the quality of the food items. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Anticipate and address guests service needs. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: Technical, Trade, or Vocational School Degree.
Related Work Experience: At least 3 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Prepare special meals or substitute items. Regulate temperature of ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters. Pull food from freezer storage to thaw in the refrigerator. Ensure proper portion, arrangement, and food garnish. Maintain food logs. Monitor the quality and quantity of food that is prepared. Communicate assistance needed during busy periods. Inform Chef of excess food items for use in daily specials. Inform Food Beverage service staff of menu specials and out of stock menu items. Ensure the quality of the food items. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Anticipate and address guests service needs. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: Technical, Trade, or Vocational School Degree.
Related Work Experience: At least 3 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Microsoft M365 Delivery Manager - Senior Manager
EY GDS Consulting Digital is seeking an experienced Microsoft 365 Delivery Manager at the Senior Manager level to lead complex, large-scale Microsoft 365 transformation and managed-service engagements. The individual will be accountable for end-to-end delivery, including solution shaping, delivery planning, governance, financial and resource management, quality assurance, risk and dependency management, and client stakeholder engagement. The role requires strong technical and delivery experience across Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, security, compliance, and hybrid environments. The Delivery Manager will provide strategic direction and technical oversight, establish effective delivery controls and operating rhythms, manage globally distributed and multidisciplinary teams, address escalations, and ensure that engagements achieve agreed business outcomes, service quality, timelines, and commercial commitments. The individual will also identify opportunities for continuous improvement, automation, reusable assets, capability development, and account growth while coaching delivery leads, architects, and other team members.
The opportunity
We re looking for resources with capacity that ranges from assisting on in-flight initiatives, up to technical briefings and demonstrations of new technologies across the organization. In senior level roles, leads business solutions, capabilities, and is a strong influencer that engages with client executives and stakeholders. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering.
Your key responsibilities
Engage with clients and senior stakeholders to understand their business objectives, technology landscape, operational challenges, and security requirements, translating them into scalable Microsoft 365 solutions and delivery roadmaps.
Act as the Microsoft 365 subject matter expert and delivery leader, accountable for the successful delivery of complex, enterprise-scale transformation, migration, adoption, and managed-service engagements.
Own end-to-end engagement delivery, including planning, governance, scope, financial performance, resource management, quality, risks, dependencies, milestones, and contractual commitments.
Establish effective delivery governance, operating rhythms, controls, performance measures, and escalation mechanisms to ensure predictable and consistent delivery across multiple workstreams and globally distributed teams.
Provide technical leadership and oversight for solutions across Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Power Platform, security, compliance, and hybrid environments.
Lead solution architecture and design activities for complex Microsoft 365 engagements, ensuring alignment with agreed architecture principles, security requirements, design standards, delivery methodologies, and reusable assets.
Lead major workstreams within large-scale transformation programs, ensuring coordination across architecture, engineering, migration, testing, change management, adoption, service transition, and operations teams.
Own the resolution of critical technical and delivery challenges, acting as the senior escalation point for architects, engineering teams, project managers, clients, and other stakeholders.
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders by translating the Microsoft 365 product roadmap, technology trends, and service changes into customer-specific recommendations, risk mitigation plans, adoption opportunities, and measurable business benefits.
Manage engagement economics, including effort estimation, budgeting, forecasting, utilization, delivery productivity, scope control, and margin performance, while balancing quality and client expectations.
Identify and manage delivery risks, architectural dependencies, security and compliance considerations, and service-readiness requirements throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Define and promote Microsoft 365 governance and best practices covering identity, access, security, compliance, information protection, lifecycle management, administration, monitoring, and user adoption.
Drive continuous improvement through automation, standardized delivery methods, reusable tools, accelerators, reference architectures, and lessons learned from previous engagements.
Lead, mentor, and coach architects, technical leads, and delivery team members through performance management, technical communities, knowledge sharing, succession planning, and capability development.
Support workforce planning, staffing, hiring, demand management, and the effective deployment of skills across concurrent engagements and account portfolios.
Contribute to proposals, solution shaping, estimations, client presentations, and account growth by identifying additional opportunities and developing credible delivery approaches.
Work effectively across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models, adapting governance, planning, controls, and reporting to suit the engagements complexity and client environment.
Communicate complex technical and delivery topics clearly to audiences ranging from engineering teams to C-level stakeholders, enabling timely decisions and maintaining alignment across all parties.
Skills and attributes
Strong experience managing complex Microsoft 365 transformation, migration, implementation, adoption, or managed-service engagements.
Good working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Power Platform, security, compliance, and hybrid environments.
Ability to understand Microsoft 365 solutions and technical dependencies sufficiently to support delivery planning, challenge delivery assumptions, manage risks, and facilitate informed decisions. The role is not expected to perform detailed solution architecture or design.
Demonstrated experience leading multiple workstreams or a portfolio of engagements involving architects, engineers, project managers, business analysts, security specialists, change-management teams, and globally distributed delivery teams.
Strong experience managing scope, schedules, budgets, forecasts, resources, utilization, quality, delivery risks, dependencies, contractual commitments, and commercial performance.
Experience establishing delivery governance, operating rhythms, executive reporting, performance measures, issue-resolution processes, and escalation mechanisms.
Practical experience delivering through Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid methodologies, with the ability to adapt governance and delivery controls to the engagement context.
Consulting or professional-services experience is strongly preferred, including client engagement, proposal support, effort estimation, delivery planning, and account-growth activities.
Soft Skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage technical, non-technical, and executive stakeholders.
Strong leadership and team-management skills, with the ability to motivate, mentor, and develop globally distributed teams.
Collaborative team player who builds trusted relationships across clients, partners, vendors, and internal functions.
Self-motivated, proactive, and highly accountable, with a strong sense of ownership for delivery outcomes.
Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills, including the ability to manage expectations and facilitate decisions.
Excellent presentation and facilitation skills, with the confidence to communicate delivery status, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.
Ability to remain composed, decisive, and solution-focused in high-pressure and fast-paced delivery environments.
Strong problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and negotiation skills.
Ability to prioritize competing demands and coordinate multiple workstreams effectively.
Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to lead teams through ambiguity, organizational change, and evolving client priorities.
Culturally aware and able to collaborate effectively across geographies, time zones, and diverse working styles.
Results-oriented, with a focus on quality, timely execution, continuous improvement, and measurable business outcomes.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelors or masters degree
A minimum of 14+ years of experience, preferably background in a professional services firm.
Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred
Ideally, you ll also have
Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
What working at EY offers
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Apprentice Trainee Resources (HR)
Company
Manappuram Finance Limited (MAFIL)
Location
Corporate Office, Valapad, Thrissur, Kerala
Position
Apprentice Trainee Human Resources
Department
Human Resources (HR)
Employment Type
Apprenticeship (NATS/Apprenticeship Program)
stipend: As per NATS Norms
Job Summary
The Apprentice Trainee will assist the Human Resources Department in recruitment, onboarding, employee documentation, HR operations, data management, and administrative activities. The trainee will gain practical exposure to HR processes and support day-to-day HR functions while ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures.
Key Responsibilities
Recruitment & Onboarding
Assist in sourcing and screening candidate profiles.
Coordinate interview schedules with candidates and department heads.
Follow up with selected candidates regarding joining formalities.
Support onboarding activities and document collection.
Maintain candidate and joining trackers.
HR Operations
Verify employee documents and ensure completeness of records.
Update employee information in HRMS and related databases.
Assist in maintaining employee personal files and HR records.
Support preparation of HR reports and MIS.
Apprentice & Internship Coordination
Assist in NATS Apprentice and PMIS Intern recruitment activities.
Coordinate with branches and candidates for document submission.
Monitor joining status and maintain compliance records.
Employee Engagement & Administration
Support employee communication initiatives.
Assist in organizing HR events, training programs, and engagement activities.
Provide administrative support to HR team members.
Compliance & Documentation
Maintain confidentiality of employee information.
Ensure proper filing and record management.
Assist in HR audits and compliance-related documentation.
Support preparation of HR letters, reports, and correspondence.
Eligibility Criteria
Educational Qualification:
Any Graduate (B.Com, BBA, BA, B.Sc, BBM, BCA, or equivalent).
Fresh graduates are preferred.
Candidates enrolled under the NATS Apprenticeship Program will be given preference.
Skills Required
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
Ability to maintain confidentiality.
Willingness to learn and work in a professional environment.
Desired Competencies
Teamwork and collaboration.
Time management.
Organizational skills.
Problem-solving ability.
Professional attitude and integrity.
Learning Outcomes
The Apprentice Trainee will gain practical exposure to:
Recruitment and Talent Acquisition
Employee Onboarding
HR Documentation and Compliance
HRMS Operations
Employee Engagement Activities
HR Reporting and MIS Management
Department: Human Resources
Location: Valapad, Thrissur
Company: Manappuram Finance Limited (MAFIL)
Position: Apprentice Trainee Human Resources (HR)
AboutCompany:
Manappuram Finance Ltd. is one of Indias leading NBFCs. Promoted by Shri. V.P. Nandakumar, the current MD & CEO, its origins go back to 1949 when it was founded in the coastal village of Valapad (Thrissur District) by his late father Mr. V.C. Padmanabhan. The firm was involved in pawn broking and money lending carried out on a modest scale. Shri Nandakumar took over the reins in 1986 after his father expired.
Since then, it has been a story of unparalleled growth with many milestones crossed. Incorporated in 1992, Manappuram Finance Ltd. has grown at a rapid pace. Today, it has more than 5,200 (Includes branches of subsidiary companies) branches across 28 states/UTs with assets under management (AUM) of Rs 420.69 billion and a workforce of more than 50,000.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Complete closing duties, including storing all reusable goods, breaking down goods, cleaning all equipment and areas, returning equipment to proper locations, locking refrigerators, restocking items, turning off lights, locking doors, and completing daily cleaning checklist. Set up, stock, and maintain work areas. Inspect the cleanliness and presentation of all china, glass, and silver prior to use. Maintain cleanliness of work areas throughout the day, practicing clean-as-you-go procedures.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
We are looking for skilled SEO and digital marketing executives to join our team at JKL INFO SOLUTIONS. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in search engine optimization and digital marketing strategies.

Roles and Responsibility


Develop and implement effective SEO strategies to improve website rankings and drive organic traffic.

Conduct keyword research and analyze website analytics to optimize content and structure.

Create high-quality, engaging content for social media platforms and websites.

Manage and optimize online advertising campaigns across various channels.

Monitor and report on website performance metrics and adjust strategies accordingly.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align SEO efforts with overall business goals.


Job Requirements


Proven experience in SEO and digital marketing with a strong understanding of search engine algorithms and ranking factors.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

Ability to stay up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and digital marketing.

Experience with SEO tools such as Google Analytics and SEMrush.

Strong knowledge of digital marketing platforms, including social media management and email marketing.

Description:
Job Summary
Discipline: GDS Enablement Services Growth & Innovation
Role title: Quantum Senior Associate
The Quantum Senior Associate will play a hands-on delivery role across Quantum Technology initiatives, with stronger ownership for solution design, technical execution, stakeholder communication and delivery quality than an Associate role. The role requires practical experience in quantum-safe security and/or quantum computing, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business and delivery outcomes.
The role is expected to have a primary focus on quantum safety, including post-quantum cryptography readiness, and a secondary focus on quantum computing use cases such as optimization, machine learning and simulation.
Responsibilities
Support the development of quantum safety and quantum computing solutions, prototypes and demonstrations.
Contribute to post-quantum cryptography readiness assessments, including data gathering, analysis and documentation.
Develop and evaluate quantum algorithms and workflows for selected optimization, machine learning and simulation use cases.
Build and maintain software tools, accelerators and proof-of-concept assets using established engineering practices.
Prepare technical documentation, assessment reports and presentation materials for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including cybersecurity, AI/ML, platform engineering and product teams.
Participate in testing, validation and benchmarking activities to assess solution performance and applicability.
Stay current on developments in quantum computing, post-quantum cryptography and related emerging technologies.
Quantum Specialist Responsibilities
Quantum Cyber / Safety:
Support quantum risk assessments and identify areas that may require future cryptographic modernization.
Assist in prototyping and benchmarking post-quantum cryptography algorithms within applications and services.
Contribute to analysis of quantum-safe and hybrid cryptographic approaches and document findings.
Support development of crypto-inventory and discovery capabilities to identify legacy cryptography dependencies.
Execute testing of hybrid key exchange mechanisms and document performance observations.
Assist with implementation and validation of crypto-agility patterns, certificate updates and key management enhancements.
Contribute to creation and maintenance of migration guides, standards documentation and operational runbooks.
Quantum Compute & Algorithms:
Develop and evaluate quantum algorithms using industry-standard quantum development platforms.
Support experimentation and testing to assess the practicality of quantum use cases.
Build proof-of-concept solutions for optimization, simulation and emerging Quantum + AI use cases.
Perform basic resource estimation and analysis of quantum circuits and algorithm performance.
Compare classical and quantum approaches and document observations and recommendations.
Maintain reproducible experimentation environments using Python, Jupyter notebooks, containers and source control tools.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements
Foundational understanding of quantum computing concepts, including qubits, gates, quantum circuits and current hardware limitations.
Basic understanding of post-quantum cryptography concepts, key encapsulation mechanisms, digital signatures and emerging standards.
Familiarity with cryptographic concepts such as public-key cryptography, certificates and secure communication protocols.
Experience with at least one quantum development platform such as Qiskit, PennyLane, Cirq, Azure Quantum or AWS Braket.
Proficiency in Python programming and familiarity with commonly used scientific and data analysis libraries.
Working knowledge of software development fundamentals, including version control and testing practices.
Ability to design and execute experiments, analyse results and communicate findings effectively.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in global, cross-functional teams.
Interest in emerging technologies and willingness to continuously learn new concepts and tools.
Education and Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
25+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:
Software development or engineering
Applied cryptography or cybersecurity
Data science, machine learning or advanced analytics
Quantum computing research or development
High-performance or scientific computing
Experience developing prototypes, proof-of-concepts or technical solutions using modern programming languages and frameworks.
Familiarity with Python and scientific computing libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas or similar tools.
Exposure to quantum computing concepts, quantum software development kits or post-quantum cryptography is preferred but not mandatory.
Understanding of cybersecurity and cryptography fundamentals is desirable.
Experience working in agile, research or innovation-focused environments is advantageous.
Ability to independently complete assigned deliverables while collaborating effectively with senior team members.
Publications, hackathons, certifications, research projects or open-source contributions related to quantum technologies are beneficial but not required.
Willingness to work with global teams and support overlap with US East Coast hours when needed.

Description:
Job description
Experience- 09 to 15
Location- Pune, Kolkata, Kochi, Trivandrum

Your key role and responsibilities
Perform project management activities to include:
Financial management, pricing scenario modelling
Budget v/s spend tracking, Invoicing
Project planning using tools like Excel or MS Projects
Collection and tracking status of deliverables
Set up/structure instances of PM tools and manage development lifecycle
Reporting and preparing Dashboards for client team including senior leadership
Prepare and manage RAID logs, Stakeholder register etc.
Work with applications like excel, Power Point, Power Bi, SharePoint etc.
Act as a central point of contact for the assigned project(s), manage communication plan
Be insightful about the services the project provides and utilize that knowledge to make suggestions and/or recommendations
Support quality and risk management, manage documentation
Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment
Develop strong working relationships and leverage information gained to anticipate client needs
Flexible to work Onsite/work from office needed (hybrid)
Open to work in shifts
Willing to work on Indian Holidays as per client requirement
Willing to travel, within the country and internationally as required.

Skills and attributes for success
Any Graduate, preferably B. Com/BBA/Economics or masters degree
Good to have CSM/PSM, CAPM/Prince2/PMP or Project Management Fundamentals certification
Previous relevant industry or project management experience of 9 yrs
Strong computer skills, including advanced Microsoft suit (Excel, power point presentation etc.)
Must have skills Power BI, Power apps, MS Project, Visio, SharePoint
Experience with JIRA/Confluence, Azure DevOps, Trello etc.
Experience of Agile project management, understanding of Product backlog, EPIC & User stories etc.
Strong English communication - both written and verbal
Strong analytical/numerical skills, attention to detail even when dealing with routine tasks
Confident, Assertive, with strong communication and influencing skills
Prior experience working with Global cliental required
Self-starter, excellent team player, organized and self-disciplined. Ability to work with senior leadership.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, GMP regulations, data integrity requirements, and industrial automation systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain PI Data Archive, PI AF (Asset Framework), PI Vision, and PI Interfaces/Connectors to collect, contextualize, and deliver real-time process data.
Build and manage AF templates, element hierarchies, event frames, and analyses to model plant assets and business logic.
Configure and troubleshoot PI interfaces (OPC DA/UA, Modbus, custom interfaces) for data acquisition from PLCs, DCS, SCADA, and historians.
Develop PI Vision displays, dashboards, and PI DataLink/Excel reports for operations, engineering, and management stakeholders.
Write and maintain scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, PI SDK/AF SDK, PI Web API) to automate data workflows, integrations, and system health checks.
Integrate PI System data with other platforms (MES, ERP, SQL/historian databases, cloud data lakes, Aveva Data Hub/Connect).
Monitor system performance, data quality, and tag counts; perform capacity planning and license management.
Support PI System upgrades, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and high-availability (PI Collective) configurations.
Enforce cybersecurity best practices for OT/IT systems, including PI System security (mappings, identities, firewalls).
Document architecture, standards, naming conventions, and data governance processes.
Collaborate with process/controls engineers to identify new tagging, KPI, and analytics requirements.
provide Tier 2/3 support and root-cause analysis for PI System issues.Required Technical Skillset
Strong hands-on experience with AVEVA System Platform (Application Server / Galaxy, Historian, InTouch, Web Client / Operations Control).
Working knowledge of AVEVA MES / AVEVA Batch Management, or exposure to integrating third-party MES/LIMS/ERP with SCADA layer.
Proficiency in OPC UA/DA, Modbus, and native communication drivers for PLC/DCS integration
Experience with scripting (QuickScript/VBScript) and object-oriented Galaxy template design.
Understanding of network/OT architecture, redundancy, cybersecurity hardening (ISA/IEC 62443 awareness a plus), and virtualization (VMware) for industrial systems.
Familiarity with SQL Server/reporting tools for Historian data extraction and dashboarding (AVEVA Insight / Reports is a plus).
Pharmaceutical / Regulatory Domain Expertise (Preferred)
Sound knowledge of GAMP 5 computerized system validation (CSV/CSA) lifecycle and documentation practices.
Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and data integrity (ALCOA+) requirements.
Certifications (Preferred)
AVEVA PI certification
GAMP 5 / CSV training certification.
Soft Skills & Other Requirements
Strong client-facing communication skills; ability to work directly with pharma quality, validation, and automation stakeholders.
Ability to prepare and present technical estimations, proposals, and solution walkthroughs to client/hiring stakeholders.
Strong documentation discipline suited to regulated/validated environments.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills for live plant support scenarios.

INNOV8 | Area Sales Manager Job
Description
About INNOV8
INNOV8 is one of Indias leading coworking and managed office space brands, creating
beautifully designed, premium workspaces that enable people and companies to work,
collaborate, and grow together. With a growing presence across major Indian cities, INNOV8
serves a diverse ecosystem of entrepreneurs, freelancers, startups, and enterprises by offering
flexible workspace solutions tailored to different stages of growth.
Position: Area Sales Manager INNOV8
Reports To: City Head
Employment Type: Full-time
Role Overview
The Area Sales Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth, occupancy, and
market penetration for INNOV8 centers in the assigned region. The role combines new
business acquisition, account management, and channel development, with a strong focus on
building long-term client and broker relationships.
You will work closely with center teams, marketing, and leadership to ensure sustained seat
sales, timely collections, and best-in-class client experience.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & Growth
• Develop and implement a growth strategy for the region focused on financial gain,
occupancy improvement, and customer satisfaction.
• Identify, build, and expand new markets across relevant customer segments (startups,
SMEs, enterprises, freelancers).



• Generate a strong pipeline of prospects through cold outreach, referrals, ecosystem
connects, and channel partners.
2. Sales, Revenue & Collections
• Achieve monthly and quarterly seat sales and revenue targets for assigned centers.
• Prepare and present formal proposals, quotes, and commercial offers to prospects.
• Negotiate and close deals with key decision-makers, ensuring mutually beneficial
terms.
• Drive monthly collections based on invoices raised; ensure minimal delays and
revenue leakage.
3. Client Relationship Management & Retention
• Build long-term relationships with new and existing customers to drive repeat and
expansion business.
• Regularly engage with clients to understand their evolving needs and identify
upsell/cross-sell opportunities.
• Focus on renewal, expansion, and churn control for key accounts in the region.
• Ensure timely resolution of client complaints within defined TAT and proactively
address service gaps.
4. Channel & Lead Generation Strategy
• Devise and execute strategies for lead generation through:
o Brokers, channel partners, and IPCs
o Online and direct channels
o Startup and ecosystem collaborations
o Partnerships and alliances in the region
• Build and nurture a strong broker and partner network to ensure steady inflow of
qualified leads.
5. Reporting, Tracking & Governance
• Keep accurate records of sales, revenue, pipeline, collections, and key account
activity.
• Maintain updated data and reports on CRM/trackers as per organizational standards.
• Share regular updates and insights on market trends, competition, and customer
feedback with leadership.
Qualifications & Experience
• Proven experience in sales, preferably in coworking, commercial real estate, flex
spaces, or related sectors.



• Strong communication, negotiation, and deal-closing skills with comfort in handling
CXO/decision-maker conversations.
• Good connections and working relationships with brokers, IPCs, property consultants,
or relevant ecosystem partners.
• Experience in community building, events, or client engagement will be an added
advantage.
•
Bachelors degree in any field is preferred; MBA or equivalent in Sales/Marketing is
a plus.
Key Skills & Competencies
• Strong sales ownership and target orientation
• Relationship-building and stakeholder management
• Market understanding of coworking / office space / real estate ecosystem
• Analytical approach to revenue, pricing, and occupancy
• High level of responsiveness, follow-through, and execution discipline
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment

Description:
About the Company
BPL Medical Technologies is a leading Indian medical technology company committed to advancing healthcare through innovative, reliable, and accessible solutions. With a strong legacy and nationwide presence, BPL serves hospitals, clinics, and healthcare providers across India and select international markets.
The company offers a diverse portfolio across patient monitoring, imaging, critical care, and other medical solutions, supported by robust manufacturing, service, and distribution capabilities. With a growing installed base and a focus on quality and customer trust, BPL continues to strengthen its position as a trusted partner in healthcare delivery.
Driven by innovation and operational excellence, BPL is focused on building future-ready capabilities and delivering long-term value to customers, partners, and stakeholders.
Role Summary
A field-facing sales leader for BPL's Ultrasound business, responsible for driving business growth across an assigned territory while managing, guiding, and developing the sales team. The role involves building strong customer relationships, identifying business opportunities, strengthening Ultrasound brand presence, and ensuring effective execution of the sales strategy within the territory.
Position: Area Sales Manager Ultrasound
Key Responsibilities
Sales & Business Development
Drive sales and business development activities across the assigned territory.
Identify and prioritize key customers, prospects, and business opportunities.
Travel extensively within the assigned territory to meet potential and existing customers.
Present company offerings and strengthen BPL's brand presence in the market.
Drive the sales team towards achieving assigned business objectives.
Team Management & Development
Manage, guide, and provide overall direction to the sales team within the assigned territory.
Support the team in identifying and prioritizing key customers and prospects.
Coach and train team members to strengthen their sales effectiveness and customer engagement.
Implement effective sales management processes to improve team performance.
Customer Relationship Management
Develop and sustain long-term relationships with customers.
Engage with customers through face-to-face meetings, calls, and email communication.
Understand customer requirements and provide appropriate solutions from the company's portfolio.
Collect customer feedback and ensure relevant insights are communicated to management.
Market & Sales Reporting
Monitor territory-level market activities and sales opportunities.
Gather customer and market feedback and provide timely updates to senior management.
Track sales activities and support effective territory planning and prioritization.
Maintain regular communication with the Regional Sales Manager on business progress and market developments.
What We're Looking For
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or any relevant field.
An MBA/PG degree in Operations Management or a related field would be an added advantage.
6–7+ years of experience working specifically with Ultrasound products.
Key Skills
Strong sales and business development skills.
Good team management and leadership abilities.
Strong product and clinical knowledge of Ultrasound systems and applications.
Strong customer relationship and communication skills.
Ability to manage and prioritize a sales territory effectively.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
Why This Role Matters
You'll play a key role in expanding BPL's presence across the market while building and enabling a strong sales team. This role offers:
