Title: Telecom Engineer (Metro Railways) Contractual role - Kochi
EmploymentType: Siemens Direct Contract Experience Level: Junior (5 Years) Industry: Metro Rail / Transportation Telecom Systems Job Summary: We are seeking an skilled Telecom Engineer to oversee our Metro Rail projects in the South Region, encompassing the state of Keral (Kochi City). The ideal candidate should possess a Engineering Graduate with minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience; out of which a minimum of 3+ years’ experience in Telecommunication domain in Metro Railway project or similar transportation system environment. The Telecom Engineer will be responsible for design, installation, testing, commissioning, integration, operation, and maintenance of all telecommunication systems that support safe, reliable, and efficient train operations by ensuring compliance with safety, quality and regulatory standards. Key Responsibilities: System Design & Engineering in Coordination with Design Manager: • Review Employer's Requirements, Specifications, and Standards. • Prepare telecom system architecture and detailed engineering designs. • Develop system layout drawings, schematics, cable routing plans, and interface documents. • Coordinate with signaling, power supply, rolling stock, civil, and MEP teams. • Ensure compliance with Metro Rail standards, IEC, EN, IEEE, and local regulations. Telecommunication Systems Management in coordination with Project Manager, Design Manager, Interface Manager, Testing & Commissioning Engineer, Quality Manager, EHS Manager, and system OEMS/Vendor partners: • Fiber Optic Communication Network (OFC) o Design and supervise installation of fiber optic backbone networks. o Conduct fiber splicing, OTDR testing, and link performance verification. • Telephone Systems o Manage Emergency Telephone System (ETS). o Manage Operational Telephone System (OTS). o Configure IP-PBX and VoIP systems. • Radio Communication System o Implement TETRA, LTE, or other radio systems. o Ensure communication coverage throughout tunnels, stations, viaducts, and depots. o Coordinate radio frequency testing and optimization. • CCTV Surveillance System o Supervise installation of CCTV cameras and recording systems. o Configure Network Video Recorders (NVRs) and video management software. o Ensure integration with Operations Control Center (OCC). Page1 | 3 • Passenger Information System (PIS) o Configure audio and visual passenger information systems. o Integrate train arrival/departure information. o Ensure real-time announcements and display functionality. • Public Address System (PAS) o Design and configure station and depot PA systems. o Ensure emergency and routine announcements are delivered effectively. o Test audio clarity and coverage. • Master Clock System o Implement synchronized master and slave clock systems. o Ensure synchronization across all stations and operational areas. • Access Control & Intrusion Detection o Implement access control systems. o Configure card readers, biometric devices, and monitoring systems. o Ensure integration with security management systems. • Installation & Site Supervision o Supervise telecom equipment installation at stations, depots, tunnels, and OCC. o Monitor cable tray installation and cable pulling activities. o Ensure installation quality according to approved drawings and method statements. o Verify contractor compliance with safety requirements. • Testing & Commissioning o Prepare Inspection and Test Plans (ITP). o Conduct Site Acceptance Test (SAT). o Perform integrated system testing. o Support Trial Running and revenue operation readiness activities. 6. Documentation & Reporting • Prepare: o Method statements o Risk assessments o Inspection reports o Test reports o As-built drawings o O&M manuals • Maintain project progress reports and punch lists. 7. Safety & Quality Management • Ensure compliance with: o Metro Rail Safety Requirements o Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) procedures o HSE standards and regulations • Participate in safety audits and inspections. 8. Project Management Responsibilities. • Track telecom installation and commissioning progress. • Coordinate with vendors and subcontractors. • Participate in technical and progress review meetings. 9. Operation & Maintenance Support • Assist during trial operations. • Troubleshoot telecom system faults. • Train operations and maintenance personnel. • Support defect liability period (DLP) activities. Page2 | 3 Qualifications and Skills: • Education: Engineering Graduate, Bachelors of Degree in Electronics & Communications, Telecommunication or Electrical Engineering Experience & Skills: • Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience, out of which a minimum of 3+ years of hands-on experience in Telecommunication domain in Metro Railway Projects or similar transportation network system • Sound technical skills on Telecommunication systems for Metro Railway project or similar environment • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. • Willingness to travel as per project needs. • Ability to work independently and take ownership of project deliverables. • Ability to adopt technical skills faster • Demonstrated commitment to EHS practices

Job Summary
We are looking for Executive Assistant who would be required to work in a team environment in delivering the secretarial needs of the global EY office senior management team such as diary management, calendar management, travel management, documentation, tool support and other administrative requirements that may arise on a need basis.
Role Details
Discipline: Executive Assistance CoE
Role Type: Assigned Support / Associate
Responsibilities
The primary role and responsibility of this position will be to work in a team environment and deliver administrative services including, but not limited to
Diary Management - Provide support to the project team members on maintaining and managing key project meetings and the meeting location
Calendar Management - Maintaining project teams calendar to showcase all key events that needs to be planned.
Meetings Management - Working closely with the project teams and other stakeholders in scheduling/organizing the meeting or conference call
Travel Management - Support the project team members in booking the travel tickets
Workshop or Area visit Plan - Help in planning the agenda, for workshops/area visits by handling the logistics of stay, food and printing, etc.
Documentation - Recording the minutes of the meeting with clear emphasis on the key action points from the meeting. Maintaining the project database and ensure all documentations are captured and organized for ease of access.
Training Management - Provide support in setting up training by sending out invites, enabling cut-off point for training sessions, issuing confirmations and/or offering alternative dates. Supplement delegates with correct pre-work and sessions

Administration and organization
Enjoys problem solving
Able to prioritize effectively
Strong project coordination skills
Comfortable using IT systems
Interpersonal skills
Excellent written and oral communication skills
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others
Must be able to work virtually, and independently

Comfortable working on several activities concurrently
Able to work in a rapidly changing environment and prioritize accordingly
Key attributes
Professional and diplomatic communicator
Quality focused and takes pride in paying attention to detail
Self-starter, who can manage with minimal direction
Able to interact with senior management
Extremely organized and enjoys administration
Able to work in a team arrangement
Demonstrated experience
Demonstrated experience in MS Office (Word, Excel & PowerPoint) and fair knowledge of MS Outlook
Qualifications
To qualify for the role, you must have Any graduate or Postgraduate
Ideally, you'll also have
1 to 4 Years
At least a year of experience working in a team environment handling virtual secretarial services is preferred
Good command over English (written & spoken) is mandatory

Description:
EYP Staff EYP Financial Restructuring Job Description
Support financial restructuring and turnaround advisory business development activities under the guidance of senior team members. Assist with proposal development support including:
Financial analysis of companies - reviews of historical and forecast performance, profitability, cash flows, working capital and capital structure
Support the team in understanding clients businesses, key financial trends, profitdrivers and potential areas of risk or improvement
Conduct desktop market and industry research, gather relevant data and summarize findings into meaningful insights
Assist with benchmarking analyses, including capital and debt mix, working capital levers, revenue trends and product performance
Prepare clear and well-structured Excel analysis, PowerPoint presentations and supporting reports for business development requirements.
Assist in preparing materials for client discussions, internal reviews and pursuit meetings.
Document the analysis and procedures performed, ensuring that work products are accurate, organized and aligned with project objectives.
Coordinate with team members across different service lines and locations to support data collection and timely project delivery.
Contribute ideas, ask relevant questions and work collaboratively with colleagues in a multicultural and multidisciplinary environment.
Demonstrate attention to detail, adaptability and a willingness to learn while managing assigned responsibilities and deadlines.
This internship provides hands-on exposure to financial restructuring, turnaround, capital advisory and transaction-related projects, supported by structured learning and coaching.
Candidate Profile
Ideal for candidates looking to start their career in finance
Strong academic foundation in finance, accounting and financial statement analysis.
Basic understanding of corporate finance concepts such as cash flow, working capital, debt, capital structure and business performance.
Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and draw logical conclusions.
Good desktop research skills and the ability to identify, organize and summarize relevant market and company information.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with an interest in developing financial analysis and presentation skills.
Knowledge of how to leverage AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot in a business setting would be an added advantage.
Ability to communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate, well-structured work.
Proactive, curious and willing to learn new concepts, industries and analytical approaches.
Able to work effectively both independently on assigned tasks and collaboratively as part of a project team.
Comfortable working across multiple tasks and adapting to changing project requirements and deadlines.
Prior internship, academic project or coursework in corporate finance, banking, restructuring, transactions or consulting would be an advantage but is not mandatory.
Familiarity with the MENA business environment, banking products or Islamic Finance would be an added advantage.
Fluency in English is required, while knowledge of Arabic would be an added advantage.

Business unit specific description Clients & Industries GDS Europe West

Power BI/Other BI tools/ Alteryx - Data Integration and Data Visualization etc.

Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 3 - 6 years work experience in professional services industry.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

A strong work ethic, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy and timeliness are essential to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Experience doing secondary research using Google and other external sources like Factiva, Company Inforgator, BoardEx, OneSource etc
Content management Familiar with maintenance of SharePoint, preparation of newsletters, managing surveys etc.
Private Equity/Investment Banking Industry experience preferable but not essential.

Description:
Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.


EY- Assurance Senior
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.


The opportunity
We're looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.


Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.


Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.


To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.


Ideally, you'll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.


What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Description:
Assistant Manager - Ad Sales (GCS)
We are looking for a high-energy, execution-focused Key Account Manager to join the GCS (Growth Customer Sales) team at JioStar. This role is built for someone who understands the digital advertising ecosystem deeply and enjoys managing day-to-day client relationships, driving incremental revenue, and ensuring seamless campaign delivery across a fast-moving portfolio. This role demands a sharp focus on performance-led, digital-first advertising solutions for growth advertisers.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and grow revenue from a defined portfolio of GCS accounts across digital advertising solutions.
- Act as the primary point of contact for clients, agencies, and internal stakeholders
- Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities aligned to client objectives and campaign outcomes.
- Own pipeline hygiene, forecasts, and internal tracking; flag risks and gaps proactively
- Work closely with campaign execution, product, analytics, and finance teams to ensure smooth delivery and client satisfaction.
- Track trends across the Indian digital advertising ecosystem, including formats, platforms, and performance benchmarks.
- Support campaign planning, proposals, and post-campaign reviews with actionable insights

Skills Attributes for Success
- Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem - media planning, buying, performance metrics, and client KPIs
- Solid relationship management and client-handling skills
- Commercial mindset with attention to detail and follow-through
- Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-volume sales environment
- Clear communicator with strong coordination and stakeholder management abilities

Preferred Experience
- 4-8 years of experience in digital ad sales, media sales, or performance advertising
- Experience managing multiple accounts and delivering against revenue targets
- Familiarity with ad tech platforms, reporting tools, and campaign optimisation frameworks is a plus.

Description:
Job Summary
The Regional Contracts & Supplier Governance Assistant Manager serves as a key enabler of effective contract management, supplier governance, and procurement compliance across the UK&I business. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end contract lifecycle, supporting supplier onboarding and governance activities, and ensuring adherence to contractual, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
Acting as a central point of coordination between business stakeholders, Procurement, Risk, Finance, and suppliers, the Assistant Manager drives operational excellence through robust governance, process optimization, reporting, and continuous improvement. The role ensures that third-party engagements are managed efficiently, risks are mitigated, and supplier relationships deliver sustainable value and strategic business outcomes.
Your key responsibilities
Manage contract and supplier governance mailboxes, providing guidance and coordinating contract requests through to execution.
Draft, review, negotiate, and administer supplier contracts while ensuring compliance with procurement and governance requirements.
Oversee contract execution processes, including approvals, DocuSign workflows, and maintenance of executed agreements.
Maintain contract repositories, lifecycle trackers, renewals, and audit-ready documentation.
Support supplier onboarding, vendor enablement, and supplier due diligence activities.
Manage supplier governance programs, MSA renewals, performance reviews, and compliance obligations.
Ensure adherence to risk, compliance, and third-party governance frameworks, escalating issues where required.
Support procurement and sourcing activities, including supplier evaluations and governance approvals.
Prepare management reports, dashboards, and analytics on contracts, suppliers, compliance, and performance metrics.
Coordinate audit reviews, remediation activities, invoice governance, and payment-related issue resolution.
Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, stakeholder training, and continuous enhancement of contract management practices.
Ariba supply chain management life cycle
Skills and attributes for success
Demonstrates expertise in leveraging advanced analytics platforms and visualization tools (such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, or similar) to transform raw data into actionable insights.
Skilled in designing interactive dashboards, reports, and visual narratives that enable stakeholders to quickly interpret trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
Presentation and facilitation skills - Ability to drive meetings, build presentations that interpret the data, creating valuable business insights and delivering the message to the stakeholders
Work under minimal direction/supervision - Be accountable for projects assigned, take complete ownership and drive projects end to end
Business acumen and Adaptability Capable of quickly understanding the needs of the business and be able to align with changing customer expectations
Quick learner - Ability to grasp or quickly understand the process, objectives / intricacies of projects and move to delivery mode in a short span
Attention to detail - Utmost importance to numbers, formatting etc.
Excellent Communication - Listening, reading, writing & speaking skills
MS Office skills: Advanced level experience in Excel reporting & PowerPoint.
Power BI/Other BI tools/ Alteryx - Data Integration and Data Visualization etc.
High degree of professionalism and integrity
To qualify for the role, you must have
Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 6 - 8 years work experience in professional services industry.
Strong understanding of data analytics, best practices when developing solutions and experience in solution development, specifically utilizing Microsoft Power Platform.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ideally, youll also have
The role demands expertise in Power BI and related Microsoft Power Platform tools, including PowerApps and Power Automate, to design, develop, and maintain robust data solutions. A strong work ethic, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy and timeliness are essential to ensure high-quality deliverables.
What we look for
Self-motivated towards continuous learning and upskilling.
Solution oriented - Ability to focus on solutions in case of ambiguity /uncertainties and not stuck with the problem.
Display a positive attitude, interest in learning new things, capability to work under pressure and thinking out of the box with strategic mindset.
Content management Familiar with maintenance of SharePoint, MS office (Excel and PowerPoint proficiency is a must)

Description:
Job Summary
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence.
A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value.
Your key responsibilities
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations.
The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing.
Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation.
Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting.
Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including:
Workflow execution metrics
OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends
Drift detection signals
ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation
Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including:
Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
Virtualization platforms Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware
Kubernetes cluster concepts pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization
Network fundamentals VLANs, DNS, IP management
Storage and compute provisioning concepts
Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources.
Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting.
Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources.
Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources.
Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks:
Python (pandas, NumPy, requests)
PowerShell
Bash
Strong written and verbal communication skills able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences.
Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones.
To qualify for the role, you must have experience with
Power BI report and dashboard development 57 years.
Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations 57 years.
ELK stack data analysis Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development 35 years.
SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores 57 years.
KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services.
Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent).
Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data metrics, logs, workflow events and traces.
Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms.
Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis.
Workflow orchestration data analysis Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics.
OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting.
Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis.
Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data.
Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI).
Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation 35 years.
PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection.
Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery.
Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred).
Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred).
Ideally, you'll also have
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired).
Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have).
ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have).
Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms.
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data.
Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs.

Description:
Job Summary
To work with the Sales team to support part of the business of the respective cluster. The incumbent will act as a key link between Programming/Content team and Sales teams and drive the brand philosophy and sales/revenue strategy for the channel to maximize revenue. This will be done through effective forecasting, planning, pricing and property integrations based on deep understanding of customer needs and patterns.
The incumbent will play a critical role in developing a comprehensive roadmap and vision for our business, studying industry-specific trends, and creating compelling narratives to drive monetization growth. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical and communication skills, as well as the ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics.
Key Responsibilities
- Creating revenue business plan across portfolio, defining the pricing strategy along with the Channel PRS Head for the channel/cluster basis organization objectives, budget for the year, market scenario, competition, etc. in order to ensure the sales organization achieves overall revenue target.
- Driving the channel pricing agenda - setting benchmarks, providing inputs and sign-offs on deals, and participating in deal negotiations as and when required
- Build client wise strategy/ deal structuring for the channel which includes creating and recommending client pricing options for individual client deals, building monthly client packages including decisions on what time bands to allocate to each client based on what works for their target segments and track deviations in delivery
- Build sponsor packages for impact shows and ensure maximum monetization for each property on the channel
- Build band wise revenue budget, show and property wise pricing including determination of sponsor packages
- Create and maintain strategies based on key genres to help understand the genre behavior, trends, movements etc. that may have impact on business.
- Building bottom-up revenue plans for the fiscal, quarter month
- Tracking performance vs. annual plan, revising forecasts etc.
- Developing insights into the genre channel deliveries to develop customized pitches for clients
- Creating implementing trade marketing agenda for the channel - Mailers, On Air promos, Trade events etc.
- Define a measurement process to ensure that client and agency are aligned on key performance metrics, establishing realistic business goals, and providing frontline support through reporting and analytics
- Impact landscape sizing of a particular genre - understand the kind of impact properties across channels, changes and evolutions compared to the previous year and deeper understanding of the advertisers who buy impact
- Engage with sales teams for ensuring revenue rationalization by forecasting projections/trends for a healthy business and designing attractive packages for the sales team to take to the market, conducting roadshows. Prepare the sales team so they can handle queries from clients and media planners/buyers with confidence.
- Supporting ad sales team with operational tasks on rate cards, internal deal approvals, client sales proposals etc.
- Liaise with the Programming teams and build a thorough understanding of the channel objectives and performance in order to identify monetization opportunities, as also provide market / sales feedback in relation to channel properties
- Work collaboratively across Sales and Ops to ensure seamless delivery on deals from a client perspective, as well as inventory optimization and revenue maximization from a business perspective
- Helps building client dockets to understand the advertising patterns for key advertisers versus competition genre wise, channel wise, brand wise, market wise and make recommendations basis the same to improve the efficiency of clients buys
Skills Attributes for success
Business Acumen
- Strategic planning
- Influencing Skills
- Result Orientation
- Negotiation Skills
- Analytical thinking
- Strategic planning
- Leadership
Preferred Education Experience
Minimum Qualification: MBA
- 5+ years of post-qualification experience
- Business consulting/ strategy background preferred

Role & responsibilities
Self Operated Business (SOB) About OYO OYO is a global platform that aims to empower entrepreneurs and small businesses with hotels and homes by providing full-stack technology products and services that aims to increase revenue and ease operations; bringing easy-to-book, affordable, and trusted accommodation to customers around the world. OYO offers 40+ integrated products and solutions to patrons who operate over 157K hotel and home storefronts in more than 35 countries including India, Europe, and SEA. OYO operates a unique business model that helps its patrons transform fragmented, unbranded and underutilized hospitality assets into branded, digitally-enabled storefronts with higher revenue generation potential and provides its customers with access to a broad range of high-quality storefronts at compelling price points. Website Link https://www.oyorooms.com/ Location Multiple Role Type Field Role (involves daily travel), Mon-Sat What will you be doing • Responsible for identifying suitable commercial properties for opening new hotels in assigned geography, negotiating commercials, scope of work & finalizing acquisition deals • Building join business plans with key partners like property developers, landlords, project consultants, property brokers in order to have a profitable business association for OYO & its stakeholders • Liaising for legal due diligence and paperwork involved in signing & acquiring SOB portfolio • Coordinating with various department internally during the property onboarding process to ensure end-to-end closure on each property launch on ground • Evaluate operator performance & inventory management to generate contribution margin from SOB portfolio and action as needed • Develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of growth opportunities, both organic growth and acquisitions through strong relationships with owners & operators Key Performance Indicators • Number of Sellable Rooms signed / made live month on month • Contribution margin derived from the properties signed Required Skills • Excellent negotiation skills, especially on large portfolio deals • Superior analytical, evaluative, and problemsolving abilities • Strong networking ability • Proof reading of legal contracts Who are we looking for • At least 3 years of experience in franchise development, preferably in QSR / hospitality industry • Experience of managing entire life-cycle of B2B clients from onboarding to business metrics

Job Summary
Relationship Associate plays a pivotal role in driving business growth by managing branch relationships and collaborating with Axis Bank sellers. The role involves lead conversion, ensuring process adherence, and supporting operational excellence. The incumbent will be responsible for meeting business targets and maintaining customer satisfaction. This position requires consistent coordination with stakeholders and adherence to company guidelines. Manages branches, collaborates with the objective to support and contribute to Axis bank strategy, achieve operations excellence, ensure systems are deployed and help build the channel within the company guidelines and the achieve business targets.


Responsibilities
Managing relationship with Axis Branch Sellers and thereby meeting target through Bank s FOS
Responsible for managing the leads generated from Branch and thereby convert into quality business.
Must adhere to the process set and timely coordinate with Cluster Manager and Operations HUB. Ensuring minimal customer complain.
Shall adhere to agree TATs on first customer contact and follow-ups from the date of the lead being registered.
Ensuring 15month persistency on track and thereby ensure a robust follow up mechanism with the customers.
Coordinating with Cluster Training manager to ensure bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.
Shall be responsible for making active the branch banking sellers and thereby achieving the activation target
Ensuring LMS usage as Tracking Mechanism on line and follow up Calls


Key Competencies / Skills
Excellent Relationship Skill
Managing various levels of bank management
Adherence to Process


Qualifications and Experience
Graduate in Any Discipline from a UGC / AICTE approved College and University.
1 to 2 years of experience in sales, experience in Insurance will be preferred.
Experience in the fields of Life insurance sales management, Retail bank distribution, and Channel Management and/or DSA relationship

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY - FB and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side. Our FB Service Experts is skilled in a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests experience is well taken care of from start to finish.

Whether setting tables and event materials communicating with the kitchen, interacting, and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the FB Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintece needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.

Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Oracle Fusion Program / Project Manager - Manager
(Oracle Fusion Implementation, OUM, Agile Program Governance)
Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Program / Project Manager at Manager level with proven, hands-on experience leading end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation projects across ERP, SCM, HCM, EPM, or related workstreams. The ideal candidate will be well versed in Oracle Unified Method (OUM), Application Implementation Methodology (AIM), Testing and Change Management (TCM), Agile and hybrid delivery models, and the complete project lifecycle. The role requires strong ownership of program governance, integrated planning, financial and resource management, RAID and dependency management, executive status reporting, and client discussions from mobilization through go-live and Hypercare.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
Lead end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation programs from mobilisation, discovery, design, configuration, build, testing, deployment, go-live, Hypercare, and transition to support.
Create and manage integrated program plans covering scope, milestones, workstreams, critical paths, dependencies, resources, budgets, environments, deliverables, and release schedules.
Apply and tailor OUM, AIM, TCM, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches based on project complexity, contractual commitments, and client governance requirements.
Establish program governance, decision rights, escalation paths, stage gates, quality controls, meeting cadence, and reporting standards across functional and technical workstreams.
Own RAID management by identifying, assessing, assigning, tracking, mitigating, escalating, and closing risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies with clear owners and due dates.
Prepare and present weekly and monthly status reports, executive dashboards, steering committee packs, milestone health, effort and budget variance, resource outlook, decision logs, and recovery plans.
Lead client workshops, governance meetings, scope and design discussions, status reviews, risk escalations, steering committees, and executive communications, driving timely decisions and stakeholder alignment.
Manage scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, change requests, contracts, and deliverable acceptance while protecting project outcomes and commercial commitments.
Coordinate solution design, configuration, integrations, data migration, reporting, security, testing, change management, training, cutover, and business readiness across all workstreams.
Drive fit-to-standard adoption, design governance, traceability, deliverable quality, defect closure, cutover rehearsals, go-live criteria, and production stabilisation.
Prepare, baseline, maintain, and control Microsoft Project Plan (MPP) schedules, including work breakdown structures, task dependencies, milestones, critical paths, resource assignments, progress updates, schedule variance, forecasting, and management reporting.
Manage system integrators, Oracle, third-party vendors, internal teams, and client stakeholders, ensuring accountability for scope, timelines, service levels, and quality.
Job Requirements:
Minimum 10 years of overall experience, including at least 5 years in project or program management and proven hands-on leadership of multiple end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations.
Strong delivery experience across one or more Oracle Fusion domains such as ERP, SCM, HCM, EPM, Procurement, Projects, or cross-pillar transformation programs.
Thorough knowledge of OUM, AIM, TCM, Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid project lifecycles.
Demonstrated experience establishing governance, PMO controls, steering committees, stage gates, design authority, change control, delivery cadence, and quality assurance.
Strong command of scope, schedule, budget, effort, forecasting, resource capacity, dependency, critical-path, milestone, and benefits tracking.
Hands-on expertise in RAID logs, issue resolution, risk mitigation, decision logs, assumptions, actions, change requests, recovery plans, and executive escalation management.
Experience managing requirements, design, Conference Room Pilots, configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, defect management, security, training, cutover, go-live, Hypercare, and support transition.
Mandatory real hands-on expertise in Microsoft Project and MPP files, including creating and managing detailed schedules, baselines, dependencies, critical paths, milestones, resources, actuals, remaining work, slippage, variance, and forecasts.
Ability to generate schedule, milestone, resource, cost, and executive status reports directly from MPP and explain schedule health, delays, impacts, and recovery actions to senior stakeholders.
Strong client-facing experience, including leading difficult discussions, negotiating priorities, managing expectations, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving decisions and closure.
Experience managing distributed teams, system integrators, vendors, subcontractors, and business stakeholders across locations and time zones.
PMP, PRINCE2, PgMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, or equivalent project/program management certification is preferred.
Competencies / Skills:
Strong leadership, ownership, commercial awareness, and delivery discipline, with the ability to maintain control in complex and high-pressure programs.
Excellent client communication, facilitation, negotiation, conflict resolution, presentation, and executive stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to translate strategic objectives into executable plans, measurable milestones, clear accountability, and outcome-focused governance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with sound judgement in prioritisation, decisions, risk response, and program recovery.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams while maintaining quality, schedule, budget, compliance, and stakeholder confidence.
Must have a valid passport.
Willing to work in MENA shift timings, Sunday to Thursday.
Willing to work at client sites and undertake business travel as required.
Education:
B.Tech, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. An MBA is preferred. Relevant Oracle Fusion Cloud and project/program management certifications are advantageous.

Description:
Job Summary
Function SummaryCluster Manager - Bancassurance role manages a large cluster to drive Axis Banks business targets. It involves relationship management with Circle and Branch Heads, performance tracking, and mentoring. The role ensures product training, branch activation, and persistency. It drives revenue through contests and recognition platforms. Prior insurance experience with leadership and process management skills is essential.
Job SummaryManages a large cluster, collaborates with the objective to support and contribute to Axis bank strategy, achieve operations excellence, ensure systems are deployed and help build the channel WITHIN the company guidelines and the achieve business targets.


Key Responsibilities
Relationship Management with the Axis Circle Head, Circle Business Managers, Segment Heads and Branch Heads.
With the advent of cluster formation relationship management with the Branch Heads in order to achieve business targets and builds a progressive partnership with the bank.
Provide inputs to the CRM and make plans for achievement in order to support and contribute to Axis Bank Strategy.
Periodic Analysis of the performance, Counsel and Mentor performance, Conduct Fortnightly PRPs with the RA and ASMs and Facilitate performance management.
Co-create and implement recognition platforms in order to build a capable and motivated team in the AXIS Bank resources.
Liaise with training team and circle trainer, ensuring product training departed to all sellers including Axis Bank resources.
Daily updates in alignment with Axis Clusters of focused business Parameters-Business Plan, Branch Seller Activation and persistency and thereby tracking the performance in all the vectors.
Ensuring Branch visits to the top branches, whose ge achievement on budget is lower than the smaller branches, and come out with the strategy.
Deploy the BOLD system to own team and ensure that the system requirements are met in order to ensure that the relationship is productive and mutually beneficial and compliant with all regulatory requirements.
Deploy and monitor the implementation specifically Bank staff contests/RR in order to accelerate revenue generation with the Channel.


Key Competencies/ Skills
Relationship
Leading people
Effective Management of Process


Qualifications
Master of Business Administration or equivalent.
3 to 5 years of experience in intensive Distribution, Channel Management. Prior experience in insurance essential.
Result Orientation, Customer Centricity, Technical Expertise, Managerial Expertise, Problem Solving, Role Modeling Core Values.

Description:
Dear Candidate,

Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Sr. Associate Operations.

About the role:
Own the end-to-end order journey for steel and bitumen raw material orders, from order verification to delivery and proof of delivery. You will be the face of Tata nexarc Operations for customers.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage the full supply chain lifecycle of assigned orders: order verification, documentation checks and seller dispatch coordination.
Monitor deliveries, collect Proof of Delivery (POD), and ensure quality and compliance requirements are met.
Track payments and customer credit limits as per SOPs and payment terms.
Maintain OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery performance of 85% or higher, and escalate exceptions early.
Validate documents: customer and seller POs, proforma and tax invoices, e-way bills, Mill Test Certificates (MTC) and delivery proofs.
Coordinate with transporters, fleet owners and drivers, and visit seller locations and transporter hubs when needed.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Graduate or postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics or Engineering.
2–6 years in operations, supply chain, logistics or customer operations; steel experience preferred, bitumen or commodity exposure a plus.
Working knowledge of ERP, CRM and AI-enabled productivity tools.
Strong English and Hindi communication, stakeholder management, attention to detail and a bias for action.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include a hybrid work model, need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.


Skills: Order Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, OTIF, E-way Bill, MTC, Steel, Bitumen, ERP, Stakeholder Management .

If this sounds like you, apply now and be part of the Tata nexarc journey.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Conduct investigations and gather evidence related to theft/fraud or lost items, noise complaints, assault complaints, food poisoning complaints, and other guest complaints and incidents. Conduct interviews with relevant parties in order to obtain statements and information related to incidents. Assist with and notify manager/supervisor, local police, or other appropriate individuals in the event of accidents, attacks, or other incidents. Complete incident reports to document all Security/Loss Prevention related incidents such as theft, accidents, physical hazards, and fire alarms. Handle business interruptions and complaints, such as suspicious individuals, civil disturbances or demonstrations, noise complaints, intoxicated individuals, etc. Escort any unwelcome persons from the property without interrupting the orderly flow of property operation. Defuse guest or employee disturbances/altercations, including summoning appropriate authorities if necessary, and documenting incident.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manage. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. In addition, some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements to be considered for this position. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Move at a speed required to respond to work situations (e.g., run, walk, jog). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

AboutCompany:
Jindal Power Limited (JPL) is a leading Indian power company with a diverse energy portfolio encompassing thermal and renewable sources. With an impressive installed capacity of 4300 MW, JPL has been instrumental in meeting the nation's growing power demands. Pioneering the establishment of an Independent Power Plant (IPP) in 2007 with its 4x250 MW thermal power unit in Chhattisgarh's Raigarh district, JPL has continued its expansion in Tamnar with a 2400 MW (4X600 MW) thermal power plant.

JPL energy portfolio includes 3400 MW at Tamnar, Chhattisgarh and 600 MW at Simhapuri Andhra Pradesh & 300 MW at Shirpur, Maharashtra. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies and best practices, JPL has set new standards in India's power sector.
The company's vision is to emerge as a significant player in the industry, contributing to the nation's development. Committed to renewable energy sources, JPL aims to substantially increase the share of power generated through sustainable means. As the 5th largest integrated power producer in India, based on million units of generation, and with three captive mines, JPL stands as a key player in the sector. The company envisions establishing benchmarks in renewable energy, carbon emissions, and environmental protection. Furthermore, JPL is a trailblazer in community development and welfare initiatives.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.


Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

Description:
Purpose of the role

The face of the D2C platform in the physical market. Visit mechanics, roadside garages, small workshops, and truck operators in an assigned territory. Demonstrate the platform, register new buyers, facilitate the first purchase, and ensure the buyer can use the app independently. This role converts an unorganized market buyer into a digital platform user.

Key Responsibility
Cover assigned pin codes daily visit mechanics, garages, and small fleet operators to introduce the D2C platform
Register new buyers on the platform (app install + profile creation) target 15+ new registrations per day
Demonstrate app search (by vehicle model and part name), part selection, payment, and delivery tracking
Facilitate the buyer's first online spare parts purchase stay with them through the transaction
Follow up within 7 days of first purchase to ensure delivery satisfaction and resolve any issues
Capture buyer feedback on platform gaps: parts not found, confusing UX, delivery complaints report weekly
Maintain a daily activity log: shops visited, registrations done, first purchases facilitated
Attend weekly territory review with Category Manager / Lead BD
Participate in platform training sessions when new features or categories are launched

Qualification & Experience

13 years in field sales, FMCG distribution, insurance agency, or fintech outreach roles
Knowledge of commercial vehicles or spare parts market strongly preferred
Smartphone proficiency; able to demonstrate app fluently in local language
High energy and comfort with ground-level market work workshops, roadside interactions
Local language fluency essential; Hindi and regional language preferred
Diploma Holder from Mechanical Background

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Accountable for the quality, consistency and production of the restaurant kitchen. Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions. Coordinates menus, purchasing, staffing and food preparation for the propertys restaurant. Works with team to improve guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget. Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved. Develops and trains team to improve results.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met for Restaurant
- Develops, designs, or creates new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions for restaurant.
- Supervises restaurant kitchen shift operations and ensures compliance with all Food Beverage policies, standards and procedures.
- Maintains food preparation handling and correct storage standards.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Plans and manages food quantities and plating requirements for the restaurant.
- Communications production needs to key personnel.
- Assists in developing daily and seasonal menu items for the restaurant.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations regulations.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Estimates daily restaurant production needs.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
Leading Kitchen Team
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Leads shift teams while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Supervises and manages restaurant kitchen employees. Managing all day-to-day operations. Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensuring and maintaining the productivity level of employees.
- Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Establishing and Maintaining Restaurant Kitchen Goals
- Sets and supports achievement of kitchen goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
- Developing specific guidance and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish daily kitchen operations work.
- Understands the impact of kitchen operation on the overall property financial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Effectively investigates, reports and follows-up on employee accidents.
- Knows and implements company safety standards.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Participates in training restaurant staff on menu items including ingredients, preparation methods and unique tastes.
- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with appropriate skills.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Job Summary
Position: Project Coordinator - Project SAMBAL
Location: Bhatapara, Chattisgarh
Reporting To: State Programme Manager (in State) Senior Programme Manager - Livelihoods (Head Office)
Project Duration: As per project period (annual contract, renewable based on performance and availability of funds)
This role supports and coordinates field-level implementation of the project by mobilising rural elderly, strengthening Elder Self-Help Groups (eSHGs), promoting financial inclusion and livelihoods, and facilitating access to government entitlements. The role also includes monitoring project progress, maintaining records, and reporting outcomes to the Head Office.


Key Responsibilities
Manage day-to-day implementation of project activities at the field/project level.
Mobilise rural elderly and facilitate the formation and strengthening of Elder Self-Help Groups (eSHGs).
Supervise regular group meetings, savings, internal lending and maintenance of group records with support of mobiliser/ESHG leaders.
Support livelihood activities, financial literacy and access to government entitlements and social security schemes.
Coordinate with local government functionaries, banks and other stakeholders for project activities and service linkages.
Undertake regular field visits and provide support to ESHGs and community members.
Maintain project records, update MIS and submit periodic progress reports to the Head Office.


Requirements
Graduate in any discipline, preferably in Social Sciences or related fields.
2-3 years of relevant experience in rural development, community mobilisation, SHG promotion or livelihood programmes.
Preference will be given to candidates having experience in SHG formation, management and working with community-based institutions.
Basic understanding of rural livelihoods, financial inclusion and government welfare schemes.
Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with rural communities.
Basic computer knowledge, particularly MS Office and data entry.
Willingness to undertake regular field visits and proficiency in the local language.

Description:
SUMMARY
Job Description
Title : Field Sales Executive
Location: Raipur - (Bhatapara, korba and Raigarh)
Job Type: Contract (For more than 1 year)
Industry : Paint - Chemical
Summary :
This field sales role is pivotal in driving business growth by building strong relationships with key stakeholders such as painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. The ideal candidate will be responsible for consistently achieving and surpassing sales targets through proactive customer engagement, daily site visits, and active presence at assigned retail locations. By organizing regular shop meetings, maintaining accurate sales records, and leveraging a strong understanding of the market, the sales representative will play a critical role in expanding market reach and enhancing brand visibility. The position requires a self-driven, results-oriented professional with a proven ability to thrive in a dynamic, customer-focused environment.
Responsibilities :
Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales targets.
Develop and nurture long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key customers.
Conduct a minimum of two site visits per day to identify and pursue new business opportunities.
Spend at least two hours daily at the assigned store to engage customers and support sales activities.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to drive product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports via the online portal.


Requirements
Requirements :

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers.

Test foods to determine if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintece needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language.

Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Job Summary
Function Summary IRDA Regulation on IMF was released, where companies which are LLP / Pvt limited / cooperative societies were allowed to distribute financial products. IMFs are allowed to deal in Insurance of 6 companies (2LI, 2GI, 2HI), mutual funds, banking products, post etc. Max life spotted this opportunity to attract established financial distributors from the market to engage and distribute max life products - PEARL ACQUISITION. A dedicated team of 50 CDMs were recruited in two phases and trained to hire farm these relationships. Currently we have 95 licensed IMFs on board and expected to touch 150 which are work in progress. The pool of IMF s primarily comprises of top Agents in Insurance, Wealth Managers, Loan DSA, CA, Ex - employees from financial services with an existing customer base customer base. Present IMF carries avg. 2500 customers and big turnover book. As a later part of Pearl acquisition strategy, Insurance Managers is a career option provided to establish financial distributors who are not able to meet the requirements of forming an IMF. This has also proven to be an exciting opportunity. Insurance Manager is part time employee model which provides a platform to the pearl to associate with MLI and improve their earnings, flexible working hours and better choices to their customers. IM will be different from an ADM/APC as he will not be recruiting and mentoring Agents and will only source business by penetrating into his existing client base. Avg book size with them is also 750 customers.


Key Responsibilities
Understand the IM acquisition and IMF regulation, value proposition registration process
Acquisition of 6 - 7 IMs in a year independently.
Independently managing a pool of Insurance Managers mapped to them from existing pool in the beginning only.
Post successful completion of 1 year, the next level is CDM wherein the focus will be on IMF journey
Manage performance of IMs
Develop understanding of products coach IM staff on product USP s
Implement performance management and rewards system in IMs
Provide marketing, training and operational support to IMs
Manage attrition of IMs through revival or replacement
Drive quality of business sourced from IMs
Ensure right product mix and control key quality measures such as leakage and persistency.


Measures of Success
Minimum 6-8 IM Acquisition in a year
Achieving sales target through team of IMs
IM Activity Retention
Quality of Business
Create pipeline for IMF s


Qualifications and Experience
Educational Background: Minimum a graduate
Work Experience: At least 1-3 years of experience in recruiting business partners / Agents and achieving sales target through them.
Good communication skill.


Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
Excellent Written, presentation communication skills
Exceptional consultative interpersonal skills
Stakeholder management
Influencing without authority
Full understanding / experience of handling entire life cycle of a deal from initiation to successful completion
