Title: Assistant General Manager - Lead Tooling R&D
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, ToolingsTeam Handling, Tool DesignTool DevelopmentTool ManufacturingTool EngineeringTooling OperationstoolTeam LeadershipTeam Leading, About company
Description:
Role Purpose
Lead development, industrialization, maintenance, and lifecycle management of production tools, molds, dies, jigs, fixtures, and gauges. Ensure tooling readiness, reliability, quality, productivity, cost competitiveness, and minimum production downtime at the Gagret plant.

Key Responsibilities
Own tooling strategy and execution for NPI, capacity expansion, localization, and continuous improvement.
Lead design, development, trials, validation, and production release of injection molds, press/progressive tools, sheet-metal tools, jigs, fixtures, gauges, and assembly/welding/testing fixtures.
Apply DFM/DFA, GD&T, DFMEA/PFMEA, APQP, PPAP, MSA, and SPC during tooling development and industrialization.
Establish preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance covering tool-life monitoring, refurbishment, calibration, critical spares, and replacement planning.
Reduce defects, breakdowns, changeover time, and tooling-related downtime using RCA, TPM, Lean, and Kaizen.
Coordinate with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Industrial Engineering, Purchase, and Supply Chain for pilot builds, ramp-up, and stable production.
Develop toolmakers and machining/fixture vendors; manage RFQs, technical evaluation, trials, acceptance, cost, delivery, and localization.
Lead tooling engineers, designers, tool-room technicians, and external partners with safety, quality, delivery, and cost accountability.

Candidate Requirements

B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, or Tool Engineering. PG Diploma/M.Tech in Tool Design or Manufacturing preferred.
12-18 years in tooling design/development, industrialization, and high-volume plant support.
At least 8 years leading tooling/tool-room teams and cross-functional projects.
Exposure in Injection molds, press/progressive tools, sheet-metal tooling, jigs, fixtures, gauges, assembly/welding fixtures, and tool validation.
Desirable hands-on responsibility for preventive/predictive maintenance, refurbishment, spares planning, tool-life improvement, and downtime reduction.
Exposure in Battery, inverter/UPS, energy storage, automotive components, electrical/electronics, or comparable high-volume manufacturing.
GD&T, DFM/DFA, PFMEA, APQP/PPAP, MSA/SPC, RCA, Lean, TPM, and vendor development.
Working knowledge of SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, NX, or AutoCAD.
AboutCompany:
Luminous Power Technologies is a leading player in energy solutions, committed to driving Indias clean energy transition with a sharp focus on innovation and sustainability. With a legacy spanning over 38 Years, Luminous has built a robust presence in the energy and residential solar space. Its wide portfolio of innovative products, including inverters, batteries, and best-in-class solar solutions that is designed to provide the end-to-end energy management ecosystem with reliability, safety, and efficiency.
As the demand for reliable, clean, and efficient power growsespecially among home consumers, as a consumer energy fulfillment company, Luminous fulfils the evolving energy needs of millions of households and businesses across the world. The company operates seven state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, supported by an expansive network of over 28 sales offices and 100,000 channel partners across India. Today, Luminous powers over 100 million Indian homes and is expanding its reach globally, with a presence in more than 40 international markets.
Research and development, and continuous innovation, drive Luminous to constantly enhance the efficiency and lifespan of products, the convenience of consumers, and to stay ahead of technological trends. As an emerging Prosumer technology brand, the companys vision goes beyond just providing power; it's about empowering consumers. Through their flagship Connect-X app and integrated technologies, consumers get real-time insights and complete transparency over their energy ecosystems, through valuable information on energy consumption and monitoring, solar energy generation, and inverter performance.
The companys culture is a true representation of inclusion, allyship, and empowerment. Luminous remains committed to responsible business practices, demonstrated through extensive Corporate Social Responsibility programs supporting Education & Employment, Environmental conservation, and Electrification through Solar.
With a passionate team and a relentless drive to innovate, Luminous continues to set benchmarks in the energy sector. Its consistent recognition, such as five consecutive Consumer Superbrand Awards for residential power backup, underscores its trusted reputation in homes across India and beyond.
Luminous Power Technologies is more than an energy solutions company its a catalyst for a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

Description:
Roles & Responsibilities:

Checking of Daily first piece & study reports (warping, cooking, sizing, loom study etc & keeping record on daily basis.
Different audits report preparation & checking (selvage. Catch-chord, CFM, Carbon impression, hardness, tail end, pallet weight, warping tension etc.)
Audits of Preparatory, loom shed go-downs and folding.
Audits of packing cone in time of yarns coming from different supplier like VFB, Vardhman Yarns & Anant.
To preparation the yarn supplier wise warping breaks/mm, remnant % & No. Of Cone finish and share the report to concern yarn supplier on weekly basis.
Data preparation for the review reports & Yarn supplier ratings.
Indent and issue slips preparation for any required items.
Yarn & fabric trial followup & maintaining the trial records of same.
To send the defected greige sample for dyeing & take followup on daily basis also keeping the record for analysis.
To Send the Lycra greige fabric or Lycra lee to process for shrinkage potential test & maintain its record on daily basis.
Raise the In house & outsource yarn complaints to the supplier after discussed with seniors& maintaining complaints and yarn rejection records.
Regular training given to worker related to 5S,TPM.
To attend the yarn related issues comes in preparatory,Loom shed & folding.
Analysis of defects in Microscope.
Physical checking of yarn package before issuing if required
Audit of unloading Practice of Raw material
Package Hardness Testing
General warping machine audit by cross checking with SOP
Sizing process studies (Size Pick up, Solidity, Viscosity, Size Lappers, Migration, Carbon impression of size/ squeeze Roller, Hardness of size/ squeeze rollers, Cooking Process, Zone wise Tension, Beam Hardness, Size Recipe audit)
Auto Drawing Studies (Beam Dressing, Pattern checking of close shade, Dropper, Heald Wire Grading)
Loom Studies (Pre-winder checking of looms, Daily weft go-down round, Air leakage CFM, Loom Quality Round, Weft lot checking, Multi count/Mix count, Mix Lots, Weft card detail, Package Hardness of knotting/gaiting loom/Problematic looms, Cross ends, Wax Rods, Catch Cord, Fringe length, Cones without Tail end, Tail end tied or not, Piece Ticket, RCA of low efficiency loom, RCA of low RPM looms, RCA of bottom generation, Organic Quality, Red Leno in lycra, Boil off of Lycra, Crease prone Qualities, Selvedge checking,
AboutCompany: Vardhman is the largest vertically integrated textile manufacturer in India. Annually, producing 2,40,000 metric tons of yarn and 220 million metres of woven fabric, providing direct employment to over 30,000 people.
CompanyAddress: Vardhman Spinning and Geneal Mills,,,Chandigarh R, LUDHIANA, Punjab, India

Description:
Job Summary
A Center Manager in the education and EdTech industry runs the daily operations, P&L, sales targets, and academic quality of a learning center. Major platforms like upGrad Offline Learning Centres frequently hire local center leaders to manage student enrollments and staff.
Core Responsibilities
Sales & Revenue: Drive student admissions, hit monthly targets, and manage local outreach.
Operations & P&L: Oversee center budgets, daily workflows, facilities, and cost control.
Team Leadership: Hire, train, and mentor counselors, trainers, and support staff.
Student Experience: Ensure high satisfaction, resolve parent/student feedback, and track learning outcomes.
Key Requirements
Experience: 3 to 10+ years in education management, coaching, EdTech, or sales.
Education: Graduate or MBA in a relevant field.
Skills: Strong communication, team handling, local networking, and target orientation.

Description:
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking a motivated and dynamic Associate Sales Manager for our Branch Banking division. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth by managing a team of sales executives, building strong relationships with clients, and ensuring exceptional customer service. The role includes identifying new business opportunities, promoting insurance products, and achieving sales targets while maintaining compliance with company policies and industry regulations.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead and manage a team of sales executives to achieve sales objectives and targets.
- Develop and implement effective sales strategies to expand the customer base.
- Cultivate and maintain relationships with existing clients to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
- Conduct training and mentoring sessions for team members to enhance their sales skills and product knowledge.
- Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth.
- Prepare reports and presentations on sales performance for upper management.
- Collaborate with other departments to ensure smooth operations and consistency in service delivery.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong leadership and team management skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Sales-oriented mindset with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
- Ability to analyze financial data and market trends.
- Familiarity with insurance products and services.
- Proficient in using CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Strong problem-solving abilities and decision-making skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications:
- A Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
- Previous experience in sales, preferably in the insurance or financial services industry.
- Relevant certifications in insurance sales would be an added advantage.

Join Axis Max Life Insurance and be a part of a dynamic team that values excellence, innovation, and professional growth.

Description:
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking an Associate Sales Manager for our Branch Banking division. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales and achieving targets through effective management of a branch sales team. You will play a crucial role in developing and implementing sales strategies, fostering client relationships, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. - Develop and execute sales strategies to increase market share and revenue.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to ensure repeat business and referrals.
- Monitor sales performance and provide coaching and feedback to team members.
- Conduct regular market analysis to identify opportunities for growth.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
- Collaborate with other departments to enhance service delivery and customer experience.

- Proven experience in sales management, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
- Strong leadership and team management skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to analyze market trends and customer needs.
- Proficient in using CRM software and other sales management tools.
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
- Knowledge of insurance products and regulatory requirements is an advantage.
- Self-motivated with a results-driven approach.

Join Axis Max Life Insurance as an Associate Sales Manager and take your career to new heights while contributing to the success of our branch banking operations.

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Job Summary
Responsible for operation and Maintenance of HVAC System & Water System (Purified Water Generation & Distribution System, WFI Generation & Distribution system, Distribution system, Pure Steam Generation). Required document preparation, and execution of Qualification activity of water System & HVAC system.
Reporting To: Head of Engineering Department / Designee


Job Responsibilities
Responsible for operation and maintenance of HVAC & all Utilities Equipment including Pre Treatment (Softener), RO, EDI, Purified Water generation & distribution system, Pure steam generation system, WFI Generation & Distribution system and Air Handling Unit.
Responsible for communicating with user departments for area clearance and ensuring timely execution of Preventive maintenance, handling of breakdowns of different equipment's, qualification activity related to HVAC & Water system with all respective documentation.
Providing technical assistance to other engineers, technicians on HVAC & water system related issues.
Responsible for checking of Operation/Maintenance logbooks/Record related to HVAC system, Water system and other Engineering Equipment's.
Responsible for monitoring consumption of spare parts and maintaining critical inventory related to HVAC system and water system.
Ensure zero Accident / incident in factory premises.
100% Audit compliances by maintaining all cGMP documents and logbook as per respective SOPs.
Responsible to provide support in qualification activities of water system & HVAC system.
Responsible for requisition of logbooks or format issuance.
Responsible to execute all other activities assigned by HOD.

Description:
Job Summary
Ortho Max Mfg Co. Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Manager Domestic to drive sales growth across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in the medical devices or orthopaedic implant industry and will be responsible for developing business opportunities, strengthening customer relationships, and achieving regional sales targets across the assigned territories.
Responsibilities
Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve or exceed regional sales targets.
Identify new business opportunities and expand existing customer relationships across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh.
Conduct market research to stay updated on industry trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements.
Build strong relationships with key decision-makers in hospitals, clinics, trauma centres, and healthcare institutions.
Schedule product demonstrations, surgeon meetings, training sessions, and provide technical support as required.
Address customer complaints or issues promptly and professionally to ensure customer satisfaction.
Analyse market dynamics to identify potential growth opportunities within the assigned territories.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Product Development, and Operations, to align sales strategies with company objectives.
Consistently achieve and exceed assigned sales targets.
Track sales performance, prepare periodic reports, and identify areas for improvement.
Develop and implement strategies to increase market share throughout the assigned region.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory and company requirements related to sales activities.
Drive customer satisfaction and build long-term business relationships.
Manage distributor and dealer networks within the assigned territories, where applicable.
Experience & Qualifications
Bachelor s Degree in Engineering, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related field.
3 4 years of proven sales experience in the Medical Devices or Orthopaedic Implant industry (preferred).
Strong understanding of the healthcare industry, particularly Orthopaedics and Trauma Care.
Demonstrated track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
Proficiency in Hindi is essential. Knowledge of Punjabi is preferred. Familiarity with regional languages is an added advantage.
Willingness to travel extensively across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh.
Strong leadership, planning, and territory management capabilities.
Role Details

Ortho Max Manufacturing Company Pvt. Ltd. specializes in the design and production of orthopedic implants and surgical instruments. Their portfolio includes solutions for orthopedics, neurosurgery, veterinary applications, and cranio-maxillofacial procedures. The company emphasizes innovation, precision engineering, and global market outreach.

Location: Powai (Work from Office)

Avenue E-commerce Limited (AEL) is an online extension of Avenue Supermarts Limited flagship brand. Dmart Ready is the mobile application through which our customers order grocery and other utility products. We seek to be a one - stop shopping destination for the entire family, meeting all their daily household needs offering value for money. A wide selection of home utility products is offered at an affordable price, including groceries, foods, toiletries, beauty products, garment, kitchenware, bed and bath linen, home appliances and much more. Currently we are present at Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad and Bangalore locations.

Job Description: Assistant Manager MIS & Business Analytics (Finance)

Role Objective:
We are looking for a highly analytical and result-oriented professional to lead MIS reporting, financial data analysis, dashboard development, and business performance tracking. The primary responsibility will be to transform raw financial and operational data into meaningful insights that enable management to make informed business decisions.

Key Responsibilities:
1. MIS Reporting & Management Dashboards
Develop, manage, and enhance daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management.
Design interactive dashboards to track business performance, profitability, revenue, expenses, and other key performance indicators.
Consolidate data from multiple sources and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely reporting.
Develop customised reports and dashboards based on management requirements.
Automate repetitive reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.

2. Business Insights & Data Analytics
Analyse large volumes of financial and operational data to identify trends, patterns, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Develop new reports, analytical models, and performance metrics to provide deeper visibility into business performance.
Identify the reasons behind revenue fluctuations, cost increases, margin changes, and deviations from targets.

3. MIS Automation & Process Improvement
Build advanced Excel-based reports and dashboards using Pivot Tables, Power Query, advanced formulas, and data models.
Develop Power BI dashboards and automated reporting solutions wherever applicable.
Improve data collection, validation, reporting formats, and analytical processes.
Establish standardised KPI definitions and reporting practices across departments.
Ensure data integrity, confidentiality, and reliability of management information.

Description:
Level 6: GN - SC&E - PRH - Process Excellence - Senior Manager
Management Consulting Senior Manager - Industry & Workflow Advisor / Value Architect
Accenture Strategy and Consulting
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Senior Manager | Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai | Overall Relevant Exp: 10+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.


Qualification
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.
Educational Qualification
MBA or Master's degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.

Description:
Level 6: GN - SC&E - PRH - Process Excellence - Senior Manager
Management Consulting Senior Manager - Industry & Workflow Advisor / Value Architect
Accenture Strategy and Consulting
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Senior Manager | Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai | Overall Relevant Exp: 10+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.


Qualification
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.
Educational Qualification
MBA or Master's degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.

Your Role

Technical Design Development: Write clean, scalable, and high-performing ABAP code for SAP EWM objects, including enhancements, BAPIs, BADIs, user exits, and custom reports.

Job Summary:
Accenture AI is seeking a talented and motivated Generative AI Data Scientist Consultant to join our Banking team. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Generative AI models, Machine Learning, Data Analysis, and Cloud Platforms to develop innovative solutions and enhance AI capabilities. This role will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and implement generative AI solutions that meet our business needs.

Security and Compliance:Implement security best practices and ensure APIs comply with data privacy and regulatory standards.
Documentation:Create comprehensive API documentation, including usage examples, SDKs, and troubleshooting guides.

Strong problem-solving, analytical, and creative thinking skills to design and implement innovative solutions.
Excellent communication skills, capable of conveying complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.


Additional Information:
Experience with large-scale data processing and expertise in NLP or computer vision.

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native era? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.

Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.
You are:
A workstream owner. You take a defined part of an engagement end-to-end - the agent hierarchy for a process, or use-case and data-product definition for a domain - and are its day-to-day client contact.


Qualification
The work

Basic Requirements
* Assist in discovery workshops to identify business opportunities and translate them into AI use cases, business cases, and solution requirements.

* Develop functional specifications and collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to deliver implementation-ready solution designs.
* Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise data, data management, and analytics to shape AI solution design and business outcomes.
* Evaluate AI platforms, tools, and industry best practices to support solution recommendations and client engagements.
Good to Have
* Experience defining data products, enterprise data models, and AI-ready data foundations.
* Exposure to knowledge graphs, knowledge layers, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Experience developing AI capability roadmaps, AI platform assessments, and value realization plans.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and presentation skills with experience working in cross-functional teams
Tech fluency
Hands-on depth in at least one platform (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), or foundation models (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI)., plus conversant across the categories. Can weigh trade-offs (fit, cost, risk) within an engagement.

Working knowledge of one priority industry's processes and value drivers; applies it to use-case and roadmap work..

Strong communication

An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Description:
We are looking for experienced and quality-driven Quality Analysts HCC Medical Coding to join our growing team.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in HCC and ICD-10-CM coding, practical quality auditing experience, and the ability to drive coder performance through effective feedback and continuous improvement.
Eligibility & Requirements
Graduate/Postgraduate in Life Sciences or Allied Medical Sciences (BHMS, BAMS, BPT, BDS, Nursing, Pharmacy, etc.).
Certified Medical Coder with AAPC/AHIMA credentials (CPC, CCS, CCS-P, CPC-H).
Minimum 4 years of relevant medical coding experience, including hands-on quality auditing experience.

Good understanding of risk adjustment coding, HCC capture, MEAT criteria, diagnosis validation, and documentation requirements.

Analyze error trends, perform root cause analysis, and drive quality improvement initiatives.

Stay updated with ICD-10-CM guidelines and HCC model changes.
Meet defined quality, productivity, and turnaround time (TAT) targets.
Key Expectations
We are looking for QA professionals who can independently perform audits, demonstrate strong HCC and ICD-10 coding knowledge, provide effective daily error feedback, and take ownership of improving coder performance and overall quality metrics.

About the Role:
We are looking for an organized and detail-oriented Vendor Management Executive to oversee
vendor-related activities and support the sourcing process. This role involves managing documentation,
tracking deliverables, coordinating with internal teams, and ensuring smooth operational flow.

What Youll Be Owning
1. Vendor Management
Identify, evaluate, and onboard vendors for Recruitment services (India and US), US SME
sourcing, freelancer talent pools, and project-based outsourcing
Manage contract negotiations, rate finalizations, and Service Level Agreement (SLA)
definitions.
Track vendor performance, quality of submissions, and fulfillment timelines.

Coordinate closely with the US Sourcing Team to align on talent needs.

to leadership

Ensure compliance with internal policies and governance standards.

Generate periodic reports (weekly/monthly) for leadership and sourcing teams.
Monitor contract expiration dates, project progress, and resource utilization.

Ensure data integrity and timely updates in internal systems/tools.
Organize and store documents for audit readiness

Support sourcing activities by providing required data and documentation.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams for smooth process execution.
Handle vendor communication where needed

Previous experience with managing a team.
Strong experience in US sourcing and vendor ecosystems (mandatory).

Description:
Job Title: Relationship Manager - CAT - Elite
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance


As a Relationship Manager in the CAT - Elite team, you will be responsible for managing and nurturing relationships with our high-value clients, ensuring that their financial needs are met effectively. Your main focus will be on developing comprehensive financial strategies that align with clients objectives, providing personalized service, and maximizing client satisfaction. You will collaborate closely with various internal teams to deliver exceptional service and drive business growth.

Key Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain strong relationships with high-value clients, understanding their financial goals and needs.
- Provide tailored financial advice and solutions to meet client requirements, including insurance products and investment opportunities.
- Conduct regular client meetings to review portfolios, discuss market trends, and assess client satisfaction.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
- Identify new business opportunities and drive customer acquisition through referrals and networking.
- Monitor client portfolios and recommend adjustments to align with changing financial situations or goals.
- Stay updated on industry trends, product offerings, and regulatory changes to provide informed advice to clients.

Skills and Qualifications:
- Bachelors degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Proven experience in relationship management, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
- Strong understanding of insurance products, investment strategies, and financial planning.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with clients.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Proficiency in using CRM systems and MS Office Suite.
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a collaborative team.
- Initiative and proactive approach to managing client relationships and identifying opportunities.

Tools Required:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software
- Financial modeling tools
- MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
- Market analysis tools and platforms
- Communication tools (email, video conferencing, etc.)

This position offers a unique opportunity for individuals who are passionate about building strong client relationships and helping clients achieve their financial objectives while being part of a dynamic team at Axis Max Life Insurance.

Ensure solutions are designed with production deployment, scalability, resilience, security, observability, and supportability in mind.
3. Cross-functional Program Orchestration
Drive execution across multiple product, engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, operations, business, and partner teams.
Establish a common deployment plan with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and decision points.
Track cross-team dependencies and actively drive closure of blockers.
Manage deployment risks, issues, assumptions, and escalations.
Establish governance and operating cadence for large or strategically important rollout programs.
Ensure all participating teams remain aligned to the deployment objective, timelines, and production outcomes.
Facilitate executive-level reviews and decision-making where cross-functional intervention is required.
4. Deployment Readiness
Define and manage deployment readiness criteria across technology and business dimensions.
Ensure readiness of environments, infrastructure, integrations, data, security controls, observability, support processes, documentation, and operational teams.
Coordinate UAT, pilot readiness, production readiness, cutover, and go-live activities.
Identify gaps that may create operational or business risk after launch.
Establish readiness checkpoints and ensure exceptions are explicitly assessed and managed.
5. Product Rollout & Enterprise Scale
Drive successful production deployment and phased rollout of digital products and services.
Coordinate launch activities across technology and business teams.
Monitor deployment progress, adoption, operational issues, and business readiness during rollout.
Lead resolution of issues that prevent or delay deployment and scale.
Define expansion strategies for successful pilots and early deployments.
Standardize successful deployment approaches for reuse across other products, business units, and markets.
6. Business & Stakeholder Alignment
Work closely with business leaders and product teams to understand deployment objectives, constraints, and expected outcomes.
Translate business priorities into actionable deployment strategies and execution plans.
Communicate complex technical dependencies and risks in a clear business context.
Build alignment across stakeholders with potentially conflicting priorities.
Drive timely decisions on scope, sequencing, dependencies, investment, and deployment approach.
Act as a key interface between business leadership and technology execution teams.
7. Technology & Platform Readiness
Assess whether existing enterprise platforms and technology capabilities are sufficient to support large-scale deployment.
Drive reuse of enterprise capabilities such as identity, integration, data, cloud, AI, observability, security, and common platforms.
Identify platform capabilities that need to be enhanced to enable product rollout.
Promote standardization of deployment and integration approaches across digital initiatives.
Ensure new deployments do not create unnecessary technology duplication or fragmented architectures.
8. Partner & Vendor Orchestration
Work with system integrators, technology vendors, cloud providers, startups, and strategic partners involved in deployment.
Define technical and delivery boundaries between internal and external teams.
Review partner solution approaches and deployment plans.
Ensure partner dependencies and deliverables are aligned with enterprise rollout milestones.
Drive resolution of cross-partner integration and deployment issues.
9. Post-deployment Scale & Continuous Improvement
Ensure structured transition from implementation into stable business-as-usual operations.
Track deployment outcomes, adoption, operational performance, and user feedback.
Identify recurring deployment bottlenecks and opportunities for process or platform improvement.
Capture lessons learned and convert them into reusable deployment patterns.
Continuously improve the enterprise approach to digital rollout and scale.

Description:
Position : Client Manager
About Nobroker-
NoBroker is Indias FIRST and ONLY PropTech Unicorn with a disruptive tech-based, capital-efficient business model. We use technology in the real-estate space to help customers buy/sell/rent a property seamlessly by eliminating third-party(Brokers) involvement and brokerage. We assist our stakeholders in reducing 90% of transaction cost by connecting property owners and tenants, buyers and sellers directly with the help of AI-driven technology. Our mission is to make real estate transactions streamlined, convenient and brokerage-free for everyone across India.
With cumulative 1.5 crore customers, it has grown 10X in the last two years. With five rounds of funding of $361 mn, it is well funded by key US, Indian, Japanese and Korean investors like Tiger Global, General Atlantic, SAIF Partners, Moore Strategic Ventures; KTB ventures and BeeNext. It is headquartered in Bangalore with a team of 5,000+ people.
Job Description :
At NoBroker, we’re seeking a qualified sales lead to help us sell the products and services that our customers have grown to rely on. The sales lead will have a strong understanding of the sales process, excellent at building relationships, and closing deals. The ideal candidate will be a quick learner with strong negotiating skills, and the ability to showcase our offerings in a compelling way. Often tasked with attending customer meetings , site visits and giving presentations,it’s essential that our sales lead be personable and professional.
Objectives of this Role :
Educate a client on our company’s products ( home interiors catalogue like modular / loose furniture , decor ,etc ),services ( end to end execution ) and USPs.
Be the soul ground representative by attending customer meetings and site visits if required to build a rapport and trust required for a sales closure.
Bring maturity to marketing/internal qualified leads until closure ( booking amount received ) through quote discussions, sales presentation and required follow ups.
Maintain working relationships with the customers for any iteration in quote/escalation/potential new sales opportunity.
Meet/exceed monthly targets through sales closure.
Coordinate with pre-sales and project management teams to maintain the overall lead cycle.
Prepare professional, complete, concise and accurate reports, proposals, booking packages, and other documentation as required for executive-level presentations.
Qualifications :
Bachelor’s / Master’s degree.
1-3 years in sales / Business Development ( Preferably within the home/commercial interiors or furniture industry ).
Proven success rate at levels above sales quotas.
Requirements :
Ability to balance persuasion with professionalism , deliver effective customised sales pitch.
Pro-active in initiating discussions with customers, scheduling meetings and being efficient in frequent
travelling within the city as and when required.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, negotiation,presentation, and organizational skills.
Proficiency with excel.
Sincerity and passionate about selling

Job Description - PLM Windchill Technical Consultant
Experience: 8-10 Years
Work Location: Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai, Noida
Shift: Afternoon

Role Summary
We are seeking a skilled PLM Windchill Technical Consultant with expertise in PTC Windchill development, customization, integration, and support. The candidate will be responsible for delivering technical solutions, implementing enhancements, and supporting PLM applications to enable efficient product lifecycle and engineering processes.
Key Responsibilities
Configure, customize, and support PTC Windchill solutions based on business requirements.
Develop and maintain Windchill workflows, lifecycle states, OIRs, soft types, attributes, and access controls.
Perform custom development using Windchill APIs, Java, J2EE, JSP, and related technologies.
Design and develop integrations between Windchill and enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle ERP, CAD, and MES applications.
Support data migration, system upgrades, testing, deployment, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot technical issues and perform root cause analysis for application incidents.
Prepare technical documentation, unit test cases, and deployment artifacts.
Collaborate with functional teams, architects, and business users during project execution.
Required Technical Expertise and Skills
8-10 years of experience in PLM solutions with at least 3-5 years of hands-on experience in PTC Windchill.
Strong knowledge of Windchill PDMLink, Change Management, Document Management, and Product Structure Management.
Experience in Windchill customization including: OIRs (Object Initialization Rules), ACLs (Access Control Lists, Attribute Management, Business Rules
Proficiency in Java, J2EE, Spring Framework, JSP, Servlets, JavaScript, HTML, and SQL.
Experience working with Windchill APIs, InfoEngine, REST APIs, and SOAP Web Services.
Hands-on experience integrating Windchill with ERP and CAD systems.
Good understanding of Oracle or SQL Server databases. Experience with Git, Maven, Jenkins, JIRA, and Agile delivery methodologies.
Domain Knowledge, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Data Management (PDM), Engineering Change Management (ECR/ECO/ECN), Bill of Materials (BOM) Management, Product Release Processes, Engineering and Manufacturing Operations.

Description:
Job Summary
As a Lead Engineer - Basic Automation Testing, you will play a critical role in ensuring the successful planning, coordination, governance, and deployment of software releases across complex healthcare products and platforms. You will serve as both a Release Coordinator and Release Engineer, driving releases from initiation through production deployment while collaborating with Engineering, QA, Product, and Customer teams.


Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks and test suites across UI, API, and database layers.
Drive end-to-end test coverage including functional, regression, integration, and automation testing of critical business workflows.
Automate high-value test scenarios to reduce manual effort and improve release quality.
Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines, and enhance test infrastructure for speed, reliability, and scalability.
Ensure quality ownership across Agile sprints by validating features, tracking defects, debugging failures, and supporting release readiness.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Developers, Business Analysts, and QA teams to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
Analyze automation results, identify root causes, and drive defect resolution.
Establish automation best practices, coding standards, and reusable framework components.
Contribute to continuous improvement of testing strategies, quality metrics, and engineering processes.
Mentor junior automation engineers, and promote quality engineering culture across teams.
Support test planning, estimation, risk assessment, and quality governance activities.
Drive innovation through adoption of modern tools, frameworks, and testing methodologies.


Experience
7 - 9 Years


Location
Mumbai
Pune
Chennai
Bangalore


Educational Qualifications
Engineering Degree - BE/ME/BTech/MTech/BSc/MSc.
Relevant certifications in Release Management, DevOps, Agile, Scrum, or Cloud technologies are desirable.


Skills
Mandatory Technical Skills:
UI and API Test Automation Expertise (Selenium / Playwright / Cypress / REST Assured/SoapUI/Postman)
Programming and OOP Skills (JavaScript / TypeScript / Java / Python / C#)
CI/CD and Test Integration (Jenkins/Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions/Git)
Automation Framework Design and Development
Test Strategy, Test Planning and Defect Management
Agile/Scrum Methodologies
Good to Have Skills:
Advanced SQL
BDD (Cucumber)
TDD Practices
AWS/Cloud Exposure
Performance Testing (JMeter, LoadRunner)
Docker and Kubernetes
Security Testing
Test Management Tools (Jira, Zephyr)
Healthcare Domain Knowledge
Microservices Testing
Service Virtualization
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
Strong collaboration and teamwork mindset
Ability to lead automation initiatives and mentor teams
Effective planning and organizational skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced Agile environment
Customer-centric approach with focus on quality and continuous improvement

Description:
About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate

Description:
Job Purpose

To manage and drive sales through distribution in order to attain market leadership in the given territory, through growth in gross numbers and revenues
Key Result Areas/Accountabilities

Sales
Establish a Best-in-Class distribution footprint and a strong promoter channel where the TSM is supervising promoters
Deliver sales target for all products (voice-prepaid / post-paid, data etc.) by executing the distribution strategy
Help zone and circle achieve Revenue targets by driving secondaries through Mass Retail distribution and by pushing unlimited products penetration
Monitor quality of acquisition through the distribution channel
Competition Tracking & reporting schemes & programs
Ensure availability of stock at retail while adhering to the norms
Execute promotional activities for channel partners to drive sales and build market credibility
Revenue
Achieve zonal revenue target for the distribution channel across all products
Distribution expansion and extraction
Achieve retail (MBO) expansion targets through increase in number of outlets in existing and new geographies
People
DSE Management
Target Setting DSE
DSE Beat Plan adherence
Systems/formats at DSE end
Drive Distribution KPIs delivery
MD/AD/SD Management
DSE Availability monitoring
Monitor Stock holding
Day to day Performance Review & discussions
Problem Solving
Load Out monitoring
Systems/formats at MD point
HSW compliance
Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience

Good communication skills
Sales Planning & Forecasting
Products Services & Technology Knowledge - Consumer
Leads Decision Making & Delivering Results
Analytical Thinking
Building Team Commitment
Must have technical / professional qualifications

Essential : Graduation - Regular
Desired : post - graduation in business management/MBA
work ex: 1 - 4 years
Experience with distribution planning and channel implementation.

Description:
Responsible for availability of Raw Material & Components as per agreed delivery dates aligned to Production Schedule by effective vendor management and internal escalations.
To prepare the RM delivery schedule against Purchase Orders in alignment with the Production schedule based on supplier capacity in mind.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
Vendor Management & Expediting
Drive proactive vendor engagement with a go-getter attitude to ensure timely deliveries.
Prepare and monitor scheduling lines post-PO release; align supplier schedules with plant requirements.
Track delivery performance, escalate critical delays, and ensure adherence to monthly supply plans.
Utilize Vendor Portal for streamlined communication and grievance resolution.
Collaborate with planning and plant teams to maintain safety stock and optimize storage utilization.
Develop and maintain procurement dashboards for performance tracking and reporting.

Operational Procurement & P2P Cycle
Own the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P process, ensuring compliance and efficiency.
Process orders via SAP MM; manage both domestic and import purchases using various Incoterms.
Implement engineering change notifications (ECR/ECN) and manage rejection material disposal within defined timelines.
Understand and apply payment terms such as LC/BG in procurement transactions.
Ensure the Long Lead Time parts are well planned based on Season requirement
Supplier RM wise (ABS) monitoring and ensure uninterpreted supplies.

Inventory & Material Management
Manage raw material inventory and refine lead times based on plant requirements.
Measure and report RM/component availability against production plans.
FSN Analysis & Aging Inventory Analysis
Indirect Purchase (Opex/Capex) Experience.

Governance & Compliance
Ensure adherence to government norms related to taxation, safety, and environmental regulations.
Apply 5S, QC tools, and process control charts to enhance procurement operations.
Support corporate SCM initiatives across logistics, planning, strategic sourcing, and supplier development.
Desired Skills & Experience
Strong analytical and communication skills.
Exposure to vendor negotiations, import/export regulations, and compliance frameworks.
SAP End user skill level important
Must have experience in relevant Consumer durable /Appliance industry, handled Metals/Plastics/Packaging/Fabrication item.
Indirect purchase experience

Description:
Role & responsibilities: Qualified and passionate professionals for the Academic Session 2027-2028 with knowledge in lesson planning, teaching, assessing and evaluating, trainings, student motivation, curriculum planning & result oriented approach.

Teaching Positions:
PGT (B.ED Mandotary): Accountancy, Business Studies, Economics, Chemistry, Psychology, Computer Science, Geography, Fine Arts, and Nepali.
TGT (B.ED Mandotary): Science, Mathematics, Social Studies, Computer Science, and English.
STEAM / Robotics: Teaching Robotics, AI, IoT, or related technology/electronics fields.
Performing Arts: Music, Classical Dance, Dance, Theatre/Drama, or equivalent.
PTI / PE Teacher (Preferred Female): Sports training, coaching, and sports management, yoga.
Specialized & Administrative Positions:
Special Educator, Child Counsellor.
Executive Assistant to Principal.
HR with required qualification and previous experience in educational organization.

How to Apply: Candidates may send their updated resume to principal@dpsgangtok.com or info@dpsgangtok.com with the position applied for mentioned in the subject line. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next round.

Preferred candidate profile:
PGT: Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject with B.Ed./M.Ed., minimum 60% marks, and at least 5 years of CBSE/ICSE/IB Board-class teaching experience.
TGT: Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject with B.Ed./M.Ed., minimum 60% marks, and at least 3 years of experience.
STEAM / Robotics: B.Tech./M.Tech./M.Sc. in Technology/Electronics.
Performing Arts: Graduate/Postgraduate in Performing Arts with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience.
PTI / PE Teacher: B.P.Ed./M.P.Ed. or equivalent in Physical Education and Sports Sciences with a minimum of 3 years of experience (school-level sports experience preferred).
Special Educator: RCI-registered with Diploma/Graduation/Postgraduation in Special Education (B.Ed. Special Education or equivalent).
Child Counsellor: Postgraduate degree in Psychology (M.A./M.Sc. or equivalent) with relevant counselling experience.
Executive Assistant to Principal: Graduate/Postgraduate with computer proficiency (MS Office/Google Workspace) and a minimum of 3 years of experience.
HR (Human Resources): Graduate/Postgraduate (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred) with a minimum of 3 years of experience in HR operations, recruitment, and administration.
General Requirements: All qualifications must comply with CBSE by-laws. Excellent communication skills are essential. Teachers with residential school experience and exposure to other education boards will be given preference.
Perks and benefits:
Remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Opportunity to be part of a purpose-driven learning community at a CBSE-affiliated institution.
AboutCompany: Delhi Public School, Gangtok is a CBSE-affiliated institution (Affiliation No.: 1820228 [X/XII]) located at 5th Mile, Lumsey, Upper Tadong, Gangtok, Sikkim. Dedicated to building a purpose-driven learning community, the school offers a strong academic and co-curricular environment across primary, secondary, and senior secondary levels, supported by modern learning initiatives such as STEAM/Robotics, Performing Arts, Sports, and specialized student support.

Description:
Senior Resident Paediatrics

Role Overview
The Senior Resident Paediatrics is a full-time, post-MD/DNB clinical and academic tenure position at a leading university-run super speciality teaching hospital and medical college integrating compassionate care, advanced medicine, teaching and research. The role delivers round-the-clock paediatric and neonatal care across the wards, emergency, NICU, PICU and outpatient services, while supporting the training of undergraduate and postgraduate medical students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of the Department of Paediatrics through the assigned unit faculty and supervises Junior Residents, interns and nursing teams on duty. It is a tenure position of up to 3 years under National Medical Commission (NMC) norms, suited to a qualified paediatrician seeking clinical depth alongside teaching and research exposure.

Work Mode
Work mode: work from hospital (fully on-site), with working days per hospital/NMC norms, including duty, on-call and emergency rosters as assigned by the department. No travel requirement has been specified for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Provide first-line senior clinical care to neonates, infants, children and adolescents admitted to paediatric wards, NICU and PICU, including daily rounds and clinical decision-making.
Assess, stabilise and manage paediatric and neonatal emergencies, including resuscitation, shock, respiratory distress, seizures, sepsis and poisoning.
Lead neonatal resuscitation at high-risk deliveries and caesarean sections in coordination with the obstetrics team.
Perform and supervise essential procedures such as endotracheal intubation, umbilical and peripheral vascular access, lumbar puncture, intraosseous access and surfactant administration, as clinically indicated.
Initiate and monitor respiratory support, including oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation, under faculty guidance.
Conduct paediatric outpatient and specialty clinics, including growth and development assessment, nutrition counselling, well-baby care and follow-up of high-risk newborns.
Implement immunisation services in line with the national immunisation schedule and Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) recommendations, including counselling of parents.
Take on-call and emergency duties as per the departmental roster, ensuring timely handover and continuity of care across shifts.
Teach and mentor MBBS students, interns and Junior Residents through bedside teaching, case presentations, skills sessions and assessments under competency-based medical education.
Maintain accurate, timely and legally sound medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, consent, discharge summaries and death certification.
Communicate clearly and compassionately with parents and families on diagnosis, prognosis and treatment plans, including breaking difficult news and obtaining informed consent.
Adhere to infection control, antimicrobial stewardship, patient safety and quality protocols, and participate in clinical audits and mortality and morbidity reviews.
Participate in departmental academic activities and clinical research, including journal clubs, seminars, case reports and approved research projects.
Coordinate with paediatric surgery, obstetrics, radiology, laboratory and other super speciality teams for multidisciplinary care and timely referrals.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical college recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MD (Paediatrics) or DNB (Paediatrics) from an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited institution, completed with results declared by the date of joining.
Valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, with the postgraduate qualification registered or eligible for registration.
Age below 45 years at initial appointment, as per prevailing NMC norms for Senior Residents in broad specialties.

Required Experience
Experience range: 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB paediatric clinical experience. Freshly qualified MD/DNB Paediatrics doctors are eligible to apply.
Relevant experience: postgraduate residency in Paediatrics with substantial rotations in NICU, PICU, paediatric emergency and general paediatric wards in a tertiary care or teaching hospital.
Preferred experience: prior work as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in Paediatrics in a medical college, teaching hospital or multi-specialty tertiary care hospital.
Industry preference: medical colleges, university teaching hospitals, super speciality hospitals and high-volume tertiary paediatric or neonatal care centres.

Technical and Functional Skills
Neonatal resuscitation and stabilisation in line with Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) and National Neonatology Forum (NNF) guidelines.
Paediatric emergency and critical care management in line with Paediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) principles, including airway, breathing and circulation support.
Working knowledge of respiratory support: oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation.
Procedural competence: intubation, umbilical venous and arterial catheterisation, intraosseous access, lumbar puncture, surfactant administration and exchange transfusion.
Fluid, electrolyte and nutritional management, including parenteral nutrition in neonates and critically ill children.
Management of neonatal jaundice, prematurity, sepsis, respiratory distress, malnutrition, diarrhoeal disease and common infectious diseases of childhood.
Interpretation of blood gases, laboratory results and paediatric and neonatal imaging.
Growth monitoring, developmental assessment, immunisation practice and preventive paediatrics.
Clinical documentation on hospital information systems or electronic medical records, and adherence to evidence-based IAP and NNF protocols.
Bedside teaching and assessment methods under competency-based medical education.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Compassionate, family-centred communication with children and parents, including counselling under stress and breaking difficult news.
Composure, sound judgement and rapid decision-making during emergencies and night duties.
Team leadership on duty, guiding Junior Residents, interns and nursing staff with clarity and respect.
Collaboration with faculty, nursing, allied health and other clinical departments.
Strong professional ethics, integrity, patient confidentiality and respect for child rights and safeguarding.
Teaching aptitude, patience and a willingness to mentor learners.
Time management, reliability on rosters and accountability for patient outcomes.
Cultural sensitivity and the ability to communicate with patients from diverse linguistic and social backgrounds.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Valid NRP, PALS and Basic Life Support (BLS) certifications.
Fellowship or certificate training in Neonatology, Paediatric Critical Care or a related paediatric subspecialty.
Publications, case reports or conference presentations in Paediatrics or Neonatology.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and exposure to medical education workshops.
Membership of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) or National Neonatology Forum (NNF).
Exposure to hospital quality, accreditation and patient safety programmes.
