Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

About The Role


Job Title -

Instructional Design - Associate

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:12 - Associate

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 0-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:-0-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Description:
#ACN Song GN Reinvention Services Customer Service Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Job Title Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Management Level: L07 Manager
Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai (India; global remit)
Experience: 10+ Years (L07)
Must have skills: Retail Service Reinvention / Customer Service Strategy Transformation; a blend of industry and consulting experience with deep understanding of the end-to-end retail value chain and how it drives service demand, volume and exceptions; experience shaping AI-native / agentic service operating models.
The Practice A Brief Sketch
The practice works with clients across their marketing, commerce, sales and service functions to reinvent how they engage customers. As part of the Reinvention Services Customer Service team, you will help the worlds leading retailers transform service from a reactive, cost-driven function into an intelligence-led, AI-native capability that senses signals in real time, resolves issues before they escalate, and continuously improves from every interaction across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystem driving customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience.
Job summary
As a Retail Service Reinvention Senior Manager / Associate Director, you will advise C-suite executives, shape AI-native service operating models, and lead end-to-end transformation for the worlds leading retailers. Reporting to the Customer Service Managing Director, you will build and lead a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts and carry accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M. The role requires a strong blend of retail domain expertise, consulting leadership, end-to-end value chain understanding, executive stakeholder management, and business development capability to shape and deliver scalable, future-ready retail service solutions.
Roles and responsibilities
Service Strategy Advisory
Define enterprise and omnichannel service strategy across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystems.
Shape AI-native service vision, target operating models and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
Develop business cases, prioritize investment and establish value-realization frameworks.
Advise boards and C-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise-scale change.
Experience Design
Map end-to-end journeys for shoppers (order, delivery, returns, loyalty, complaints), associates (store, picker, contact centre) and suppliers (onboarding, purchase orders, invoicing, disputes).
Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.
Identify moments of truth and design service recovery for stock-outs, failed deliveries, substitutions and disputed refunds.
Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.
Operating Model Process Transformation
Design target operating models spanning shopper services, supplier services, store workforce services, and fulfilment/ecosystem services.
Design the workforce across shoppers, store associates, pickers and inventory teams, contact-centre specialists and leads, supplier account teams, and delivery partners/dispatchers.
Establish governance frameworks policy and business rules, approval/escalation thresholds, SLAs and entitlements, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.
Technology AI Transformation
Set CRM and CCaaS platform strategy (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect).
Shape knowledge and case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk).
Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.
Integrate across order, store and supply-chain systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, supplier/EDI portals) and IoT/GPS-enabled field and delivery tracking.
Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root-cause analysis capability.
Human + Agentic Operations
Design hybrid workforce models blending advisors, associates, AI copilots and autonomous agents across the shopper, supplier, store and fulfilment domains.
Design agents for high-volume service capabilities order status, substitutions, returns, refunds, delivery orchestration, supplier collaboration and dispute resolution.
Lead change management, upskilling and adoption programmes for frontline and support teams.
Establish AI governance, ethics and bias controls, and ongoing model/agent performance oversight.
Enterprise Transformation Delivery
Lead end-to-end programmes from strategy through implementation, adoption and value realisation.
Orchestrate multi-workstream delivery across business, experience, operations, technology and data/AI teams.
Manage executive steering committees and track value against committed business cases.
Practice Building
Develop market-leading thought leadership and intellectual property.
Build reusable methods, accelerators, assets and AI workflows for retail reinvention services.
Coach and mentor consulting teams.
Support business development and strategic pursuits collaborating with Song leadership to identify new opportunities and with Songs Consulting, Technology and Data AI teams for delivery.
Professional Technical Skills
Deep expertise in grocery, apparel or large omnichannel retail, with working knowledge of the end-to-end value chain merchandising and assortment planning, inventory and price management, promotions execution, digital commerce, in-store operations, supplier and partner operations, and last-mile fulfilment and how each stage drives customer demand, service volume and service exceptions.
First-hand practitioner experience inside leading grocery, apparel or omnichannel retailers (not advisory-only) having lived these operations, partnered with frontline teams, and redesigned them at enterprise scale.
Proven track record across service strategy advisory, experience design, operating model transformation, technology AI transformation, and enterprise delivery; consulting background is valuable but strong industry leadership experience counts equally.
Hands-on shopper/customer service experience across the lifecycle: order status and delivery-exception handling; substitutions, out-of-stock and refund/credit resolution; returns and reverse-logistics servicing; loyalty, rewards and membership servicing; complaint, feedback and social/review response; and multi-channel delivery (mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social) with consistent resolution regardless of entry channel.
Supplier and partner service experience: onboarding, compliance and account management; forecast, purchase-order and inventory collaboration; quality issues, disputes and score-carding; invoice, payment and reconciliation servicing; and supplier/partner portals, EDI exchanges and account-management workflows.
Store and workforce service experience: inventory accuracy, price integrity and promotion execution at store level; pick, pack and in-store fulfilment; store-to-contact-centre escalation and case hand-off; associate empowerment tools (store apps, picker/associate devices, knowledge assistants); and workforce scheduling, service standards and frontline performance management.
Fulfilment and ecosystem service experience: delivery orchestration, routing and ETA/live tracking; failed-delivery, missed-slot and delivery-recovery workflows; reverse logistics and returns-to-warehouse operations; driver, dispatcher and 3PL partner management; and last-mile SLAs, on-time performance and partner score-carding.
Working knowledge of core retail service processes order-to-delivery, returns refunds, complaint case management, store-to-contact-centre escalation, substitution/refund workflows and supplier dispute resolution with the SLAs and benchmarks that define operational excellence, and fluency in how cases move end-to-end (detect, triage/categorise, route/assign, investigate/enrich, decide/approve, orchestrate, execute/communicate, confirm/close).
Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root-cause analytics).
Experience designing target operating models that combine human and AI/agentic capacity reusable service capability design, hybrid workforce design, and governance/guardrail frameworks (policy business rules, approvals escalation, human-in-the-loop controls, SLAs entitlements, privacy consent, security access, compliance audit, model/agent performance governance, ethics bias controls, and data quality traceability).
Demonstrated track record of driving measurable outcomes customer value (NPS/CSAT, trust, advocacy); growth (repeat purchase rate, average order value, attach rate, customer lifetime value); service quality productivity (first-contact and overall resolution, reduced cost-to-serve and contact volume, higher associate productivity); and availability resilience (in-stock rate, on-time delivery/payment, margin protection, and supply/compliance resilience).
Executive stakeholder management, communication and storytelling; ability to build and defend a business case at board level; fluency across business, experience, operations, technology and AI/data teams; and comfort translating complex operating models into a clear enterprise narrative.
Additional information
Experience in retail, customer service or enterprise service transformation, including large-scale programmes delivered end-to-end from strategy through implementation; the ideal candidate blends industry and consulting experience.
Reports to the Customer Service Managing Director; builds and leads a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts, with accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M.
Employment type: Permanent. Work arrangement: remote / hybrid / onsite, flexed to client and project needs; travel expectation varies by client engagement.
MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred. Relevant certifications a plus CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking, or platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).



Qualification
Experience in Retail industry (physical + digital) - Grocery, Apparel or large omnichannel retail sector experience
Good to have skills: relevant certifications (CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking) and platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).
Educational Qualification: MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred; MBA or equivalent degree in Business, Strategy, Sales Marketing.

Join our team of Strategy & Consulting Global Network Song who solve customer facing challenges at clients spanning sales, service , and marketing to accelerate business change.

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Are you passionate about scaling businesses using in-depth frameworks and techniques to solve customer facing challengesDo you want to design, build, and implement strategies to enhance business performanceDoes working in an inclusive and collaborative environment spark your interest
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities within on Accentures Strategy & Consulting Global Network Song practice.

The Practice A Brief Sketch
The practice is aligned to the Global Network Song Practice of Accenture and works with clients across their marketing, sales and services functions. As part of the team, you will provide transformation services driven by key offerings like Marketing, Sales and Service, Commerce. These services help our clients become living businesses by optimizing their marketing, sales and customer service strategy, thereby driving cost reduction, revenue enhancement, customer satisfaction and impacting business metrics in a positive manner.
The Customer Data Platform Manager is a mid-level position within the Marketing transformation vertical of Accenture GN Song.

The key responsibilities as Customer Data Platform Manager will include
the following:
Conduct assessment of clients current data management and Customer Data Platform (CDP) capabilities. Provide recommendations on optimizing the current stack and develop use cases to improve utilization.
Gather business requirement and strategize and build clients digital marketing data management program that delivers high performance profiles for segmentation, personalization & activation across Digital channels.
Identify different data sources, approaches to enrich customer profiles/segments in CDP (customer data platforms) and define use cases across multiple channels/destinations. Design Data cleaning, transformation, and integration approach from various data sources into CDP.
Evaluate and recommend new ways of data management through CDP and how it connects into the broader marketing technology landscape (campaign management and insight generation).
Identify, scope and partner with technology solution providers, clients IT, BU teams, compliance, and marketing agencies to deliver the best solution meeting the needs of our clients.
Plan, design, implement & integrate CDP solutions such as Adobe Experience Platform RT CDP and work with partners to leverage various data management capabilities offered these solutions.
Understand and convey the impact of regulations like CCPA, GDPR and clients own internal or industry regulation on data gathering and management. Should be able to guide towards privacy by design, consent management for customer profile activation across digital marketing channels.
Understand and design integrations (including API based/ file-based integrations) b/w tools/platforms of different vendors/ MarTech/AdTech components/ data sources.
Stay abreast of MarTech landscape & engage ecosystem players/vendors to ensure best in class digital audience management capabilities for clients. Propose and conduct pilots as needed.
Develop and manage a team of CDP specialists by managing key tasks such as work allocation, time management, project SME support, hiring, training etc.
Aside from client delivery, the selected candidate will also drive business development efforts and thought leadership in the Martech, CDP and other digital marketing platform space.

Key Skills:
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Creating and maintaining client relationships
Strong understanding of Marketing processes, data management, data strategy, data integration, marketing & Advertising technologies and their integrations with other technologies
Partner with technology solution providers and marketing agencies to deliver the best solution meeting the needs of our clients.
Strong project management skills: ability to mobilize and organize across multiple stakeholders (client and internal) and projects.

In addition , to excel at the role , you will also need to have :
An ability to work with the leadership to support business development and thought leadership.
Data-driven mindset within proven utilization of information to drive decisions, calibrate and results.
Strong communication and presentation skills to share the perfect pitch with key stakeholders.
Strong client handling skills to develop, manage and deepen relationships with key stakeholders.
Team building skills to collaborate, work and motivate teams with diverse skills and experience to achieve goals.
Ability to work effectively in a remote, virtual, global environment.
Ability to work in a fast paced and unstructured environment.
Ability to learn new and understand new tools/solutions.
Identify new opportunities, develop solutions and own proposals end to end.
Contribute to offering development skills to identify areas of growth related to specific skills, platforms, assets etc. that contribute to enhancing the offering.

Read about us.
Your experience counts
Proven working experience (8+ Years) in Marketing and digital data management/ audience management with tools like Adobe experience platform (RT CDP), Oracle unity, salesforce CDP, Tealium etc. and relevant marketing technology solutions (including implementations), particularly within the industry (E-Commerce, Retail, Telecom, Pharma, Banking etc.)
Profile & segmentation: Experience building Data management platform capability preferably with tools like Adobe Audience Manager to generate profiles & segments for onsite and paid media activation.

MarTech ecosystem: Able to guide and deliver integration of customer profiles and segmentation across MarTech tools like SFMC, Google 360, Adobe Marketing cloud, Real time interaction management tool, Sprinklr for social media, etc. to build end to end customer focused MarTech stack.
Experience in ad tech & web/app analytics & their implementations such as cross device and omnichannel consumer experience, paid media (E.g. DSPs, Google, FB etc.) and owned media platform integrations, web/app analytics tools, Omniture, campaign tracking & attribution tools, firebase, Appsflyer also beneficial.

Experience working with Ads data hub, ad platforms and their API'' s i.e., Google API, Facebook conversion API etc.

Good to have skills:R, Spark, data bricks, Ability to leverage design thinking, business process optimization, and stakeholder management skills.





Job

Summary:

This role involves driving strategic initiatives, managing business transformations, and leveraging industry expertise to create value-driven solutions.





Roles & Responsibilities:
Deliver strategic advice to clients by providing data-driven recommendations that enhance business outcomes.
Independently manage communications with clients, ensuring clear understanding of project objectives and progress updates.
Design and implement GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, or traditional AI/ML algorithms tailored to address specific business challenges within the healthcare and life sciences sector.
Demonstrate knowledge of life sciences datasets and maintain strong domain expertise to drive the development of robust analytics solutions.
Support the delivery of consulting projects for global clients, working as part of a small to medium-sized team or as an individual contributor as required.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, leveraging skills in data engineering, data science, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Apply design thinking principles and business process optimization to recommend and implement innovative, value-driven solutions.
Engage in ongoing learning to develop consulting acumen, industry knowledge, and technical capabilities.





WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
An opportunity to work on high-visibility projects with top Pharma clients around the globe.
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners, and business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge, and capabilities.
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.





What you would do in this role
Support delivery of small to medium-sized teams to deliver consulting projects for global clients.
Responsibilities may include strategy, implementation, process design, and change management for specific modules.
Work with the team or as an Individual contributor on the project assigned which includes a variety of skills to be utilized from Data Engineering to Data Science
Provide Subject matter expertise in various sub-segments of the LS industry.
Develop assets and methodologies, point-of-view, research, or white papers for use by the team and the larger community.
Acquire new skills that have utility across industry groups.
Support strategies and operating models focused on some business units and assess likely competitive responses. Also, assess implementation readiness and points of greatest impact.
Co-lead proposals, and business development efforts and coordinate with other colleagues to create consensus-driven deliverables.
Execute a transformational change plan aligned with the client’s business strategy and context for change. Engage stakeholders in the change journey and build commitment to change.
Make presentations wherever required to a known audience or client on functional aspects of his or her domain.



Who are we looking for?
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field.
Extensive GenAI expertise with a track record of creating and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
Proven experience (4+ years) in working on Life Sciences/Pharma/Healthcare projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Excellent understanding of Pharma data sets – commercial, clinical, RWE (Real World Evidence) & EMR (Electronic medical records)
Leverage one’s hands on experience of working across one or more of these areas such as real-world evidence data, R&D clinical data, digital marketing data.
Hands-on experience with handling Datasets like Komodo, RAVE, IQVIA, Truven, Optum etc.
Hands-on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modeling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Proficiency in Programming languages such as Python, SQL, Spark, etc.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings/insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL.
Experience with any of the cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Experience with any of the Data Visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, Qlikview, Spotfire is good to have.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, etc.
Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Strong writing skills to build points of view on current industry trends.
Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills



Professional & Technical

- Relevant experience in the required domain.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.






Additional Information:

- Opportunity to work on innovative projects.

- Career growth and leadership exposure.

Shape vulnerability management and exposure management strategies and value propositions to drive impactful discussions with CISOs, Heads of Security Operations, and senior leadership.
Demonstrate strong analytical and consulting skills to assess VM maturity and identify gaps across people, process, technology, and governance.

Must have skills: Process Excellence, Process Re-engineering, Customer Service Transformation, Lean Six Sigma
Good to have skills: Customer Experience Design, AI-enabled Process Design, Process Mining, CCaaS, CRM, Operating Model Design

Job Summary:
As a Service Operating Model & Process Design Team Lead/Consultant, you will support process and service transformation engagements, from assessing market, customer, and technology shifts through defining future-state process and service strategies and enabling adoption. You will combine process re-engineering and Lean Six Sigma rigor with customer experience design to diagnose service friction, quantify its impact, and design practical future-state processes, operating models, technology enablement, and AI integration. You will produce structured analytical work and supporting materials that enable senior practitioners to shape transformation recommendations.

Roles & Responsibilities:
- Design future-state process specifications covering AI integration points, operating model changes, human-machine interaction requirements, and workforce adoption approaches for the assigned domain.
- Map and model current-state and future-state service processes using structured notation and modelling tools; document handoffs, decision points, and channel transitions across the customer journey.
- Apply Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value stream mapping, and root cause analysis, to identify service-process inefficiencies and quantify improvement opportunities.
- Develop customer journey maps and service blueprints that identify key touchpoints, friction points, and opportunities to improve experience and efficiency.
- Conduct process analysis and support the delivery of digital and platform solutions across operations, including contact centre and customer service technology.
- Build analytical frameworks and data-driven assessments using AI-assisted visualization and analysis tools; connect process metrics to customer outcomes such as first contact resolution, handling time, containment, and satisfaction.
- Conduct benchmarking analysis using AI-accelerated industry and peer-comparison tools.
- Develop change-impact assessments using AI-assisted organizational analysis tools.
- Use relevant AI tools across tasks and deliverable creation, including creating agents and other tools that support analysis and delivery.
- Apply industry or function knowledge to review and improve domain-specific reinvention designs and functional playbook content.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Basic Qualification:
- Proficiency in process modelling tools and software such as Visio, ARIS, or Signavio.
- Experience with process mining and data analytics tools such as Celonis or Power Automate.
- Working knowledge of how AI and automation integrate into business-process and customer-service design.
- Exposure to customer service or contact centre operations, including familiarity with core service metrics.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project-management skills.
- Ability to analyze data and translate findings into structured recommendations for senior review.

Preferred Qualification:
- Experience in a management consulting firm.
- Exposure to CRM or contact centre platforms such as Salesforce, Genesys, or Amazon Connect.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate complex findings in clear business terms.
- Experience working on proposals and contributing to business-development activities.
- Lean Six Sigma certification, with Green Belt or above preferred.

Additional Information:
- The ideal candidate combines process-analysis capability, customer-centric service design, AI-enabled transformation, and the ability to develop structured recommendations.
- The role requires growing fluency in process disciplines and the ability to design interactions among people, AI agents, and processes across the service journey.


Qualification
Experience: Minimum 4 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification: MBA or equivalent postgraduate degree from a Tier 1 institute

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernisation, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programmes? Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping CIOs, CTOs and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organisations, and ensuring transformation investments generate lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organisations.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernising delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.
We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organisations through complex transformation journeys - from translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:
Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership:Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to enterprise priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. End-to-End Delivery Accountability:Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization - including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernisation, and cloud-native migration programmes, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity.Revenue Management and Financial Governance:Carry P&L accountability for accounts and portfolios with budgets of $5M-$30M; manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership:Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Integration and Dependency Management:Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes Value Realisation and Benefits Framework:Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio - cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at board level Global Delivery Leadership:Act as a trusted partner to C-suite executives and senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. Executive Stakeholder Leadership:Shape CxO narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings


Role Summary
As Delivery Lead Associate Director, you are accountable for the overall delivery performance of an account or portfolio of transformation programmes with budgets of $5M-$30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, carry P&L accountability, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at C-suite level, govern Senior Manager delivery leads, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organisation.



Key Responsibilities

Own delivery accountability across an account or portfolio of programmes;


Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CICD practices and modern ways of working within client organisations.


Lead executive-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client.


Manage relationships at C-suite and board level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation.


Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.


Accountability for the account P&L manage budgets of $5M-$30M, protect margin, drive revenue recognition and pursue revenue growth opportunities.


Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure.


Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs.


Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio.


Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio.


Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits.


Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings.

17-20 years' total experience; 3-5 years proven experience managing and delivering complex portfolio of transformation programmes with budgets of $5M-$30M.


Proven ability to govern complex, multi-programme transformation portfolios in a large global services environment, with direct accountability for delivery, revenue and commercial outcomes.


Demonstrated track record of C-suite stakeholder engagement, influence, and relationship management.


Experience leading organisational change and embedding operational performance improvements at scale.


Track record of account growth, deal-shaping, and business development alongside delivery execution.


Strong executive presence:communicates with clarity and gravitas; builds trust with senior audiences rapidly.


Must have experience of working across at least one of the following areas; Technology Modernization, Mainframe Modernisation, AI Enterprise Transformation, Complex Delivery, Enterprise Agility

Set yourself apart:
Mastery of managing complex deliveries coordinating with more than one supplier with multiple dependencies and work plans
Experience delivering cloud-native transformation programmes leveraging Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), microservices architectures, API-led integration, or SaaS platforms
Experience of delivering transformation at scale within a highly regulated or complex industry sector
Cloud/Industry and Programme Management certifications and credentials
Demonstrate a strong Technical and Emotional Quotient





Qualifications & Certifications

Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); Master's / MBA strongly preferred.


PMP, MSP, or equivalent programme management certification.


SAFe, or equivalent Agile certification.


Cloud/enterprise platform certifications (AWS, Azure, Guidewire, SAP, ServiceNow etc.) - advantageous.

What's in it for you?
An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.

(5-8) years of relevant consulting experience in IT Service Management, with hands-on exposure to ITSM assessments, process design, and operating model development. Description:
Role Overview
The Assistant Cluster Lead will support the Cluster Lead in managing operations across multiple residential & comemrcial communities. The incumbent will be responsible for driving operational excellence, team effectiveness, vendor performance, customer satisfaction, governance compliance, and financial discipline across assigned sites while ensuring adherence to organizational standards and service commitments.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Management
Support the Cluster Lead in overseeing daily facility management operations across assigned communities.
Ensure implementation and adherence to FM guidelines, SOPs, statutory requirements, and work instructions.
Conduct regular site visits and operational audits to ensure service quality and compliance.
Monitor preventive and corrective maintenance activities across sites.

Team Management
Guide, mentor, and supervise Site Managers, Community Executives, and operational teams.
Ensure manpower deployment, attendance management, roster adherence, and workforce productivity.
Support hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management of site teams.
Drive a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement.

Financial Management
Review operational expenses and support budget control across assigned sites.
Monitor monthly budgets and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Coordinate with Finance for billing, collections, vendor payments, and financial reconciliations.
Assist in achieving revenue and profitability targets for assigned communities.

Stakeholder Management
Build strong relationships with Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), Management Committees, and Developer Representatives.
Support governance meetings and ensure closure of action items.
Act as a key escalation point for operational and service-related issues.

Customer Experience
Drive resident satisfaction by ensuring timely resolution of complaints and service requests.
Monitor customer feedback and implement improvement initiatives.
Support resident engagement activities and community-building programs.
Minimize escalations through proactive issue identification and resolution.

Vendor Management
Monitor vendor performance against defined SLAs, KPIs, and contractual commitments.
Conduct periodic vendor reviews and service quality audits.
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and operational standards.
Support onboarding and governance of service partners.

Compliance & Governance
Ensure adherence to EHS guidelines, statutory compliances, and internal audit requirements.
Monitor documentation, licenses, certifications, and compliance trackers.
Support implementation of risk mitigation and corrective action plans.

Review & Reporting
Prepare and review Monthly Management Reports (MMR), operational dashboards, and business review presentations.
Track key operational, financial, and customer experience metrics.
Share periodic updates with stakeholders and management on site performance.

Educational Qualification
Any Graduate / BE/ B.Tech/ MBA/ Hospitality courses/ BHM (Any)

Experience
8-17 years of experience in Facility Management, Property Management, Community Management, or Operations.
Experience managing residential townships, premium housing societies, or mixed-use developments preferred.
Prior experience leading multiple sites and vendor management is desirable.

Job Description
Overview
Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. We support integration of renewables, digital engineering, and global compliance standards to ensure reliable and sustainable energy delivery.
The BIM team drives digital transformation by creating accurate 3D models, enabling clash detection, and supporting Scan-to-BIM workflows. Opportunities include advanced modelling, project coordination, automation using tools like Dynamo, and collaboration on global projects ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and multidisciplinary design.
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking Apprentice to join our Bangalore Gurugram office. This role involves working on single and multi-disciplinary Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), focusing on delivering high quality BIM and CAD outputs that meet international standards. The role spans Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewables, Infrastructure, and nuclear domains.
Your Role
Prepare SLDs, control schemes, layouts, 3D models, and hazardous area classifications.
Develop substation layouts and infrastructure drawings including power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Engage in BIM and Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Support project setup, customization, and delivery tracking.
About you
Essential:
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo.
Strong understanding of CAD/BIM standards and drawing protocols.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings.
Familiarity with Electrical/Structural/Mechanical design basics.
Desirable:
Exposure to international engineering standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC)
Understanding of 3D modelling concepts and BIM maturity levels
Familiarity with:
BIM Execution Plan (BEP)
Xrefs / model linking
Common Data Environments (CDEs)
Interest or exposure to Scan-to-BIM workflows
Rewards benefit
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Self - Medical Insurance.
Generous annual leave balance.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsRalis
We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Worker Type Contingent Worker
Job Type Loan of Personnel
At AtkinsRalis , we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Description:
Job Summary
The Builder - Logistics is a high-agency, 0-to-1 role embedded within Ca's GS Retail Logistics function in the South. Based out of Bengaluru and working closely with the Regional Head - South, you will build new programs, ship new tools, and run controlled experiments across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala. This is not a steady-state ops role - you'll spend most of your time defining problems, prototyping solutions, and turning what works into repeatable playbooks that city teams can run at scale. You'll operate at the intersection of ops, data, product, and AI.
Key Responsibilities
New Program Design - Identify gaps across pilot supply, CSP adherence, auto-allocation, and fulfilment. Design new programs from scratch, run pilots, and hand off winning plays to city teams.
Ops Diagnostics Deep Dives - Own regional data - cut it by city, cohort, and process step to surface what's broken and where the fastest wins sit. Convert findings into structured action plans.
Product Specs Tool Building - Write clear specs for internal tools and dashboards. Partner with Product and Tech to ship what the region needs; use no-code and AI where full builds are overkill.
Automation of Manual Workflows - Map the region's sheet-heavy workflows and lead their transition to automated systems. Ship quick wins with Apps Script, Zapier, or AI copilots before scoping full products.
City-Level Experimentation - Run controlled A/B tests across cities to validate whether a new process, script, or intervention actually moves the KPI. Kill what doesn't work, scale what does.
Cross-functional Execution - Work directly with city heads, Category Managers, Product, and Tech to unblock progress. Translate ground-team pain-points into shipped fixes fast.
Qualifications Experience
2-4 years in high-agency roles - startup ops, strategy consulting, category management, or founders office.
Track record of shipping something end-to-end - a program, a tool, a dashboard, a new city launch - that survived after you moved on.
Comfortable in ambiguity - can walk into a messy problem and leave with a structured plan.
Strong first-principles thinking; happy to visit yards and talk to pilots before writing a single line of a proposal.
Bengaluru-based or willing to relocate; comfortable travelling across Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala.
Data AI Skills
Advanced Excel / Google Sheets - pivots, lookups, and formula-based analysis at scale.
SQL fluency for querying large operational datasets; Python or R for deeper analysis is a strong plus.
Comfort building dashboards (Looker, Data Studio, Tableau) that drive city-level decisions.
Hands-on with AI copilots (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate analysis, drafting, and prototyping.
Familiar with no-code automation (Apps Script, Zapier, Retool) to ship quick wins without engineering support.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Grwoth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic, results-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.

Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.

Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations, including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.

Benefits

Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):

For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Patrol all areas of the property; secure rooms; assist guests with room access. Conduct emergency response drills, daily physical hazard/safety inspections, investigations, interviews, and key control audit. Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions and alarm systems. Authorize, monitor, and document access to secured areas. Assist guests/employees during emergency situations. Respond to accidents, contact EMS or administer first aid/CPR as required. Gather information and complete reports. Maintain confidentiality of reports/documents, release information to authorized individuals. Defuse disturbances in accordance with company policies and procedures. Resolve safety hazard situations. Handle all interruptions and complaints. Escort unwelcome persons from the property. Ensure compliance with alcoholic beverage control laws. Call for assistance using proper code responses. Provide proper paperwork to employees.
Assist management in training, motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. In addition, some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements to be considered for this position. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Move at a speed required to respond to work situations (e.g., run, walk, jog). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Role & responsibilities
Operational Management: Oversee order fulfillment, including inbound/outbound sorting, scanning, bagging, and loading. Ensure timely dispatches and adherence to Turnaround Time (TAT).

Role & responsibilities:

Track CC & PUP-level error trends and highlight deviations for corrective action.
Conduct internal audits of assigned partners as per defined schedules using a predefined checklist.

Monitor key pre-analytical KPIs such as sample rejection, leakage, mismatch, low volume, temperature compliance, etc.
Coordinate with interdepartmental teams to ensure compliance with sample collection, labelling, packaging, storage, and transport SOPs.

Handle onboarding of personnel at CC & PUP.
Manage PA complaints in coordination with regional teams.

Knowledge of CRM/LIS workflows, barcode systems, and sample life cycle management.
Basic understanding of audit processes, documentation, RCA, and CAPA.
Ability to analyse error logs and KPIs with basic proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, charts) or similar tools.
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify deviations or process gaps. • Good communication, coordination, and report documentation skills.
Ability to work with CC & PUP teams and ensure compliance with SOPs.
Basic understanding of NABL portal and processe

AboutCompany:
Established in 1949, Dr Lal PathLabs today is the largest and most respected diagnostic service provider in the country. It has a proven track record of over six decades for strict adherence to international standards and benchmarks. Dr Lal PathLabs offers widest test menu and has a pan India presence in all important cities and towns of India, in the form of state-of-the-art laboratories and patient service centres.

The company has more than 190 Labs and over 2000 centres across India and international operations in Nepal and Bangladesh.

It serves over 13 million customers every year through its widest test menu and panels in the disciplines of Molecular Diagnostics, Biophysics, Flow Cytometry, Immunophenotying, Cytogenetics, Endocrinology, Genetics, Nutrition and Metabolism, Oncology, Toxicology, Immunohistochemistry, Infectious diseases, Biochemistry, Haematology, Histopathology and Cytology.

Dr Lal Path Labs has internationally accepted external and internal quality assurance programs in place. The Company is India's highest accredited laboratory, with accreditation from College of American Pathologists (CAP), National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL), Ministry of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and ISO 9001:2000 certification.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. CSR Strategy & Program Design
Lead the formulation of CSR strategies with a primary focus on public health and community well-being.
Drive evidence-based planning through field assessments using PRA, FGDs, baseline surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Develop Detailed Project Reports (DPRs) for health and rural development initiatives.
Collaborate with senior leadership to align CSR strategy with organizational priorities and SDGs.
Provide actionable recommendations to enhance impact, scalability, and sustainability.
2. Public Health Program Development & Implementation
Conceptualize and implement public health interventions (e.g., nutrition, maternal & child health, communicable diseases, sanitation, health system strengthening).
Ensure end-to-end project lifecycle managementplanning, execution, monitoring, and closure.
Set and track project KPIs, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality outcomes.
Integrate convergence with government health programs (NHM, ICDS, etc.) where applicable.
3. Administrative & Operational Leadership
Oversee program administration, including budgeting, vendor management, compliance, and documentation.
Ensure adherence to CSR regulations, audit requirements, and internal governance standards.
Manage implementation partners (NGOs/agencies) and ensure performance accountability.
Manage direct reporting team and strengthen internal processes for efficient program execution and reporting.
4. CSR Communication & Reporting
Develop structured communication strategies for CSR and employee volunteering initiatives.
Prepare high-quality internal and external reports, impact assessments, and case studies.
Support leadership communication through presentations, dashboards, and annual CSR disclosures.
5. Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships
Build and manage partnerships with government bodies, Tata Group entities, NGOs, CSR implementing agencies, and community institutions.
Act as a key interface with district/state administration, PRI institutions, and development partners.
Facilitate CSR audits, reviews, and third-party evaluations.
6. Digitization, MIS & Data-Driven Monitoring
Drive adoption of digital tools and MIS platforms for real-time project monitoring and reporting.
Design dashboards for data visualization, decision-making, and impact tracking.
Ensure data integrity, transparency, and usage compliance across stakeholders.
Apply scientific and TQM methodologies to improve program efficiency and outcomes

Preferred candidate profile
5to11 years of experience in CSR / development sector
Strong experience in public health program design and implementation
Prior experience with NGOs, CSR implementing agencies, or government health programs preferred
Demonstrated exposure to program administration and team/partner management

De-escalate internal and client facing issues. Lead generation and follow-up. Lead filtering & database management Prepare a multitude of Sales reports Prepare, Lead and participate in client meetings Preparation and lead Sales pitches, presentation, Service packs

Description:
Job Summary
The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customers in resolving policy service needs, renewal collection to resolve policy holder s service needs, cross sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment - Develop various sources of agent hiring; build a team of agent pipeline.
Agent Recruitment - Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring.
Agent Recruitment - Conduct Career Seminar of prospects; follow agent hiring mechanism and other hiring norms.
Agent Development - Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training; Field demonstration (FODs).
Agent Development - Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Agent Development - Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Agent Development - Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same.
Meet Business Targets - Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Meet Business Targets - Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc.
Meet Business Targets - Ensure companies product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Meet Business Targets - Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan.
Customer Centricity - Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion.
Customer Centricity - Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty.
Customer Centricity - Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need.
Customer Centricity - Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.


Measures of Success
Achievement of business plan GPA
Recruitment / Development activation of agent as per plan.
Number MTD Active
Persistency as per grid
Number of EC/MDRT agent


Qualifications Experience
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience, At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Description:
Position Summary
The ideal candidate must be well versed with Paint shop process and equipment.
Must be able to recognize the abnormalities in Conveyors, ASU-exhaust system, Rotary equipment like Pumps and blowers, Baking ovens (Direct & indirect type both), Electrified Monorail Hoists, Paint line circuits and related components.
Working exposure with robot maintenance is preferable.
Must have key expertise for basic Trouble shooting and fast restoration of system /equipment.
Must have knowledge about condition Based Monitoring (Vibration analysis and Thermography).
Should be able to handle shift operation independently by ensuring smooth & reliable operation of equipment. Personnel shall also be responsible for spares management i.e., keeping track of spares stock and raising requisitions timely to ensure timely availability of spares. Must be an expert with Microsoft Office applications and SAP- PM module.
Must have knowledge of annual budgeting cycle, defining scope of activities for Service requests, Creation of Purchase requisitions, chasing up with service purchase for creation of Purchase order.
Daily Job involves handling / manning of 15-20 blue collar employees and contractual service providers.

Key Responsibilities:
Carrying out PM activities as per schedule.
Trouble shooting & Breakdown Maintenance
Spares Management
Breakdown analysis, PSR and Corrective actions.
Implementing improvement projects.
Maintaining records and documentation related to IATF standard
Records and documentation for OHSMS (ISO 45001), EMS (ISO 14001)
Updating and monitoring assigned key deliverables i.e. MPs and CPs in TQM way
Daily Work Management as per defined Key Performance Indicators
Updating and monitoring assigned key deliverables i.e. MPs and CPs in TQM way
Records keeping related to contractual services
Creation of Service PRs and Machinery Spare PRs
Chasing up with service purchase for PO creations of services
Manpower and Job Planning for periodic shutdowns to carry out scheduled maintenance activities.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Experience
5-10 years of experience in Mechanical Maintenance
Preferred Industry
Automobile Industry preferably from Paint Shop
