Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a hands-on Full Stack Java Developer to build, test and support enterprise applications. In this role, you will bring strong Java, Spring Boot, REST API and SQL skills together with exposure to modern frontend technologies to deliver high-quality, secure software solutions.
Day to day, you will design, develop and maintain enterprise applications, build and integrate RESTful APIs, microservices and database components, and support user-interface development. You will work closely with business analysts, QA and engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum environment, taking part in code reviews, CI/CD processes, deployments and production support.
This role also requires an AI-tool-ready mindset: you will use approved AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, refactoring, testing, debugging and documentation activities, while critically validating all AI-generated output for correctness, security and maintainability.
Essential Job Functions
Design, develop, test and maintain enterprise applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Build and integrate RESTful APIs, microservices and database components.
Develop or support user-interface components using Angular, React, JavaScript or TypeScript.
Write clean, maintainable code with appropriate unit and integration tests.
Troubleshoot application, API, integration and data issues, and perform root-cause analysis.
Participate in code reviews, CI/CD, deployments and production support.
Collaborate with business analysts, QA and engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.
Use approved AI-assisted development tools for coding, refactoring, testing and documentation, validating all generated output for correctness, security and maintainability.
Basic Qualifications
4-6 years of hands-on software development experience.
Strong Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring Framework and Spring Data JPA experience.
RESTful API development and service integration.
SQL and relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.
JPA/Hibernate or an equivalent ORM framework.
JUnit and Mockito; unit and integration testing practices.
Git and Maven or Gradle.
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design principles, debugging and coding standards.
Ability to independently deliver low-to-medium complexity application changes.
Comfort using or rapidly adopting GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q Developer, Microsoft Copilot or similar GenAI engineering assistants.
Ability to use AI for code generation, code understanding, refactoring, unit-test creation, debugging, SQL assistance and technical documentation.
Ability to critically review AI-generated code and follow enterprise security, privacy and source-code handling standards.
Other Qualifications
Angular or React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS or Microsoft Azure.
CI/CD using Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman or REST Assured.
Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, batch processing or high-volume data processing.
Data migration and reconciliation experience.
Insurance, banking or financial-services domain exposure.

About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC

Job Description -
Responsible toacquire New Customers for generating Gold Loan business and for other cross sell products

Participate in field- marketing activities toimprove the brand visibility of IIFL Finance Limited branch in the catchment areas and generate leads of prospective customers

Drive & ensure continuous customer engagement through various channels

Maintaining quality portfolio by tracking& controlling ROI

Provide after salesservice to existing customers and obtain references from them to increase thecustomer base

Strong follow up on interest collectionsto keep NPAs (non-performing assets) under control

Candidateswith 6 months of sales experience in Banking & Financial Services can applyfor the role

Fresherswith flair in Sales can also apply

In summary,the role focuses heavily on sales - acquiring new customers, engaging withexisting ones, ensuring portfolio quality, and collecting payments to minimizedefaults

Brand building through field marketing is also a key component

Build upon your classroom studies through our Hotel Internship Program opportunities.

IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Job Title: PPRT Teacher Location: Indore, Radio Colony

Job Overview: We are looking for a warm, responsible, and energetic Daycare & PPRT Teacher to support early childhood learning and provide a safe, engaging environment for young children.

Key Responsibilities:
Supervise and care for children in the daycare and pre-primary section.
Plan and conduct age-appropriate learning activities.
Ensure safety, hygiene, and well-being of all children.
Maintain attendance, daily records, and parent communication.
Support overall classroom management and learning routines.
Requirements:
Minimum 1-2 years of experience in daycare or early childhood teaching.
Strong communication, patience, and child-handling skills.
Ability to create a joyful, nurturing learning atmosphere. Role & responsibilities
AboutCompany:
Podar Education was started and operates with the prime purpose of building young minds to spearhead a dynamic future globally. Podar is a growing network that which has a wide spectrum of brands including pre-primary options, primary, secondary schools, junior colleges, part-time courses and teacher training courses.
Headquartered in Mumbai, there are a host of Podar Schools all across India. Podar offers a wide choice of academic boards including International General Certificate of Secondary Education (IGCSE), International Baccalaureate (IB), Indian Certificate of Secondary Education (ICSE), Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) and Secondary School Certificate (SSC).
Podars key strength emanates from its teaching team. The schools employ the best quality teachers, most of whom have years of experience and a commitment to quality education. National and international trainings are a regular feature to keep the staff abreast with the latest educational developments around the world.
A focus on technology and innovative educational teaching methods has helped Podar establish a leading position among schools in India. In all Podar schools, technology is given special attention and state-of-the-art facilities are available for all the students.
Podar also lays extensive emphasis on sports and extra-curricular activities. Specialized and experienced coaches are deployed in a wide spectrum of sporting disciplines. The schools participate and excel in various inter-school sports tournaments.

IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

POSITION SUMMARY
Check figures, postings, and documents for correct entry, mathematical accuracy, and proper codes. Organize, secure, and maintain all files, records, cash and cash equivalents in accordance with policies and procedures. Record, store, access, and/or analyze computerized financial information. Maintain accurate electronic spreadsheets for financial and accounting data. Classify, code, and summarize numerical and financial data to compile and keep financial records, using journals, ledgers, and/or computers. Prepare, maintain, and distribute statistical, financial, accounting, auditing, or payroll reports and tables. Complete period-end closing procedures and reports as specified. Prepare, review, reconcile, and issue bills, invoices, and account statements according to company procedures.
Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Address guests service needs in a professional, positive, and timely manner. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones and emails using appropriate etiquette. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Role Name: SAP S/4HANA SD / Vistex / CS Consultant
Experience: 4 to 10 Years
Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli
Work Mode: Hybrid
Roles & Responsibilities
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to Sales & Distribution and Customer Service processes.
Configure and implement SAP S/4HANA SD solutions based on business needs.
Design and support Vistex solutions for rebates, chargebacks, incentives, claims, and pricing programs.
Work on Customer Service (CS) processes including service orders, warranty management, and service contracts.
Participate in end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation, rollout, and enhancement projects.
Perform system configuration, testing, defect resolution, and user acceptance testing support.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including MM, FI, PP, and technical teams.

Conduct client workshops, provide solution recommendations, and support go-live activities.
Ensure adherence to SAP best practices and project standards.

Strong hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution (SD).
Mandatory experience in Vistex.
Mandatory experience in SAP Customer Service (CS).
Strong knowledge of:
Order-to-Cash (O2C)
Pricing
Sales Orders
Deliveries
Billing
Credit Management
Returns Process
Experience in Vistex modules such as:
Rebates
Chargebacks
Incentives
Claims Management
Pricing Programs
Minimum one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Implementation project.
Experience in requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.
Integration knowledge with MM, FI, and other SAP modules.
Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.

Experience: 3 Years
Job Title: GCP Data Engineer
Work Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Indore
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled GCP Cloud Engineer with 3 years of hands-on experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, cloud infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, and automation. The ideal candidate should have experience in managing cloud environments and supporting scalable, secure, and reliable cloud solutions.
Required Skills & Responsibilities
3 years of hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Good knowledge of GCP services such as:
Compute Engine (GCE)
Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
Cloud Storage (GCS)
BigQuery
Cloud Functions / Cloud Run
Cloud SQL
Experience with IAM, service accounts, roles, and permissions.
Good understanding of VPC, subnets, firewall rules, and networking.
Experience in deploying and managing applications on GCP.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab, or Cloud Build.
Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
Knowledge of cloud monitoring and logging using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging.
Understanding of cloud security, backup, and disaster recovery concepts.
Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Good to Have
Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer certification.
Knowledge of Python or Shell scripting.
Exposure to DevOps practices and automation.
Understanding of AWS or Azure cloud platforms.
Candidate Expectations
Strong communication and analytical skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period preferred.

Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled Spark Scala Engineer with 5-7 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining large-scale data processing applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Apache Spark, Scala, AWS services, and hands-on experience working on data migration projects. Experience with MongoDB schema validation, cloud-native architectures, and data pipeline optimization is highly desirable.
Roles & Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and optimize scalable batch and real-time data processing solutions using Apache Spark and Scala.
Build and maintain robust data ingestion frameworks for processing high-volume data from multiple source systems.
Participate in large-scale data migration projects, including data analysis, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
Develop and manage ETL/ELT pipelines using AWS services such as EMR, S3, and Step Functions.
Analyze and resolve data quality issues, ensure data consistency, and support production troubleshooting.
Work closely with business stakeholders, data architects, and cross-functional teams to gather and translate requirements into technical solutions.
Implement monitoring, logging, and performance tuning of Spark applications.
Perform schema design, validation, and data modeling activities in MongoDB.
Conduct root cause analysis for data ingestion and processing issues and implement preventive measures.
Ensure adherence to coding standards, security guidelines, and best practices.
Required Skills & QualificationsTechnical Skills
3-6 years of hands-on experience in Scala and Apache Spark development.
Strong experience in building ETL/Data Ingestion pipelines.
Extensive knowledge of AWS Cloud Services, including:
Amazon EMR
Amazon S3
AWS Step Functions
IAM and CloudWatch (preferred)
Experience working on data migration projects involving legacy-to-cloud or platform modernization initiatives.
Strong SQL skills and experience with large-scale data processing.
Hands-on experience with MongoDB, including:
Schema design
Schema validation
Data modeling
Query optimization
Experience in handling structured and semi-structured datasets (JSON, CSV, Avro, Parquet, etc.).
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Agile development methodologies.
l scripting for automating tasks.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in VAPT, API Security and Cloud Security Testing
Good knowledge of OWASP, CVSS, authentication/authorization, IAM and network security
Experience testing Kubernetes, Docker/containers, Linux and REST APIs
Understanding of OpenStack, virtualization, cloud networking and multi-tenant security is highly desirable.
Ability to automate security tests using Python, Bash or similar scripting
Experience: 5+ years in application, cloud or infrastructure security testing.
Roles & Responsibilities
Perform Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) across Private Cloud services including IaaS, PaaS, Kubernetes, containers, storage, network and IAM.
Conduct security testing of REST APIs, web services and microservices aligned with OWASP Top 10 / OWASP API Security Top 10.
Test authentication, authorization, RBAC, session management, input validation, tenant isolation and business-logic security. These are established testing areas in the current security program.
Assess Kubernetes, container, Linux and cloud infrastructure configurations for vulnerabilities and security weaknesses.
Perform dependency, image and container vulnerability assessments using tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Trivy, SonarQube and OWASP Dependency-Check. Trivy, Sonar and OWASP Dependency-Check are already represented in the current security-testing workflow.
Document vulnerabilities with severity, impact, evidence and remediation guidance, and validate fixes through retesting.
Work closely with Engineering and DevSecOps teams to integrate security testing into CI/CD and release security gates.

AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Description:
Position: Cluster Human Resource

Eligibility Parameters:
3-4 years of experience in Human Resource generalist role.

Education Qualification
Minimum : MBA/ PGBDA (HR) (regular course)

Position Reports to : AHR /Zonal HR
Reportees : HR Intern (Wherever applicable)

Required Competencies
Technical Expertise
Communication & Presentation skills
Planning & Organising
Counselling & Coaching
Teamwork & networking
Problem Solving

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities
The most important end-results for which an incumbent would be held responsible at the end of the year.

Manpower Budgeting
Involved in proposing the manpower budgets after taking into account various projections & projected manpower numbers for the coming year.
Allocates the staff in various sub-departments considering various factors like Strengths & weaknesses of each member, GMROL, level of intervention required with the customer (A/B/C), MPA along with DMs & UM
Ensures availability of that manpower as per budgets and checks that budgets are not exceeded beyond permissible limits.
Does availability study periodically, gives feedback to DMs & Supervisors and arrives at solutions for problem areas.

Recruitment, Selection & Induction
Ties up with consultants to meet manpower requirements. Negotiate with them for least possible service fees.
Follows up with consultants for filling up vacancy as soon as possible
Maintains database of applications, rejects
Liases with institutes and colleges for CCA applications
Prepares for and conducts assessment centre for selection
Conducts interviews with UH for selection for all store level positions upto Department Managers.
Evaluates need for placing of advertisements & gets required approvals
Ensures induction schedule is prepared for new joinees, induction goes as per plan, adequate inputs are given and employees are equipped enough before they are on the job.

Training & Development
Prepares training calendar after collating data from PA forms & discussions with concerned Supervisors & DMs.
Does module development on certain training areas
Ensures all infrastructure is in place for internal training programs
Liases with external consultants for specific training needs which cannot be catered to internally & negotiates for best quality at best rate and gets necessary approvals for external trainings.
Ensures smooth execution of trainings.
Ensures training evaluation is done for each program conducted
Liases with Brands/ SO for product/ brand training
Delivers training programs

Payroll Activities
Ensure error-free & timely updation of employee data on system.
Ensures all payroll inputs to be closed as per given timelines with the central payroll team.

Employee Communication & Policy implementation
Communicates employee related policies and ensures adherence to the same
Clarifies queries related to policies and gives feedback on the same to the SO

Welfare Activities
Handles employee grievances at all levels by coaching & counselling
Ensures tie-ups for employees with other institutions like computer institutes, libraries etc.
Ensures execution of employee engagement activities as per annual calaneder.
Activates unit led awards to keep motivation levels high

Statutory Compliances
Liases with consultants to ensure statutory compliances & timely filing of returns.
Ensures statutory compliances are met wrt brand staff, concessionaires etc.

Performance Appraisal
Communicates to the staff the appraisal schedules & process to be followed which are sent be SO
Conducts PA workshops for assessors to throw light on process & common appraisal errors
Ensures regular follow ups to ensure appraisals are done as per time lines
Goes through appraisal forms to oversee the quality of the feedback & comments & evaluate objectivity
Does the normalisation for each supervisor team and communicate ratings as per normal curve back to the supervisors. Make changes, discuss with concerned HODs and arrive at final ratings
Sends collated data to SO
Counsels employees if dissatisfaction arises post increments showing them the organization perspective & the way ahead

Description:
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving B2B customer acquisition for PTL vertical. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
Position: Senior Azure Data Engineer (MS fabric)
Location: Hyderabad/Indore- India
Duration: Full time

Job Description :

Summary
We are looking for dynamic and result oriented cloud data engineers to join our fast-growing Cloud Analytics practice.

Position Summary
Candidate should be self-starters with a passion for business analytics and Data and use their excellent problem solving and analytical skills along with superb written and oral communication skills to develop solutions that delight our customers.
Keep reading if you have a strong desire to excel and are keen to work on end-to-end cloud analytics projects while further developing your career.
Key Responsibilities:
Understand existing landscape and business objectives of the customers.
Translate their explicit and implicit requirements into optimal, scalable, high performance Azure Analytics solution.
Modify existing solutions to enhance, optimize, or to incorporate new functionality.
Ensure high quality of deliverables from self and team.
Provide candid, meaningful feedback and regular progress updates to the team and customer.
Explore how the world of data has evolved and how the advent of cloud technologies is providing new opportunities for businesses to explore.
Learn the various data platform technologies that are available, and how to take advantage of the available technologies for organizational benefit.
Contribute to presales activities including proposals, POC and Demos.
Requirements / Qualifications:
Education:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience & Requirements:
5-8 years of professional work experience with at least 3 years as cloud data engineer preferably in Microsoft Azure.
Well versed with relational databases, nonrelational databases, data streams, and file stores
Should be able to perform data-related tasks in Microsoft Azure cloud analytics platform.
Well versed with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, and Azure Analysis Services (AAS)
Must possess excellent programming skills with SQL, and Python.
Having experience working on spark platform
Should be able to use services and tools to ingest, egress, and transform data from multiple sources, including SAP, within Microsoft Azure.
Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and meet data requirements.
Ability to Design and implement Azure analytics solutions.
Manage, monitor, and ensure the security and privacy of data to satisfy business needs.
Having Azure data engineer associate certification is preferred.
Good to have experience in reporting tools like PowerBI.
Having experience with Snowflake and Snowpro certification is a bonus.
Excellent communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable).

Description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Fiori Developer with ABAP CDS Experience
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated SAP S/4HANA Fiori UI5 Developer (About 4 to 7 years of experience) with expertise in ABAP and CDS. As a member of our dynamic team, you will be responsible for developing and enhancing SAP Fiori applications using Fiori Elements \ UI5 framework, ensuring a seamless user experience and efficient utilization of SAP S/4HANA capabilities.
Responsibilities:
Develop and customize SAP Fiori/UI5 applications using SAP UI5 framework, adhering to Fiori design principles and guidelines.
Design, develop, and implement custom Fiori/UI5 applications based on business requirements, ensuring high performance, responsiveness, and scalability.
Collaborate with functional consultants, business analysts, and end-users to understand business requirements and translate them into technical designs and solutions.
Enhance existing SAP Fiori/UI5 applications by adding new features, optimizing performance, and improving user experience.
Work closely with the ABAP team to develop backend logic and integrate UI5 applications with SAP S/4HANA backend systems using ABAP programming and CDS views.
Develop and maintain SAP Gateway services (OData services) to expose backend data for consumption by Fiori/UI5 applications.
Perform unit testing, troubleshooting, and bug fixing of Fiori/UI5 applications to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Follow best practices and coding standards for SAP Fiori/UI5 development, ensuring compliance with security and data privacy guidelines.
Stay updated with the latest SAP technologies, tools, and frameworks related to Fiori/UI5 development, and proactively apply them to improve application development processes.
Required Skills:
Solid understanding of the Fiori framework and capability to develop custom apps
Experience with SAP Gateway for service creation and OData for data provisioning
Proficiency in integrating SAP back-end systems using OData services
Familiarity with Business Application Studio (BAS) for deploying and managing Fiori applications

Executive - Handover & Snag Management (Real Estate)

Experience: 5-10 Years
Department: Customer Experience / CRM /
Location: Indore

Role Summary
Responsible for managing end-to-end unit handover, snagging, de-snagging, quality inspections, and possession processes for residential and commercial real estate projects. The role ensures timely closure of defects, seamless customer handover, and enhanced customer satisfaction while coordinating with Project, Construction, Sales, CRM, and Facilities teams.

Key Responsibilities
Manage complete handover and possession activities for residential/commercial projects.
Conduct pre-possession unit inspections and identify snag points related to civil, architectural, electrical, plumbing, and finishing works.
Prepare and track snag lists, coordinate with contractors/vendors, and ensure timely de-snagging closure.
Monitor quality standards and ensure units are handed over as per approved specifications.
Coordinate with Construction, MEP, Facilities, and CRM teams for handover readiness.
Schedule and conduct customer walkthroughs and pre-handover inspections.
Address customer observations and ensure closure before possession.
Ensure all statutory approvals, NOCs, documentation, and payment clearances are completed before handover.
Facilitate possession formalities, key handover, and customer onboarding.
Maintain handover MIS, snag/de-snag trackers, possession reports, and customer feedback records.
Drive customer satisfaction and resolve escalations during possession.

Required Skills
Strong experience in snagging, de-snagging, handover, and possession management.
Knowledge of civil finishing, MEP systems, quality control, and defect rectification.
Exposure to residential high-rise and township projects.
Expertise in customer handling and stakeholder management.
Proficiency in MS Excel, CRM systems, and project tracking tools.
Strong problem-solving, coordination, and communication skills.

Qualification
5-10 years of experience in real estate handover, quality inspections, snagging, and possession management.

Job description

Lead overall branch operations, customer service, and retail product marketing. Drive business growth by achieving targets in book size, yield, fee income, and customer quality.

Primary Responsibilities:
1. Drive CASA book growth, yield, fee income, and business quality targets.
2. Manage branch sales and service environment effectively.
3. Build and deepen relationships with retail customers.
4. Plan and execute cross-sell strategies and improve sales productivity.
5. Lead local sales campaigns and promotions.
6. Foster a customer-centric culture that ensures high engagement and satisfaction.

Please share the resume at shubham.gupta07@jana.bank.in
AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Description:
Product Sales Executive (PSE) Institutional Sales
Department: PSD
Function: Institutional Sales
Designation: Product Sales Executive (PSE)
Reporting To: ABM/ Regional Manager
Experience: 3 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location - Mumbai, Kolkata, Patna, Bihar


Job Purpose
The Product Sales Executive (PSE) Institutional Sales will be responsible for driving product
sales and business growth through institutional customers. The role involves identifying new
business opportunities, developing relationships with key institutional clients, generating
enquiries, preparing quotations, negotiating commercial terms, and ensuring achievement of assigned sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and develop new institutional customers and business opportunities.
- Manage relationships with existing institutional clients and ensure repeat business.
- Conduct regular customer visits and understand product requirements.
- Generate leads through market visits, references, networking and other business development activities.
- Present and demonstrate products to institutional customers as required.
- Prepare and submit quotations, proposals and commercial offers.
- Coordinate with internal teams for pricing, product availability, dispatch and delivery.
- Follow up on enquiries, quotations and orders to ensure timely conversion.
- Negotiate with customers within approved company guidelines.
- Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
- Maintain an updated database of institutional customers, prospects and sales activities.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer requirements.
- Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments in coordination with the finance team.
- Handle customer queries and coordinate for resolution of complaints.
- Maintain regular sales reports, visit reports and pipeline updates.
- Support the organization in developing new territories, accounts and product opportunities.

Key Accountabilities / KPIs
- Achievement of assigned sales targets.
- New institutional customer acquisition.
- Revenue and product-wise sales growth.
- Enquiry-to-order conversion.
- Number and quality of customer visits.
- Development of active sales pipeline.
- Customer retention and repeat orders.
- Timely payment/collection follow-up.
- Gross margin as per company guidelines.
- Accuracy and timely submission of sales reports.

Target Customer Segments
The candidate may be responsible for developing business from:
- Corporates and large organizations
- Educational institutions
- Hospitals and healthcare institutions
- Government/semi-government institutions
- Hotels and hospitality organizations
- Dealers/distributors and institutional buyers
- NGOs and other bulk purchasers
- Other B2B/institutional customers relevant to the company's product portfolio

Candidate Profile
Qualification:
- Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Sales & Marketing will be an added advantage.

Experience:
- 3 years of experience in B2B, institutional sales, corporate sales or field sales.
- Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude may also be considered.
Skills Required:
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills.
- Ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
- Target-oriented and self-motivated approach.
- Good presentation and convincing skills.
- Basic knowledge of MS Office/Excel and CRM systems.
- Willingness to travel extensively for customer meetings.
- Ability to work independently.

Desired Competencies
- Business development
- Customer relationship management
- Sales planning and execution
- Negotiation skills
- Market intelligence
- Follow-up and closing skills
- Problem-solving ability
- Time management
- Result orientation

Description:
Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the company's business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan; coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.
Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities - Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Respond to any questions from guests and follow up with guests to ensure their requests have been met to their satisfaction. Take and confirm reservations and cancellations. Supply guests with information regarding property amenities, services, room features, and local areas of interest and activities. Respond to guest requests for special arrangements or services (e.g., spa services, transportation, religious services, babysitting, financial services, business center services, interpretation services, reservations, dry cleaning, entertainment/sporting events, shopping) by making arrangements or identifying appropriate providers. Contact appropriate individual or department as necessary to resolve guest requests.
Collaborate with management to develop and carry-out ideas and procedures and set goals to continuously improve department performance. Assign and ensure work tasks are completed on time and that they meet appropriate quality standards. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Job Title: Service Engineer X-Ray & C-Arm
Company: Trivitron Healthcare
Locations: Bangalore | Chennai | Aurangabad | Ahmedabad
Experience: 2–7 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Job Description
We are looking for technically skilled and customer-focused Service Engineers to handle installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance and breakdown support for our X-Ray and C-Arm product portfolio.
The ideal candidate should have experience in servicing medical equipment, preferably in X-Ray, C-Arm, Radiology or Medical Imaging systems.
Key Responsibilities
Install, commission and maintain X-Ray and C-Arm systems at customer locations.
Diagnose and resolve technical issues and equipment breakdowns within defined service timelines.
Perform preventive maintenance, equipment inspections and functional testing.
Maintain service reports, records and technical documentation.
Coordinate with the Service Head and technical teams for troubleshooting complex issues.
Manage service spares, tools and testing equipment effectively.
Provide basic product operation and technical training to customers.
Support Sales and Applications teams during product demonstrations and customer visits.
Ensure compliance with service, quality and safety procedures.
Maintain strong customer relationships and ensure customer satisfaction.
Travel extensively within the assigned territory as required.
Required Qualifications
Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Biomedical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, Medical Electronics or a relevant discipline.
2–7 years of experience in medical equipment servicing.
Prior experience in X-Ray, C-Arm, Radiology or Medical Imaging equipment is preferred.
Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Experience in installation, commissioning and preventive maintenance.
Good communication and customer-handling skills.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

Sales

DSE Availability monitoring
Monitor Stock holding
Day to day Performance Review & discussions
Problem Solving
Load Out monitoring
Systems/formats at MD point
HSW compliance
Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience

Good communication skills
Sales Planning & Forecasting
Products Services & Technology Knowledge - Consumer
Leads Decision Making & Delivering Results
Analytical Thinking
Building Team Commitment
Must have technical / professional qualifications

Essential : Graduation - Regular
Desired : post - graduation in business management/MBA
work ex: 1 - 4 years
Experience with distribution planning and channel implementation.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Drive business growth and achieve revenue targets across assigned centres.
Build and maintain relationships with referring doctors, hospitals, clinics, and healthcare partners.
Identify new referral sources and business opportunities to increase patient footfall.
Ensure achievement of centre-wise registration, consultation, conversion, and revenue targets.
Coordinate and monitor marketing campaigns, awareness programs, health camps, and outreach activities.
Conduct regular market visits and strengthen referral networks.
Review centre performance and implement action plans to improve business outcomes.
Monitor patient feedback and ensure a high standard of patient experience across centres.
Handle patient escalations and ensure timely resolution of concerns.
Drive patient retention, follow-ups, and treatment continuation rates.
Ensure patient confidentiality and adherence to quality standards.
Conduct regular visits to assigned centres to review operations, service quality, and team performance.
Monitor centre-wise revenue, profitability, and operational efficiency.
Review daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports and take corrective actions wherever required.
Monitor operational expenses and implement cost-control measures.
Ensure accurate billing, revenue tracking, and reporting across centres.
Ensure adequate staffing, infrastructure, inventory, and resources for smooth operations.
Monitor compliance with SOPs, PCPNDT guidelines, and organizational policies.
Identify operational gaps and implement process improvement initiatives.
Provide guidance, support, and performance management to centre teams.
Ensure consistency in service delivery, patient satisfaction, and operational standards across all assigned locations.

Preferred candidate profile
Graduate in any discipline (MBA/MHA preferred).
2+ years of experience in Healthcare, Hospital, IVF, Fertility, Diagnostics, or Clinic Operations.
Minimum 2 years of team handling experience.

Location
Meerut, Uttar Pradesh

Interested candidates can share their resume on mohini.gedam@indiraivf.in
AboutCompany:
About Indira IVF
Indira IVF is a leading fertility clinic in India, with a network of 130+ IVF centers across the country. The clinic provides a wide range of fertility treatments, including in vitro fertilization (IVF), intrauterine insemination (IUI), ICSI (Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection,) egg donation, surrogacy, and fertility preservation. Indira IVF is known for its high success rates, state-of-the-art facilities, and experienced team of fertility specialists. The clinic is committed to providing personalized care and support to every patient on their journey to parenthood.

• Change Management: Implement and oversee production solution changes via the Change Management Process.
• Incident Management: Manage and resolve incidents within the Network Operations environment.
Preferred candidate profile

• Event & Alert Management: Ability to monitor, interpret, and respond to system alerts and events effectively.
• Utility Billing Systems: Familiarity with the processes and systems used for utility billing.

• Technical Support Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities to provide effective technical support to field teams.
• Shift Work: Willingness and ability to work in rotational shifts covering 24x7x365 operations.
• Communication & Coordination: Excellent communication skills with the ability to coordinate among various teams and stakeholders.

Description:
Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.


Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.


Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities
Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills


Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Description:
Job Summary
Function Summary: IRDA Regulation on IMF was released, where companies which are LLP / Pvt limited / cooperative societies were allowed to distribute financial products. IMFs are allowed to deal in Insurance of 6 companies (2LI, 2GI, 2HI), mutual funds, banking products, post etc. Max Life spotted this opportunity to attract established financial distributors from the market to engage and distribute Max Life products - Pearl Acquisition. A dedicated team of 50 CDMs were recruited in two phases and trained to hire and foster these relationships. Currently we have 95 licensed IMFs on board and expected to touch 150 which are work in progress. The pool of IMFs primarily comprises top Agents in Insurance, Wealth Managers, Loan DSA, CA, ex-employees from financial services with an existing customer base. Present IMFs carry avg. 2500 customers and big turnover book. As a later part of Pearl acquisition strategy, Insurance Managers is a career option provided to establish financial distributors who are not able to meet the requirements of forming an IMF. This has also proven to be an exciting opportunity. Insurance Manager is a part-time employee model which provides a platform to the pearl to associate with MLI and improve their earnings, flexible working hours and better choices for their customers. IMFs will be different from an ADM/APC as they will not be recruiting and mentoring Agents and will only source business by penetrating into their existing client base. Avg book size with them is also 750 customers.


Key Responsibilities
Understand the IMF regulation, value proposition registration process
Independently implement the IMF acquisition plan in the territory
Identify potential leads and sources for prospective IMFs, coordinate with HO for referred leads
Connect with prospects, organize seminars for IMF acquisition
Ensure conversion of leads through effective pitch of IMF value proposition
Ensure quality of IMFs in sync with desired profile
Enable the setup of IMFs of agreed prospects
Understand all regulatory requirements and manage the IMF registration process with IRDA
Oversee technology support to enrolled IMFs
Ensure seamless contracting of IMFs with Max Life
Manage performance of setup IMFs in steady state
Develop understanding of products, coach IMF staff on product USP s
Implement a performance management and rewards system
Drive IMF profitability through improving productivity of IMF s, sellers, controlling cost of sales
Provide marketing, training and operational support to IMFs
Manage attrition of IMFs through revival or replacement


Measures of Success
IMF Acquisition
Revenue
IMF Activity Retention
Quality of Business


Qualifications and Experience
Educational Background: Preferably a graduate
Work Experience: At least 5-6 years of experience in Sales Distribution, Key Account Management


Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
Written communication
Presentation skills
Interpersonal skills
Stakeholder management
Partner management
Strategic initiatives management
Program management
Training
Coaching the Partner employees

Description:
Overview
The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customers in resolving policy service needs, renewal collection to resolve policy holder's service needs, cross sale opportunity.


Job Summary
Agent Quality Recruitment
Agent Development
Meeting WFYP Business targets
Conducting Career Seminar for Agents
Communicating Agent RnR regularly


Key Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment -Develop various sources of agent hiring build a team of agent agent pipe line.
Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring
Conduct Career Seminar of prospects
Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms
Agent Development -Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training Field demonstration (FOD s)
Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same
Meet Business Targets -Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc
Ensure companies product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan
Customer Centricity -Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion
Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty
Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need
Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.


Measures of Success
Achievement of business plan GPA
Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Number MTD Active
Persistency as per grid
Number of EC/MDRT agent


Desired qualifications and experience
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience
At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Function Summary
The Bancassurance Department within Axis Max Life Insurance plays a critical role in driving the distribution of life insurance products through our strategic partnership with Yes Bank. This department leverages Yes Bank s existing customer base and infrastructure to offer insurance solutions.
Bancassurance Department serves as a bridge between Axis Max Life Insurance Company and Yes Bank, ensuring that insurance products are effectively marketed and sold to a wide customer base, while maintaining high standards of customer service, compliance, and performance.
Below is a summary of the key functions typically performed by the Bancassurance Department:
Sales and Distribution Management
Customer Relationship Management
Compliance and Regulatory Oversight
Job Summary
This role involves establishing and strengthening relationships with branch managers and staff to generate leads, the candidate will actively participate in branch activities. The incumbent will be responsible for closing sales and ensuring follow-up on issuance.
A key aspect of the role is to increase the bank s customer awareness about life insurance solutions and achieve targeted penetration of cross-sell within the branch s customer base. The candidate will effectively drive reward and recognition programs for bank staff and regularly train them on life insurance concepts and new product introductions.
Key Responsibilities
Establishing strengthening relationship with branch manager staff to gain leads from them.
Involvement in work site activities (putting up stalls and making presentations in corporate.
Closing sale and following up on issuance.
Increasing bank s customer awareness about Life Insurance solutions and achieve the targeted penetration on cross sell within the branch s customer base.
Drive effectively the Reward and recognition programs launched for the bank staff.
Train the bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.
Key skills required
Communication skills
Strategic thinking
Product Knowledge
Problem solving
Time management
Customer relationship management
Deal closing skills
Goal oriented
Customer centricity.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
About the Role:The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving B2B customer acquisition for PTL vertical. As a sales professional, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
New Business Development: Identify and onboard new B2B clients manufacturers, traders, distributors, and retailers who have regular
PTL freight movement needs.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.
Preferred Background & Skills:
1+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.
AboutCompany: Delhivery Limited is India's largest and fastest-growing fully-integrated logistics services player by revenue as of Fiscal 2021. With its nationwide network covering over 17,000 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services. Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 23,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands. For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com
CompanyAddress: PLOT NO. 5 SECTOR 44 GURGAON , GURGAON, Haryana, India

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Preparing the Operation Theater for all elective and emergency operative procedures.
Communication & informing Sr. Consultants, Anesthetist, other OT technician & support staff about all Posted, Elective/Emergency procedure, for timely execution.
Explain patients all required information about procedure in Ward and patient query resolution.
To prepare Patient for Procedure as per Pre-Procedure Check List, clinician & Anesthetist instruction (to do part preparation in absence of Ward Boy).
To ensure that all the necessary consent & payment are done for the procedure. To make sure that all the necessary supplies/needs and surgical instrument are sterile & ready before the procedure
Providing appropriate Surgical Position & doing Scrub, painting & Draping as per the procedure.
Providing assistance as Surgical/Anesthesia assistant during Operative Procedure.
Monitoring patients Vital sign & observing their status during Intra-operative period or in Recovery Room, and informing same to Anesthetist or clinician urgently if abnormality in then is observed.
Collecting, labeling & transporting advised tissue/blood sample, along with TRF to laboratory for testing.
Shifting & Monitoring Patient in Recovery Ward.
Following all standard rules, guideline and achieving compliances as per the policies of universal precaution, Biomedical Hazard, infection control.
Regularly doing emergency drill along with other staff like CPR/AED drills

Position Title: Paramedics/Senior Paramedics
Reports To: Regional Paramedic/Medical Officer I/Medical Officer II

Location: Airport Locations

Job Purpose
To provide timely and effective medical support to employees through medical assessments, emergency care, and regulatory health compliance activities, while ensuring adherence to DGCA and company requirements. The role is responsible for maintaining operational readiness of the Medical Centre, conducting Breath Alcohol Testing (BAT), supporting audits and investigations, managing medical inventories, and contributing to a safe, compliant, and healthy workplace environment.

Key Accountabilities
To conduct pre-flight/post-flight medical checks and maintain all its documentation and records as per prevailing DGCA and company rules. • Conduct Pre-Duty Breath alcohol tests for ground staff and maintains all its documentation and records as per prevailing DGCA and company rules.
To maintain the upkeep of the Medical Centre and address all discrepancies.
Assist in replenishing and certifying the contents of the First Aid Kit, Medical Kit and Universal Precaution Kit.
• Treat the employees and attend to emergencies in the capacity of a paramedic.
Assist in dealing with the casualties of the accidents/medical incidents in the Airport areas for employees of IndiGo, if needed as a paramedic and administer first aid.
Coordinate with emergency services if necessary.
Assist and submit themselves to DGCA/internal audits and investigations, if required.
Maintaining administrative requirements of medical room like monthly stock taking for PFMC related stationery/eqpt, medicine stock, stationery requirements and initiate process for purchase as and when necessary, etc.

Qualifications Essential
GNM/B.Sc Nursing
Valid Nursing Registration

Basic computer knowledge

To recruit, train, and develop a team of Insurance Advisors / Agents and generate business through them. The role involves both recruitment and field sales management to achieve monthly business targets.

- Source and recruit new Insurance Advisors from the local market

- Recognize and nominate top performers for R&R and contests
- Resolve Advisor queries related to commission, payouts, and processes

- Ensure all business is done as per IRDA guidelines
- Verify Advisor KYC and documentation

- Strong interest in sales and people management
- No job gaps in last 2years
- Two-wheeler preferred for field work
- Local market knowledge will be an added advantage

Description:
Programme Overview
India has the world's highest burden of tuberculosis (TB). The National TB Elimination Program (NTEP), led by the Central TB Division (CTD), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, aims to end TB, and expanding access to rapid molecular testing is central to that goal. WJCF has supported the CTD and state health departments on TB, across case detection, access to diagnostics, preventive therapy, private-sector engagement and technical support to governments.
India built a large network of RT-PCR laboratories during COVID-19, and much of it now sits underused. With ICMR having validated an open RT-PCR kit for TB, this network could substantially expand rapid molecular testing for TB. WJCF has supported the Central TB Division's operational feasibility assessment of open RT-PCR for TB, including at IGIMS Patna and Siwan District Hospital.
Before the feasibility assessment was conducted, sites collocated with open real time PCR and NAAT (currently used under the programme) were identified by the State and CTD. These facilities were individually assessed on site by a team of technical experts using a detailed structured checklist. The non-conformities were addressed; kits and consumables were procured; the lab personnel trained subsequently on laboratory practices by the microbiologist followed by demonstration and hands-on practice facilitated jointly by a microbiologist and the manufacturers technical representative.
Learnings from the feasibility assessment encourage scale up of Open Real Time PCR-based testing for TB.

About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving B2B customer acquisition for PTL vertical. As a sales professional, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

New Business Development: Identify and onboard new B2B clients manufacturers, traders, distributors, and retailers who have regular
PTL freight movement needs.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.

Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.
