Description:
Customer Service & Sales -
Greet customers understand their needs, and recommend suitable products and services.
Build rapport with pet parents and provide information about pet care, grooming, and vet services.
Actively upsell and cross-sell products and services to enhance the customer experience and increase basket size.
Handle customer queries and complaints, escalating to the Store Manager when necessary.
Booking & Appointment Support -
Assist customers in booking grooming and vet appointments, both in-store and via digital channels.
Confirm, reschedule, or cancel bookings as needed and inform customers of any service updates.
Coordinate with grooming and vet teams to ensure schedules run on time.
Cashiering & Transaction Management
Processsales transactions accurately through POS/Kiosk systems.
Handle cash, card, and digital payments, issue receipts, and manage refunds or exchanges per policy.
Reconcile daily sales and report any discrepancies immediately.

Stock Handling & Shrinkage Control
Follow FIFO for product replenishment and rotation.
Assist with inward and outward stock checks, ensuring quantities and quality match records.
Monitor shelves for out-of-stock, damaged, or expired items and inform the Store Manager promptly.
Actively support the target of maintaining shrinkage at or below 1.5% of total net sales by adhering to stock handling protocols, promptly reporting suspicious activity, and being vigilant on the sales floor and at POS.
Product Knowledge & Merchandising
Maintain updated knowledge of all product categories, private label items, and new arrivals.
Support merchandising as per planograms to maximise visibility and sales impact.
Teamwork & Engagement
Participate in daily briefings, product training, and team discussions to stay updated on targets and promotions.
Contribute ideasto improve store operations and customer satisfaction.
Support colleagues during peak hours and events.

Compliance & Safety Support
Follow SOPs for hygiene, safety, and pet handling within the store.
Be aware of the stores license requirements and support readiness for official visits or inspections as guided by the Store Manager.
AboutCompany:
Cosmo Films Ltd.

With manufacturing units in India, Cosmo has a BOPP manufacturing capacity of 1,96,000 TPA and CPP manufacturing capacity of 30,000 TPA and a BOPET capacity of 30,000 TPA with a sales turnover of around USD 375 million in FY 2022-2023. With offices spread across all metro cities in India, the USA, Korea, Europe and Tokyo, Japan. The company exports its products to over 100+ countries across the globe. The company also has multiple patents across India and is globally known as one of the global leaders in speciality films. Cosmo Films is also the largest BOPP film exporter from India and the worlds largest manufacturer of thermal lamination films. Over the years, the company has also forayed into the technical film, rigid packaging, synthetic paper, and premium window film businesses.

As a Key Account Manager at Cars24, you will play a crucial role in driving business growth by engaging directly with dealers and car mechanics, building strong networks, and generating procurement leads. Your responsibilities will include:

Key Competencies / Skills
Excellent Relationship Skill
Managing Various level of Bank Management
Adherence to Process


Qualifications

Experience in the fields of Life insurance sales management, Retail bank distribution, and Channel Management and/or DSA relationship

Train the bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.

Communication skills
Strategic thinking
Product Knowledge
Problem solving
Time management
Deal closing skills
Goal oriented
Customer centricity.

Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline

Description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Associate Agency Development Manager to join our team at Axis Max Life Insurance Limited. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in agency development and management, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


Roles and Responsibility
Develop and implement effective agency development strategies to drive business growth.
Build and maintain strong relationships with agents, brokers, and other stakeholders.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide feedback to agents to improve their sales skills.
Identify new business opportunities and develop plans to capitalize on them.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives.
Analyze market trends and competitor activity to stay ahead of the competition.


Job Requirements
Minimum 2 years of experience in agency development or a related field.
Strong knowledge of the insurance industry and its regulations.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with financial products and services is an added advantage.

Description:
Function SummaryRelationship Associate plays a pivotal role in driving business growth by managing branch relationships and collaborating with Axis Bank sellers. The role involves lead conversion, ensuring process adherence, and supporting operational excellence. The incumbent will be responsible for meeting business targets and maintaining customer satisfaction. This position requires consistent coordination with stakeholders and adherence to company guidelines.


Job Summary
Manages branches, collaborates with the objective to support and contribute to Axis bank strategy, achieve operations excellence, ensure systems are deployed and help build the channel WITHIN the company guidelines and the achieve business targets.


Key Responsibilities
Managing relationship with Axis Branch Sellers and thereby meeting target through Bank s FOS
Responsible for managing the leads generated from Branch and thereby convert into quality business.
Must adhere to the process set and timely coordinate with Cluster Manager and Operations HUB. Ensuring minimal customer complain.
Shall adhere to agree TATs on first customer contact and follow-ups from the date of the lead being registered.
Ensuring 15month persistency on track and thereby ensure a robust follow up mechanism with the customers.
Coordinating with Cluster Training manager to ensure bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.
Shall be responsible for making active the branch banking sellers and thereby achieving the activation target
Ensuring LMS usage as Tracking Mechanism on line and follow up Calls


Key Competencies/ Skill Required
Excellent Relationship Skill, Managing Various level of Bank Management , Adherence to Process


Desired qualification and experience
Graduate in Any Discipline from a UGC / AICTE approved College and University.
1 to 2 years of experience in sales, experience in Insurance will be preferred.
Experience in the fields of Life insurance sales management, Retail bank distribution, and Channel Management and/or DSA relationship

Description:
JobProfile



Job Profile

Job Title: Section Manager
Reward Level: Associates 3
Reporting To: Commercial Manager / Store Manager
Qualification: Essential: Any Graduate
Key Deliverables (Essential functions & Responsibilities of the Job) :

As a Section Manager, your key responsibilities include:
Oversee Daily Operations: Manage the daily activities of your section, ensure standards are met, and check that pricing and other legal requirements are followed.
Support Cashiers: Help train cashiers and provide support as needed.
Meet Sales Targets: Ensure your section meets sales goals and contribute to setting these targets. Monitor progress and take action if needed.
Communicate Performance: Keep your team informed about how the department, store, and region are performing towards targets.
Reduce Loss: Minimize stock loss by training your team on proper merchandise handling and stock protection.
Customer Service: Lead by example in providing excellent customer service, understanding and building relationships with customers, and handling complaints effectively.
Visual Merchandising: Follow and enforce visual merchandising guidelines and provide feedback to the visual merchandiser.
Operational Procedures: Ensure all procedures are followed correctly.
Audit Standards: Check areas like fitting rooms and check out for cleanliness and standards.
Product Quality: Help maintain high product quality by reporting any issues to the merchandising team.
Team Development: Train and develop your team, clearly define roles, and give constructive feedback.
Motivate Team: Inspire and motivate your team to achieve sales targets and follow process

Job Summary
This role involves establishing and strengthening relationships with branch managers and staff to generate leads, the candidate will actively participate in branch activities. The incumbent will be responsible for closing sales and ensuring follow-up on issuance.

Key Responsibilities
Establishing strengthening relationship with branch manager staff to gain leads from them.
Involvement in work site activities (putting up stalls and making presentations in corporate.
Closing sale and following up on issuance.

Drive effectively the Reward and recognition programs launched for the bank staff.
Train the bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.


Key skills required
Communication skills
Strategic thinking
Product Knowledge
Problem solving
Time management
Customer relationship management
Deal closing skills
Goal oriented
Customer centricity


Desired qualification and experience
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
2 to 4 years of experience in sales
Good communication skills - English regional language (preferred)
Age group: 22-28 years
Preferably has own conveyance

Description:
Job Summary
Function Summary The Bancassurance Department within Axis Max Life Insurance plays a critical role in driving the distribution of life insurance products through our strategic partnership with Yes Bank. This department leverages Yes Bank's existing customer base and infrastructure to offer insurance solutions. Bancassurance Department serves as a bridge between Axis Max Life Insurance Company and Yes Bank, ensuring that insurance products are effectively marketed and sold to a wide customer base, while maintaining high standards of customer service, compliance, and performance. Below is a Summary of the key functions typically performed by the Bancassurance Department - Sales and Distribution Management - Customer Relationship Management - Compliance and Regulatory Oversight
This role involves establishing and strengthening relationships with branch managers and staff to generate leads, the candidate will actively participate in branch activities. The incumbent will be responsible for closing sales and ensuring follow-up on issuance. A key aspect of the role is to increase the bank's customer awareness about life insurance solutions and achieve targeted penetration of cross-sell within the branch's customer base. The candidate will effectively drive reward and recognition programs for bank staff and regularly train them on life insurance concepts and new product introductions.


Key Responsibilities
Establishing strengthening relationship with branch manager staff to gain leads from them.
Involvement in work site activities (putting up stalls and making presentations in corporate.
Closing sale and following up on issuance.
Increasing bank's customer awareness about Life Insurance solutions and achieve the targeted penetration on cross sell within the branch's customer base.
Drive effectively the Reward and recognition programs launched for the bank staff.
Train the bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.


Key skills required
Communication skills
Strategic thinking
Product Knowledge
Problem solving
Time management
Customer relationship management
Deal closing skills
Goal oriented
Customer centricity


Desired qualification and experience
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
2 to 4 years of experience in sales
Good communication skills
English regional language (preferred)
Age group: 22-28 years
Preferably has own conveyance

Description:
FORVIA HELLA is a listed international automotive supplier. As a company of the FORVIA Group, FORVIA HELLA stands for high-performance lighting technology and vehicle electronics and, with the Lifecycle Solutions Business Group, also covers a broad service and product portfolio for the spare parts and workshop business as well as for manufacturers of special vehicles. With currently around 34,000 employees at over 125 locations, the company is active worldwide and generated adjusted sales of 8.0 billion in the fiscal year 2025.
Design and optimize optical systems, components, and assemblies for product development and engineering applications.
Develop optical layouts, perform ray-tracing analyses, and evaluate performance against technical requirements.
Select lenses, mirrors, coatings, light sources, detectors, and other optical components based on system needs.
Create optical design specifications, tolerance analyses, drawings, and supporting technical documentation.
Build, test, and validate optical prototypes using laboratory instruments and measurement techniques.
Investigate optical performance issues, identify root causes, and implement design improvements.
Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, software, manufacturing, and quality engineering teams to integrate optical solutions.
Support supplier selection, component qualification, and technical reviews for optical hardware.
Ensure optical designs comply with applicable safety, quality, reliability, and regulatory requirements.
Maintain project documentation and communicate design status, test results, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
YOUR QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor s degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
3+ years of experience designing, analyzing, and validating optical systems, components, or assemblies.
Proficiency with optical design and simulation tools such as Zemax OpticStudio, CODE V, LightTools, TracePro, or equivalent software.
Strong understanding of geometrical optics, physical optics, illumination design, imaging systems, lasers, detectors, and optical coatings.
Experience developing optical tolerances, performing sensitivity analyses, and defining alignment and test requirements.
Ability to create detailed optical specifications, drawings, test plans, technical reports, and manufacturing documentation.
Knowledge of optical fabrication processes, including lenses, mirrors, prisms, filters, coatings, and optomechanical assemblies.
Experience collaborating with mechanical, electrical, software, manufacturing, and quality engineering teams throughout product development.
Hands-on experience with optical laboratory equipment, including interferometers, beam profilers, spectrometers, power meters, cameras, and alignment tools.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and project-management skills.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Ensure staff is working together as a team to ensure optimum service and that guest needs are met. Inspect grooming and attire of staff, and rectify any deficiencies. Complete opening and closing duties including setting up necessary supplies and tools, cleaning all equipment and areas, locking doors, etc. Inspect storage areas for organization, use of FIFO, and cleanliness. Complete scheduled inventories and stock and requisition necessary supplies. Monitor dining rooms for seating availability, service, safety, and well being of guests. Complete work orders for maintenance repairs.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; and serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; and identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
PurificationExecution: Processoptimization and execution of downstream unit operations includingclarification (filtration, centrifugation), chromatography (affinity,ion-exchange, multimodal, size-exclusion), and tangential flow filtration (TFF/ UF-DF).
DrugSubstance (DS) Preparation: Perform final formulation, sterile filtration, bulk filling, andfreezing/storage steps to generate compliant Drug Substance for recombinantproteins and viral vaccines.
ViralClearance Inactivation: Execute and validate viral inactivation (e.g., low pH,solvent/detergent) and viral filtration steps in accordance with regulatorysafety guidelines.
ProcessScale-Up Tech Transfer: Support scale-up activities from benchtop (AKTA systems) to pilotand GMP manufacturing scales, authoring technology transfer protocols and batchrecords.
AnalyticalProcess Monitoring: Collaborate with Analytical Development and QC teams to monitor in-processcontrols (IPC), critical process parameters (CPPs), and critical qualityattributes (CQAs) such as host cell protein (HCP), host cell DNA (hcDNA),aggregates, and viral titers.

Technical Skills:
Proficiencyin operating chromatography systems (e.g., Cytiva KTA avant/pure/pilot) andtangential flow filtration (TFF/UF-DF).
Experiencehandling sensitive viral modalities (e.g., live-attenuated, inactivated, viralvectors, or VLPs) and maintaining aseptic/closed-system processing.
Familiaritywith Design of Experiments (DoE) and data analysis.

Additional Competencies
Strongtroubleshooting skills for column packing, membrane fouling, and yieldoptimization.
Abilityto work cross-functionally with Upstream Processing (USP), Analytical, QA, andManufacturing teams.

Description:
Job Title: Sales Manager
CompanyCredila Financial Services Limited
Location Aurangabad
DepartmentSales - Institutional Funding
TravelYes

Job DescriptionA self-driven target oriented individual role with a mix of both Direct and Channel sourcing, involved in building and setting up a network of Channel partners. This involves visiting and building a pipeline of prospective Institutional lending customers seeking loan for the purpose of Institutional development and meeting the channel partners on a regular basis.
Key roles and responsibilities Daily visits to and follow-up with the Educational Institutions falling within the target segment, desirous of seeking a loan.
1. Building a healthy pipeline of logins and sanctions w.r.t the assigned sales target for both Direct and Channel Sourcing.
2. Achieving the target assigned on a month-on-month basis.
3. Understanding the Customers loan requirement and helping them as a SPOC in the end-to-end loan journey from login to disbursement.
4. Coordinating with the customer/s or channel partners and collecting all the required documents mentioned in the policy to ensure a hassle-free loan approval process for the customer.
5. Meet the assigned Channel partners on a regular basis and generate leads/referrals for New Business Acquisition.
6. Maintaining high levels of integrity at all times while engaging with the prospective / existing customers, Channel partners and the various support teams (Credit, Operations, Service, legal etc) within Credila.
7. Training and supporting the Channel partners in understanding the process & policies, joint customer visits and timely release of payouts.
8. Active involvement in fulfilment of the required documents by the Credit and Operations team during the login, approval and disbursement / post disbursement process.
9. Scouting and onboarding potential Channel partners to source business for Credila.
10.Maintaining the portfolio quality at all times by sourcing quality logins as per the defined product and credit policy and ensuring customers regularly pay the EMI dues in time.
11. Active involvement in collection of overdue EMIs from the customers.
12.Building a healthy relationship with all the Customers in the mapped portfolio to fulfill their future loan requirements and prevent them from going to the competition i.e. retention.
13. Deliver quality Customer Service and generate referrals from existing customers.
14. Cross-selling of Insurance & other allied products
Skills
Strong Negotiation skills
Team Worker
Creative (we thrive on this)
Analytical skills
Good communication skills
Perseverance
Nimble-footed
Self-motivated
Qualifications & Experience Graduate in any stream. MBA in Marketing and Finance will be preferred
At least 3 years of relevant Sales experience in Institutional Funding product
AboutCompany:
Credila Financial Services Limited is one of Indias largest education loan non-banking financial companies (NBFCs) offering education loans to Indian students. With an in-depth understanding of the higher education domain in India as well as overseas, Credila offers tailor-made education loan solutions that help enable students to be financially equipped to pursue their education at their dream university and country of study. Since inception, Credila has funded 178,000+ Indian students across 63 countries in 4,600 institutes Mention things you would want to highlight to jobseekers

Description:
Company Description
Heritage Foods Ltd. is one of India's largest and reputable FMCG companies, founded in 1992 by Mr. Nara Chandrababu Naidu. The company has two divisions - Dairy and Renewable Energy, under its flagship Company Heritage Foods Limited. Heritage's milk and milk products have a market presence in multiple states across PAN India.

Role Description
This is a full-time on-site role for a Trade Marketing Executive located in Bangalore & Vijayawada. Trade Marketing Executive will be responsible for Execute trade marketing strategies to boost brand visibility, drive sales, and enhance retailer engagement. This role involves understanding regional market trends, implementing trade programs, and working with sales and marketing teams to support business growth. market planning, utilizing analytical skills, Sales Promotions, and implementing sales & marketing initiatives on a regional level.

Key Result Areas
Trade Marketing Strategy Execution Implement and drive regional trade marketing plans effectively to support business growth.
Sales Growth Contribution Enhance product visibility and drive promotions to achieve targeted sales growth.
Retailer & Distributor Engagement Strengthen relationships with trade partners to improve brand presence and trade participation.
Merchandising & POSM Deployment Ensure proper placement and utilization of POS materials to maximize impact.
Market Analysis & Competitive Insights Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and consumer preferences to refine strategies.
Budget Utilization & ROI Optimize trade marketing spend and assess the return on investment for promotional activities.
Cross-functional Collaboration Work closely with sales, marketing, and distribution teams to align trade initiatives with business goals.
Compliance & Process Adherence – Ensure all trade marketing activities adhere to company policies and regulatory guidelines.

Qualifications
3-8 years of experience in trade marketing, sales, or retail marketing, preferably in the FMCG or dairy industry.
MBA or PGDM in Marketing
28-35 years Old
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
Willingness to travel frequently within the assigned region.

Interested Candidate share there CV's to suryavamsikrishna.k@heritagefoods.in
AboutCompany:
Heritage Group, founded in 1992 by Mr. Nara Chandrababu Naidu, is a prominent and fast-growing public listed company in India. It operates through various divisions, including Dairy, Renewable Energy, and VetCa, all under its flagship company, Heritage Foods Limited (formerly known as Heritage Foods Limited). Heritage Foods limited is known for being a premier provider of pure and fresh milk and value-added dairy products. The company has always been committed to its philosophy and vision of delivering fresh & healthy products to every home.

As of the financial year 2022-23, Heritage Foods has achieved an impressive annual turnover of over Rs. 3,200 crores. The company's products, particularly its milk and milk-based items, have established a strong market presence in several regions across India. These areas include Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Odisha, and the National Capital Region (NCR) of Delhi. Heritage Foods' success can be attributed to its dedication to providing high-quality dairy products and its expansion into various regions of the country.

Description:
Job Title: Loan Officer Gold Loan Sales
Company: Keertana Finserv Limited
Industry: NBFC / Financial Services
Department: Sales & Business Development
Qualification: Any Graduate
Job Description
Keertana Finserv Limited, a Gold Loan Company, is looking for enthusiastic and motivated candidates for the position of Loan Officer across various locations in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
Candidates should be graduates with a strong interest in Sales, Business Development and Customer Relationship Management. Freshers and experienced candidates with good communication and customer-handling skills are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities :
1. Customer Acquisition
Identify potential customers and generate leads through local contacts, referrals, networking and direct marketing.
Convert prospective leads into Gold Loan customers.
2. Field Marketing
Conduct regular field visits and meet prospective customers and local referral sources.
Promote Keertana Gold Loan products, services and schemes.
3. Sales & Business Development
Explain Gold Loan products, basic processes and services to customers.
Generate branch walk-ins, follow up with leads and support loan conversions.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Maintain regular contact with prospective and existing customers.
Develop strong local relationships and generate repeat and referral business.
5. Target Achievement
Work towards assigned daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Focus on lead generation, customer visits, follow-ups, new customer acquisition and business volume.
6. Local Market Development
Identify new customer segments and referral networks.
Participate in branch-level promotional and customer-acquisition activities.
7. Branch Coordination
Coordinate with the branch team for customer handling, loan applications, follow-ups and smooth processing of business generated through field activities.
Eligibility & Requirements
Any Graduate from a recognized university.
Must have a genuine interest in Sales and Business Development.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Compensation & Benefits
Attractive monthly salary.
Additional performance-based incentives based on business achievements.
Opportunity to grow in the NBFC and Gold Loan industry.
Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to apply.
AboutCompany: Keertana is a fast growing Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC) operating in JLG , Gold & MSME Loans Lending. As part of the business activities, the company is predominantly focused into Asset Financing and Lending business.

Description:
We are Licious and we are a Bengaluru based meat and seafood company founded in 2015 by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, our founders, foodies and friends. We pride ourselves on being Indias most successful D2C food-tech brand operating in 20 cities across the country delighting over 32 lac customers with our de-licious fresh meat and seafood!

Think you have what it takes to be the magic ingredient in the recipe that is Licious? Read on

What makes the role meaty?

Oversee daily quality operations, including raw material inspections, in-process checks, finished product
evaluations, and sanitation verification.
Maintain and enforce quality standards in accordance with company policies and industry regulations.
Develop, implement, and maintain Food Safety Management Systems.
Ensure legal compliance is in place.
Prepare for and manage external audits, inspections, and customer quality assessments.
Maintain QA records, verification logs, corrective actions, and traceability documentation.
Lead root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA).
Prepare quality and food safety performance reports for leadership.
Supervise, train, and mentor QA/QC staff.
Conduct ongoing training for plant employees on food safety, hygiene, and quality procedures.
Analyze quality trends and implement process improvements to reduce defects, waste, and customer
complaints.
Collaborate with production, maintenance, procurement, and R&D teams to enhance product consistency and
operational efficiency.

We hope that you have..

Bachelors/Master’s degree in Food Technology, Microbiology, Dairy/Food Science, or related field.
10 –15 years of experience in Quality Assurance/Quality Control — FMCG experience is mandatory.
Must have strong factory or plant-level working experience in quality & food safety.
In-depth understanding of FSMS, HACCP, FSSAI regulations, GMP, GLP, and audit compliance.
Experience handling plant-level audits and cross-functional coordination
Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills

Description:
TSM Tile Adhesive

Role Objective
To drive primary and secondary sales of Tile Adhesive products by expanding dealer and distribution network, improving market penetration, ensuring product availability, and strengthening brand presence within the assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities
Identify, appoint, and develop dealers and distributors to enhance market penetration and increase depth market share.
Analyze sales plans against the previous years performance and implement effective sales actions to achieve assigned targets.
Drive sales activities to ensure consistent volume and value growth across the territory.
Support dealers in achieving targets through regular engagement, guidance, and on-ground training.
Ensure proper seeding of new products across appropriate channels.
Monitor and ensure availability of complete SKU range at key outlets.
Plan and execute sales promotion and brand-building initiatives in the market.
Ensure dealer profitability in line with organizational policies and business objectives.
Prepare and submit monthly territory monitoring reports, including competitor activity analysis.
Conduct regular retail audits to assess market potential and estimate competitor sales, enabling strategic decision-making.
Resolve dealer-related issues promptly to maintain smooth and long-term business relationships.

Education & Qualification
Any Graduate

Experience
4 - 6 years of experience in distribution channel (preferably in Tile Adhesive/Tiles/Waterproofing/Cement)

Desired Skills & Competencies
Strong communication, negotiation, and selling skills.
High energy, self-motivated, and confident personality.
Strong market sensing ability with a focus on converting opportunities into business.
Proactive go-getter attitude with high ownership and initiative.
Ability to work independently and manage assigned territory effectively.

Other Requirements
Candidate should be a local resident of the assigned territory.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned area.

Job Title: Loan Officer Gold Loan Sales
Company: Keertana Finserv Limited
Industry: NBFC / Financial Services
Department: Sales & Business Development
Qualification: Any Graduate
Job Description
Keertana Finserv Limited, a Gold Loan Company, is looking for enthusiastic and motivated candidates for the position of Loan Officer across various locations in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
Candidates should be graduates with a strong interest in Sales, Business Development and Customer Relationship Management. Freshers and experienced candidates with good communication and customer-handling skills are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities :
1. Customer Acquisition
Identify potential customers and generate leads through local contacts, referrals, networking and direct marketing.
Convert prospective leads into Gold Loan customers.
2. Field Marketing
Conduct regular field visits and meet prospective customers and local referral sources.
Promote Keertana Gold Loan products, services and schemes.
3. Sales & Business Development
Explain Gold Loan products, basic processes and services to customers.
Generate branch walk-ins, follow up with leads and support loan conversions.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Maintain regular contact with prospective and existing customers.
Develop strong local relationships and generate repeat and referral business.
5. Target Achievement
Work towards assigned daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Focus on lead generation, customer visits, follow-ups, new customer acquisition and business volume.
6. Local Market Development
Identify new customer segments and referral networks.
Participate in branch-level promotional and customer-acquisition activities.
7. Branch Coordination
Coordinate with the branch team for customer handling, loan applications, follow-ups and smooth processing of business generated through field activities.
Eligibility & Requirements
Any Graduate from a recognized university.
Must have a genuine interest in Sales and Business Development.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Compensation & Benefits
Attractive monthly salary.
Additional performance-based incentives based on business achievements.
Opportunity to grow in the NBFC and Gold Loan industry.
Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to apply.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Assistant Manager / Manager O&M to manage plant operations, production, manpower, safety and maintenance coordination. Candidates must have hands-on experience with Crusher and Screener operations, preferably in mining, steel, metals or heavy engineering industries.
Key Responsibilities
Manage daily plant operations, production, dispatch and shift execution.
Oversee Crusher, Screener and related plant machinery operations.
Coordinate preventive and breakdown maintenance with technical teams.
Manage manpower deployment, attendance, productivity and discipline.
Ensure safety protocols, SOP compliance and regular safety briefings.
Monitor machine availability, diesel consumption, spare usage and operational costs.
Handle client coordination and operational reviews.
Verify daily and monthly operational reports before submission to HO.
Lead onsite teams and ensure smooth plant execution.


Requirements
Minimum 10 years of experience in O&M / Plant Operations.
Mandatory hands-on experience with Crusher and Screener operations.
Experience in Steel, Metals, Mining, Engineering, Construction, Infrastructure or Heavy Machinery industries.
Strong expertise in manpower management, maintenance coordination and industrial safety.
Prior experience as Team Lead / Site In-Charge / Plant Supervisor preferred.
Knowledge of HEMM, plant machinery and industrial safety.
NEBOSH / IOSH / Safety Training will be an added advantage.
Good communication, client-handling and onsite execution skills.
Candidates must be willing to work in Visakhapatnam.

Description:
We re always looking for new ways to raise the bar. So we re searching for a Sales Director with a track record of driving sales and smashing targets to help us fill our rooms, meeting suites and banquet halls.

A little taste of your day-to-day:

Every day is different, but you ll mostly be:
Managing daily sales activities and coaching your team to deliver to their full potential
Hitting all personal and team sales goals to help us maximise profitability
Creating and implementing sales plans that drive measurable incremental occupancy, increase average rates, increase volume, food and beverage and banquet sales
Producing and reviewing monthly reports to monitor performance
Developing and maintaining relationships with key clients and outside contacts

What We need from you:
Bachelor s degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in marketing or related field
Four or more years of experience in a hospitality or hotel sales and marketing setting with direct supervisory experience over a sales team
Strong knowledge of local businesses and business trends required

Other languages preferred

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well - both inside and outside of work - and through our myWellbeing
framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

Description:
Job Description
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants learning their business understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.

Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates

Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Google sheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Title: Loan Officer Gold Loan Sales
Company: Keertana Finserv Limited
Industry: NBFC / Financial Services
Department: Sales & Business Development
Qualification: Any Graduate
Job Description
Keertana Finserv Limited, a Gold Loan Company, is looking for enthusiastic and motivated candidates for the position of Loan Officer across various locations in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
Candidates should be graduates with a strong interest in Sales, Business Development and Customer Relationship Management. Freshers and experienced candidates with good communication and customer-handling skills are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities :
1. Customer Acquisition
Identify potential customers and generate leads through local contacts, referrals, networking and direct marketing.
Convert prospective leads into Gold Loan customers.
2. Field Marketing
Conduct regular field visits and meet prospective customers and local referral sources.
Promote Keertana Gold Loan products, services and schemes.
3. Sales & Business Development
Explain Gold Loan products, basic processes and services to customers.
Generate branch walk-ins, follow up with leads and support loan conversions.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Maintain regular contact with prospective and existing customers.
Develop strong local relationships and generate repeat and referral business.
5. Target Achievement
Work towards assigned daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Focus on lead generation, customer visits, follow-ups, new customer acquisition and business volume.
6. Local Market Development
Identify new customer segments and referral networks.
Participate in branch-level promotional and customer-acquisition activities.
7. Branch Coordination
Coordinate with the branch team for customer handling, loan applications, follow-ups and smooth processing of business generated through field activities.
Eligibility & Requirements
Any Graduate from a recognized university.
Must have a genuine interest in Sales and Business Development.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Compensation & Benefits
Attractive monthly salary.

Description:
Job Title: Loan Officer Gold Loan Sales
Company: Keertana Finserv Limited
Industry: NBFC / Financial Services
Department: Sales & Business Development
Qualification: Any Graduate
Job Description
Keertana Finserv Limited, a Gold Loan Company, is looking for enthusiastic and motivated candidates for the position of Loan Officer across various locations in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
Candidates should be graduates with a strong interest in Sales, Business Development and Customer Relationship Management. Freshers and experienced candidates with good communication and customer-handling skills are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities :
1. Customer Acquisition
Identify potential customers and generate leads through local contacts, referrals, networking and direct marketing.
Convert prospective leads into Gold Loan customers.
2. Field Marketing
Conduct regular field visits and meet prospective customers and local referral sources.
Promote Keertana Gold Loan products, services and schemes.
3. Sales & Business Development
Explain Gold Loan products, basic processes and services to customers.
Generate branch walk-ins, follow up with leads and support loan conversions.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Maintain regular contact with prospective and existing customers.
Develop strong local relationships and generate repeat and referral business.
5. Target Achievement
Work towards assigned daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Focus on lead generation, customer visits, follow-ups, new customer acquisition and business volume.
6. Local Market Development
Identify new customer segments and referral networks.
Participate in branch-level promotional and customer-acquisition activities.
7. Branch Coordination
Coordinate with the branch team for customer handling, loan applications, follow-ups and smooth processing of business generated through field activities.
Eligibility & Requirements
Any Graduate from a recognized university.
Must have a genuine interest in Sales and Business Development.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Compensation & Benefits
Attractive monthly salary.
Additional performance-based incentives based on business achievements.
Opportunity to grow in the NBFC and Gold Loan industry.
Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to apply.
AboutCompany: Keertana is a fast growing Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC) operating in JLG , Gold & MSME Loans Lending. As part of the business activities, the company is predominantly focused into Asset Financing and Lending business.
CompanyAddress: 2, PLOT 31 32, RAMKY SELENIUM TOWERS Nanakramgud a Main Road, Hyderabad, Rangareddy , Hyderabad, Telangana, India

Job Purpose
To manage and drive distribution KPIs of prepaid distributors in order to attain market leadership in Area allocated within the Prepaid Distribution Segment.
Drive growth, in terms of subscriber base, revenues, market share, complying with retail service norms, to ensure ROI of Channel partners along with handling FOS.
Focus on Channel Infrastructure and Channel Ecosystem to increase the customer acquisition and Data market share at assigned Area.
Key Result Areas/Accountabilities
Ensure the desired product availability up to the last point of the market. 
Ensure that the distributors/ retailers maintain adequate stocks of all company products and merchandise as per norms.
Ensure the availability of required manpower at distributorships as per plan and monitor their conduct/ behavior
Build trust and relationship with distributors / retailers and company by clearing any doubts/confusions and providing solutions to any issue within a reasonable time frame.
Work with circle marketing in management of schemes/ promotions/ contests being run to promote the company brand.
Ensure flow of knowledge, skills and training from company to the dealer/ retailer staff to ensure output as per targets. Assess training requirements on an ongoing basis.
Coordinate with training content and service providers to implement training.
Establish retail channel schemes at the zonal level based on corporate guidelines and with the approval of the circle/zone sales head.
Ensure targeted productivity norms for the channel.
To ensure Proper retail penetration.
To ensure required distributor manpower is on board
To ensure training to the distributor manpower
Build and develop the retail team. Enhance team motivation and productivity levels. Assist HR in identifying team-training inputs.

 Build and develop a team. Enhance team motivation and productivity levels. Assist HR in identifying team-training inputs.
Supervise MIS generation and analysis on a periodic basis and provide feedback on best practices to the zonal head.
Execution of Zonal level brand promotion, print advertisement layout within the budgetary provision & ensuring maximum output from the same.
Adaptive in technological changes and capable of educating the team  members and  trade with regards to the usage  of various Applications.
Capable of planning the infrastructure, for  future ready of the Organisation.
Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience
Good communication skills
Good interpersonal skills
Able to handle team
Distribution knowledge
Hands on exposure in MS Office

Graduation / MBA

Division/Department: Sales

Purpose of the Admission Officer role:
The admission officer advises students-parents for their learning needs through structured Counselling Sessions to improve student outcomes and help students succeed academically.

Contribute towards revenue generation by working on the sales targets.
Selling/up-selling/cross-selling the company's exclusive range of education courses to existing & prospective students.
Responsible for converting new/ qualified leads into successful admissions, in turn achieving the assigned sales target.

Ensure adherence to internal process and compliances.

quired to have:
Ability to handle students and parents in an empathic & patient manner

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and writing emails & comfortable while working on software related to sales & services.
Fluency in English and Regional Language.

Customer Orientation
Sense of Ownership and Accountability.
Result orientation
Emotional intelligence for working in a team.

Must have bachelor's degree.
Preferred BTech / MBA /Masters in Psychology, Education etc.

Experience:
Previous experience in counselling in education or careers counselling.
Previous experience of Business to Customer (B2C) sales across industries.

We are looking for an experienced Area Sales Manager CCGI Doors & Windows with strong expertise in Government sales and market development.

The candidate will be responsible for achieving sales targets, developing relationships with CPWD, PWD, MES & Housing Board Departments & managing the sales team, and expanding business opportunities within the assigned territory.

Desired Candidate Profile
10 to 12 years of relevant experience in Government Sales of CCGI Doors & Windows.
Strong understanding of the CCGI Doors & Windows market and Government sales cycle.
Proven experience in handling CPWD, PWD, MES & Housing Board Departments
Good knowledge of the assigned geographical market and customer network.
Strong team-handling, negotiation and business development skills.
Fluent in English and the local language.
Graduate / Post Graduate from a reputed institution.
Key Responsibilities
Drive monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets for the assigned territory.
Develop Government business for CCGI Doors & Windows through CPWD, PWD, MES departments.
Identify and develop new business opportunities
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers and channel partners.
Develop a strong project pipeline and ensure timely conversion of leads into orders.
Lead, guide and motivate the sales team to achieve business objectives.
Prepare and implement territory-wise sales and business development strategies.
Conduct regular market visits and track competitor activities, pricing and market trends.
Understand customer/project requirements and provide appropriate technical and commercial solutions.
Coordinate with internal operations/technical teams for smooth execution of sales orders.
Follow up on order processing, dispatch, collections and outstanding payments.
Resolve customer queries and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
Maintain regular sales reports, project pipelines, forecasts and MIS.
Identify opportunities for increasing market share and expanding the company's presence in the assigned territory.
Perks and benefits Incentives and Travel Allowance are in addition to CTC

Job Description Fleet Manager

Role Overview:
Responsible for managing end-to-end fleet operations, rider availability, deployment planning and last-mile delivery performance across assigned locations.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage rider hiring, onboarding, roster planning and shift allocation.
Monitor rider availability, fleet utilization, DPH and asset availability.
Track live orders, delivery TAT, delays, BTO and DNR cases.
Handle rider unavailability, vehicle breakdowns and operational contingencies.
Coordinate with store teams and central operations for issue resolution.
Manage fleet planning during festivals, peak days and new store launches.
Monitor open orders, cancellations, serviceability issues and escalations.
Prepare operational MIS reports and track performance against targets.

Key Skills:
Fleet Management, Last-Mile Operations, Rider Management, Manpower Planning, Fleet Utilization, Delivery Operations, MIS Reporting and Stakeholder Management.

Description:
Muthoot Finance is hiring Field Sales Officers LAP for Vijayawada, Nandigama, Guntur, Eluru, And Kalidindi Locations.
This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for freshers looking to start their career in Sales and Financial Services. Prior LAP or financial-services sales experience is NOT required. Training will be provided.

Key Responsibilities
Generate LAP business through field visits, local market sourcing and customer acquisition.
Identify and approach potential customers for Loan Against Property (LAP) products.
Conduct customer visits and understand their loan requirements.
Explain LAP product features, eligibility criteria and documentation requirements.
Build and maintain relationships with customers, connectors and local market contacts.
Collect and verify customer documents required for loan processing.
Coordinate with internal teams for application processing, approval and disbursement.
Follow up with customers throughout the loan process.
Maintain accurate records of leads, customer interactions and sales activities.
Achieve assigned sales and business targets while following company policies and compliance requirements.

Candidate Eligibility
Freshers are welcome to apply.
LAP experience is NOT required.
Candidates who have completed Intermediate, Graduation or Post Graduation can apply.
Age: Up to 26 years.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to work in a field sales role and interact with customers.
Interest in sales, business development and customer acquisition.
Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.
Male candidates only.

Compensation & Job Details

CTC: 2.30 LPA
Location: Vijayawada
Experience: 01 Years (Freshers Welcome to apply)
Employment Type: Full Time
Industry: Banking / Financial Services

Description:
Job Description – Area Sales Manager (FLSP)
Location: Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh
Department: Sales & Business Development
Designation: Area Sales Manager – FLSP
Industry: IVD / Medical Diagnostics / Healthcare
Experience: 5–8 Years
Employment Type: Full Time
Salary: 8–10 LPA
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Area Sales Manager to drive business growth and manage sales operations in the assigned territory. The candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, managing customer relationships and achieving sales targets in the medical diagnostics and IVD segment.
Key Responsibilities
- Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve business targets.
- Manage sales operations across the assigned territory.
- Generate new business opportunities in the IVD and medical diagnostics segment.
- Develop and maintain relationships with hospitals, diagnostic laboratories and healthcare institutions.
- Manage distributors, dealers and channel partners.
- Promote diagnostic products and medical equipment.
- Conduct product presentations, demonstrations and customer meetings.
- Identify market opportunities and monitor competitor activities.
- Coordinate with technical and service teams to ensure customer satisfaction.
- Prepare sales reports and provide regular updates to management.
- Ensure achievement of monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
Candidate Requirements
- Graduate in Science, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry or Life Sciences.
- MBA in Marketing will be an added advantage.
- 5–8 years of relevant experience in IVD, medical diagnostics or healthcare sales.
- Strong experience in territory management and business development.
- Experience handling distributors and key accounts.
- Excellent communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
- Ability to achieve sales targets and develop business relationships.
- Willingness to travel within the assigned territory.
Key Skills
IVD Sales, Medical Equipment Sales, Diagnostic Equipment Sales, Territory Management, Business Development, Healthcare Sales, Hospital Sales, Laboratory Sales, Distributor Management, Channel Partner Management, Key Account Management and Customer Relationship Management.
AboutCompany:
Transasia Bio-Medicals Ltd is India’s largest In Vitro Diagnostics Company and offers solutions and products in Biochemistry, Hematology, Coagulation, ESR, Immunology, Urinalysis, Critical Care, Electrophoresis, Molecular Diagnostics, Diabetes Management and Microbiology.

Transasia was incepted in the year 1979 and is headquartered in Mumbai.

Transasia is a part of the global Erba Diagnostics Mannheim GmbH Group. The Erba Transasia Group has spread its footprint across USA, UK, Europe, Turkey and Eastern Europe, Russia and France, by means of various acquisitions – Erba Germany, Erba Czech Republic, Erba Russia, Erba Turkey, Erba France, Erba Diagnostics (USA), Erba Molecular (UK), Diamedix (USA), Delta Biologicals (Italy), ImmunoVision (USA), JAS Diagnostics Inc. (USA) and Drew Scientific (USA). Today, the Erba Transasia Group serves millions across 100 countries.

Transasia manufactures and markets Equipment and Reagents, with an impressive installation base of above 50,000 equipments across India.

Transasia’s commitment to healthcare has been recognized by various awards and accolades, the latest one from the World Economic Forum which conferred the organization with ‘Global Growth Company Award, 2014’, ‘Most Indigenous Medical Equipment Devices Company’, ‘Pioneer for the Make in India Concept’ Award, by the Hon’ble Minister of Science & Technology & Earth Sciences, Government of India and recently was bestowed with the ‘Maker in India’ Award 2015.

With a vision of being recognized as a ‘local for global’ organization, Transasia continues to provide doctors and patients with reliable, affordable and innovative Medical Diagnostic Systems.

Description:
Job Description Trainee Cluster Internal Auditor
Role Overview:
The Trainee Cluster Internal Auditor will assist in conducting branch audits across the assigned cluster, ensuring compliance with company policies, SOPs and operational guidelines. The role involves verifying loan documentation, gold appraisal procedures, branch operations and employee conduct.
Roles & Responsibilities:
Verify loan applications, KYC documents, loan files, agreements and other mandatory records.
Check gold weight, purity, valuation and appraisal procedures as per company guidelines.
Conduct regular and surprise branch audits across the assigned cluster.
Review loan processing, disbursements, collections, repayments and daily branch activities.
Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs, attendance and employee conduct guidelines.
Identify missing documents, discrepancies and operational irregularities and report them to the reporting authority.
Prepare branch-wise audit reports and follow up on audit observations and corrective actions.
Key Requirements:
Willingness to travel across assigned branches.
Good observation and attention to detail.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and documentation.
Good communication and reporting skills.
Interest in audit, finance and branch operations.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
AboutCompany: Keertana is a fast growing Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC) operating in JLG , Gold & MSME Loans Lending. As part of the business activities, the company is predominantly focused into Asset Financing and Lending business.

Description:
Job Description
Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance

The Associate Agency Development Manager is responsible for driving business growth through the recruitment, development, and management of a team of insurance agents. This role involves identifying potential agents, conducting training sessions, and providing ongoing support to ensure agents meet their sales targets. The successful candidate will be focused on achieving branch sales goals, enhancing agent performance, and maintaining strong relationships with agents to foster a motivated sales environment. Key responsibilities include developing business plans, analyzing market trends, implementing sales strategies, and ensuring compliance with regulatory guidelines.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and onboard new agents to build a robust sales team.
- Design and implement training programs to enhance agents sales skills and product knowledge.
- Set performance targets for the team and monitor progress, providing feedback and support as needed.
- Foster growth and maintain motivation among agents through consistent communication and mentorship.
- Analyze sales data and market trends to develop effective sales strategies.
- Collaborate with management to align team goals with organizational objectives.
- Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements in the insurance sector.
- Organize performance assessments and identify areas for improvement for agents.

Skills Required:
- Strong leadership and team-building skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to analyze data and market trends effectively.
- Proficient in sales strategies and customer relationship management.
- Strong problem-solving abilities and decision-making skills.
- Proven track record in sales and business development in the insurance sector.

Tools Required:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software (e.g., Salesforce, Zoho CRM).
- Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Data analysis tools for sales tracking and performance monitoring.
- Online training platforms for agent development.
- Communication tools (e.g., email, video conferencing software).

Description:
Job Purpose:
Responsible for evaluating and underwriting loanapplications received via digital channels

Focus on quick, accuratedecisioning with policy adherence, KYC verification, fraud checks, andcoordination with stakeholders to achieve seamless, paperless disbursements

Key Responsibilities:
Evaluate digital loan applications within definedturnaround time (TAT) using scorecards and policy rules

Perform digital KYC, bureau checks, income surrogates,and fraud screening; escalate suspicious cases

Prepare concise credit notes/CAMs for non-STP orexception cases; recommend decisions as per DOA

Ensure accurate documentation and track post disbursement document (PDD)closure where applicable

Coordinate with sales/operations for clarifications,rework, and smooth disbursement

Monitor early vintage performance/FPD for approvedcases and provide feedback to improve filters

Adhere to underwriting policy, regulatoryrequirements, and internal audit standards, clear QA observations & PDs ofspecific cases

Skills Required:
Strong analytical and decision-making skills

Knowledge of retail lending credit policies andscorecards

Proficiency in digital KYC, fraud control, and MIStools

Attention to detail and compliance orientation

Educational Qualifications and Experience:
Graduate / Post-Graduate in Finance, Commerce, orrelated field

13 years in credit appraisal/underwriting; experiencein digital/fintech lending preferred

Description:
Job Description Branch Head (Sales )
Department: Sales & Marketing
Experience: 812 Years

1. Job Summary
We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Branch Head to lead the branch's sales, marketing, admissions, and operational activities. The incumbent will be responsible for achieving branch revenue targets, driving business growth, managing the sales team, developing institutional partnerships, and ensuring an excellent customer experience throughout the student lifecycle.
The ideal candidate should have strong leadership capabilities, business acumen, consultative sales experience, and the ability to drive team performance and operational excellence.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities
A. Sales & Business Development
Achieve branch revenue targets and Annual Business Plan (ABP).
Develop and execute regional sales and marketing strategies.
Identify new business opportunities across B2B and B2C segments.
Manage the sales pipeline, monitor conversions, and forecast monthly revenue.
Build strong relationships with schools, principals, coordinators, educational institutions, and corporate clients.
Explore new market segments and drive business growth.

B. Marketing & Lead Generation
Plan and execute marketing activities across the assigned region.
Organize seminars, school campaigns, open seminars, residential township activities, and corporate events.
Participate in relevant promotional activities to increase brand visibility and market share.
Ensure effective merchandising and product displays to drive customer engagement and sales.
Monitor competitor activities and identify market opportunities.

C. Student Lifecycle & Admissions Management
Drive the complete student lifecycle, including prospecting, counselling, admissions, orientation, and post-admission support.
Ensure effective lead management, follow-ups, and admission conversions.
Interact with parents and educational institutions to understand their requirements and provide need-based solutions.
Ensure timely resolution of customer queries and grievances to maximize customer satisfaction.

D. Team Leadership & Performance Management
Lead, motivate, and manage the branch sales and operations teams.
Conduct regular training on product knowledge, sales processes, and service offerings.
Monitor daily sales activities, team productivity, and admission performance.
Build strong collaboration between academic, sales, and operations teams.
Address employee concerns, sales-related conflicts, and pricing issues promptly.
Drive employee engagement and ensure a positive working environment.

E. Branch Operations & Business Governance
Manage end-to-end branch operations and ensure process compliance.
Prepare and review MIS reports, sales dashboards, and business performance reports.
Monitor daily sales activities and admission management processes.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders, including Product, Marketing, Academic, and Operations teams.
Ensure effective execution of business strategies and operational standards.

3. Required Skills & Competencies
Strong experience in consultative sales and business development.
Excellent leadership, team management, and people management skills.
Strong business acumen and target-oriented approach.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure.
Excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills.
Self-motivated, innovative, proactive, and result-oriented.
Strong interpersonal skills and stakeholder management capabilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Knowledge of South Indian regional languages is mandatory.

4. Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
MBA will be an added advantage.
8–12 years of relevant professional experience.
Candidates with experience in Education, Teaching, Training, Insurance, or Pharma industries are preferred.
Prior experience in branch management, sales leadership, business development, and team handling is desirable.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Achievement of monthly and annual revenue targets.
Lead generation and admission conversion ratios.
Branch profitability and business growth.
B2C business development.
Team productivity and individual target achievement.
Customer satisfaction and grievance resolution.
Operational efficiency and process compliance.
Market penetration and competitor tracking.

Ideal Candidate Profile: A strong business leader with proven sales performance, excellent team-handling capabilities, and the ability to independently manage branch-level business operations while driving sustainable revenue growth.
AboutCompany:
About Us
Aakash Educational Services Ltd. (AESL) is one of India’s most trusted names in test preparation, known for providing students with a competitive edge through classroom, digital, hybrid and distance learning programs. We specialize in coaching for major medical and engineering entrance exams such as NEET and JEE (Main & Advanced), as well as school/board examinations, scholarship tests, and Olympiads.
Our philosophy of “Student First” drives everything we do. With highly qualified and passionate faculty, we focus on understanding each student’s unique learning needs and guiding them to achieve their goals. AESL is committed to expanding its reach nationwide, delivering high-quality education to students in every corner of the country, including regions where access to physical classrooms is limited.
We are proud to be certified a Great Place to Work ® for five consecutive years.
Aakash Advantage
As a leader in competitive exam preparation, AESL offers a workplace where passionate individuals can make a lasting difference. What sets Aakash apart:
Nationwide Presence and Growth: With more than 400 branches across India, AESL provides employees ample opportunities to grow within a leading educational brand.
Student-Centric Culture: Over 10,000 employees collaborate with expert faculty members, united in their commitment to mentoring and building the success of students.
Cutting-Edge Technology: Aakash’s fully digitized classrooms and hybrid learning models combine traditional teaching with advanced digital methods, keeping employees at the forefront of educational innovation.
Proven Impact: Aakash’s results speak for themselves, with 9 Lakh+ NEET and JEE qualifiers over the years, including All India Rank 1 in NEET and JEE (Advanced).

Role Description
The position is for an Apprenticeship - PB Operations based out of Mumbai and reporting to the Head, Controls - Operations (NPC).

Tracking deadlines for Key Operating document (KOD) for PB Operations and follow-ups with stakeholders for timely upload of KODs on policy portal.

Revisit Key Performance Indicator (KPI) for each Ops related process and modify / re-define time and motion.
Follow-up and publication of End of Day checklist for Operations.
Assist in drafting BRDs for Ops and follow-up on deliverables with stakeholders to ensure timelines are met.
Reconciling of vendor bills.
Other Operations related activities which may be assigned from time to time.
Your skills and experience
Good knowledge of Excel, Word, and Power point presentation.
Excellent communication skills.
Education | Certification (Recommended):
Bachelor Degree from an accredited college or university
Education/ Qualifications

How we ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression

About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits etc
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep ie while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service

CTC Upto 3 Lacs ( for Non-Metro) / 4

20 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry
