Description:
As a Digital Transformation Specialist, you will lead a high-impact portfolio, connecting technology and business needs and delivering concrete results. You will be responsible for developing, implementing and executing IT capabilities within this area of expertise, planning and building IT solutions from business functions. You will work in a multinational team, conducting one or more projects/programs, and be the single focal point (SPOC) between IT Technology and the business for these transformation projects/programs. They will also be responsible for interacting with functional leaders and business units to monitor and execute projects/programs.
How you'll make an impact
Execute the PLM strategy, aligning it with digital transformation objectives and driving business value in the engineering and manufacturing areas
Integrate PLM with ERP, MES, and downstream systems, ensuring seamless data flow and process integration
Act as a promoter of the Digital Thread and configuration management, expanding traceability, collaboration and decision-making along the value chain
Optimize cross-functional processes using Lean and Six Sigma, with a focus on BOMs, process plans, roadmaps, and supply chain integration
Engage business and IT stakeholders, capturing complex requirements and facilitating global collaboration
Drive PLM governance and change management, supporting the adoption of new tools and continuous improvement initiatives
Act as a reference expert in PLM, guiding teams and supporting training on platforms such as Windchill or Teamcenter
Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable internal and external standards, procedures and guidelines.
Your background
Relevant experience in IT and digital transformation, with a strong background in Computer Science or Engineering and deep knowledge in PLM systems and strategy
Experience in leading global PLM transformation programs in engineering and manufacturing, with hands-on experience in Windchill, Teamcenter or similar platforms
Advanced knowledge of the processes that connect PLM to manufacturing, including mBOMs, process plans, routings, and integration with ERP and MES
Proven ability to manage third-party vendors and virtual delivery teams on a global scale, ensuring alignment across distributed stakeholders
Application of Lean, Six Sigma and Industry 4.0 concepts for optimization of cross-functional processes in engineering, supply chain, quality and procurement
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English and proven experience in multicultural and multinational environments
Travel availability of up to 30%, supporting deployments at global engineering plants and sites, as well as stakeholder relationships
More about us
We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.
We can provide more information during the recruitment process.

Our benefits offering for this role generally includes:
Private medical care and life insurance
Access to fitness and wellness programs
Access to benefits platform with discounts and perks
Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
Equipment for working from home or allowances for setting up a workplace at home
Spectacles and contact lenses allowance
Company events and team-building activities
Psychological support program
Free parking available
You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

Position: API Automation Test Engineer
Experience: 2 to 13 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai

Required Skills
2-13 years of experience in software testing with strong expertise in API Automation Testing.
Hands-on experience in API automation using Rest Assured, Postman, and Swagger/OpenAPI.
Strong programming skills in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
Experience in testing and automating RESTful APIs, Web Services, JSON, and XML payloads.
Good understanding of TestNG, JUnit, Maven, Gradle, and Git.
Experience working with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI.
Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and SDLC/STLC processes.
Experience in database testing using SQL and backend validation techniques.
Knowledge of defect tracking tools such as JIRA, Azure Boards, etc.
Understanding of API authentication and security mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0, JWT, and Basic Authentication.
Experience in integration testing, regression testing, and microservices testing.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.
Work with large datasets to perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis.
Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.
Monitor model performance and retrain models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Research and implement the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.
Ensure adherence to data security, governance, and ethical AI standards.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Statistical Modeling.
Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.
Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, and big data technologies.
Location
Bangalore (Hybrid/Onsite/Remote)
Employment Type
Full-time

Description:
About the Role:
Hurix Digital is looking for an accomplished business and operations leader to lead the next phase of growth across our Content, Technology and AI Data Services businesses. This is a senior enterprise leadership role with responsibility for business operations, delivery, revenue realization, profitability, customer success, people leadership and organizational capability. The EVP will work closely with the CEO and the leadership team to build a predictable,profitable and scalable operating organizationone that delivers consistently for customers,develops strong leaders and enables sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities:

Business & P&L Leadership
Own operational performance across Content, Technology and AI Data Services.
Drive revenue realization, gross margin, EBITDA, productivity, utilization and cost optimization.
Lead annual operating plans, forecasting, capacity planning and business reviews.
Partner closely with Finance, Sales and business leaders to make informed decisions on growth, investments, costs and profitability.
Ensure that signed business translates into successful, profitable and sustainable delivery. The role should carry genuine business accountability; the earlier EVP framework similarly linked the position directly to growth, profitability, revenue and margin outcomes.

Delivery & Operational Excellence
Build a strong operating rhythm through dashboards, metrics, forecasting, reviews and early-warning mechanisms.
Strengthen delivery governance and establish a high-performing PMO Excellence capability.
Improve predictability across quality, timelines, capacity, productivity and margins.
Build systems and processes that reduce dependence on firefighting and individual heroics.
Drive continuous improvement through technology, automation and AI-enabled workflows.

Customer Leadership
Act as a senior executive sponsor for strategic customers.
Build strong relationships with customer leadership teams and participate actively in QBRs, reviews and critical engagements.
Lead major escalations and ensure strong recovery and closure.
Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales on solutioning, commercials, feasibility and transition of new opportunities.
Identify opportunities for account expansion and deeper customer partnerships.

People & Leadership
Build and develop a strong second line of leaders across operations and delivery.
Assess leadership capability, identify talent risks early and take decisive action where the organization needs stronger talent.
Coach high-potential leaders and create clear succession and development plans.
Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and high performance.
Be a visible and accessible leader, especially during critical business and delivery situations.
Ensure that business growth is achieved without compromising team health,leadership quality or organizational sustainability.
People and customer outcomes were already explicit components of the prior EVP incentive framework through Client Happiness, Team Happiness and People/Customer/Revenue Impact.

AI Data Services & Technology
Play a key role in scaling Hurixs emerging AI Data Services business.
Bring strong business understanding of data operations, human-in-the-loop models,expert talent ecosystems, quality, throughput, productivity and margin.
Strengthen the Technology business by connecting technology capability with customer needs, solutions and profitable delivery.
Drive practical adoption of AI and automation across operations to improve speed,quality and business economics.

Enterprise Leadership
Operate as a trusted partner to the CEO and leadership team.
Provide clear visibility into business performance, risks, customer concerns and people issues.
Surface problems early, bring data-backed recommendations and take ownership for execution.
Work effectively across Sales, Finance, HR, Solutions and other functions to drive enterprise outcomes.
Act as a strong leadership presence on the ground and help translate strategy into execution.

Experience & Background:
We are looking for a leader with approximately 20+ years of experience, including significant responsibility for large-scale operations, delivery or business-unit leadership.
The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
Meaningful P&L and business ownership, beyond project or delivery management.
Experience leading large, complex and multi-disciplinary teams.
Strong track record of driving revenue realization, profitability, productivity and operational predictability.
Executive-level customer management and experience handling strategic accounts.
Demonstrated ability to build strong leadership teams and second-line capability.
Strong numerical and analytical orientation with experience using dashboards,forecasting and operating metrics.
Experience in solutioning, pre-sales, commercials and transition from Sales to Delivery.
Exposure to AI/Data Services, technology services, digital services, learning/content services or adjacent knowledge-intensive businesses.
Strong partnership experience with Finance on business planning, revenue, cost and profitability.
Experience working with global customers and distributed teams.
Prior experience in digital learning or content services is valuable but not mandatory.
We are equally interested in leaders from technology, data and digital services who bring the right combination of business, customer, people and operating leadership.

Leadership Traits We Value
We are looking for someone who can combine:
Structure without bureaucracy.
Speed without chaos.
Customer obsession without organizational burnout.
Commercial ambition with delivery discipline.
High standards with strong people leadership.
Data-driven thinking with sound judgement.


Values:
Get stuff done
Move fast with purpose
Win with ideas
Sweat the details
Deliver great customer experiences
Make your teammate successful


Perks:
Health Insurance
Kwench Library (Klib)

Hybrid Work Model

Why Join Hurix Digital?
Hurix Digital is building on its established strength in global content and digital learning while expanding its Technology and AI Data Services businesses. This role offers the opportunity to influence not just how work is delivered, but how businesses scale, how leaders are built, how customers experience Hurix and how the operating model evolves in an AI-first environment. For the right leader, this is a high-impact enterprise role with significant autonomy, visibility and the opportunity to shape Hurixs next phase of growth.

Job Description Senior DevSecOps Engineer
Company: Hurix Digital
Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview
Hurix Digital is seeking an experienced Senior DevSecOps Engineer to strengthen security across AWS cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and production environments. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in cloud security, security automation, vulnerability management, and incident response, ensuring secure and efficient software delivery.

Key Responsibilities
Design and implement AWS security controls, including IAM, SCPs, KMS, VPC, and multi-account governance.
Integrate security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA, and secret scanning) into CI/CD pipelines.
Manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security using Terraform and policy-as-code tools.
Secure containerized environments using Docker, ECS, and Kubernetes security practices.
Implement secrets management, identity federation, and access controls.
Lead vulnerability assessments, risk-based remediation, security monitoring, and incident response.
Automate security compliance processes aligned with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
Conduct threat modeling, strengthen software supply chain security, and mentor engineering teams.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience in AWS cloud security, including IAM, Organizations, Control Tower, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, and CloudTrail.
Expertise in CI/CD security, preferably GitHub Actions, with tools such as Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, and Dependabot.
Proficiency in Terraform and security tools such as Checkov, tfsec, OPA, or Sentinel.
Experience securing ECS/Kubernetes environments, container images, and runtime workloads.
Knowledge of AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, OIDC, and SSO.
Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and Bash.
Experience in vulnerability management, SIEM integration, threat modeling, and incident response.
Understanding of security compliance frameworks and software supply chain security, including SBOMs and artifact signing.

Preferred Skills
Experience implementing automated compliance and security governance.
Familiarity with STRIDE, SLSA, and Sigstore.
Strong security architecture, risk assessment, and stakeholder communication skills.
Ability to mentor developers and drive security best practices across engineering teams.

Ideal Candidate

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and passionate Full Stack Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have experience working across both frontend and backend technologies, possess strong problem-solving skills, and be capable of collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain responsive web applications using modern frontend frameworks.
Design, build, and manage backend services, APIs, and databases.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers, product managers, and stakeholders to implement business requirements.
Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.
Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards.
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives.
Integrate third-party services and APIs as needed.
Continuously evaluate and implement emerging technologies and best practices.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
3-8 years of experience in Full Stack Development (adjust based on requirement).
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript.
Experience with frontend frameworks such as:
React.js
Angular
Vue.js
Experience with backend technologies such as:
Node.js
Java
.NET
Python
Knowledge of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases:
MySQL
PostgreSQL
MongoDB
SQL Server
Familiarity with Git version control systems.
Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with cloud platforms:
Microsoft Azure
AWS
Google Cloud Platform
Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
Understanding of security best practices and OAuth/JWT authentication.
Experience with automated testing frameworks.
Technical Skills
Frontend
HTML5
CSS3
JavaScript (ES6+)
TypeScript
React.js / Angular / Vue.js
Bootstrap / Tailwind CSS
Backend
Node.js / Express.js
Java Spring Boot
ASP.NET Core
Python Django / Fast API
Database
MySQL
PostgreSQL
MongoDB
SQL Server
Tools & Platforms
Git/GitHub/GitLab
Azure DevOps/Jenkins
Docker
Kubernetes
Postman
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Nice to Have
Experience working in enterprise-scale applications.
Exposure to AI/ML integrations.
Knowledge of serverless architectures.
Experience in DevOps and infrastructure automation.
Location
Bangalore / Hybrid / Remote (as applicable)
Employment Type
Full-time
AboutCompany:
Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 46 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. Hiring: TSS Real Estate

Location: BANGALORE
Work Mode: Work from Office + Field Visits
Experience: Property Sales preferred

Salary -17000 per month fixed

About the Role

We are looking for a Business Development Associate (BDA) who will work closely with property owners and prospective tenants to facilitate property transactions and close deals.

The candidate will receive leads from the company, visit properties with clients, understand owner requirements, identify potential tenants, and drive the deal to closure.

Key Responsibilities
Handle company-generated leads and connect with potential clients/tenants.
Visit properties and show them to prospective tenants/clients.
Travel approximately 3040 km daily for property visits and client meetings.
Understand and manage property owner requirements.
Identify suitable and potential tenants based on property requirements.
Coordinate between property owners and tenants throughout the transaction.
Conduct property visits, explain property details, and address client queries.
Negotiate and follow up with both parties to close the deal.
Maintain regular follow-ups with leads until closure.
Build strong relationships with property owners and clients.
Maintain updated records of leads, property visits, follow-ups, and closures.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Real estate knowledge is preferred.
Good understanding of property types, location, configuration, and surface/built-up/carpet area.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Good convincing, negotiation, and sales skills.
Comfortable with daily field travel of 3040 km.
Ability to understand client and owner requirements and match them effectively.
Target-oriented and strong in follow-ups.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple property/client requirements.
Ideal Candidate

Someone who is sales-driven, confident in client interactions, comfortable with field work, and has a good understanding of the real estate market.

If you enjoy meeting clients, exploring properties, and closing real estate deals, this role is for you!e & responsibilities

The opportunity:
The Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 2600+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project Management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energys units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.The Inventory Management Lead will play a vital role in ensuring effective inventory control and data accuracy across global operations. By collaborating with internal teams and stakeholders, this role will focus on minimizing excess inventory, standardizing processes, and improving data integrity within the organization. The Inventory Management Lead will provide actionable insights, optimize stock utilization, and drive alignment across plants worldwide, contributing to operational efficiency and strategic business objectives.
How youll make an impact:
Lead the implementation of the GA SCM TTL strategy in collaboration with internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment with global policies, processes,systemsand the defined governance model.
Partner with GA Hubs and Global Product Groups (GPGs) toconsolidatevolume data andvalidateGA TTL budget forecasts,targetsand planning assumptions.
Act as the key liaison with the TTL Center of Expertise (CoE), reviewing centrally managed initiatives and coordinating their effective implementation within GA.
Monitor TTLCoEservice-level performance and drive corrective actions or improvement initiatives whererequired.
Track GA SCM TTL initiatives in close alignment with the TTLCoE, ensuring progress, risks and dependencies are clearly visible.
Drive standardization, processharmonizationand supplier consolidation across GA Hubs and GPGs.
Engage GA Hubs and GPGs toidentify, develop andconsolidatea pipeline of opportunities supporting delivery of the GA TTL cost reduction (CR) and cost avoidance (CA) plan; conduct regular reviews tomonitorprogress against targets.
Act as a change agent by building awareness, supporting stakeholder engagement and enabling the successful rollout of new TTL projects,toolsand processes.
Provide regular and ad hoc updates on TTL topics, regulatorychangesand compliance requirements;identify,addressor escalate gaps to ensure GAremainscompliant.
Collaborate with counterparts across other Business Units to exchange knowledge, benchmark performance and implement relevant best practices.
Represent GA in relevant workshops and provide input on GA forecasts,performanceand annual TTL budget planning.
Support best-in-class delivery against Hitachi Energy KPIs, includingmaintainingaccuratepurchasing information records (PIRs), such as material weights and country of origin data.
Undertakeadditionalresponsibilities asrequiredto support the team and evolving business priorities.
Your background:
Bachelors degree in engineering, supply chain management,logistics, businessadministrationora relateddiscipline.
Minimum of five yearsrelevant experience in supply chain management, transport, trade,logistics,procurementor a related operational environment.
Experience working in cross-functional,matrixedor global organizations, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business units,functionsand geographies.
Knowledge of SAP or similar enterprise systems is desirable.
Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong commercial awareness, with an understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements or a willingness to develop thisexpertise.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management,negotiationand influencing skills.
Proactive and accountable, witha strong senseof ownership and the ability to drive topics forward independently.
Structured,collaborative,and results-oriented, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver outcomes in a dynamic environment.
Analytical and solutions-focused, with strong problem-solving capability and attention to detail.
Comfortable working across cultures and countries, with a mindset that supports collaboration, continuousimprovementand change adoption.

Job Description: Data Engineer / Data Warehouse Developer
Experience: 4 to 7 Years

Core Technologies: Google BigQuery (GBQ), dbt, Python, Informatica IICS, SQL
Role Overview
We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer / Data Warehouse Developer with 47 years of experience in building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable data engineering and data warehousing solutions. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in SQL, Python, Google BigQuery, dbt, and Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS), along with a solid understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL/ELT development.
The candidate will develop robust data pipelines, implement complex transformations, automate data engineering processes using Python, optimize BigQuery workloads, and deliver high-quality, analytics-ready datasets to support business intelligence and analytical use cases.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and transformation workflows using BigQuery, dbt, Informatica IICS, Python, and SQL.
Develop complex SQL queries and reusable transformation logic to process large volumes of data efficiently.
Build and maintain dbt models, including incremental models, data tests, documentation, and dependency management.
Develop Python scripts and utilities for data processing, pipeline automation, validation, reconciliation, and operational monitoring.
Use Python libraries and APIs to integrate data sources, automate repetitive tasks, and streamline data engineering workflows.
Develop and support ETL/ELT integrations using Informatica IICS, including mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, scheduling, and error handling.
Apply data warehousing principles to design dimensional models, fact and dimension tables, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions.
Optimize BigQuery query performance and cost through efficient SQL, partitioning, clustering, and execution-plan analysis.
Implement data quality checks, automated validations, reconciliation processes, and exception handling.
Troubleshoot pipeline failures, investigate data discrepancies, and resolve production issues.
Use Git and established CI/CD practices for source control, code reviews, testing, and deployments.
Collaborate with business analysts, BI developers, architects, and other engineering teams to deliver reliable, business-ready data products.
Maintain technical documentation and follow engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, and maintainability.
Required Technical Skills
1. Python
Strong hands-on programming experience with Python for data engineering and automation.
Proficiency in writing reusable, modular, and maintainable Python code, including functions, classes, exception handling, and logging.
Experience with data manipulation and processing using libraries such as Pandas and NumPy.
Ability to develop scripts for data validation, reconciliation, file processing, automation, and operational support.
Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, CSV, and other common data formats.
Understanding of Python package management, virtual environments, dependency management, and debugging.
Ability to write efficient code, handle large datasets, and implement robust error handling and logging.
2. Google BigQuery (GBQ)
Hands-on experience developing and optimizing complex SQL queries in BigQuery.
Strong understanding of datasets, tables, views, materialized views, and BigQuery architecture.
Experience with partitioning, clustering, query execution analysis, and cost optimization.
Ability to design scalable data models and efficiently process large datasets.
Familiarity with integrating BigQuery workloads with Python-based applications or automation.
3. dbt (Data Build Tool)
Hands-on experience developing and maintaining dbt models using SQL and Jinja.
Understanding of dbt project structure, model dependencies, materializations, and incremental models.
Experience implementing dbt tests, source definitions, documentation, and lineage.
Familiarity with Git integration, automated testing, and CI/CD-based deployments.
4. Informatica IICS
Hands-on experience with Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services for data integration and transformation.
Experience developing mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, and data integration workflows.
Understanding of source-to-target mapping, scheduling, error handling, and operational monitoring.
Ability to troubleshoot and optimize ETL workflows.
5. Data Warehousing and SQL
Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture and ETL/ELT design patterns.
Expertise in dimensional modeling, star and snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, and SCD Types 1 and 2.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, subqueries, and query optimization.
Understanding of staging, curated, and business-ready data layers, incremental loading, CDC concepts, and data quality management.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Functions.
Experience automating cloud operations and data workflows using Python and APIs.
Familiarity with shell scripting and Linux/Unix environments.
Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker or Power BI.
Exposure to Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and reusable data products.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and using Jira.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4–7 years of relevant experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or ETL/ELT development.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Description:
Regulatory, Risk & Forensic
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.
Position Summary
Level: Consultant or equivalent
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
Work youll do:
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic Operate professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries. 
We support clients by delivering Operate services spanning the Regulatory, Risk & Forensic portfolio. We embed continuous advantage through domain, industry, technology / Gen AI, and transformation skills to perform client business functions that manage risk and deliver value - added outcomes.
The Consultant will be responsible for completing timely and high-quality validation activities, as well as, for identifying issues, validation concerns, and observations, recommending corrective actions, presenting results of validation reviews, interfacing with business partners, and writing reports. Additionally, in this role, you will:
Plan and complete testing within required timeframes and in accordance with established processes and procedures
Applying risk analysis principles, determine the scope, including focus, objectives, and rationale
Develop testing strategies, including procedures and selection of samples, sample size, and rationale 
Prepare working papers, ensure that documentation appropriately supports the testing conclusions, and document process flows and describe major processes within the area being reviewed
Analyze the results of testing and review activities. Analyze exceptions and make recommendations to enhance internal controls
Ensure that testing is accurate, complete, and in accordance with standards and protocols. Communicate test/review results and issues/concerns to leadership, validating and recommending resolutions to issues
Effectively communicate the testing or validation process, status, and results to business and risk partners
Write and/or review reports or presentations that clearly articulate the results/conclusions of testing or validation activities
Effectively communicate with leadership and escalate validation concerns or issues as appropriate
Identifying and implementing efficiencies and process improvements
Complete assigned activities in accordance with established processes and procedures under limited supervision
Actively participate in learning & development opportunities to ensure the use of best-in-class processes and procedures
Proven client-facing experience with strong relationship-building skills
Experience in coaching and mentoring junior team members
Developing clear and concise reporting to be shared with leadership
Assist in managing change to ensure an effective risk management program
The team: 
We are experts in :
Providing FinCrime Operate solutions to optimize cost, quality, and effectiveness of FinCrime operations, including transaction monitoring, fraud investigations, Know Your Customer, screening, and controls testing, leveraging GenAI, technology platforms, and data analytics.
Comprehensive Discovery and data analysis support, preservation, collection, processing, hosting, and production using advanced technologies and GenAI.
Industrialized testing and transformation of regulatory, risk, and compliance processes, driving efficiency with automation, GenAI, and technology.
Dynamic, cost-effective risk monitoring using expert resources and technology to quickly identify elevated risks and potential noncompliance.
Qualifications
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in in risk management (includes control testing, issue identification and validation, compliance, financial crimes, operational risk, internal audit, business process management)
Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
Financial services knowledge: compliance, risk management, audit operations
Experience in testing procedures; evaluating policies, processes, controls; identifying compliance issues
Public accounting experience in audit or SOX advisory/consulting
Intermediate Microsoft Office skills
High responsibility, initiative, accountability
Excellent communication skills
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail
Ability to interact across organizational levels
Education: 
B. Com / BBA or similar 3 year graduate course
M.Com / MBA or similar post grad course (Tier 2/3 colleges)
Location:
Hyderabad , Bangalore, Chennai
The professionals are expected to work from Office all 5 days in a week.
Shift Timings: 
11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirements. Role & responsibilities


Preferred candidate profile

Description:
As an AES Guidewire ClaimCenter Business Analyst Senior Associate you will help shape and support Guidewire ClaimCenter work within our Advisory practice, focusing on business analysis, client support, and the delivery of enhancements that improve insurance operations and user experience. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build meaningful client relationships, mentor junior team members, and apply critical thinking to navigate ambiguity while strengthening your personal brand and technical skills. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will contribute to Application Evolution Services for Guidewire by gathering requirements, interpreting feedback, evaluating process impacts, and supporting solution development for deployed ClaimCenter environments.
Responsibilities
Demonstrates expert abilities managing ITIL Processes; Tracking SLAs, and contracting;
- Demonstrates advanced abilities providing solution strategy and Application Evolution Services (AES, formerly AMS) delivery as a Guidewire Functional Lead. Employees in the Functional Lead position should think of themselves and be regarded by the client as a trusted advisor and think strategically about how to create value using the Guidewire Suite of products;
- Demonstrates expert abilities with ITIL Incident and Problem management for the Guidewire Suite of applications as it will be critical that Senior Business Analyst in this position are capable of navigating both business processes as well as enterprise solution perspectives at high level and holistic view;
- Demonstrates expert abilities and/or a proven record of success in leading proposal development efforts; Senior Business Analyst in these positions should be capable of delivering Advisory-level work and be able to discuss future enhancements in Guidewire roadmap discussions with the client;
- With a focus on AES, demonstrates expert organization skills and abilities assisting clients in the support of Guidewire Suite solutions and improving business processes; and taking a proactive approach to quality;
- Analyzing Guidewire ClaimCenter business needs and translating them into functional requirements for insurance operations
- Supporting client service workstreams across enhancements, defect resolution, and production support for deployed Guidewire solutions
- Configuring and validating Guidewire ClaimCenter functionality while coordinating with technical teams on integrations and system changes
- Reviewing user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria to clarify scope and identify implementation impacts
- Interpreting business feedback and data points to recommend process improvements and application adjustments
- Mentoring junior team members on Guidewire concepts, delivery methods, and issue resolution approaches
- Collaborating across application, testing, and support teams to track work progress and address dependencies
- Applying problem-solving skills to diagnose system issues, evaluate options, and support timely resolution of incidents and enhancements
- Contributing to continuous improvement efforts by identifying automation, tooling, and process opportunities within application support
What You Must Have
- Expertise in ClaimCenter and working knowledge on Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ContactManager - leading requirement gathering sessions, conduct analysis, develop functional specifications and perform business walkthroughs;
- User story creation/updation, developing process flows, UI mock ups, and developing data mapping in the standard Guidewire recommended user stories;
- Familiarity with Use case, SWOT analysis, Mindmapping, PESTLE analysis; Product Designer
- Usage of Tools JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, Splunk and familiarity with SQL
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4-9 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

Description:
Third Party Pay Roll
Officer - Costing & Budgeting
Location: Bangalore RO
Experience Required
Minimum 4 years of experience in Costing & Budgeting.
Mandatory experience in handling Real Estate Projects (Residential, Commercial, Mixed-use developments).
Job Purpose
The objective of this position is to prepare and monitor construction budgets, estimate quantities, perform cost analysis, and support effective cost control for real estate projects. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate cost estimation, budget monitoring, rate analysis, and timely reporting.
Key Responsibilities
Cost Estimation
Preparation of BOQs and quantity estimation based on construction drawings.
Analysis and interpretation of drawings received from Structural Consultants, Architects, and MEP Consultants.
Preparation of project cost estimates for residential and commercial real estate developments.
Assist in budget planning during project feasibility and execution stages.
Cost & Budget Monitoring
Preparation of detailed project budgets and periodic budget revisions.
Monitor project costs against approved budgets and identify variances.
Track budget vs. actual expenditures and provide recommendations for cost optimization.
Prepare and submit monthly cost monitoring reports to management.
Rate Analysis
Conduct rate analysis for various construction activities and materials.
Maintain and update cost databases considering location-wise and project-specific parameters.
Evaluate vendor quotations and support procurement teams in cost comparison exercises.
Develop benchmarking data for residential and commercial projects.
Reporting & Coordination
Prepare MIS reports related to project costs, budgets, and forecasts.
Coordinate with Project, Procurement, Contracts, and Finance teams for cost tracking and control.
Support management in decision-making through cost analysis and reporting.
Key Competencies
Strong knowledge of construction costing, budgeting, and estimation.
Ability to read and analyze architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
Proficiency in MS Excel and cost estimation tools.
Good analytical and reporting skills.
Attention to detail and ability to work within timelines.
Key Deliverables
Timely and accurate cost estimation.
Effective project budget preparation and monitoring.
Accurate rate analysis and cost benchmarking.
Monthly budget variance and cost monitoring reports.
Cost optimization recommendations for real estate projects.
This version aligns the role to an Officer level and emphasizes the requirement of 4+ years of experience in real estate project costing and budgeting.

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the worlds mostinnovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as theyprovide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days arethe same.
Job Description
Your Role
Creation, modification, and revision of AMM (Aircraft Maintenance Manual) content for Airbus aircraft programs.
Develop and update maintenance procedures in accordance with Airbus documentation standards and guidelines.
Airbus tool experience is mandatory.
Good understanding of Airbus standards, tools, processes, and technical publication guidelines.
Analyze engineering source data, drawings, specifications, and change requests to develop accurate AMM content.
Perform impact analysis and incorporate technical changes into the relevant maintenance procedures.
Ensure technical content meets quality, accuracy, consistency, and compliance requirements.
Coordinate with engineering teams, illustrators, reviewers, and other stakeholders for technical clarifications.
Guide and mentor Junior Authors/Preparators/Proofreaders when required.
Your Profile
6+ Years of experience in AMM Authoring for Airbus aircraft programs.
Strong knowledge of Aircraft Maintenance Manual structure, maintenance procedures, and technical documentation.
Hands-on experience working with Airbus technical publication processes and authoring environment.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, source data, and other engineering documents.
Experience in source data analysis, technical analysis, and impact analysis.
Good understanding of engineering changes and their impact on technical publications.
Experience in XML/SGML-based technical documentation and authoring tools will be an advantage.
Strong attention to detail with good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently while maintaining high levels of accuracy and quality.
Experience mentoring team members and supporting process improvement initiatives will be an added advantage.
What You'll Love About Working Here
We value flexibility and support our employees with hybrid work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence.
At Capgemini, you can work on cutting-edge projects in technology and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.

SAP MDG Consultant

Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)

Experience:
JL4: 2-5 Years
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years


About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

Mandatory Skills
SAP MDG
Data Governance
Data Quality Management
Data Replication
Data Validation
Material Master
Business Partner Master
Customer Master
Vendor Master
Financial Master Data
Good to Have
SAP Information Steward
SAP Data Services (BODS)
SAP MDG on S/4HANA
Workflow Configuration
Business Rules Framework (BRF+)
Data Modeling
Master Data Consolidation
Data Cleansing
Data Harmonization
SAP S/4HANA Integration
Master Data Management Processes
SAP Migration Cockpit
SAP Cloud Integration
SAP Fiori for MDG
SAP BTP Exposure
Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Senior Engineering Manager
 Your role and responsibilities:

Throughout project execution, you adhere to cost, quality, and schedule targets, report any safety, compliance, cybersecurity, or contract concerns, and ensure all engineering deliverables are completed and updated for successful project closure.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

Description:
Job description
Interview mode-Face to face
Locations-Chennai, Bangalore
Shifts-US Shift timings
Cab-Two way Cab Facility available
Night Shift allowance also available

Role Overview
The role involves assisting shareholders with buying and selling shares in accordance with established procedures and service standards. The candidate will also handle customer queries and provide operational support under appropriate guidance and supervision.

Key Responsibilities
Handle inbound calls and emails from shareholders, addressing their queries within agreed service standards.
Assist shareholders with share purchase and sale transactions over inbound calls.
Resolve basic customer queries and escalate complex issues to senior team members when necessary.
Support the team in completing daily workloads and meeting operational targets.
Continuously develop operational knowledge and skills while identifying opportunities to improve processes and service quality.
Perform additional duties of a similar nature as required.
Follow company policies, procedures, quality standards, and reporting requirements, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory and statutory obligations.
Carry out all responsibilities in accordance with the requirements of the company's regulators.
Adhere to established physical and information security procedures to protect company and customer information.
Ensure all activities comply with the applicable quality management system.
Follow scheduled break timings to maintain operational efficiency and meet Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Work according to the designated US business holiday calendar.

Required Skills, Experience, and Competencies
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and telephone communication skills, with strong active listening abilities.
Shift Flexibility: Willingness and ability to work in US shifts.
Customer Support Experience: Previous experience in a customer service or customer support role
Target Achievement: Ability to meet targets related to accuracy, quality, productivity, and agreed service levels.
CRM Knowledge: Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and practices.
Data Protection and AML: Basic understanding of data protection principles and Anti-Money Laundering (AML).
Customer Focus: Ability to understand customer needs and adapt communication styles to different personalities.
Time Management: Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and manage time effectively.
Compliance and Process Adherence: Ability to follow established procedures, policies, and regulatory requirements.
Teamwork: Willingness to support team members and contribute beyond assigned responsibilities.

Manager – Learning & Development (Manufacturing & Sales)
You will be leading end-to-end capability building across manufacturing operations and commercial sales teams. This role aligns technical, operational, and sales training programs with business goals to improve shop-floor safety and productivity as well as field sales effectiveness.
Key Responsibilities
F Training Needs Analysis (TNA): Partner with plant heads, production leads, and sales leaders to identify skill gaps, operational bottlenecks, and revenue enablement needs.
F Manufacturing & Technical Capability: Design and oversee programs covering SOPs, machinery/process operations, quality standards, EHS/safety compliance, lean/operational excellence, and new-hire plant induction.
F Sales Enablement & Capability: Build and deliver training on product knowledge, consultative selling, objection handling, territory/channel management, CRM adoption, and sales onboarding.
F Program Design & Delivery: Develop blended learning solutions—including hands-on shop-floor coaching, workshops, field ride-alongs, and LMS/e-learning modules—using internal SMEs and external trainers.
F LMS & Governance: Manage the Learning Management System (LMS), training calendars, compliance tracking, vendor contracts, and the L&D budget.
F Impact & ROI Measurement: Track completion, assessments, on-the-job transfer, safety/quality metrics, and sales KPIs to evaluate and refine programs.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Should have 6–10+ years in L&D or corporate training, with demonstrated exposure to both manufacturing/industrial environments and sales/commercial teams. Hindi Speaking is a must.
2. Instructional design, facilitation and coaching, stakeholder management with plant and sales leaders, LMS/analytics proficiency, and willingness to travel to plants and sales territories.
3. Prior experience working as a learning and development manager
4. Knowledge of learning and developmental theories and practices
5. Demonstrable communication, organisational and time management skills
6. Learning Needs Analysis
7. Content Creation/Instructional Design
8. Organizational Development
9. Talent Management
10. Leadership Development
11. Team Leadership
12. Project Management
13. Vendor Management
14. Learning & Development Metrics
15. Budget Management
16. Ability to bring innovative Learning & Development ideas and proposals to the team that can improve associate career development.

Director Fund Raising And CSR (Philanthropy)
Responsible for cultivating relationships with donors, planning and executing fundraising campaigns and events, researching prospective donors, writing grant proposals, managing donor databases, and tracking financial goals to secure financial support for a non-profit's mission. Responsibilities include strategic planning, communication, donor stewardship, budget management, and reporting on fundraising progress to ensure organizational sustainability and growth.
Key Responsibilities>:
Donor Cultivation & Stewardship: Developing and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with individual, corporate, and foundation donors to secure ongoing financial support.
Campaign & Event Management: Planning, organizing, and executing fundraising campaigns and events, including community-led initiatives and major donor cultivation events.
Prospect Research: Identifying and researching potential donors, sponsors, and grant-making foundations interested in supporting the organization's mission.
Proposal & Grant Writing: Researching opportunities and writing persuasive grant applications and fundraising proposals to secure financial contributions.
Database & Financial Management: Creating and maintaining accurate donor databases, tracking donations, preparing financial reports, and managing budgets to meet fundraising goals.
Communication & Marketing: Creating fundraising materials, such as presentations, brochures, and thank-you letters, to effectively communicate the organization's mission and needs.
Fund Raising

Manage and maintain donor databases and records.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align fundraising efforts with our mission
and objectives.

1. A bachelor's degree in fields like Social Work, Nonprofit Management, or a related area is often preferred and experience of 10 Plus Years in fundraising, event planning, nonprofit work, volunteers, and community members etc.
2. The ability to develop and implement successful fundraising strategies that align with organizational goals.
3. Proven track record of successful fundraising efforts, with a focus on raising immediate funds.
4. Organizational: Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities to manage multiple projects and events simultaneously.
5. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including writing, editing, and public speaking.
6. Strong abilities to build and nurture relationships with diverse groups of people, including donors,
Career Focus
1. Fundraising in philanthropy is a people-focused role that requires strong empathy and communication to understand what inspires potential donors and to articulate the benefits of their support.

Description:
Job Summary
Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 3000+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energy's units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy. To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
Mission Statement: As a Tender/Quotation Specialist for Distribution Transformer Factory - Egypt, you will be part of Indian Operation Center in India (INOPC), aiming to develop a global value chain, where key business activities, resources and expertise are shared across geographic boundaries to optimize value for Hitachi Energy customers across market.
You will support tendering activities of Distribution Transformer Factory in Egypt play a pivotal role in ensuring seamless bid submission and order booking. Work location will be based out of Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
Your Responsibilities
Product Marketing Management: Supports the product marketing organization/customer in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions. Formulates competitive bids/estimates/quotations, taking into account best available oil/ dry type transformer product mix and appropriate technical and commercial considerations for each individual situation. Ensures tenders are well documented in a timely manner and with appropriate level of detail, including full and accurate costs.
Offer Preparation - Manages the preparation of all technical (e.g. defining the most suitable technology and product type(s)), financial (e.g. total price sheet, cash flow analysis) and if necessary project management (e.g. quantifies hours of engineering and commissioning) aspects of the bid/estimate/quotation, indicating prices and trading conditions.
Order booking and SFDC Support: Customer creation/Change, Customer credit request, Order booking basing on ERP work as well as SFDC data input/configuration
Risk - Identifies potential risks in the bids, quotations and estimates, and in any related contract agreements across customers/channels. Provides information and/or participates in the Risk Review process in accordance with policy.
Documentation - Collects and archives documentation regarding the offer/order and records assumptions and decisions taken during the development process. Regularly reports the status of the bids/estimates/quotations using defined tools and collects and analyses the reasons for tenders being lost and won.
Health, safety and environment (HSE) - Ensures the project follows and complies with company health, safety, and environmental policies


Your Background
Bachelor's degree in engineering, with 2 plus years of professional experience in Distribution Transformer Tendering or Front End Sales.
Familiarity with Microsoft Excel, Word
Prociency in English language.
Preferred who have worked in sizable and well-structured organization

Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.

Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.

Location: Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata
Must have skills: GCC / GBS Strategy, Functional Operating Model Design, Shared Services Design, Sourcing & Location Strategy, Business Case Formulation, Functional Transformation such as Finance Process Transformation (O2C / P2P / R2R / FP&A)
Good to have skills: Multi-function GBS, Transition & Migration Management, Service Management & SLA Design, Agentic AI in functions, Data Visualization Tools
Experience: 12-15 years
Educational Qualification: MBA from Tier-1 Institute or CA / CPA
Job Summary:
Manage defined workstreams within GBS / GCC and operating model transformation engagements, taking responsibility for structuring the approach, shaping the analysis, and delivering high-quality outputs within agreed timelines
Own and lead projects - guiding team, reviewing outputs, and ensuring coherence across deliverables at the workstream level
Manage client presentations, workshop materials, and proposal sections independently, contributing actively to client discussions and working sessions
Develop business cases, cost analyses, value realization frameworks, and supporting models for GBS / SSC setup and transformation assignments
Apply a process and operating-model perspective across GBS design, governance, KPI and maturity frameworks, and emerging areas such as Gen AI-enabled processes
Lead business development efforts through research, pitch preparation, and proposal development
Excel as a long-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends
Roles & Responsibilities:
GBS / GCC Strategy and Setup: Lead analysis of operating model options (centralized, federated, hybrid) and build-operate setup models, location and sourcing strategy, GBS guiding principles, and process taxonomy (L0-L5) design for new and scaling shared services
Operating Model Design: Design integrated operating models for GBS / GCC setups, including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition, knowledge-transfer, and stabilization planning considerations independently
Operating Model: Manage the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of the Operating Model by analyzing processes, roles, governance, and performance metrics to enable efficient service delivery
Cost Analysis and Value Realization: Lead analysis and detailed cost model development covering setup costs, run-rate costs, and total cost of ownership for GBS and transformation scenarios; build value realization frameworks that track benefit and savings delivery against investment over time, incorporating productivity, quality, and strategic value levers
Org Design and Sizing: Design organization structures for the GBS / SSC and retained teams - roles, spans and layers, reporting lines, and FTE sizing methodologies
SSC Location Strategy: Lead location assessment and selection studies across cost, talent availability, risk, and scalability dimensions to recommend best-fit delivery locations for shared services
KPI and Performance Frameworks: Design KPI and SLA frameworks for GBS performance management, covering operational, financial, service, and experience metrics; develop dashboards and reporting cadences aligned to governance structures
Capability Maturity Assessment: Conduct structured maturity assessments across functions and processes against leading-practice benchmarks; translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines
Governance, RACI and Interaction Model Design: Design governance frameworks (councils, decision rights, escalation paths), RACI matrices, and interaction models defining roles and collaboration patterns between the GBS, retained organization, business units, and third-party providers
Operating Model Design: Design integrated operating models for GBS / GCC setups, including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition, knowledge-transfer, and stabilization planning considerations
Gen AI in Functions: Contribute to assessments and recommendations on Gen AI and intelligent automation use cases across functional processes - such as AP invoice processing, reconciliations, close acceleration, and management reporting


Qualification
Professional & Technical Skills:
12-15 years of total experience in GBS consulting, operating model, functional transformation, or advisory, or in-house shared services; experience at a top-tier or Big 4 firm preferred
Experience leading workstreams in GBS / GCC design, functional operating model, or shared services engagements
Working knowledge of at least 2-3 of the following: GBS / GCC / SSC setup, operating model design, sourcing & location strategy, org design & sizing, process maturity assessment, governance & interaction model design
Ability to build and interpret cost models, TCO analyses, and value realization frameworks and GBS transformation contexts
Experience designing KPI and SLA frameworks and performance measurement structures; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches - capability, process, or operating-model maturity - and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
Familiarity with core functional processes and process taxonomy frameworks such as the L0-L5 process hierarchy
Understanding of ERP and digital technologies (e.g. SAP S/4HANA, Oracle) and automation tools such as RPA and process mining
Awareness of Gen AI adoption in one or more functions including intelligent automation use cases and their implications for GBS process and workforce design
Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills
Additional Information:
Opportunity to work on GBS / GCC and operating model programs for marquee G2000 clients across industries
Exposure to senior stakeholder engagements and client-facing responsibilities as part of high-performing delivery teams
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you like, where youll be supported and inspired bya collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine whats possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations


Your Role

We are looking for experienced Guidewire professionals with strong hands-on expertise across Billing Center and Guidewire Integrations to design, configure, customize, and support scalable solutions for Property Casualty insurance clients. The role involves working across the Guidewire Insurance Suite ecosystem to enable seamless policy administration, claims management, billing operations, and system integrations.
Design, develop, configure, and maintain Guidewire applications across Billing Center, and Integration modules.
Customize Guidewire components using Gosu, Java, Guidewire Studio, and configuration tools.
Configure and enhance Billing Center workflows such as invoices, payments, write-offs, adjustments, refunds, delinquency processes, commissions, payment allocation, and GL postings.
Design and build integrations using the Guidewire Integration Framework, including plugins, messaging, web services, batch processes, event triggers, and data exchange pipelines.
Develop and maintain SOAP/REST APIs, XML/XSD-based data exchanges, JSON structures, messaging components, and integration interfaces.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Perform unit testing, support QA/UAT phases, troubleshoot application and integration issues, and assist in production deployments.
Participate in code reviews, Agile ceremonies, documentation, and development best practices to ensure quality and delivery excellence.

Your Profile
6+ years of experience in software development, with strong hands-on exposure to Guidewire Insurance Suite applications.
Strong experience in one or more Guidewire module:Billing Center and Billing guidewire Integrations.
Proficiency in Gosu, Java, XML, JSON, XSD, SQL, SOAP/REST Web Services, and Guidewire configuration tools.
Good understanding of Property Casualty insurance domain processes across billing and integration landscapes.
Hands-on experience with Guidewire data models, workflows, rules engine, plugins, messaging, batch processes, and web services.
Experience integrating Guidewire applications with Billing Center, comp raters, payment gateways, document systems, accounting platforms, customer portals, and other external systems.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
[Job Descri...C CC Integ | Word]
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools, Git, Jenkins, Maven, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Guidewire Cloud is preferred.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
Guidewire certification in BillingCenter is preferred.

What you will love about working here
Opportunity to work on large-scale Guidewire InsuranceSuite transformation programs for global PC insurance clients.
Exposure to end-to-end insurance technology delivery across policy, claims, billing, and integration platforms.
Hands-on experience with modern engineering practices including Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevOps, cloud, and integration-led architecture.
Structured learning, certifications, and continuous upskilling opportunities in insurance platforms and emerging technologies.
A collaborative and inclusive culture focused on innovation, delivery excellence, and client value.

We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of 22.5 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

Description:
Responsibility
Define automation architecture, standards, and best practices across testing initiatives.
Design, develop and maintain reusable automation framework modules and libraries.
Enable shift-left testing practices and continuous quality validation.
Analyze technical requirements and design effective test scenarios from a customer-centric perspective.
Perform UI and API automation using modern tools and frameworks.
Contribute to contract testing activities to validate Web service interactions and integrations.
Continuously improve automation practices by applying standards, best practices, and clean coding principles.
Perform test design and Code reviews.
Review peer work, including test cases, automation code, and related test artifacts, ensuring quality and adherence to standards.
Ability to design, develop and maintain frameworks independently
Ability to integrate, execute, monitor and troubleshoot automation pipelines
Ability to independently investigate failures, manage deliverables and guide other engineers
Investigate failures, support debugging, and assist in resolving automation and product issues.
Identify, monitor, and handle the dependencies and risks.
Raise technical challenges, dependencies, and risks related to assigned work modules in a timely manner to stakeholders.
Prepare estimations and work breakdown for assigned modules and communicate them to the lead.
Collaborate with peers, developers, product owners, and stakeholders to ensure quality delivery across the product lifecycle.
Collaborate with project stakeholders across time zones.
Support junior team members through technical guidance, code walkthroughs, and collaborative problem-solving.
Maintain test documentation, execution evidence, and related quality records.
Qualifications : Bachelors degree in Computer Science and Engineering or any related field.
Graduates with Software Testing background (With Python knowledge)
Experience: 7 to 10 years of experience in testing domain, with a minimum of 5 years in test automation (predominantly Python).
Required skills:
Proficient in understanding and analyzing the requirements.
Good test design skills and an affinity for quality required by a tester.
Capability and experience in developing and executing Test Cases.
Expert proficiency in Python, including OOPs concepts, design patterns, and clean coding principles.
Practical experience with REST APIs, gRPC, PyTest and UI automation
Hands on experience with Custom Test automation frameworks design and implementation.
Prior experience in maintaining or extending Test automation frameworks modules / libraries.
Proficient in unit testing with frameworks like PyTest.
Experience in model-based, context-driven.
Hands-on experience with REST API and gRPC interfaces with Python.
Experience in SQLAlchemy (object-relational mapper for Python).
Database design (preferably PostgreSQL) and understanding of databases and services
Experience in web application development using Vue.js and FastAPI.
Strong exposure to Python static code analysis tools
Must have hands-on experience in Git, CI/CD pipelines.
Must have hands-on experience in Dockers and containerized environments
Experience in any ALM tools, preferably MS Azure DevOps.
Willingness to work in an international team across time zones, preferably has prior experience collaborating with international teams
Fluent in English (oral and written)

Nice to have skills:
Hands on experience with Squish and UI automation for QT/QML.
Knowledge on Linux.
Knowledge on C++, QT/QML modules
ISTQB Certified or equivalent experience in Embedded system testing.
Experience on instrument firmware testing is a plus.
Knowledge of Analytical chemistry / Laboratory domain

Role & responsibilities

Manager Software (Full-time)
As Manager - Software Development, for our division in Coimbatore or Bangalore, India you will act as a
Technical Delivery Manager and lead a team of experienced engineers in supporting the Research &
Development in software design and development projects.
In your role as a Manager - Software, you will have the opportunity to:
Understand stakeholders needs and priorities for software program development and delivery.
Prioritize work across projects and manage the project portfolio.
Apply entrepreneurial thinking and be the single point of contact for the project portfolio.
Create sense of ownership, quality in the team and enable program deliveries.
Achieve cost, time and quality goals defined for project portfolio.
Be accountable for managing all aspects of risk, issues, and dependencies in the portfolio.
Measure and improve project(s) performance indicators using appropriate tools and techniques.
Demonstrate strong people management and leadership skills.
Build and manage a team of high-performing engineers.
Ensure schedule and quality commitments are met.
Attract, retain, and build top-notch engineering, technical and functional talent.
Lead and mentor team through complex customer requirement implementations.
Enable continuous learning and improvement by practicing Lean management and agile principles.
Demonstrate strong leadership, communication and coaching skills.
Work closely with stakeholders including Business / Product Owners, Development, and Management
teams.
Emphasize engineering best practices, delivering value, and data driven decision making.
Focus on delivering business value from the overall program.
